## Bank Act {#bank-act .Title-of-Act}

[S.C.]{.abbr title="Statutes of Canada"} 1991, c. 46
:::

Assented to 1991-12-13

An Act respecting banks and banking
::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: section
::: {.section .order}
###### Preamble {#preamble .MarginalNote}

Whereas a strong and efficient banking sector is essential to economic
growth and prosperity;

Whereas a legislative framework that enables banks to compete
effectively and be resilient in a rapidly evolving marketplace, taking
into account the rights and interests of depositors and other consumers
of banking services, contributes to stability and public confidence in
the financial system and is important to the strength and security of
the national economy;

And whereas it is desirable and is in the national interest to provide
for clear, comprehensive, exclusive, national standards applicable to
banking products and banking services offered by banks;
:::

:::: Enacts
Her Majesty, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate and House
of Commons of Canada, enacts as follows:

::: HistoricalNote
- 2012, c. 19, s. 525
:::
::::

## [Short Title]{.HTitleText1} {#h-10042 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Short title

**[[1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1 .sectionLabel}** This Act may be cited as
the [Bank Act](/eng/acts/B-1.01).

## [PART I]{.HLabel1}[Interpretation and Application]{.HTitleText1} {#h-10045 .Part}

### [Definitions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-10046 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-2 .sectionLabel}** In this Act,

[[affairs]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[affairs]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, with respect to a bank, an
    authorized foreign bank or a bank holding company, means the
    relationships among the bank, authorized foreign bank or bank
    holding company and its affiliates and the shareholders, members,
    directors and officers of the bank, authorized foreign bank or bank
    holding company and its affiliates, but does not include the
    business of the bank, authorized foreign bank or bank holding
    company or any of its affiliates; ([affaires
    internes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[affiliate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[affiliate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an entity that is affiliated
    with another entity within the meaning of section
    6; ([groupe]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Agency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Agency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Financial Consumer Agency
    of Canada established under section 3 of the [Financial Consumer
    Agency of Canada Act](/eng/acts/F-11.1); ([Agence]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[annual return]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[annual return]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a return prepared in
    accordance with section 601; ([état annuel]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[annual statement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[annual statement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a bank,
    means the annual financial statement of the bank within the meaning
    of paragraph 308(1)(a) and, in relation to a bank holding company,
    means the annual financial statement of the bank holding company
    within the meaning of paragraph 840(1)(a); ([rapport
    annuel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[authorized foreign bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[authorized foreign bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a foreign bank
    that is the subject of an order under subsection 524(1); ([banque
    étrangère autorisée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a bank listed in Schedule I or
    II; ([banque]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[bank holding company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[bank holding company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a body corporate
    that is incorporated or formed under Part XV; ([société de
    portefeuille bancaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[bearer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[bearer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a security, means the
    person in possession of a security payable to bearer or endorsed in
    blank; ([porteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[bearer form]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[bearer form]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a security, means
    a security in bearer form as determined in accordance with
    subsection 83(2); ([titre au porteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[beneficial ownership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[beneficial ownership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes ownership
    through one or more trustees, legal representatives, agents or other
    intermediaries; ([véritable propriétaire]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"} et [propriété effective]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[body corporate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[body corporate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an incorporated body
    wherever or however incorporated; ([personne
    morale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[branch]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[branch]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a bank, means an agency, the head
      office or any other office of the bank, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an authorized foreign bank, means
      an agency, the principal office or any other office of the
      authorized foreign bank in Canada at which is carried on the
      business in Canada of the authorized foreign
      bank; ([succursale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Canadian entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Canadian entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an entity that is
    incorporated or formed by or under an Act of Parliament or of the
    legislature of a province, or otherwise formed in Canada, and that
    carries on business in Canada; ([entité canadienne]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[Canadian financial institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Canadian financial institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    financial institution that is incorporated or formed by or under an
    Act of Parliament or of the legislature of a province; ([institution
    financière canadienne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[central cooperative credit society]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[central cooperative credit society]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    body corporate organized on cooperative principles by or under an
    Act of the legislature of a province, one of whose principal
    purposes is to receive deposits from and provide liquidity support
    to local cooperative credit societies, and

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} whose membership consists solely or primarily of
      local cooperative credit societies, or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} whose directors are wholly or primarily persons
      elected or appointed by local cooperative credit
      societies; ([société coopérative de crédit
      centrale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[central securities register]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[central securities register]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[securities
    register]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a bank, means the
    register referred to in section 248 and, in relation to a bank
    holding company, means the register referred to in section
    825; ([registre central des valeurs mobilières]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"} ou [registre des valeurs mobilières]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[Commissioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Commissioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Commissioner of the
    Financial Consumer Agency of Canada appointed under section 4 of the
    [Financial Consumer Agency of Canada
    Act](/eng/acts/F-11.1); ([commissaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[common-law partner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[common-law partner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to an
    individual, means a person who is cohabiting with the individual in
    a conjugal relationship, having so cohabited for a period of at
    least one year; ([conjoint de fait]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[complainant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[complainant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a bank or any
    matter concerning a bank, means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a registered holder or beneficial owner, and a
      former registered holder or beneficial owner, of a security of a
      bank or any of its affiliates,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a director or an officer, or a former director or
      officer, of a bank or any of its affiliates,

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any other person who, in the discretion of a
      court, is a proper person to make an application under section
      334, 338 or 989, or

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a member or a former member of a federal credit
      union; ([plaignant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[consumer provision]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[consumer provision]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a provision
    referred to in paragraph (a) or (a.1) of the definition [[consumer
    provision]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in section 2 of the [Financial
    Consumer Agency of Canada Act](/eng/acts/F-11.1); ([disposition
    visant les consommateurs]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[court]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[court]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the Province of Ontario, the Superior Court of
      Justice,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the Province of Quebec, the Superior Court of
      the Province,

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the Provinces of Nova Scotia, British Columbia
      and Prince Edward Island, the Supreme Court of the Province,

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the Provinces of New Brunswick, Manitoba,
      Saskatchewan and Alberta, the Court of Queen's Bench for the
      Province,

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} in the Province of Newfoundland and Labrador, the
      Trial Division of the Supreme Court of the Province, and

    - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the Supreme Court of Yukon, the Supreme Court of
      the Northwest Territories and the Nunavut Court of
      Justice; ([tribunal]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[court of appeal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[court of appeal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the court to which an
    appeal lies from a decision or order of a court; ([cour
    d'appel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[debt obligation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[debt obligation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a bond, debenture,
    note or other evidence of indebtedness of an entity, whether secured
    or unsecured; ([titre de créance]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[delegate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[delegate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a natural person appointed or
    elected to represent a member of a federal credit union at a meeting
    of members; ([délégué]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[director]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[director]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a natural person occupying
    the position of director, by whatever name called, of a body
    corporate, and [[board of directors]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or
    [[directors]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} refers to the directors of a body
    corporate as a body; ([administrateur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"},
    [conseil d'administration]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
    [conseil]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[domestic systemically important bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[domestic systemically important bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    bank that is designated as a domestic systemically important bank
    under section 484.1; ([banque d'importance systémique
    nationale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a body corporate, trust,
    partnership, fund, an unincorporated association or organization,
    Her Majesty in right of Canada or of a province, an agency of Her
    Majesty in either of such rights and the government of a foreign
    country or any political subdivision thereof and any agency
    thereof; ([entité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[equity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[equity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a bank or a bank
    holding company, means its equity as determined in accordance with
    the regulations; ([capitaux propres]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[external complaints body]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[external complaints body]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the body
    corporate designated under subsection 627.48(1); ([organisme externe
    de traitement des plaintes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[federal credit union]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[federal credit union]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a bank that,
    within the meaning of section 12.1, is organized and carries on
    business on a cooperative basis; ([coopérative de crédit
    fédérale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[federal financial institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[federal financial institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a bank,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate to which the [Trust and Loan
      Companies Act](/eng/acts/T-19.8) applies,

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an association to which the [Cooperative Credit
      Associations Act](/eng/acts/C-41.01) applies, or

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an insurance company or a fraternal benefit
      society incorporated or formed under the [Insurance Companies
      Act](/eng/acts/I-11.8); ([institution financière
      fédérale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[federation of cooperative credit societies]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[federation of cooperative credit
    societies]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an association under the
    [Cooperative Credit Associations Act](/eng/acts/C-41.01) or a
    federation, league or corporation incorporated or organized by or
    under an Act of the legislature of a province, the membership or the
    shareholders of which include two or more central cooperative credit
    societies; ([fédération de sociétés coopératives de
    crédit]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[fiduciary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[fiduciary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any person acting in a
    fiduciary capacity and includes a personal representative of a
    deceased person; ([représentant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[financial institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[financial institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a bank or an authorized foreign bank,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate to which the [Trust and Loan
      Companies Act](/eng/acts/T-19.8) applies,

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an association to which the [Cooperative Credit
      Associations Act](/eng/acts/C-41.01) applies,

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an insurance company or a fraternal benefit
      society incorporated or formed under the [Insurance Companies
      Act](/eng/acts/I-11.8),

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a trust, loan or insurance corporation
      incorporated by or under an Act of the legislature of a province,

    - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a cooperative credit society incorporated and
      regulated by or under an Act of the legislature of a province,

    - [(g)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is incorporated or formed by or
      under an Act of Parliament or of the legislature of a province and
      that is primarily engaged in dealing in securities, including
      portfolio management and investment counselling, and

    - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a foreign institution; ([institution
      financière]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[foreign bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[foreign bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, subject to section 12, means
    an entity incorporated or formed by or under the laws of a country
    other than Canada that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is a bank according to the laws of any foreign
      country where it carries on business,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} carries on a business in any foreign country
      that, if carried on in Canada, would be, wholly or to a
      significant extent, the business of banking,

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} engages, directly or indirectly, in the business
      of providing financial services and employs, to identify or
      describe its business, a name that includes the word "bank",
      "[banque]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", "banking" or
      "[bancaire]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", either alone or in combination
      with other words, or any word or words in any language other than
      English or French corresponding generally thereto,

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} engages in the business of lending money and
      accepting deposit liabilities transferable by cheque or other
      instrument,

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} engages, directly or indirectly, in the business
      of providing financial services and is affiliated with another
      foreign bank,

    - [(f)]{.lawlabel} controls another foreign bank, or

    - [(g)]{.lawlabel} is a foreign institution, other than a foreign
      bank within the meaning of any of paragraphs (a) to (f), that
      controls a bank incorporated or formed under this Act,

    but does not include a subsidiary of a bank named in Schedule I as
    that Schedule read immediately before the day section 184 of the
    [Financial Consumer Agency of Canada Act](/eng/acts/F-11.1) comes
    into force, unless the Minister has specified that subsection 378(1)
    no longer applies to the bank; ([banque étrangère]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[foreign bank subsidiary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[foreign bank subsidiary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2001, c.
    9, s. 35\]]{.Repealed}

[[foreign institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[foreign institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an entity that is

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} engaged in the business of banking, the trust,
      loan or insurance business, the business of a cooperative credit
      society or the business of dealing in securities or is otherwise
      engaged primarily in the business of providing financial services,
      and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} incorporated or formed otherwise than by or under
      an Act of Parliament or of the legislature of a
      province; ([institution étrangère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[form of proxy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[form of proxy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a written or printed
    form that, when completed and executed by or on behalf of a
    shareholder, constitutes a proxy; ([formulaire de
    procuration]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[going-private transaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[going-private transaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    going-private transaction as defined in the
    regulations; ([transaction de fermeture]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[guarantee]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[guarantee]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes a letter of
    credit; ([garantie]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[head office]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[head office]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a bank, means
    the office required to be maintained under section 237 and, in
    relation to a bank holding company, means the office required to be
    maintained under section 814; ([siège]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[holder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[holder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a security certificate, the person
      in possession of the certificate issued or endorsed to that person
      or to bearer or in blank,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of the ownership of a share, the
      shareholder of the share within the meaning of section 7, and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in respect of the ownership of a membership
      share, the member who holds the membership share within the
      meaning of section 7.1; ([détenteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[holding body corporate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[holding body corporate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a holding body
    corporate within the meaning of section 4; ([société
    mère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[incorporated]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[incorporated]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, when used with reference to a
    body corporate that is incorporated by or under an Act of Parliament
    or of the legislature of a province, also refers to a body corporate
    that is continued by or under any such Act; ([constitué en personne
    morale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[incorporating instrument]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[incorporating instrument]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the special
    Act, letters patent, instrument of continuance or other constating
    instrument by which a body corporate was incorporated or continued
    and includes any amendment to or restatement of the constating
    instrument; ([acte constitutif]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[incorporator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[incorporator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a bank or a
    bank holding company, means a person who applied for letters patent
    to incorporate the bank or bank holding company, as the case may
    be; ([fondateur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[insurance holding company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[insurance holding company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a body
    corporate that is incorporated or formed under Part XVII of the
    [Insurance Companies Act](/eng/acts/I-11.8); ([société de
    portefeuille d'assurances]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[issuer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[issuer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a security, means the
    entity that issues or issued the
    security; ([émetteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[letters patent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[letters patent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an instrument
    authorized to be issued under this Act, means letters patent in a
    form approved by the Superintendent; ([lettres
    patentes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[local cooperative credit society]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[local cooperative credit society]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    body corporate organized on cooperative principles incorporated by
    or under an Act of the legislature of a province

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} whose members or shareholders consist
      substantially of natural persons, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} whose principal purpose is to receive deposits
      from and make loans to its members and shareholders; ([société
      coopérative de crédit locale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[member]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[member]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a federal credit
    union, means a person who is one of the members of the federal
    credit union in accordance with subsection
    47.04(2); ([membre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[membership share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[membership share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a federal
    credit union, means an ownership interest in the federal credit
    union that confers the rights referred to in subsection
    79.1(1); ([parts sociales]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[members register]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[members register]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a federal
    credit union, means the register referred to in section
    254.1; ([registre des membres]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Minister]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Minister]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Minister of
    Finance; ([ministre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[minor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[minor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in the
    applicable provincial law and in the absence of any such law has the
    same meaning as the word [[child]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in the
    United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child adopted in the
    United Nations General Assembly on November 20,
    1989; ([mineur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[NAFTA country resident]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[NAFTA country resident]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 1999, c.
    28, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

[[non-WTO Member foreign bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[non-WTO Member foreign bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a foreign
    bank that is not controlled by a WTO Member resident; ([banque
    étrangère d'un non-membre de l'OMC]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in relation to a body corporate, a chief
      executive officer, president, vice-president, secretary,
      controller, treasurer and any other natural person designated as
      an officer of the body corporate by by-law or by resolution of the
      directors of the body corporate, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in relation to any other entity, any natural
      person designated as an officer of the entity by by-law, by
      resolution of the members thereof or
      otherwise; ([dirigeant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[order form]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[order form]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a security, means
    a security in order form as determined in accordance with subsection
    83(3); ([titre à ordre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ordinary resolution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ordinary resolution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a resolution
    passed by a majority of the votes cast in respect of that
    resolution; ([résolution ordinaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[patronage allocation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[patronage allocation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an amount that a
    federal credit union allocates among its members based on the
    business done by them with or through the federal credit
    union; ([ristourne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[person]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[person]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a natural person, an entity or
    a personal representative; ([personne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[personal representative]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[personal representative]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who
    stands in place of and represents another person and, without
    limiting the generality of the foregoing, includes, as the
    circumstances require, a trustee, an executor, an administrator, a
    committee, a guardian, a tutor, a curator, an assignee, a receiver,
    an agent or an attorney of any person, but does not include a
    delegate; ([représentant personnel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[prescribed]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[prescribed]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means prescribed by
    regulation; ([Version anglaise seulement]{.DefinitionOtherLangOnly})

[[principal office]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[principal office]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in relation to an
    authorized foreign bank, the office required to be maintained under
    section 535; ([bureau principal]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[principal officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[principal officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in relation to an
    authorized foreign bank means the person appointed under section
    536; ([dirigeant principal]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[proxy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[proxy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a completed and executed form of
    proxy by means of which a shareholder appoints a proxyholder to
    attend and act on the shareholder's behalf at a meeting of
    shareholders; ([procuration]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[proxyholder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[proxyholder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the person appointed by
    proxy to attend and act on behalf of a shareholder at a meeting of
    shareholders; ([fondé de pouvoir]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[real property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[real property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes a leasehold interest
    in real property; ([biens immeubles]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[recorded address]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[recorded address]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in relation to a person who is a shareholder of a
      bank or a bank holding company, the latest postal address of the
      person according to its central securities register,

    - [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} in relation to a person who is a member of a
      federal credit union, the latest postal address of the person
      according to the members register, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in relation to a person in any other respect in
      relation to a bank, the latest postal address of the person
      according to the records of the branch concerned; ([adresse
      enregistrée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[registered form]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[registered form]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a security,
    means a security in registered form as determined in accordance with
    subsection 83(4); ([titre nominatif]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[regulated foreign entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[regulated foreign entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an entity
    that is

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} incorporated or formed otherwise in a country or
      territory, other than Canada, in which a trade agreement listed in
      Schedule IV is applicable, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subject to financial services regulation in that
      country or territory; ([entité étrangère
      réglementée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[regulatory capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[regulatory capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a bank or
    a bank holding company, has the meaning given that expression by the
    regulations; ([capital réglementaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[resident Canadian]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[resident Canadian]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a natural person who
    is

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian citizen ordinarily resident in Canada,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian citizen not ordinarily resident in
      Canada who is a member of a prescribed class of persons, or

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a permanent resident within the meaning of
      subsection 2(1) of the [Immigration and Refugee Protection
      Act](/eng/acts/I-2.5) and ordinarily resident in Canada, except a
      permanent resident who has been ordinarily resident in Canada for
      more than one year after the time at which the individual first
      became eligible to apply for Canadian citizenship; ([résident
      canadien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[residential property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[residential property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means real property
    consisting of buildings that are used, or are to be used, to the
    extent of at least one half of the floor space thereof, as one or
    more private dwellings; ([immeuble résidentiel]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[securities underwriter]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[securities underwriter]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who,
    as principal, agrees to purchase securities with a view to the
    distribution of the securities or who, as agent for a body corporate
    or other person, offers for sale or sells securities in connection
    with a distribution of the securities, and includes a person who
    participates, directly or indirectly, in a distribution of
    securities, other than a person whose interest in the distribution
    of securities is limited to receiving a distributor's or seller's
    commission payable by a securities underwriter; ([souscripteur à
    forfait]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[security]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[security]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in relation to a body corporate, a share of any
      class of shares of the body corporate or a debt obligation of the
      body corporate, and includes a warrant of the body corporate, but
      does not include a deposit with a financial institution or any
      instrument evidencing such a deposit or, for greater certainty, a
      membership share, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in relation to any other entity, any ownership
      interest in or debt obligation of the
      entity; ([titre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [valeur
      mobilière]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[security interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[security interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an interest in or
    charge on property by way of mortgage, lien, pledge or otherwise
    taken by a creditor or guarantor to secure the payment or
    performance of an obligation; ([sûreté]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[send]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[send]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes
    deliver; ([envoyer]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[series]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[series]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of shares, means a
    division of a class of shares; ([série]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} does not include a membership
    share; ([Version anglaise seulement]{.DefinitionOtherLangOnly})

[[significant interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[significant interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a significant
    interest determined in accordance with section 8; ([intérêt
    substantiel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[special resolution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[special resolution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a resolution passed
    by a majority of not less than two thirds of the votes cast in
    respect of that resolution or signed by all the persons who are
    entitled to vote on that resolution; ([résolution
    extraordinaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[squeeze-out transaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[squeeze-out transaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a transaction
    by a bank that is not a distributing bank, or a bank holding company
    that is not a distributing bank holding company, that requires an
    amendment to a by-law referred to in subsection 217(1) and that
    would directly or indirectly result in the interest of a holder of
    shares of a class of shares being terminated without their consent
    and without substituting an interest of equivalent value in shares
    that are issued by the following persons and have rights and
    privileges equal to or greater than those of the shares of the
    affected class:

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a bank, the bank, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a bank holding company, the bank
      holding company; ([transaction d'éviction]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

[[subordinated indebtedness]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[subordinated indebtedness]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
    instrument evidencing an indebtedness of a bank that by its terms
    provides that the indebtedness will, in the event of the insolvency
    or winding-up of the bank, be subordinate in right of payment to all
    deposit liabilities of the bank and all other liabilities of the
    bank except those that, by their terms, rank equally with or are
    subordinate to such indebtedness; ([titre
    secondaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[subsidiary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[subsidiary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an entity that is a
    subsidiary of another entity as defined in section
    5; ([filiale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[substantial investment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[substantial investment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a substantial
    investment determined in accordance with section 10; ([intérêt de
    groupe financier]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Superintendent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Superintendent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Superintendent of
    Financial Institutions appointed pursuant to the [Office of the
    Superintendent of Financial Institutions
    Act](/eng/acts/O-2.7); ([surintendant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[trade]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[trade]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of securities, means any
    sale or disposition of securities for valuable
    consideration; ([opération]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[transfer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[transfer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of securities, includes
    a transmission by operation of law; ([transfert]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[voting share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[voting share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a share of any class of
    shares of a body corporate carrying voting rights under all
    circumstances or by reason of an event that has occurred and is
    continuing or by reason of a condition that has been
    fulfilled; ([action avec droit de vote]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[WTO Member resident]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[WTO Member resident]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a WTO Member
    resident within the meaning of section 11.1. ([résident d'un membre
    de l'OMC]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-10196 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}References to "authorized foreign bank"

**[[2.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-2.1 .sectionLabel}** References in this Act
to the carrying on of business in Canada by an authorized foreign bank
and to the business in Canada of an authorized foreign bank are deemed,
respectively, to be references to the carrying on of business in Canada,
or to business in Canada, under Part XII.1.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 2
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Major shareholder

**[[2.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-2.2 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
this Act, a person is a major shareholder of a body corporate if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of the shares of any class of voting
  shares of the body corporate that are beneficially owned by the person
  and that are beneficially owned by any entities controlled by the
  person is more than 20 per cent of the outstanding shares of that
  class of voting shares of the body corporate; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of the shares of any class of
  non-voting shares of the body corporate that are beneficially owned by
  the person and that are beneficially owned by any entities controlled
  by the person is more than 30 per cent of the outstanding shares of
  that class of non-voting shares of the body corporate.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 36
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Widely held

**[[2.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-2.3 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
this Act, an entity is widely held if it is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate that has no major shareholder;

- [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} a federal credit union;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} an insurance company incorporated or formed under a
  mutual plan;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} an association to which the [Cooperative Credit
  Associations Act](/eng/acts/C-41.01) applies; or

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a cooperative credit society incorporated or formed,
  and regulated, by or under an Act of the legislature of a province.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 36
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1895
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-2.3-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 2.3"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations --- distributing bank or bank
holding company

- **[[2.4]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-2.4 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  Governor in Council may make regulations respecting the determination
  of what constitutes a distributing bank or distributing bank holding
  company for the purposes of this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption --- bank or bank holding
  company

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On the application of a bank or bank holding company,
  the Superintendent may determine that it is not or was not a
  distributing bank or distributing bank holding company, as the case
  may be, if the Superintendent is satisfied that the determination
  would not prejudice any security holder of that bank or bank holding
  company or any holder of a membership share of that bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption --- class of banks or bank
  holding companies

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may determine that members of a
  class of banks or bank holding companies are not or were not
  distributing banks or distributing bank holding companies, as the case
  may be, if the Superintendent is satisfied that the determination
  would not prejudice any security holder of a member of the class or
  any holder of a membership share of a bank that is a member of the
  class.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2005, c. 54, s. 2
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1896
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-2.4-20061128.html "Link to previous version of section 2.4"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Control

- **[[3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-3 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the
  purposes of this Act,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a person controls a body corporate if securities of
    the body corporate to which are attached more than 50 per cent of
    the votes that may be cast to elect directors of the body corporate
    are beneficially owned by the person and the votes attached to those
    securities are sufficient, if exercised, to elect a majority of the
    directors of the body corporate;

  - [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} a person controls a federal credit union if the
    person and all of the entities controlled by the person have the
    right to exercise more than 50 per cent of the votes that may be
    cast at an annual meeting or to elect the majority of the directors
    of the federal credit union;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a person controls an unincorporated entity, other
    than a limited partnership, if more than 50 per cent of the
    ownership interests, however designated, into which the entity is
    divided are beneficially owned by that person and the person is able
    to direct the business and affairs of the entity;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the general partner of a limited partnership
    controls the limited partnership; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a person controls an entity if the person has any
    direct or indirect influence that, if exercised, would result in
    control in fact of the entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed control

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person who controls an entity is deemed to control
  any entity that is controlled, or deemed to be controlled, by the
  entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed control

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A person is deemed to control, within the meaning of
  paragraph (1)(a) or (b), an entity if the aggregate of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any securities of the entity that are beneficially
    owned by that person, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any securities of the entity that are beneficially
    owned by any entity controlled by that person

  is such that, if that person and all of the entities referred to in
  paragraph (b) that beneficially own securities of the entity were one
  person, that person would control the entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Guidelines

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, for any purpose of any provision of
  this Act that refers to control within the meaning of paragraph
  (1)(d), make guidelines respecting what constitutes such control,
  including guidelines describing the policy objectives that the
  guidelines and the relevant provisions of the Act are intended to
  achieve and, if any such guidelines are made, the reference to
  paragraph (1)(d) in that provision shall be interpreted in accordance
  with the guidelines.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Guidelines --- federal credit union

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, for any purpose of any provision of
  this Act that refers to control within the meaning of paragraph
  (1)(d), make guidelines respecting what constitutes such control of a
  federal credit union, including guidelines describing the policy
  objectives that the guidelines and the relevant provisions of the Act
  are intended to achieve and, if any such guidelines are made, the
  reference to paragraph (1)(d) in that provision is to be interpreted
  in accordance with the guidelines.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 3
- 2001, c. 9, s. 37
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1897
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Holding body corporate

**[[4]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4 .sectionLabel}** A body corporate is the
holding body corporate of any entity that is its subsidiary.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 4
- 2001, c. 9, s. 38
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subsidiary

**[[5]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-5 .sectionLabel}** An entity is a subsidiary
of another entity if it is controlled by the other entity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 5
- 2001, c. 9, s. 38
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Affiliated entities

- **[[6]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-6 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} One
  entity is affiliated with another entity if one of them is controlled
  by the other or both are controlled by the same person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Affiliated entities

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), for the purposes of
  subsections 265(1) and 283(1), one entity is affiliated with another
  entity if one of them is controlled, determined without regard to
  paragraph 3(1)(d), by the other or both are controlled, determined
  without regard to paragraph 3(1)(d), by the same person.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 6
- 2001, c. 9, s. 39
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shareholder

- **[[7]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-7 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the
  purposes of this Act, a person is a shareholder of a body corporate
  when, according to the securities register of the body corporate, the
  person is the owner of one or more shares of the body corporate or is
  entitled to be entered in the securities register or like record of
  the body corporate as the owner of the share or shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Holder of a share

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A reference in this Act to the holding of a share by
  or in the name of any person is a reference to the fact that the
  person is registered or is entitled to be registered in the securities
  register or like record of the body corporate as the holder of that
  share.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Holder of membership share

- **[[7.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-7.1 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purposes of this Act, a person is a holder of a membership share
  of a federal credit union if the person is the owner of one or more
  membership shares according to the federal credit union's members
  register or is entitled to be entered in that register, or like record
  of the federal credit union, as the owner of one or more membership
  shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}References to holding membership share

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A reference in this Act to the holding of a
  membership share by or in the name of any person is a reference to the
  fact that the person is registered or is entitled to be registered in
  a federal credit union's members register, or like record of the
  federal credit union, as the holder of that membership share.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1898
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Significant interest

- **[[8]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-8 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person
  has a significant interest in a class of shares of a bank or a bank
  holding company if the aggregate of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any shares of that class beneficially owned by the
    person, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any shares of that class beneficially owned by
    entities controlled by the person

  exceeds 10 per cent of all of the outstanding shares of that class of
  shares of the bank or bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Significant interest --- membership
  shares

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} A person has a significant interest in the
  membership shares of a federal credit union if the aggregate of
  membership shares beneficially owned by the person and membership
  shares beneficially owned by entities controlled by the person exceeds
  10 per cent of all of the outstanding membership shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Increasing significant interest

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person who has a significant interest in a class of
  shares of a bank or bank holding company increases that significant
  interest in the class of shares if the person or any entity controlled
  by the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} acquires beneficial ownership of additional shares
    of that class, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} acquires control of any entity that beneficially
    owns shares of that class,

  in such number as to increase the percentage of shares of that class
  that are beneficially owned by the person and by any entities
  controlled by the person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Increasing significant interest ---
  membership shares

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A person who has a significant interest in the
  membership shares of a federal credit union increases that significant
  interest in the membership shares if the person or any entity
  controlled by the person acquires beneficial ownership of additional
  membership shares, or acquires control of any entity that beneficially
  owns membership shares, of the federal credit union in such number as
  to increase the percentage of membership shares that are beneficially
  owned by the person and by any entities controlled by the person.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 8
- 2001, c. 9, s. 40
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1899
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-8-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 8"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Acting in concert

- **[[9]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the
  purposes of Part VII and Division 7 of Part XV, if two or more persons
  have agreed, under any agreement, commitment or understanding, whether
  formal or informal, verbal or written, to act jointly or in concert in
  respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} shares of a bank or of a bank holding company that
    they beneficially own,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} shares or ownership interests that they
    beneficially own of any entity that beneficially owns shares of a
    bank or of a bank holding company, or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} shares or ownership interests that they
    beneficially own of any entity that controls any entity that
    beneficially owns shares of a bank or bank holding company,

  those persons are deemed to be a single person who is acquiring
  beneficial ownership of the aggregate number of shares of the bank or
  bank holding company or shares or ownership interests of the entity
  that are beneficially owned by them.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Acting in concert

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Without limiting the generality of subsection (1),
  any agreement, commitment or understanding by or between two or more
  persons who beneficially own shares of a bank or bank holding company
  or shares or ownership interests of any entity referred to in
  paragraph (1)(b) or (c),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} whereby any of them or their nominees may veto any
    proposal put before the board of directors of the bank or bank
    holding company, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} under which no proposal put before the board of
    directors of the bank or bank holding company may be approved except
    with the consent of any of them or their nominees,

  is deemed to be an agreement, commitment or understanding referred to
  in subsection (1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exceptions

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, persons shall be
  presumed not to have agreed to act jointly or in concert solely by
  reason of the fact that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} one is the proxyholder of one or more of the others
    in respect of shares or ownership interests referred to in
    subsection (1); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} they vote the voting rights attached to shares or
    ownership interests referred to in subsection (1) in the same
    manner.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Designation

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where in the opinion of the Superintendent it is
  reasonable to conclude that an agreement, commitment or understanding
  referred to in subsections (1) and (2) exists by or among two or more
  persons, the Superintendent may designate those persons as persons who
  have agreed to act jointly or in concert.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contravention

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A person contravenes a provision of Part VII or
  Division 7 of Part XV if the person agrees to act jointly or in
  concert with one or more other persons in such a manner that a deemed
  single person contravenes the provision.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 9
- 2001, c. 9, s. 41
- 2007, c. 6, s. 2
:::

Version](section-9-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 9"){.PITLink}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Acting in concert --- members' rights to
vote

- **[[9.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9.1 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purposes of Part VII, if two or more members have agreed, under
  any agreement, commitment or understanding, whether formal or
  informal, verbal or written, to act jointly or in concert in respect
  of the exercise of any right to vote at a meeting of members, those
  members are deemed to be a single member.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exceptions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, members are
  presumed not to have agreed to act jointly or in concert solely by
  reason of the fact that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} their membership voting rights are vested in the
    same delegate or delegates; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} they exercise their membership voting rights in the
    same manner.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Designation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If in the opinion of the Superintendent it is
  reasonable to conclude that an agreement, commitment or understanding
  referred to in subsection (1) exists by or among two or more members,
  the Superintendent may designate those members as members who have
  agreed to act jointly or in concert.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contravention

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A member contravenes a provision of Part VII if the
  member agrees to act jointly or in concert with one or more other
  members in such a manner that a deemed single member contravenes that
  provision.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1900
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Acting in concert --- shareholders and
members' right to vote

- **[[9.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9.2 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purposes of Part VII, if one or more members of a federal credit
  union and one or more shareholders of the federal credit union have
  agreed, under any agreement, commitment or understanding, whether
  formal or informal, verbal or written, to act jointly or in concert in
  respect of the exercise of their respective rights to vote, those
  persons are deemed to be a single person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exceptions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, persons are
  presumed not to have agreed to act jointly or in concert solely by
  reason of the fact that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} one or more of the members is the proxyholder of
    one or more of the shareholders;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} one or more of the shareholders is a delegate of
    one or more of the members; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} they exercise their respective voting rights in the
    same manner.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Designation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If in the opinion of the Superintendent it is
  reasonable to conclude that an agreement, commitment or understanding
  referred to in subsection (1) exists by or among one or more members
  and one or more shareholders, the Superintendent may designate those
  members and shareholders as persons who have agreed to act jointly or
  in concert.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contravention

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A shareholder or a member contravenes a provision of
  Part VII if the shareholder or member agrees to act jointly or in
  concert with one or more other shareholders or members in such a
  manner that a deemed single person contravenes that provision.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1900
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Substantial investment in body corporate

- **[[10]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-10 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  person has a substantial investment in a body corporate where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the voting rights attached to the aggregate of any
    voting shares of the body corporate beneficially owned by the person
    and by any entities controlled by the person exceed 10 per cent of
    the voting rights attached to all of the outstanding voting shares
    of the body corporate;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of any shares of the body corporate
    beneficially owned by the person and by any entities controlled by
    the person represents ownership of greater than 25 per cent of the
    shareholders' equity of the body corporate; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a body corporate that is a federal
    credit union,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the voting rights of the person and of entities
      controlled by the person exceed 10 per cent of the aggregate of
      the voting rights that may be exercised by members and
      shareholders, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of any shares and membership
      shares of the federal credit union beneficially owned by the
      person and by any entities controlled by the person represents
      ownership of greater than 25 per cent of the members' and
      shareholders' equity of the federal credit union.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Increasing substantial investment in
  body corporate

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person who has a substantial investment in a body
  corporate pursuant to paragraph (1)(a) increases that substantial
  investment when the person or any entity controlled by the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} acquires beneficial ownership of additional voting
    shares of the body corporate in such number as to increase the
    percentage of voting rights attached to the aggregate of the voting
    shares of the body corporate beneficially owned by the person and by
    any entities controlled by the person; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} acquires control of any entity that beneficially
    owns any voting shares of the body corporate in such number as to
    increase the percentage of voting rights attached to the aggregate
    of the voting shares of the body corporate beneficially owned by the
    person and by any entities controlled by the person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Idem

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A person who has a substantial investment in a body
  corporate pursuant to paragraph (1)(b) increases that substantial
  investment when the person or any entity controlled by the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} acquires beneficial ownership of additional shares
    of the body corporate in such number as to increase the percentage
    of the shareholders' equity of the body corporate represented by the
    aggregate of the shares of the body corporate beneficially owned by
    the person and by any entities controlled by the person; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} acquires control of any entity that beneficially
    owns any shares of the body corporate in such number as to increase
    the percentage of the shareholders' equity of the body corporate
    represented by the aggregate of the shares of the body corporate
    beneficially owned by the person and by any entities controlled by
    the person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Increasing substantial investment in
  federal credit unions

  [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} A person who has a substantial investment in a
  federal credit union under subparagraph (1)(c)(i) increases that
  substantial investment when the percentage of the voting rights of the
  person and of entities controlled by the person in relation to the
  aggregate of the voting rights that may be exercised by members and
  shareholders is increased for any reason.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Increasing substantial investment in
  federal credit unions

  [(3.2)]{.lawlabel} A person who has a substantial investment in a
  federal credit union under subparagraph (1)(c)(ii) increases that
  substantial investment when

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person or any entity controlled by the person
    acquires beneficial ownership of additional shares or membership
    shares of the federal credit union in such number as to increase the
    percentage of the members' and shareholders' equity of the federal
    credit union represented by the aggregate of the shares and
    membership shares beneficially owned by the person and by entities
    controlled by the person; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the person or any entity controlled by the person
    acquires control of any entity that beneficially owns shares or
    membership shares of the federal credit union in such number as to
    increase the percentage of the members' and shareholders' equity of
    the federal credit union represented by the aggregate of the shares
    and membership shares beneficially owned by the person and by
    entities controlled by the person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}New substantial investment

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where a person has a substantial investment in a
    body corporate pursuant to paragraph (1)(a) and the person, or any
    entity controlled by the person,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} purchases or otherwise acquires beneficial
      ownership of shares of the body corporate, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} acquires control of any entity that beneficially
      owns shares of the body corporate,

    in such number as to cause the shareholders' equity of the body
    corporate represented by the aggregate of the shares of the body
    corporate beneficially owned by the person and by any entities
    controlled by the person to exceed 25 per cent of the shareholders'
    equity of the body corporate, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where a person has a substantial investment in a
    body corporate pursuant to paragraph (1)(b) and the person or any
    entity controlled by the person

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} purchases or otherwise acquires beneficial
      ownership of voting shares of the body corporate, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} acquires control of any entity that beneficially
      owns voting shares of the body corporate,

    in such number as to cause the voting rights attached to the
    aggregate of the voting shares beneficially owned by the person and
    by any entities controlled by the person to exceed 10 per cent of
    the voting rights attached to all of the outstanding voting shares
    of the body corporate,

  the acquisition is deemed to cause the person to increase a
  substantial investment in the body corporate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}New substantial investment --- federal
  credit union

  [(4.1)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if a person has a substantial investment in a
    federal credit union under subparagraph (1)(c)(i) and the person, or
    any entity controlled by the person, purchases or otherwise acquires
    beneficial ownership of shares or membership shares of the federal
    credit union or acquires control of any entity that beneficially
    owns shares or membership shares of the federal credit union, the
    acquisition is deemed to cause the person to increase a substantial
    investment in the federal credit union if the percentage of the
    members' and shareholders' equity of the federal credit union
    represented by the aggregate of the shares and membership shares of
    the federal credit union beneficially owned by the person and by any
    entities controlled by the person exceeds 25 per cent of the
    members' and shareholders' equity of the federal credit union; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if a person has a substantial investment in a
    federal credit union under subparagraph (1)(c)(ii) and the person or
    any entity controlled by the person acquires voting rights in the
    federal credit union --- or acquires control of any entity that has
    voting rights in the federal credit union --- in such number that
    the percentage of the voting rights of the person and entities
    controlled by the person exceeds 10 per cent of the aggregate of the
    voting rights of the members and shareholders of the federal credit
    union, the acquisition is deemed to cause the person to increase a
    substantial investment in the federal credit union.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Substantial investment in
  unincorporated entity

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A person has a substantial investment in an
  unincorporated entity where the aggregate of any ownership interests,
  however designated, into which the entity is divided, beneficially
  owned by the person and by any entities controlled by the person
  exceeds 25 per cent of all of the ownership interests into which the
  entity is divided.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Increasing substantial investment in
  unincorporated entities

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} A person who has a substantial investment in an
  unincorporated entity increases that substantial investment when the
  person or any entity controlled by the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} acquires beneficial ownership of additional
    ownership interests in the unincorporated entity in such number as
    to increase the percentage of ownership interests in the
    unincorporated entity beneficially owned by the person and by any
    entities controlled by the person; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} acquires control of any entity that beneficially
    owns ownership interests in the unincorporated entity in such number
    as to increase the percentage of ownership interests beneficially
    owned by the person and by any entities controlled by the person.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}WTO Member resident

- **[[11.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-11.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Act, a WTO
  Member resident is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a natural person who is ordinarily resident in a
    country or territory that is a WTO Member, as defined in subsection
    2(1) of the [World Trade Organization Agreement Implementation
    Act](/eng/acts/W-11.8), other than Canada;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate, association, partnership or other
    organization that is incorporated, formed or otherwise organized in
    a country or territory that is a WTO Member, as defined in
    subsection 2(1) of the [World Trade Organization Agreement
    Implementation Act](/eng/acts/W-11.8), other than Canada, and that
    is controlled

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} directly or indirectly, by one or more persons
      referred to in paragraph (a), or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} by a government of a WTO Member, whether
      federal, state or local, or an agency of one of those governments;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a trust established by one or more persons referred
    to in paragraph (a) or (b) or a trust in which one or more of those
    persons have more than 50 per cent of the beneficial interest; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate, association, partnership or other
    organization that is controlled, directly or indirectly, by a trust
    referred to in paragraph (c).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Interpretation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate is controlled by one or more
    persons if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} securities of the body corporate to which are
      attached more than 50 per cent of the votes that may be cast to
      elect directors of the body corporate are beneficially owned by
      the person or persons, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the votes attached to those securities are
      sufficient to elect a majority of the directors of the body
      corporate;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an association, partnership or other organization
    is controlled by one or more persons if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} more than 50 per cent of the ownership interests,
      however designated, into which the association, partnership or
      other organization is divided are beneficially owned by the person
      or persons, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the person or persons are able to direct the
      business and affairs of the association, partnership or other
      organization;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate, association, partnership or other
    organization is controlled by one or more persons if the person or
    persons have, directly or indirectly, control in fact of the body
    corporate, association, partnership or other organization; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate, association, partnership or other
    organization that controls another body corporate, association,
    partnership or other organization is deemed to control any body
    corporate, association, partnership or other organization that is
    controlled or deemed to be controlled by the other body corporate,
    association, partnership or other organization.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1993, c. 44, s. 23
- 1999, c. 28, s. 3
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption from foreign bank status

- **[[12]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-12 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  Minister may, by order, and subject to such terms and conditions as
  the Minister considers appropriate, exempt for the purposes of any
  provision of this Act any entity from being a foreign bank that, but
  for that order, would be a foreign bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Revocation of order

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, by further order, revoke or vary
  any order made under subsection (1), and any such revocation or
  variation shall come into force three months after the date the
  further order is made, unless the Minister and the entity to which the
  order relates agree that the revocation or variation should come into
  force at some other time agreed by them.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Before filing an application for an order referred to
  in subsection (1), an applicant shall publish a notice of intention to
  make the application in the [Canada
  Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 12
- 2001, c. 9, s. 42.1
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Cooperative basis

- **[[12.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-12.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Act, a
  federal credit union is organized and carries on business on a
  cooperative basis if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a majority of its members are natural persons;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it provides financial services primarily to its
    members;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} membership in the federal credit union is wholly or
    primarily open, in a non-discriminatory manner, to persons who can
    use the services of the federal credit union and who are willing and
    able to accept the responsibilities of membership;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} each member has only one vote;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a delegate has only one vote even though the
    delegate is a member or represents more than one member;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} dividends on any membership share are limited to
    the maximum percentage fixed in the federal credit union's letters
    patent or by-laws; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} surplus funds arising from the federal credit
    union's operations are used

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} to provide for the financial stability of the
      federal credit union,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} to develop its business,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} to provide or improve common services to
      members,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} to provide for reserves or dividends on
      membership shares and shares,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} for community welfare or the propagation of
      cooperative enterprises, or

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} as a distribution to its members as a patronage
      allocation.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restrictions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(c) is subject to any restrictions in
  the by-laws of the federal credit union on the classes of persons to
  which membership may be available, as long as the restrictions are
  consistent with applicable laws with respect to human rights.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1902
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Member who is shareholder

**[[12.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-12.2 .sectionLabel}** For greater
certainty, a member of a federal credit union who is also a shareholder
of the federal credit union may exercise the rights given to a
shareholder by this Act for all shares held by the member.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1902
:::

of and applies to each bank.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Schedule I and Schedule II banks

- **[[14]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-14
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to this Act,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} there shall be set out in Schedule I

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name of every bank named in Schedules I and
      II as those Schedules read immediately before the day section 184
      of the [Financial Consumer Agency of Canada Act](/eng/acts/F-11.1)
      comes into force that was not a subsidiary of a foreign bank,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the name of every bank incorporated or formed
      under this Act that is not a subsidiary of a foreign bank, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the province in which the head office of the
      bank is situated; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} there shall be set out in Schedule II

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name of every bank named in Schedule II as
      that Schedule read immediately before the day section 184 of the
      [Financial Consumer Agency of Canada Act](/eng/acts/F-11.1) comes
      into force that was a subsidiary of a foreign bank,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the name of every bank incorporated or formed
      under this Act that is a subsidiary of a foreign bank, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the province in which the head office of the
      bank is situated.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amending the schedules

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a bank is incorporated,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate is continued as a bank,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} one or more bodies corporate are amalgamated as a
    bank,

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name of a bank is changed,

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the head office of a bank is changed,

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a bank becomes, or ceases to be, a subsidiary of a
    foreign bank,

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a bank is dissolved, or

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a bank is continued, or amalgamated and continued,
    as a body corporate to which another Act of Parliament applies,

  Schedules I and II shall be amended accordingly.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of amendments

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If in any year either Schedule I or II is amended,
  the Superintendent shall, within sixty days after the end of the year,
  cause a notice to be published in the [Canada
  Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) showing Schedule I or II in its
  complete amended form as at the end of the year.
