[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Schedule III authorized foreign banks

- **[[14.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-14.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} There shall be set out in Schedule
  III

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of every authorized foreign bank and,
    where applicable, any other name under which it is permitted to
    carry on business in Canada;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the province in which the principal office of the
    authorized foreign bank is situated; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} whether the authorized foreign bank is subject to
    the restrictions and requirements referred to in subsection 524(2).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amending Schedule III

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Schedule III shall be amended accordingly where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an order made under subsection 524(1) is revoked;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any of the information referred to in paragraph
    (1)(a) or (b) changes; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the restrictions and requirements referred to in
    subsection 524(2) to which an authorized foreign bank is subject are
    added or removed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of amendments

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where in any year Schedule III is amended, the
  Superintendent shall, within sixty days after the end of the year,
  cause a notice to be published in the [Canada
  Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) showing Schedule III in its
  complete amended form as at the end of the year.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 5
- 2005, c. 54, s. 5
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-14.1-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 14.1"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Schedule IV

**[[14.11]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-14.11 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
implementing Canada's international trade obligations, the Governor in
Council may, by order, amend Schedule IV by adding or deleting the name
of a trade agreement.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2020, c. 1, s. 159](#1238211-1311866){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1238211-1311866.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption of foreign banks

**[[14.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-14.2 .sectionLabel}** The Governor in
Council may make regulations exempting any class of foreign banks from
the application of any provision of this Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 43.1
:::

## [PART II]{.HLabel1}[Status and Powers]{.HTitleText1} {#h-10489 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Corporate powers

- **[[15]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-15 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A bank
  has the capacity of a natural person and, subject to this Act, the
  rights, powers and privileges of a natural person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Powers restricted

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank shall not carry on any business or exercise
  any power that it is restricted by this Act from carrying on or
  exercising, or exercise any of its powers in a manner contrary to this
  Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Business in Canada

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A bank may carry on business throughout Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Powers outside Canada

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subject to this Act, a bank has the capacity to carry
  on its business, conduct its affairs and exercise its powers in any
  jurisdiction outside Canada to the extent and in the manner that the
  laws of that jurisdiction permit.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Policies and procedures --- integrity or
security

**[[15.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-15.1 .sectionLabel}** A bank shall
establish and adhere to policies and procedures to protect itself
against threats to its integrity or security, including foreign
interference.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2023, c. 26, s. 539](#1410951-1437044){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1410951-1437044.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No invalidity

**[[16]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-16 .sectionLabel}** No act of a bank or
authorized foreign bank, including any transfer of property to or by a
bank or authorized foreign bank, is invalid by reason only that the act
or transfer is contrary to

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a bank, the bank's incorporating
  instrument or this Act; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an authorized foreign bank, this Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 16
- 1999, c. 28, s. 6
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}By-law not necessary

**[[17]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-17 .sectionLabel}** It is not necessary for a
bank to pass a by-law in order to confer any particular power on the
bank or its directors.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No personal liability

- **[[18]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-18 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  shareholders of a bank are not, as shareholders, liable for any
  liability, act or default of the bank except as otherwise provided by
  this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No personal liability --- federal
  credit unions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The members of a federal credit union are not, as
  members, liable for any liability, act or default of the federal
  credit union except as otherwise provided by this Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 18
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1903
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-18-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 18"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No constructive notice

**[[19]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-19 .sectionLabel}** No person is affected by
or is deemed to have notice or knowledge of the contents of a document
concerning a bank or authorized foreign bank by reason only that the
document has been filed with the Superintendent or the Minister or is
available for inspection at a branch of the bank or authorized foreign
bank.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 19
- 1993, c. 34, s. 6(F)
- 1999, c. 28, s. 7
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Authority of directors and officers

- **[[20]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-20 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No
  bank and no guarantor of an obligation of a bank may assert against a
  person dealing with the bank or against a person who has acquired
  rights from the bank that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bank's incorporating instrument or any by-laws
    of the bank have not been complied with;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the persons named as directors of the bank in the
    most recent return sent to the Superintendent under section 632 are
    not the directors of the bank;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the place named in the incorporating instrument or
    by-laws of the bank is not the place where the head office of the
    bank is situated;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a person held out by the bank as a director,
    officer or representative of the bank has not been duly appointed or
    has no authority to exercise the powers and perform the duties that
    are customary in the business of the bank or usual for a director,
    officer or representative; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a document issued by any director, officer or
    representative of the bank with actual or usual authority to issue
    the document is not valid or not genuine.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- knowledge

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of a person
  who has or ought to have knowledge of a situation described in that
  subsection by virtue of their relationship to the bank.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 20
- 1999, c. 28, s. 8
- 2005, c. 54, s. 6
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-20-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 20"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sunset provision

- **[[21]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-21
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) and (4),
  banks shall not carry on business, and authorized foreign banks shall
  not carry on business in Canada, after June 30, 2026.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may, by order, extend by up
  to six months the time during which banks may continue to carry on
  business and authorized foreign banks may continue to carry on
  business in Canada. No more than one order may be made under this
  subsection.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order not a regulation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The order is not a regulation for the purposes of the
  [Statutory Instruments Act](/eng/acts/S-22). However, it shall be
  published in Part II of the [Canada
  Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- dissolution

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If Parliament dissolves on the day set out in
  subsection (1) or on any day within the six-month period before that
  day or on any day within an extension ordered under subsection (2),
  banks may continue to carry on business, and authorized foreign banks
  may continue to carry on business in Canada, until the end of the
  180th day after the first day of the first session of the next
  Parliament.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 21
- 1997, c. 15, s. 2
- 1999, c. 28, s. 9
- 2001, c. 9, s. 44
- 2006, c. 4, s. 199
- 2007, c. 6, s. 4
- 2012, c. 5, s. 3
- 2016, c. 7, s. 118
- 2018, c. 12, s. 355
- [2021, c. 23, s. 154](#1307135-1311354){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1307135-1311354.html"}
- [2024, c. 17, s. 404](#1468533-1479708){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1468533-1479708.html"}
:::

[Previous
Version](section-21-20210629.html "Link to previous version of section 21"){.PITLink}
:::

## [PART III]{.HLabel1}[Incorporation and Continuance]{.HTitleText1} {#h-10541 .Part}

### [Formalities of Incorporation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-10542 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Incorporation of bank

- **[[22]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-22 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On the
  application of one or more persons made in accordance with this Act,
  the Minister may, subject to this Part, issue letters patent
  incorporating a bank, other than a federal credit union.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Incorporation of federal credit union

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On the application of five or more persons, a
  majority of whom are natural persons, made in accordance with this
  Act, the Minister may, subject to this Part, issue letters patent
  incorporating a federal credit union.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 22
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1904
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-22-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 22"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restrictions on incorporation

**[[23]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-23 .sectionLabel}** Letters patent
incorporating a bank may not be issued if the application therefor is
made by or on behalf of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} Her Majesty in right of Canada or in right of a
  province, an agency of Her Majesty in either of those rights, or an
  entity controlled by Her Majesty in either of those rights;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the government of a foreign country or any political
  subdivision thereof;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} an agency of the government of a foreign country or
  any political subdivision thereof; or

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is controlled by the government of a
  foreign country or any political subdivision thereof, other than an
  entity that is a foreign bank, a foreign institution or a subsidiary
  of a foreign bank or foreign institution.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 23
- 2001, c. 9, s. 45
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subsidiary of foreign bank

**[[24]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-24 .sectionLabel}** If a proposed bank would
be a subsidiary of a foreign bank, within the meaning of paragraphs (a)
to (f) of the definition [[foreign bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in section
2, and the application for letters patent to incorporate the bank is
made by a non-WTO Member foreign bank, letters patent to incorporate the
bank may not be issued unless the Minister is satisfied that treatment
as favourable for banks to which this Act applies exists or will be
provided in the jurisdiction in which the foreign bank principally
carries on business, either directly or through a subsidiary.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 24
- 1999, c. 28, s. 10
- 2001, c. 9, s. 46
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application for incorporation

- **[[25]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-25 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  application for letters patent to incorporate a bank setting out the
  names of the first directors of the bank shall be filed with the
  Superintendent, together with such other information, material and
  evidence as the Superintendent may require.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publishing notice of intent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Before filing an application referred to in
  subsection (1), the applicant or one of the applicants, as the case
  may be, shall, at least once a week for a period of four consecutive
  weeks, publish, in a form satisfactory to the Superintendent, a notice
  of intention to make the application in the [Canada
  Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) and in a newspaper in general
  circulation at or near the place where the head office of the bank is
  to be situated.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Objections to incorporation

- **[[26]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-26 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Any
  person who objects to the proposed incorporation of a bank may, within
  thirty days after the date of the last publication under subsection
  25(2) in respect of the proposed bank, submit the objection in writing
  to the Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Minister to be informed

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of an objection under subsection (1), the
  Superintendent shall inform the Minister of the objection.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Inquiry into objection and report

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of an objection under subsection (1), and
  if the application for the issuance of the letters patent to which the
  objection relates has been received, the Superintendent shall, if
  satisfied that it is necessary and in the public interest to do so,
  hold or cause to be held a public inquiry into the objection as it
  relates to the application and, on completion of the inquiry, the
  Superintendent shall report the findings of the inquiry to the
  Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report to be made available

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Within thirty days after receiving a report under
  subsection (3), the Minister shall make the report available to the
  public.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Rules governing proceedings

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the approval of the Governor in Council,
  the Superintendent may make rules governing the proceedings at public
  inquiries held under this section.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Matters for consideration

**[[27]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-27 .sectionLabel}** Before issuing letters
patent to incorporate a bank, the Minister shall take into account all
matters that the Minister considers relevant to the application,
including

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the nature and sufficiency of the financial resources
  of the applicant or applicants as a source of continuing financial
  support for the bank;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the soundness and feasibility of the plans of the
  applicant or applicants for the future conduct and development of the
  business of the bank;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the business record and experience of the applicant
  or applicants;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the character and integrity of the applicant or
  applicants or, if the applicant or any of the applicants is a body
  corporate, its reputation for being operated in a manner that is
  consistent with the standards of good character and integrity;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} whether the bank will be operated responsibly by
  persons with the competence and experience suitable for involvement in
  the operation of a financial institution;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the impact of any integration of the businesses and
  operations of the applicant or applicants with those of the bank on
  the conduct of those businesses and operations;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} the opinion of the Superintendent regarding the
  extent to which the proposed corporate structure of the applicant or
  applicants and their affiliates may affect the supervision and
  regulation of the bank, having regard to

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the nature and extent of the proposed financial
    services activities to be carried out by the bank and its
    affiliates, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the nature and degree of supervision and
    regulation applying to the proposed financial services activities to
    be carried out by the affiliates of the bank;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} if the bank will be a federal credit union, that it
  will be organized and carry on business on a cooperative basis in
  accordance with section 12.1; and

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} the best interests of the financial system in Canada
  including, if the bank will be a federal credit union, the best
  interests of the cooperative financial system in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 27
- 2001, c. 9, s. 47
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1905
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-27-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 27"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of letters patent

- **[[28]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-28 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} There
  shall be set out in the letters patent incorporating a bank

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the bank;

  - [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a bank that is to be a federal
    credit union, a statement that it is a federal credit union;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the province in which the head office of the bank
    is to be situated; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the date that the bank came, or is to come, into
    existence.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Provisions in letters patent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may set out in the letters patent
  incorporating a bank any provision not contrary to this Act that the
  Minister considers advisable in order to take into account the
  particular circumstances of the proposed bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Terms and conditions

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may impose such terms and conditions in
  respect of the issuance of letters patent incorporating a bank as the
  Minister considers necessary or appropriate.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 28
- 2005, c. 54, s. 7
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1906
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-28-20060427.html "Link to previous version of section 28"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Letters patent of incorporation on
application of certain companies

- **[[29]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-29 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If the
  Minister issues letters patent, under section 22, incorporating a bank
  on the application of a company to which the [Trust and Loan Companies
  Act](/eng/acts/T-19.8) or the [Insurance Companies
  Act](/eng/acts/I-11.8) applies and the paid-in capital of the bank
  immediately following its incorporation will be not less than five
  million dollars or any greater amount that the Minister may specify
  under subsection 46(1), there may, on the request of the company and
  with the approval of the Minister, be included in the letters patent a
  provision deeming shares of the bank to be issued, on a share for
  share basis, to all shareholders of the company in exchange for all
  the issued and outstanding shares of the company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of provision

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Shares of a bank deemed to be issued pursuant to
  subsection (1) are subject to the same designation, rights, privileges
  and restrictions or conditions and, subject to any agreement to the
  contrary, to the same charges, encumbrances and other restrictions as
  the shares of the company for which they are exchanged and the shares
  of the company, on the issuance of the letters patent, become the
  property of the bank free and clear of any charge, encumbrance or
  other restriction.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Idem

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An exchange of shares of a company referred to in
  subsection (1) pursuant to a provision included in the letters patent
  incorporating a bank does not deprive a person who was a holder of
  shares of the company immediately prior to the exchange of any right
  or privilege with respect to the shares or relieve the person of any
  liability in respect thereof, but any such right or privilege shall be
  exercised in accordance with this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transfer and voting of bank shares

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (3), no share of a bank
  that is deemed to be issued pursuant to a provision included in the
  letters patent incorporating a bank may subsequently be transferred or
  voted contrary to this Act, but any shareholder of a bank who acquired
  shares of the bank by means of an exchange of shares of a company
  referred to in subsection (1) pursuant to that provision may, for a
  period of ten years from the date of issuance of the letters patent,
  exercise the voting rights attached to the shares without regard to
  any provisions of this Act, other than subsection (7), that would
  otherwise prohibit the shareholder from voting the shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shareholder approval

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} No provision described in subsection (1) may be
  included in letters patent issued pursuant to section 22 unless the
  application therefor is accompanied by evidence that the request for
  such a provision was approved by a vote of at least two thirds of
  those shareholders of the applicant company entitled to vote thereon,
  present or represented by proxy and voting at a shareholders' meeting
  called to consider the application.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exchange of share certificates

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} Where, pursuant to a provision included in the
  letters patent incorporating a bank, a share exchange is deemed to
  have taken place, the bank shall, within ninety days after the
  issuance of the letters patent, make provision for the issue of share
  certificates representing shares of the bank and for the exchange of
  those certificates for share certificates representing the shares of
  the company that were outstanding on the day the letters patent were
  issued.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shares of bank may continue to be held

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding any other provision of this Act,
  where letters patent incorporating a bank include a provision
  described in subsection (1) and, on the date of issuance of the
  letters patent, another bank and any entities controlled by that other
  bank held, in the aggregate, more than ten per cent of any class of
  shares of the applicant company, that other bank may have a
  significant interest in any class of shares of the bank deemed to be
  issued pursuant to subsection (1) in exchange for the shares of the
  company for a period of two years from the date of issuance of the
  letters patent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension of period

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} On application of a bank authorized by subsection (7)
  to hold, directly or through a subsidiary, shares of another bank, the
  Minister may, by order, extend the period referred to in subsection
  (7), but the aggregate of such extensions from time to time granted to
  a bank and of the period referred to in subsection (7) may not, in any
  case, exceed ten years.

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2001, c. 9, s. 48\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, ss. 29, 573, c. 47, s. 756
- 2001, c. 9, s. 48
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of issue of letters patent

**[[30]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-30 .sectionLabel}** The Superintendent shall
cause to be published in the [Canada Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/)
a notice of the issuance of letters patent incorporating a bank.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}First directors

**[[31]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-31 .sectionLabel}** The first directors of a
bank are the directors named in the application for letters patent to
incorporate the bank.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}First members of federal credit union

**[[31.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-31.1 .sectionLabel}** The incorporators of
a federal credit union are deemed to be its first members.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1907
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of letters patent

**[[32]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-32 .sectionLabel}** A bank comes into
existence on the date provided therefor in its letters patent.

### [Continuance]{.HTitleText2} {#h-10636 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Federal corporations

- **[[33]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-33 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A body
  corporate incorporated under the [Canada Business Corporations
  Act](/eng/acts/C-44) or any other Act of Parliament, including a bank
  holding company, may apply to the Minister for letters patent
  continuing the body corporate as a bank under this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Other corporations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A body corporate incorporated otherwise than by or
  under an Act of Parliament may, if so authorized by the laws of the
  jurisdiction where it is incorporated, apply to the Minister for
  letters patent continuing the body corporate as a bank under this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Continuance for purpose of amalgamation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A local cooperative credit society may, if so
  authorized by the laws of the jurisdiction in which it is
  incorporated, apply to the Minister for letters patent continuing it
  as a federal credit union if it proposes to be continued under this
  Act for the purpose of immediately amalgamating with another federal
  credit union in accordance with this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Continuance for purpose of amalgamation

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Two or more local cooperative credit societies may,
  if so authorized by the laws of the jurisdiction in which they are
  incorporated, apply to the Minister for letters patent continuing each
  of them as a federal credit union if they propose to be continued
  under this Act for the purpose of immediately amalgamating with each
  other in accordance with this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application for amalgamation required

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} An application referred to in subsection (3) or (4)
  must be made at the same time as an application referred to in
  subsection 223(1.2) or (1.3) in respect of the amalgamation.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 33
- 1994, c. 24, s. 34(F)
- 2001, c. 9, s. 49
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1908
- 2014, c. 39, s. 270
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-33-20121219.html "Link to previous version of section 33"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application for continuance

- **[[34]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-34 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  body corporate applies for letters patent under section 33, sections
  23 to 27 apply in respect of the application, with any modifications
  that the circumstances require.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Joint notice of continuance and
  amalgamation

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} In the case of an application made under subsection
  33(3) or (4), the applicants referred to in subsection 223(1.2) or
  (1.3) may, in accordance with subsection 25(2) and paragraph
  228(2)(a), jointly publish the notices referred to in those provisions
  in the form of a single notice.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Special resolution approval

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a body corporate applies for letters patent under
  section 33, the application must be duly authorized by a special
  resolution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Copy of special resolution

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A copy of the special resolution referred to in
  subsection (2) shall be filed with the application.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Continuance and amalgamation ---
  special resolutions

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} In the case of an application made under subsection
  33(3) or (4), the vote on the special resolution must be held at the
  same time as the vote on the special resolutions referred to in
  subsection 226(4).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 34
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1909
- 2014, c. 39, s. 271
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-34-20121219.html "Link to previous version of section 34"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Power to issue letters patent

- **[[35]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-35 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On the
  application of a body corporate under section 33, the Minister may,
  subject to this Part, issue letters patent continuing the body
  corporate as a bank under this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Issue of letters patent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where letters patent are issued to a body corporate
  under subsection (1), section 28 applies in respect of the issue of
  letters patent, with such modifications as the circumstances require.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 35
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1910(E)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Power to issue letters patent

- **[[35.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-35.1 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  the application of a local cooperative credit society under subsection
  33(2), the Minister may, subject to this Part, issue letters patent
  continuing the local cooperative credit society as a federal credit
  union only if the Minister is of the opinion that the local
  cooperative credit society has complied with the regulations
  respecting notice and disclosure requirements.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Power to issue letters patent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On the application of a local cooperative credit
  society under subsection 33(3) or (4), the Minister may, subject to
  this Part, issue letters patent continuing the local cooperative
  credit society as a federal credit union only if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Minister is of the opinion that the local
    cooperative credit society has complied with the regulations
    respecting notice and disclosure requirements;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister is of the opinion that the federal
    credit union that results from the amalgamation will satisfy the
    requirements for incorporation as a federal credit union; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Minister will, immediately after issuing
    letters patent for the continuance, issue letters patent for the
    amalgamation under subsection 229(1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  respecting notice and disclosure requirements for the purpose of
  subsections (1) and (2).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of facilitating the continuance as a
  federal credit union of a local cooperative credit society, the
  Minister may, on application and by order, subject to any terms and
  conditions that he or she considers appropriate, exempt the local
  cooperative credit society from any requirement of this Part or of the
  regulations made under this Part, if he or she is of the opinion that
  it has acted in a manner that substantially complies with the
  requirement.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1911
- 2014, c. 39, s. 272
- 2016, c. 7, s. 123
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-35.1-20141216.html "Link to previous version of section 35.1"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of letters patent

**[[36]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-36 .sectionLabel}** On the day set out in the
letters patent continuing a body corporate as a bank,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the body corporate becomes a bank as if it had been
  incorporated under this Act; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the letters patent are deemed to be the incorporating
  instrument of the continued bank.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 36
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1912(E)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-36-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 36"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Copy of letters patent

- **[[37]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-37 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where
  a body corporate is continued as a bank under this Part, the
  Superintendent shall forthwith send a copy of the letters patent to
  the appropriate official or public body in the jurisdiction in which
  the body corporate was authorized to apply to be continued under this
  Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of issuance of letters patent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent shall cause to be published in the
  [Canada Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) a notice of the issuance
  of letters patent continuing a body corporate as a bank under this
  Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of continuance and amalgamation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} In the case of a continuance that results from an
  application made under subsection 33(3) or (4), the Superintendent may
  publish, in the form of a single notice, the notice referred to
  subsection (2), the notice required under subsection 229(3) in respect
  of the amalgamation and any notice required under subsection (2) in
  respect of other applicants for the amalgamation.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 37
- 2014, c. 39, s. 273
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-37-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 37"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effects of continuance

- **[[38]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-38 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where
  a body corporate is continued as a bank under this Part,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the property of the body corporate continues to be
    the property of the bank;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bank continues to be liable for the obligations
    of the body corporate;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an existing cause of action or claim by or against
    the body corporate or any liability of the body corporate to
    prosecution is unaffected;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a civil, criminal or administrative action or
    proceeding pending by or against the body corporate may continue to
    be prosecuted by or against the bank;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a conviction against, or any ruling, order or
    judgment in favour of or against the body corporate may be enforced
    by or against the bank;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a person who, on the day the body corporate becomes
    a bank, was the holder of a security issued by the body corporate is
    not deprived of any right or privilege available to the person at
    that time in respect of the security or relieved of any liability in
    respect thereof, but any such right or privilege may be exercised
    only in accordance with this Act; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the by-laws of the body corporate, except those
    that are in conflict with this Act, continue as the by-laws of the
    bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Membership shares

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In addition, if the body corporate is continued as a
  federal credit union,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a body corporate with common shares,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its common shares are deemed to be membership
      shares to which are attached the rights, privileges and
      restrictions set out in this Act,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the holders of those common shares are deemed to
      be the members of the federal credit union, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any agreement made before continuance under
      which the holders of any common shares of the body corporate have
      agreed to vote those shares in a manner provided in the agreement
      is of no effect; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a body corporate that has members,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the membership shares, however designated, of the
      body corporate are deemed to be membership shares of the federal
      credit union to which are attached the rights, privileges and
      restrictions set out in this Act,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the members of the body corporate are deemed to
      be the members of the federal credit union, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any agreement made before continuance under
      which the members of the body corporate have agreed to vote in a
      manner provided in the agreement is of no effect.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 38
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1913
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-38-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 38"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transitional

- **[[39]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-39
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding any other provision
  of this Act or the regulations, the Minister may, on the
  recommendation of the Superintendent, by order, grant to a bank in
  respect of which letters patent were issued under subsection 35(1)
  permission to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} engage in a business activity specified in the
    order that a bank is not otherwise permitted by this Act to engage
    in and that the body corporate continued as the bank was engaging in
    at the time the application for the letters patent was made;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} continue to have issued and outstanding debt
    obligations the issue of which is not authorized by this Act if the
    debt obligations were outstanding at the time the application for
    the letters patent was made;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 1994, c. 47, s. 14\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} hold assets that a bank is not otherwise permitted
    by this Act to hold if the assets were held by the body corporate
    continued as the bank at the time the application for the letters
    patent was made;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} acquire and hold assets that a bank is not
    otherwise permitted by this Act to acquire or hold if the body
    corporate continued as the bank was obliged, at the time the
    application for the letters patent was made, to acquire those
    assets; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} maintain outside Canada any records or registers
    required by this Act to be maintained in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duration

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The permission granted under subsection (1) shall be
  expressed to be granted for a period specified in the order not
  exceeding

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} with respect to any activity described in paragraph
    (1)(a), 30 days after the date of issue of the letters patent or

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if the activity is conducted under an agreement
      existing on the date of issue of the letters patent, the expiry of
      the agreement, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if the bank is a federal credit union and an
      undertaking to cease engaging in the activity has been given under
      subsection 973.02(1), the cessation date set out in the
      undertaking in respect of the activity;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to any matter described in paragraph
    (1)(b), ten years; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} with respect to any matter described in any of
    paragraphs (1)(d) to (f), two years.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Renewal

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (4), the Minister may, on the
  recommendation of the Superintendent, by order, renew a permission
  granted by order under subsection (1) with respect to any matter
  described in paragraphs (1)(b) to (e) for such further period or
  periods as the Minister considers necessary.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limitation

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall not grant to a bank any permission

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} with respect to matters described in paragraph
    (1)(b), that purports to be effective more than ten years after the
    date of the approval for the bank to commence and carry on business,
    unless the Minister is satisfied on the basis of evidence on oath
    provided by an officer of the bank that the bank will not be able at
    law to redeem at the end of the ten years the outstanding debt
    obligations to which the permission relates; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to matters described in paragraphs
    (1)(d) and (e), that purports to be effective more than ten years
    after the date of the approval for the bank to commence and carry on
    business.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 39
- 1994, c. 47, s. 14
- 1997, c. 15, s. 3
- 2007, c. 6, s. 5
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1914
:::

[Previous
Version](section-39-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 39"){.PITLink}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transitional --- federal credit unions

- **[[39.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-39.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} When the Minister issues letters
  patent continuing a local cooperative credit society as a federal
  credit union under subsection 35(1), he or she may, on application and
  by order, subject to any terms and conditions that he or she considers
  appropriate, exempt the federal credit union resulting from the
  continuance from any requirement of Part VI --- or of the regulations
  made under this Act --- relating to voting, if he or she is of the
  opinion that the federal credit union will act in a manner that
  substantially complies with the requirement.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duration

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The order shall specify the period of the exemption,
  which may not extend beyond the third anniversary of the effective
  date of the letters patent.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2016, c. 7, s. 124
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transitional --- loan guarantee

**[[39.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-39.02 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
supporting a federal credit union during the period that begins on the
effective date of the federal credit union's letters patent issued under
subsection 35(1) and ends on the third anniversary of that date, the
Minister may, subject to any terms and conditions that he or she
considers appropriate and for the period that he or she considers
appropriate, guarantee the repayment of a loan that a federal financial
institution makes to the federal credit union.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2016, c. 7, s. 124
:::

### [Discontinuance]{.HTitleText2} {#h-10756 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transferring to other federal Acts ---
banks

- **[[39.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-39.1 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank that is not a federal credit union may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} apply, with the approval in writing of the
    Minister, under the [Canada Business Corporations
    Act](/eng/acts/C-44) for a certificate of continuance as a
    corporation under that Act;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} apply, with the approval in writing of the
    Minister, under the [Canada Cooperatives Act](/eng/acts/C-1.7) for a
    certificate of continuance, or a certificate of continuance and a
    certificate of amalgamation, as a cooperative under that Act;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} apply, under the [Cooperative Credit Associations
    Act](/eng/acts/C-41.01), for letters patent continuing the bank as
    an association under that Act, or amalgamating and continuing the
    bank as an association under that Act;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} apply, under the [Insurance Companies
    Act](/eng/acts/I-11.8), for letters patent continuing the bank as a
    company (other than a mutual company) or an insurance holding
    company under that Act, or amalgamating and continuing the bank as a
    company (other than a mutual company) or an insurance holding
    company under that Act; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} apply, under the [Trust and Loan Companies
    Act](/eng/acts/T-19.8), for letters patent continuing the bank as a
    company under that Act, or amalgamating and continuing the bank as a
    company under that Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions for approval

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The approval referred to in paragraph (1)(a) or (b)
  may be given only if the Minister is satisfied that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bank has published, once a week for four
    consecutive weeks in the [Canada Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/)
    and in a newspaper in general circulation at or near the place where
    the head office of the bank is situated, a notice of its intention
    to apply for the approval;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the application has been authorized by a special
    resolution; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the bank does not hold deposits, other than
    deposits that are made by a person who controls the bank or by a
    person who has a significant interest in a class of shares of the
    bank and that are not insured by the Canada Deposit Insurance
    Corporation.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Withdrawing application

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a special resolution authorizing the application
  for the certificate or letters patent so states, the directors of the
  bank may, without further approval of the shareholders, withdraw the
  application before it is acted on.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on other transfers

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A bank may not apply to be continued, or to be
  amalgamated and continued, as the case may be, as a body corporate
  other than one referred to in subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 574
- 1997, c. 15, s. 4
- 1999, c. 28, s. 11
- 2001, c. 9, s. 50
- 2007, c. 6, s. 6
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1915
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-39.1-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 39.1"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transferring to other federal Acts ---
federal credit union

- **[[39.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-39.2 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  federal credit union may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} apply, with the approval in writing of the
    Minister, under the [Canada Cooperatives Act](/eng/acts/C-1.7) for a
    certificate of continuance, or a certificate of continuance and a
    certificate of amalgamation, as a cooperative under that Act; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} apply under the [Cooperative Credit Associations
    Act](/eng/acts/C-41.01) for letters patent continuing the federal
    credit union as an association under that Act or amalgamating and
    continuing the federal credit union as an association under that
    Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions for approval

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The approval referred to in paragraph (1)(a) may be
  given only if the Minister is satisfied that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the federal credit union has published, once a week
    for four consecutive weeks in the [Canada
    Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) and in a newspaper in general
    circulation at or near the place where its head office is situated,
    a notice of its intention to apply for the approval;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the application has been authorized by a special
    resolution of the members and, if the federal credit union has
    issued shares, by a separate special resolution of the shareholders
    of each class of shares; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the federal credit union does not hold deposits.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}All shares have right to vote

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of paragraph (2)(b), each share
  carries the right to vote in respect of the special resolution,
  whether or not it otherwise carries the right to vote in respect of
  any other matter.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on other transfers

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A federal credit union may not apply to be continued,
  or to be amalgamated and continued, as the case may be, as a body
  corporate other than one referred to in subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1997, c. 15, s. 4
- 2001, c. 9, s. 50
- 2007, c. 6, s. 6
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1916
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-39.2-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 39.2"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Act ceases to apply

**[[39.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-39.3 .sectionLabel}** If a bank applies for
a certificate or letters patent referred to in section 39.1 or 39.2 in
accordance with that section and the certificate is given or the letters
patent are issued, this Act ceases to apply to the bank as of the day on
which the certificate or the letters patent take effect.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1916
:::

### [Corporate Name]{.HTitleText2} {#h-10796 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibited names

**[[40]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-40 .sectionLabel}** A bank may not be
incorporated under this Act with a name

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is prohibited by an Act of Parliament;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is, in the opinion of the Superintendent,
  deceptively misdescriptive;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} that is the same as or, in the opinion of the
  Superintendent, substantially the same as or confusingly similar to,
  any existing

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} trademark or trade name, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} corporate name of a body corporate,

  except where the trademark or trade name is being changed or the body
  corporate is being dissolved or is changing its corporate name and
  consent to the use of the trademark, trade name or corporate name is
  signified to the Superintendent in such manner as the Superintendent
  may require;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} that is the same as or, in the opinion of the
  Superintendent, substantially the same as or confusingly similar to,
  the known name under or by which any entity carries on business or is
  identified;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} that is reserved under section 43 for another bank or
  an authorized foreign bank or a proposed bank or a proposed authorized
  foreign bank or under section 697 for a bank holding company or a
  proposed bank holding company;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} that includes the phrase "credit union" or
  "coopérative de crédit", or any abbreviation, combination or
  derivative of those phrases, unless it is to be a federal credit union
  and its name also includes the word "bank", "banque", "federal" or
  "fédérale" in conjunction with those phrases; or

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} that includes the words "cooperative" or
  "coopérative", or any abbreviation, combination or derivative of those
  words, unless it is to be a federal credit union and its name also
  includes the word "bank", "banque", "federal" or "fédérale" in
  conjunction with those words.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 40
- 1996, c. 6, s. 1
- 1997, c. 15, s. 5
- 1999, c. 28, s. 12
- 2001, c. 9, s. 51
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1917
- [2014, c. 20, s. 366(E)](#1034903-1145558){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1034903-1145558.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-40-20121219.html "Link to previous version of section 40"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Name of federal credit union

**[[40.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-40.1 .sectionLabel}** Despite any other
Act, but subject to paragraphs 40(f) and (g), a bank may be incorporated
or formed under this Act with the words "credit union" "coopérative de
crédit", "cooperative" or "coopérative", or any abbreviation,
combination or derivative of those words, in its name, but only if it
will be a federal credit union.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1918
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Affiliated bank

**[[41]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-41 .sectionLabel}** Despite section 40, a
bank that is affiliated with another entity may, with the consent of
that entity, be incorporated with, or change its name to, substantially
the same name as that of the affiliated entity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 41
- 1996, c. 6, s. 1
- 2001, c. 9, s. 52
- 2007, c. 6, s. 7
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-41-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 41"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}French or English form of name

- **[[42]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-42 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  name of a bank may be set out in its letters patent in an English
  form, a French form, an English form and a French form or in a
  combined English and French form, and the bank may use and be legally
  designated by any such form.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Alternate name

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank may identify itself outside Canada by its name
  in any language and the bank may use and be legally designated by any
  such form of its name outside Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Other name

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (4) and section 255, a bank may
  carry on business under or identify itself by a name other than its
  corporate name.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Directions

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If a bank is carrying on business under or
  identifying itself by a name other than its corporate name, the
  Superintendent may, by order, direct the bank not to use that other
  name if the Superintendent is of the opinion that that other name is a
  name referred to in any of paragraphs 40(a) to (g).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 42
- 1996, c. 6, s. 2
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1919
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-42-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 42"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reserved name

**[[43]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-43 .sectionLabel}** The Superintendent may,
on request, reserve for ninety days a name for a proposed bank or
proposed authorized foreign bank or for a bank or authorized foreign
bank that intends to change its name.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 43
- 1999, c. 28, s. 13
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Directing change of name

- **[[44]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-44 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If
  through inadvertence or otherwise a bank

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} comes into existence or is continued with a name,
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} on an application to change its name, is granted a
    name

  that is prohibited by section 40, the Superintendent may, by order,
  direct the bank to change its name and the bank shall comply with that
  direction.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Revoking name

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a bank has been directed under subsection (1) to
  change its name and has not, within sixty days after the service of
  the direction, changed its name to a name that is not prohibited by
  this Act, the Superintendent may revoke the name of the bank and
  assign to it a name and, until changed in accordance with section 215
  or 217, the name of the bank is thereafter the name so assigned.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 44
- 1996, c. 6, s. 3
- 2001, c. 9, s. 53
:::

## [PART IV]{.HLabel1}[Organization and Commencement]{.HTitleText1} {#h-10844 .Part}

### [Organization Meetings]{.HTitleText2} {#h-10845 .Subheading}

#### [Banks Other Than Federal Credit Unions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-10846 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}First directors' meeting

- **[[45]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-45 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} After
  letters patent incorporating a bank that is not a federal credit union
  are issued, a meeting of the directors of the bank must be held at
  which the directors may, subject to this Part,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} make by-laws;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} adopt forms of share certificates and corporate
    records;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} authorize the issue of shares of the bank;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} appoint officers;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} appoint, pursuant to subsection 314(1), an auditor
    or auditors to hold office until the first meeting of shareholders;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} make banking arrangements; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} deal with any other matters necessary to organize
    the bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Calling directors' meeting

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An incorporator or a director named in the
  application for letters patent may call the meeting referred to in
  subsection (1) by giving, subject to subsection 181(2), no fewer than
  five days notice of the purpose, time and place of the meeting to each
  director of the bank.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 45
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1921
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-45-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 45"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Calling shareholders' meeting

- **[[46]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-46 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If at
  least five million dollars, or any greater amount that the Minister
  may specify, has been received by a bank in respect of which letters
  patent were issued under subsection 22(1) from the issue of its
  shares, the directors of the bank must without delay call a meeting of
  the shareholders of the bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Meeting of shareholders

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The shareholders of a bank shall, by resolution at
  the meeting of shareholders called pursuant to subsection (1),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} approve, amend or reject any by-law made by the
    directors of the bank;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subject to section 168, elect directors to hold
    office for a term expiring not later than the close of the third
    annual meeting of shareholders following the election; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} appoint an auditor or auditors to hold office until
    the close of the first annual meeting of shareholders.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 46
- 2001, c. 9, s. 54
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1922
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-46-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 46"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Term of first directors

**[[47]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47 .sectionLabel}** A director named in the
application for letters patent to incorporate a bank holds office until
the election of directors at the meeting of shareholders called pursuant
to subsection 46(1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 47
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1923(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-47-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 47"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Federal Credit Unions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-10875 .Subheading}

##### [Meeting of First Directors]{.HTitleText4} {#h-10876 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Organizational meeting

- **[[47.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} After letters patent incorporating a
  federal credit union are issued, a meeting of its first directors must
  be held at which the first directors may, subject to this Part,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} adopt forms of certificates for membership shares,
    forms of share certificates and forms of corporate records;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} admit persons to membership in the federal credit
    union and issue or authorize the issuance of membership shares;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} authorize the issue of shares of the federal credit
    union;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} appoint officers;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} appoint, under subsection 314(1), an auditor or
    auditors to hold office until the first meeting of members;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} make banking arrangements; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} deal with any other matters necessary to organize
    the federal credit union.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Calling directors' meeting

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A first director may call the meeting referred to in
  subsection (1) by giving, subject to subsection 181(2), the other
  directors notice of the time and place of the meeting no fewer than
  five days before the meeting.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

##### [First Meeting of Members]{.HTitleText4} {#h-10891 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Calling members' meeting

- **[[47.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.02
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If at least five million dollars, or
  any greater amount that the Minister may specify, has been received by
  a federal credit union in respect of which letters patent were issued
  under subsection 22(2) from the issue of its membership shares and
  shares, the directors of the federal credit union must, without delay,
  call a meeting of the members of the federal credit union.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Meeting of members

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} At the meeting, the members must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} make by-laws;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} elect directors in accordance with this Act and the
    federal credit union's by-laws; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} appoint an auditor or auditors to hold office until
    the close of the first annual meeting of the federal credit union.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Term of office of first directors

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The term of office of the first directors ends at the
  close of the meeting referred to in subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

### [Membership in a Federal Credit Union]{.HTitleText2} {#h-10904 .Subheading}

#### [Conditions of Membership]{.HTitleText3} {#h-10905 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Membership governed by by-laws

- **[[47.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.03
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the provisions of this
  Act, membership in a federal credit union is governed by its by-laws.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Minimum membership shares required

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} To be a member of a federal credit union, a person
  must acquire and hold the minimum number of membership shares required
  under the federal credit union's by-laws.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Member who ceases to hold the minimum

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to any limitations in the federal credit
  union's by-laws, including limitations on the rights members may
  exercise, a member of a federal credit union who ceases to hold enough
  membership shares to be a member continues to be a member of the
  federal credit union for the purposes of this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Ground for expulsion

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, subsection (3) does not
  prevent holding fewer than the minimum number of membership shares
  from being set out in the federal credit union's by-laws as a ground
  for expulsion under subsection 47.06(1) or section 47.09.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subscription deemed application

- **[[47.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.04
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A subscription for the number of
  membership shares in a federal credit union required by the federal
  credit union's by-laws for membership constitutes an application for
  membership and the issue of a membership share to the applicant
  constitutes admission to membership.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Approval required

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (1), a person becomes a member
  of a federal credit union when the person's application for membership
  is approved by the directors or an employee authorized by the federal
  credit union and the applicant has complied fully with the federal
  credit union's by-laws governing admission of members.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

#### [Withdrawal and Termination]{.HTitleText3} {#h-10924 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Withdrawal of membership

- **[[47.05]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.05
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A member of a federal credit union
  may withdraw from the federal credit union at any time by giving
  notice in accordance with the by-laws.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed notice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A deceased member is deemed to have given notice to
  the federal credit union of their intention to withdraw on the day of
  their death.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Rights of withdrawing member

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The by-laws of a federal credit union must set out
  the rights of a withdrawing member.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Expulsion

- **[[47.06]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.06
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A member of a federal credit union
  may be expelled from membership, in accordance with the by-laws, by a
  resolution of the directors on the grounds set out in the by-laws.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Member's rights relating to expulsion

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The by-laws of a federal credit union must set out
  the rights of members who are expelled under subsection (1), and those
  rights must include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the right of a member to receive advance notice of
    any meeting of the directors at which the board will consider a
    resolution to expel the member;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the right of a member not to be expelled without
    being given an opportunity to make representations on the matter at
    the meeting of the directors;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the right of an expelled member to appeal the
    decision of the directors at the next meeting of the members; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the right of the expelled member to be reinstated
    as a member of the federal credit union if, at the next meeting of
    the members, the members, by ordinary resolution, set aside the
    directors' resolution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Procedures to be set out in by-laws

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The by-laws of a federal credit union must set out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the procedures to be followed by the directors to
    provide the advance notice referred to in paragraph (2)(a); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the procedures to be followed relating to the
    appeal referred to in paragraph (2)(c).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of decision

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the directors pass a resolution expelling a member
  under subsection (1), the federal credit union must, within five days
  after the passing of the resolution, notify the member of the
  directors' decision by registered letter addressed to the member at
  the member's recorded address.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Inactivity

**[[47.07]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.07 .sectionLabel}** No by-law may
provide for the expulsion of a member by reason only of inactivity of
the member in relation to the business or affairs of the federal credit
union.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Redemption

**[[47.08]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.08 .sectionLabel}** No by-law governing
the withdrawal of a member from membership or the termination of the
membership of a member may authorize a redemption of membership shares
in contravention of section 485.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Termination by members

**[[47.09]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.09 .sectionLabel}** Unless the by-laws
provide otherwise, the membership of a member may be terminated by a
special resolution of the members. Section 47.06 applies, with any
modifications that the circumstances require, to a termination by the
members.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Winding-up proceedings in respect of
member

**[[47.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.1 .sectionLabel}** Despite subsection
47.06(1), a federal credit union may, by written notice to a member,
terminate the membership if the member is a body corporate and
winding-up proceedings have commenced with respect to it.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

### [General Provisions --- Federal Credit Unions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-10967 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition

**[[47.11]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.11 .sectionLabel}** An entity must not
become a member of a federal credit union if, as a result of becoming a
member, the majority of the members of the federal credit union would
not be natural persons.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Provision of services

**[[47.12]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.12 .sectionLabel}** A federal credit
union must provide its services primarily to its members.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Right to vote

**[[47.13]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.13 .sectionLabel}** Each member of a
federal credit union has only one vote on all matters to be decided by
the members.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Members under 18

**[[47.14]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.14 .sectionLabel}** Subject to the
by-laws, a person less than 18 years of age may be admitted to
membership in a federal credit union and may vote at meetings of the
federal credit union.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Membership not transferable

**[[47.15]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.15 .sectionLabel}** No transfer of a
membership is valid for any purpose.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reinstatement --- section 47.06

- **[[47.16]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.16
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person whose membership has been
  terminated under section 47.06 may be reinstated as a member of the
  federal credit union only by ordinary resolution of the members.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reinstatement --- section 47.09

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person whose membership has been terminated under
  section 47.09 may be reinstated as a member of the federal credit
  union only by special resolution of the members.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transfer of membership shares

**[[47.17]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.17 .sectionLabel}** No transfer of
membership shares in a federal credit union is valid unless the transfer
is approved by resolution of the directors.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Obligation to have at least five members

- **[[47.18]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.18
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A federal credit union must ensure
  that at all times it has at least five members.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Membership too low

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the membership of a federal credit union is
  reduced to fewer than five members, the federal credit union must,
  without delay, take the steps that are necessary to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} make an application referred to in subsection
    39.2(1) or section 216.08; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} liquidate and dissolve the federal credit union
    under Part VI.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption

**[[47.19]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-47.19 .sectionLabel}** The Minister may,
subject to any terms and conditions that the Minister considers
appropriate, exempt any entity or federal credit union from the
application of sections 47.11, 47.12 and 47.18.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1924
:::

### [Commencement and Carrying on of Business]{.HTitleText2} {#h-11012 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order to commence and carry on business

- **[[48]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-48 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A bank
  shall not carry on any business until the Superintendent has, by
  order, approved the commencement and carrying on of business by the
  bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deeming

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If, on the day this subsection comes into force, an
  order approving the commencement and carrying on of business by a bank
  named in Schedule I or II as those Schedules read immediately before
  that day, has not been made, such an order is deemed to have been made
  in respect of the bank on that day.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Continued bank

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Except in respect of a body corporate that is
  continued as a bank under this Act for the purposes of forthwith
  amalgamating with one or more bodies corporate and continuing as a
  bank under this Act, where letters patent continuing a body corporate
  as a bank under this Act are issued, the Superintendent shall make an
  order approving the commencement and carrying on of business by the
  bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amalgamated bank

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where letters patent amalgamating and continuing two
  or more bodies corporate as a bank under this Act are issued, the
  Superintendent shall make an order approving the commencement and
  carrying on of business by the bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subsection 49(2) and section 52 do not
  apply

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, subsection 49(2) and section
  52 do not apply in respect of a bank referred to in subsections (3)
  and (4).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 48
- 2001, c. 9, s. 55
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Authority to make order

- **[[49]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-49 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  application by a bank, the Superintendent may make an order approving
  the commencement and carrying on of business by the bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statement of payments

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An application by a bank for an order under
  subsection (1) must contain a statement setting out the amounts paid
  or to be paid by the bank in connection with its incorporation and
  organization.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No payments before order

**[[50]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-50 .sectionLabel}** Until an order approving
the commencement and carrying on of business is made for a bank, the
bank must not make any payment on account of incorporation or
organization expenses out of moneys received from the issue of the
shares or the membership shares of the bank and interest on those
moneys, except reasonable sums

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the remuneration of not more than two officers;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the payment of costs related to the issue of
  shares, or membership shares, of the bank; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} for the payment of clerical assistance, legal
  services, accounting services, office accommodation at one location,
  office expenses, advertising, stationery, postage and travel expenses.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 50
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1925
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-50-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 50"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deposits and investments before order

**[[51]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-51 .sectionLabel}** Where a bank comes into
existence but no order approving the commencement and carrying on of
business is made for the bank, the bank may only

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} deposit, in Canada, paid-in capital of the bank in
  another deposit-taking Canadian financial institution; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} invest paid-in capital of the bank in unencumbered
  securities of the Government of Canada or the government of any
  province.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions for order

- **[[52]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-52 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  Superintendent shall not make an order approving the commencement and
  carrying on of business by a bank until it has been shown to the
  satisfaction of the Superintendent that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the meeting of shareholders of the bank referred to
    in subsection 46(1), or, in the case of a federal credit union, the
    meeting of members referred to in subsection 47.02(1), has been duly
    held;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bank has paid-in capital of at least five
    million dollars or any greater amount that is specified by the
    Minister under subsection 46(1) or 47.02(1);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the expenses of incorporation and organization to
    be borne by the bank are reasonable; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} all other relevant requirements of this Act have
    been complied with.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Time limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent shall not make an order approving
  the commencement and carrying on of business by a bank more than one
  year after the day on which the bank comes into existence.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 52
- 2001, c. 9, s. 56
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1926
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-52-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 52"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions of order

- **[[53]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-53 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  order approving the commencement and carrying on of business by a bank
  may contain such conditions or limitations that are consistent with
  this Act and relate to the business of the bank as the Superintendent
  deems expedient and necessary.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed condition

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An order approving the commencement and carrying on
  of business by a federal credit union is deemed to contain a condition
  that the federal credit union must, on an ongoing basis, be organized
  and carry on business on a cooperative basis in accordance with
  section 12.1.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 53
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1927
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-53-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 53"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Variations

- **[[54]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-54 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  respect of the order approving the commencement and carrying on of
  business by a bank, the Superintendent may at any time, by further
  order,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} make the order subject to such conditions or
    limitations that are consistent with this Act and that relate to the
    business of the bank as the Superintendent deems expedient and
    necessary, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} amend or revoke any authorization contained in the
    order or any condition or limitation to which the order is subject,
    other than the condition deemed to be in the order by subsection
    53(2),

  but before making any such further order the Superintendent shall
  provide the bank with an opportunity to make representations regarding
  that further order.

- [(2) to (6)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 1996, c. 6, s. 4\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 54
- 1996, c. 6, s. 4
- 2010, c. 12, s. 1928
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-54-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 54"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit on assets

- **[[54.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-54.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, by order, require
  a bank not to have average total assets in any three month period
  ending on the last day of a month subsequent to the month specified in
  the order exceeding the bank's average total assets in the three month
  period ending on the last day of the month immediately before the
  month specified in the order if the Minister is of the opinion that it
  is in the best interests of the financial system in Canada to do so,
  after having considered the Superintendent's opinion on

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the nature and extent of the financial services
    activities carried out by entities affiliated with the bank; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the impact that the nature and degree of
    supervision and regulation of those financial services activities
    have on the supervision and regulation of the bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Revocation of order

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister is of the opinion that the
  circumstances giving rise to the order have ceased to exist or have
  changed substantially, the Minister may, by further order, revoke the
  order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Average total assets

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), the average total
  assets of a bank in a three month period shall be computed by adding
  the total assets of the bank as calculated for the month end of each
  of the three months in the period and by dividing the sum by three.

- Definition of [[total assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsections (1) and (3), [[total
  assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a bank, has the meaning
  given that expression by the regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 57
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Permission to subsidiary of foreign bank

- **[[55]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-55 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On the
  recommendation of the Superintendent, the Minister may, at the same
  time that an order is made approving the commencement and carrying on
  of business by a bank that is the subsidiary of a foreign bank, by
  further order, grant the subsidiary permission to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} hold assets that banks are not otherwise permitted
    by this Act to hold if those assets consist of shares of a body
    corporate incorporated by or under an Act of Parliament or of the
    legislature of a province that, at the time application for letters
