#### [Securities Registers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-13579 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Central securities register

- **[[248]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-248 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank shall maintain a central securities register in which it shall
  record the securities, within the meaning of section 81, issued by it
  in registered form, showing in respect of each class or series of
  securities

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the names, alphabetically arranged, and latest
    known addresses of the persons who are security holders, and the
    names and latest known addresses of the persons who have been
    security holders;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the number of securities held by each security
    holder; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the date and particulars of the issue and transfer
    of each security.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Existing and continued banks

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), "central
  securities register" includes similar registers required by law to be
  maintained by a bank that was in existence immediately prior to the
  day that subsection comes into force or by a body corporate continued,
  or amalgamated and continued, as a bank under this Act before the
  continuance, amalgamation or coming into force of that subsection, as
  the case may be.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Access to central securities register

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Shareholders and creditors of a bank and their
  personal representatives --- and, if the bank is a federal credit
  union, its members and their personal representatives --- may examine
  the central securities register during the usual business hours of the
  bank and may take extracts from it free of charge or have copies of it
  made on payment of a reasonable fee. If the bank is a distributing
  bank, any other person may, on payment of a reasonable fee, examine
  the central securities register during the usual business hours of the
  bank and take extracts from it or have copies of it made.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Electronic access

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The bank may make the information contained in the
  central securities register available by any mechanical or electronic
  data processing system or other information storage device that is
  capable of reproducing it in intelligible written form within a
  reasonable time.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Affidavit and undertaking

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A person who wishes to examine the central securities
  register, take extracts from it or have copies of it made shall
  provide the bank with an affidavit containing their name and address
  --- or if they are an entity, the name and address for service of the
  entity --- and with an undertaking that the information contained in
  the register will not be used except in the same way as a list of
  shareholders may be used under section 242. In the case of an entity,
  the affidavit is to be sworn by a director or officer of the entity or
  a person acting in a similar capacity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Supplemental information

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} A person who wishes to examine a central securities
  register, take extracts from it or have copies of it made may on
  payment of a reasonable fee, if they state in the accompanying
  affidavit that supplementary information is required, request the bank
  or its agent to provide supplementary information setting out any
  changes made to the register.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}When supplementary information to be
  provided

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} A bank or its agent shall provide the supplementary
  information within

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 10 days after the day on which the central
    securities register is examined if the changes take place before
    that day; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 10 days after the day to which the supplementary
    information relates if the changes take place on or after the day on
    which the central securities register is examined.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 248
- 2001, c. 9, s. 90
- 2005, c. 54, s. 53
- 2010, c. 12, s. 2014
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-248-20061128.html "Link to previous version of section 248"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Branch registers

**[[249]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-249 .sectionLabel}** A bank may establish as
many branch securities registers as it considers necessary.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agents

**[[250]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-250 .sectionLabel}** A bank may appoint an
agent to maintain its central securities register and each of its branch
securities registers.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Location of central securities register

- **[[251]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-251 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  central securities register of a bank shall be maintained by the bank
  at its head office or at any other place in Canada designated by the
  directors of the bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Location of branch securities register

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A branch securities register of a bank may be kept at
  any place in or outside Canada designated by the directors of the
  bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection 245(1.1), subsection (1) does
  not apply to a bank that is a subsidiary of a foreign bank
  incorporated or formed otherwise in a country or territory other than
  Canada in which a trade agreement listed in Schedule IV is applicable
  or of a regulated foreign entity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 251
- [2020, c. 1, s. 163](#1238221-1311890){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1238221-1311890.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-251-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 251"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of registration

**[[252]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-252 .sectionLabel}** Registration of the
issue or transfer of a security in the central securities register or in
a branch securities register is complete and valid registration for all
purposes.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Particulars in branch register

- **[[253]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-253 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  branch securities register shall only contain particulars of the
  securities issued or transferred at the branch for which that register
  is established.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Particulars in central register

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Particulars of each issue or transfer of a security
  registered in a branch securities register of a bank shall also be
  kept in the central securities register of the bank.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Destruction of certificates

**[[254]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-254 .sectionLabel}** A bank, its agent or a
trustee within the meaning of section 294 is not required to produce

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a cancelled security certificate in registered form
  or an instrument referred to in subsection 69(1) that is cancelled or
  a like cancelled instrument in registered form after six years from
  the date of its cancellation;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a cancelled security certificate in bearer form or an
  instrument referred to in subsection 69(1) that is cancelled or a like
  cancelled instrument in bearer form after the date of its
  cancellation; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} an instrument referred to in subsection 69(1) or a
  like instrument, irrespective of its form, after the date of its
  expiration.

#### [Members Register]{.HTitleText3} {#h-13623 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Members register

- **[[254.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-254.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A federal credit union must maintain
  a members register in which it must record

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the names, alphabetically arranged, and latest
    known addresses of the members and former members of the federal
    credit union;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the number of membership shares held by each
    member; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the date and particulars of the issue and transfer
    of each membership share.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Similar registers

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), "members
  register" includes similar registers required by law to be maintained
  by a body corporate that was continued, or amalgamated and continued,
  as a federal credit union before the continuance or amalgamation and
  continuance.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Access to members register

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Members, shareholders and creditors of a federal
  credit union, and their personal representatives, may examine the
  members register during the usual business hours of the federal credit
  union and may take extracts from it free of charge or have copies of
  it made on payment of a reasonable fee. If the federal credit union is
  a distributing bank, any other person may, on payment of a reasonable
  fee, examine the members register during the usual business hours of
  the bank and take extracts from it or have copies of it made.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Electronic access

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The federal credit union may make the information
  contained in the members register available by any mechanical or
  electronic data processing system or other information storage device
  that is capable of reproducing it in intelligible written form within
  a reasonable time.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Affidavit and undertaking

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A person who wishes to examine the members register,
  take extracts from it or have copies of it made must provide the
  federal credit union with an affidavit containing their name and
  address --- or, if they are an entity, the name and address for
  service of the entity --- and an undertaking that the information
  contained in the register will not be used except in the same way as a
  list of shareholders or members may be used under section 242. In the
  case of an entity, the affidavit is to be sworn by a director or
  officer of the entity or a person acting in a similar capacity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Supplementary information

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} A person who wishes to examine a members register,
  take extracts from it or have copies of it made may, on payment of a
  reasonable fee, if they state in the accompanying affidavit that
  supplementary information is required, request the federal credit
  union or its agent to provide supplementary information setting out
  any changes made to the register.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}When supplementary information to be
  provided

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} A federal credit union or its agent must provide the
  supplementary information within

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 10 days after the day on which the members register
    is examined if the changes take place before that day; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 10 days after the day to which the supplementary
    information relates if the changes take place on or after the day on
    which the members register is examined.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 2015
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Branch members registers

**[[254.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-254.2 .sectionLabel}** A federal credit
union may establish as many branch members registers as it considers
necessary.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 2015
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agents

**[[254.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-254.3 .sectionLabel}** A federal credit
union may appoint an agent to maintain its members register and each of
its branch members registers.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 2015
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Location of members register

- **[[254.4]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-254.4
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The members register of a federal
  credit union is to be maintained by the federal credit union at its
  head office or at any other place in Canada designated by the federal
  credit union's directors.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Location of branch members register

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A branch members register of a federal credit union
  may be kept at any place in or outside Canada designated by the
  directors of the federal credit union.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 2015
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Particulars in branch members register

- **[[254.5]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-254.5
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A branch members register must
  contain only particulars of the membership shares issued or
  transferred at the branch for which that register is established.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Particulars in members register

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Particulars of each issue or transfer of a membership
  share registered in a branch members register of a federal credit
  union must also be kept in the members register of the federal credit
  union.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 2015
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Cancelled membership share certificates

**[[254.6]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-254.6 .sectionLabel}** A federal credit
union, its agent or a trustee within the meaning of section 294 is not
required to produce a cancelled membership share certificate in
registered form after six years from the day on which it is cancelled.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 2015
:::

#### [Corporate Name and Seal]{.HTitleText3} {#h-13672 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publication of name

**[[255]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-255 .sectionLabel}** A bank shall set out
its name in legible characters in all contracts, invoices, negotiable
instruments and other documents evidencing rights or obligations with
respect to other parties that are issued or made by or on behalf of the
bank.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Corporate seal

- **[[256]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-256 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank may adopt a corporate seal and change one that it adopted.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Validity of unsealed documents

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A document executed on behalf of a bank is not
  invalid merely because a corporate seal is not affixed to it.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 256
- 2005, c. 54, s. 54
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-256-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 256"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[257 to 264]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-257_to_264
.sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, 1997, c. 15, s. 30\]]{.Repealed}

#### [Insiders]{.HTitleText3} {#h-13683 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

- **[[265]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-265 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  this section and sections 266 to 272,

  [[affiliate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[affiliate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a body corporate that is
      affiliated with another body corporate within the meaning of
      subsection 6(2); ([groupe]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[business combination]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[business combination]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an acquisition
      of all or substantially all of the assets of one body corporate by
      another, an amalgamation of two or more bodies corporate or any
      similar reorganization between two or more bodies
      corporate; ([regroupement d'entreprises]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[call]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[call]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an option, transferable by
      delivery, to demand delivery of a specified number or amount of
      shares at a fixed price within a specified time but does not
      include an option or right to acquire shares of the body corporate
      that granted the option or right to acquire; ([option
      d'achat]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[distributing bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[distributing bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2005, c.
      54, s. 55\]]{.Repealed}

  [[insider]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[insider]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2005, c. 54, s.
      55\]]{.Repealed}

  [[officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a bank, means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an officer as defined in paragraph (a) of the
        definition [[officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in section 2, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any natural person who performs functions for
        the bank similar to those performed by a person referred to in
        paragraph (a) of the definition [[officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}
        in section 2; ([dirigeant d'une banque]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[put]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[put]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an option, transferable by
      delivery, to deliver a specified number or amount of shares at a
      fixed price within a specified time; ([option de
      vente]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a voting share and includes

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a security currently convertible into a voting
        share,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a currently exercisable option or a right to
        acquire a voting share or a security referred to in paragraph
        (a), and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a membership share. ([action]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Control

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section and sections 266 to
  272, a person controls a body corporate when the person controls the
  body corporate within the meaning of section 3, determined without
  regard to paragraph 3(1)(d).

- [(3) and (4)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2005, c. 54, s. 55\]]{.Repealed}

#### [Insider Reporting]{.HTitleText3} {#h-13705 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Insider report

**[[266]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-266 .sectionLabel}** An insider shall submit
an insider report in accordance with the regulations.

::: HistoricalNote

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption by Superintendent

**[[267]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-267 .sectionLabel}** On application by an
insider, the Superintendent may in writing and on any terms that the
Superintendent thinks fit exempt the insider from any of the
requirements of section 266. The exemption may be given retroactive
effect and the Superintendent shall publish the partic­ulars of the
exemption and the reasons for it in a periodical available to the
public.

#### [Insider Trading]{.HTitleText3} {#h-13723 .Subheading}

Meaning of [[insider]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

- **[[270]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-270 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  this section, [[insider]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means with respect to a
  distributing bank

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a director or officer of the bank;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a director or officer of a subsidiary of the bank;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a director or officer of a body corporate that
    enters into a business combination with the bank; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a person employed or retained by the bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- short sale

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No insider may knowingly sell, directly or
  indirectly, a security of a distributing bank or of any of the
  distributing bank's affiliates if the insider does not own or has not
  fully paid for the security.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (2), an insider may sell a
  security that they do not own if they own another security that is
  convertible into the security that was sold or they own an option or
  right to acquire the security that was sold, and if within 10 days
  after the sale they

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} exercise the conversion privilege, option or right
    and deliver the security so acquired to the purchaser; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} transfer the convertible security, option or right
    to the purchaser.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- calls and puts

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} No insider may knowingly, directly or indirectly, buy
  or sell a call or put in respect of a security of a bank or of any of
  the bank's affiliates.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 270
- 2005, c. 54, s. 57
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-270-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 270"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Civil remedies]{.HTitleText3} {#h-13741 .Subheading}

Extended meaning of [[insider]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

- **[[271]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-271 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  this section and sections 271.1 and 272,
  [[insider]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} with respect to a bank means

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bank;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an affiliate of the bank;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a director or officer of the bank or of any person
    described in paragraph (b), (d) or (f);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a person who beneficially owns directly or
    indirectly, or who exercises control or direction over or has a
    combination of ownership, control and direction in respect of,
    shares of the bank carrying more than the prescribed percentage of
    the voting rights attached to all of the bank's outstanding shares
    not including shares held by the person as underwriter while those
    shares are in the course of a distribution to the public;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a person, other than a person described in
    paragraph (f), who is employed or retained by the bank or by a
    person described in paragraph (f);

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a person who engages in or proposes to engage in
    any business or professional activity with or on behalf of the bank;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a person who received material confidential
    information concerning the bank while they were a person described
    in any of paragraphs (a) to (f);

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a person who receives material confidential
    information from a person who is and who they know or ought
    reasonably to have known is a person described in this subsection,
    including in this paragraph, or subsection (3) or (4); or

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed person.

- Extended meaning of [[insider]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} --- federal credit
  union

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} In addition to subsection (1), in this section and
  sections 271.1 and 272, [[insider]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} with respect
  to a bank that is a federal credit union means a member of the federal
  credit union who holds more than the prescribed percentage of the
  membership shares of the federal credit union.

- Extended meaning of [[security]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, each of the
  following is deemed to be a security of a bank:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a membership share of the bank, if the bank is a
    federal credit union;

  - [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} a put, call, option or other right or obligation
    to purchase or sell a security of the bank; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a security of another entity, the market price of
    which varies materially with the market price of the securities of
    the bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed insider --- take-over bid or
  business combination

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section and subsection
  271.1(1), a person who proposes to make a take-over bid as defined in
  the regulations for securities of a bank or to enter into a business
  combination with a bank is an insider of the bank with respect to
  material confidential information obtained from the bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed insider --- affiliate or
  associate

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} An insider of a person referred to in subsection (3),
  or the person's affiliate or associate, is an insider of the bank
  referred to in that subsection. Paragraphs (1)(b) to (i) apply in
  making this determination except that references to "bank" are to be
  read as references to "person described in subsection (3)".

- Meaning of [[associate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} In subsection (4), [[associate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}
  means with respect to a person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate that the person directly or
    indirectly controls, determined without regard to paragraph 3(1)(d),
    or of which they beneficially own shares or securities currently
    convertible into shares carrying more than 10% of the voting rights
    under all circumstances or by reason of the occurrence of an event
    that has occurred and is continuing or a currently exercisable
    option or right to purchase the shares or convertible securities;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a partner of the person acting on behalf of the
    partnership of which they are partners;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a trust or estate in which the person has a
    substantial beneficial interest or in respect of which they serve as
    a trustee or a liquidator of the succession or in a similar
    capacity;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a spouse or common-law partner of the person;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a child of the person or of their spouse or
    common-law partner; or

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} if that relative has the same residence as the
    person, a relative of the person or of their spouse or common-law
    partner.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Insider trading --- compensation to
  sellers and purchasers

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} An insider of a bank who purchases or sells a
  security of the bank with knowledge of confidential information that
  if it were generally known might reasonably be expected to materially
  affect the value of any of the securities of the bank is liable to
  compensate the seller or purchaser of the security, as the case may
  be, for any loss suffered by them as a result of the purchase or sale
  unless the insider establishes that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the insider reasonably believed that the
    information had been generally disclosed;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the information was known or ought reasonably to
    have been known by the seller or purchaser; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the purchase or sale of the security took place in
    the prescribed circumstances.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Insider trading --- compensation to
  bank

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} The insider is accountable to the bank for any
  benefit or advantage received or receivable by the insider as a result
  of a purchase or sale described in subsection (6) unless they
  establish the circumstances described in paragraph (6)(a).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 271
- 2005, c. 54, s. 57
- 2010, c. 12, s. 2017
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-271-20061128.html "Link to previous version of section 271"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Tipping --- compensation to sellers and
purchasers

- **[[271.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-271.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An insider of a bank who discloses
  confidential information with respect to the bank that has not been
  generally disclosed and that if it were generally known might
  reasonably be expected to materially affect the value of any of the
  securities of the bank is liable to compensate any person who
  subsequently sells securities of the bank to or purchases them from
  any person who received the information unless the insider establishes
  that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the insider reasonably believed that the
    information had been generally disclosed;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the information was known or ought reasonably to
    have been known by the person who alleges that they suffered the
    loss;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the insider is not a person described in
    subsection 271(3) or (4), the disclosure of the information was
    necessary in the course of their business; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} if the insider is a person described in subsection
    271(3) or (4), the disclosure of the information was necessary to
    effect the take-over bid or business combination.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Tipping --- compensation to bank

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The insider is accountable to the bank for any
  benefit or advantage received or receivable by them as a result of a
  disclosure of information as described in subsection (1) unless they
  establish the circumstances described in paragraph (1)(a), (c) or (d).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2005, c. 54, s. 57
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Measure of damages

- **[[272]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-272 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  court may assess damages under subsection 271(6) or 271.1(1) in
  accord­ance with any measure of damages that it considers relevant in
  the circumstances. However, in assessing damages in respect of a
  security of a distributing bank, the court shall consider the
  following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the plaintiff is a purchaser, the price that
    they paid for the security less the average market price of the
    security over the 20 trading days immediately following general
    disclosure of the information; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the plaintiff is a seller, the average market
    price of the security over the 20 trading days immediately following
    general disclosure of the information, less the price that they
    received for the security.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Liability --- more than one insider

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If more than one insider is liable under subsection
  271(6) or 271.1(1) with respect to the same transaction or series of
  transactions, their liability is joint and several, or solidary.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limitation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An action to enforce a right created by subsection
  271(6) or (7) or section 271.1 may be commenced only within two years
  after discovery of the facts that gave rise to the cause of action.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 272
- 2005, c. 54, s. 57
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-272-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 272"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Prospectus]{.HTitleText3} {#h-13804 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Distribution

- **[[273]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-273 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No
  person, including a bank, shall distribute securities of a bank that
  is not a federal credit union except in accordance with the
  regulations made under subsection (2).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  respecting the distribution of securities of a bank that is not a
  federal credit union, including

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting the information that is to be disclosed
    by such a bank before the distribution of any of its securities,
    including the information that is to be included in a prospectus;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} respecting the manner of disclosure and the form of
    the information that is to be disclosed; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} exempting any class of distribution of securities
    from the application of subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 273
- 2005, c. 54, s. 57
- 2012, c. 5, s. 9
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-273-20061128.html "Link to previous version of section 273"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Distribution --- federal credit union

- **[[273.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-273.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person, including a bank, shall
  distribute securities of a federal credit union except in accordance
  with the regulations made under subsection (2).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  respecting the distribution of securities of a federal credit union,
  including

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting the information that is to be disclosed
    by a federal credit union before the distribution of any of its
    securities, including the information that is to be included in a
    prospectus;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} respecting the manner of disclosure and the form of
    the information that is to be disclosed; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} exempting any class of distribution of securities
    from the application of subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2012, c. 5, s. 10
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order of exemption

- **[[274]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-274 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  application by a bank or any person proposing to make a distribution,
  the Superintendent may, by order, exempt that distribution from the
  application of any regulations made under subsection 273(2) or
  273.1(2) if the Superintendent is satisfied that the bank or federal
  credit union, as the case may be, has disclosed or is about to
  disclose, in compliance with the laws of the relevant jurisdiction,
  information relating to the distribution that in form and content
  substantially complies with the requirements of those regulations.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An order under subsection (1) may contain any
  conditions or limitations that the Superintendent deems appropriate.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 274
- 2005, c. 54, s. 57
- 2012, c. 5, s. 11
:::

Version](section-274-20061128.html "Link to previous version of section 274"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Going-private Transactions and Squeeze-out Transactions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-13832 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Going-private transactions

**[[275]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-275 .sectionLabel}** A bank may carry out a
going-private transaction if it complies with any applicable provincial
securities laws.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 275
- 1994, c. 26, s. 5(F)
- 1999, c. 31, s. 11
- 2005, c. 54, s. 57
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-275-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 275"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Squeeze-out transactions

**[[276]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-276 .sectionLabel}** No bank may carry out a
squeeze-out transaction unless, in addition to any approval by holders
of shares required by or under this Act or the bank's by-laws, the
transaction is approved by ordinary resolution of the holders of each
class of shares affected by the transaction, voting separately, whether
or not the shares otherwise carry the right to vote. However, the
following do not have the right to vote on the resolution:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} affiliates of the bank; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} holders of shares that following the squeeze-out
  transaction would be entitled to consideration of greater value or to
  superior rights or privileges than those available to other holders of
  shares of the same class.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 276
- 1999, c. 31, s. 12
- 2005, c. 54, s. 57
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-276-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 276"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Right to dissent

- **[[277]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-277 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  holder of shares of a bank may dissent if the bank resolves to carry
  out a going-private transaction or squeeze-out transaction that
  affects those shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment for shares

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In addition to any other right that the shareholder
  may have, but subject to subsection (25), a shareholder who complies
  with this section is, when the action approved by the resolution from
  which the shareholder dissents becomes effective, entitled to be paid
  by the bank the fair value of the shares in respect of which the
  shareholder dissents, determined as of the close of business on the
  day before the resolution was adopted by the shareholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No partial dissent

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A dissenting shareholder may claim under this section
  only with respect to all of the shares of a class held on behalf of
  any one beneficial owner and registered in the name of the dissenting
  shareholder.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Objection

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A dissenting shareholder shall send to the bank, at
  or before any meeting of shareholders at which a resolution referred
  to in subsection (2) is to be voted on by the shareholders, a written
  objection to the resolution unless the bank did not give notice to the
  shareholder of the purpose of the meeting and their right to dissent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice that resolution was adopted

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The bank shall within 10 days after the day on which
  the shareholders adopt the resolution send to each shareholder who
  sent an objection under subsection (4) notice that the resolution was
  adopted. If it is necessary for the Minister or Superintendent to
  approve the transaction within the meaning of subsection 973(1) before
  it becomes effective, the bank shall send notice within 10 days after
  the approval. Notice is not required to be sent to a shareholder who
  voted for the resolution or one who has withdrawn their objection.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Demand for payment

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} A dissenting shareholder shall within 20 days after
  receiving the notice referred to in subsection (5) --- or, if they do
  not receive it, within 20 days after learning that the resolution was
  adopted by the shareholders --- send to the bank a written notice
  containing

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} their name and address;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the number and class of shares in respect of which
    they dissent; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a demand for payment of the fair value of those
    shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Share certificates

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} A dissenting shareholder shall within 30 days after
  sending a notice under subsection (6) send the certificates
  representing the shares in respect of which they dissent to the bank
  or its transfer agent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Forfeiture

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} A dissenting shareholder who fails to comply with
  subsection (7) has no right to make a claim under this section.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Endorsing certificate

  [(9)]{.lawlabel} A bank or its transfer agent shall endorse on any
  share certificate received in accordance with subsection (7) a notice
  that the holder is a dissenting shareholder under this section and
  shall without delay return the share certificates to the dissenting
  shareholder.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Suspension of rights

  [(10)]{.lawlabel} On sending a notice under subsection (6), a
  dissenting shareholder ceases to have any rights as a shareholder
  other than to be paid the fair value of their shares as determined
  under this section. However, the shareholder's rights are reinstated
  as of the date the notice was sent if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the shareholder withdraws the notice before the
    bank makes an offer under subsection (11);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bank fails to make an offer in accordance with
    subsection (11) and the shareholder withdraws the notice; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the directors revoke under section 220 the special
    resolution that was made in respect of the going-private transaction
    or squeeze-out transaction.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Offer to pay

  [(11)]{.lawlabel} A bank shall, no later than seven days after the
  later of the day on which the action approved by the resolution from
  which the shareholder dissents becomes effective and the day on which
  the bank received the notice referred to in subsection (6), send to
  each dissenting shareholder who sent a notice

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a written offer to pay for their shares in an
    amount considered by the directors of the bank to be the fair value,
    accompanied by a statement showing how the fair value was
    determined; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if subsection (25) applies, a notice that it is
    unable to lawfully pay dissenting shareholders for their shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Same terms

  [(12)]{.lawlabel} Every offer made under subsection (11) for shares of
  the same class or series is to be on the same terms.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment

  [(13)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (25), a bank shall pay for the
  shares of a dissenting shareholder within 10 days after the day on
  which an offer made under subsection (11) is accepted, but the offer
  lapses if the bank does not receive an acceptance within 30 days after
  the day on which the offer is made.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Court may fix fair value

  [(14)]{.lawlabel} If a bank fails to make an offer under
  subsection (11) or if a dissenting shareholder fails to accept an
  offer, the bank may, within 50 days after the day on which the action
  approved by the resolution from which the shareholder dissents becomes
  effective or within any further period that a court may allow, apply
  to the court to fix a fair value for the shares of any dissenting
  shareholder.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shareholder application

  [(15)]{.lawlabel} If a bank fails to apply to a court under subsection
  (14), a dissenting shareholder may apply to a court for the same
  purpose within a further period of 20 days or within any further
  period that the court may allow.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Venue

  [(16)]{.lawlabel} An application under subsection (14) or (15) is to
  be made to a court having jurisdiction where the bank's head office is
  situated or, if the bank carries on business in the province in which
  the dissenting shareholder resides, in that province.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No security for costs

  [(17)]{.lawlabel} A dissenting shareholder is not required to give
  security for costs in an application made under subsection (14) or
  (15).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Parties and Superintendent

  [(18)]{.lawlabel} On an application to a court under subsection (14)
  or (15),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} all dissenting shareholders whose shares have not
    been purchased by the bank are to be joined as parties and are bound
    by the decision of the court;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bank shall notify each of them of the date,
    place and consequences of the application and their right to appear
    and be heard in person or by counsel; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the bank shall notify the Superintendent of the
    date and place of the application and the Superintendent may appear
    and be heard in person or by counsel.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Powers of court

  [(19)]{.lawlabel} On an application to a court under subsection (14)
  or (15), the court may determine whether any other person is a
  dissenting shareholder and is to be joined as a party and the court
  shall then fix a fair value for the shares of all dissenting
  shareholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appraisers

  [(20)]{.lawlabel} The court may appoint one or more appraisers to
  assist the court to fix a fair value for the shares of the dissenting
  shareholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Final order

  [(21)]{.lawlabel} The final order of the court is to be rendered
  against the bank in favour of each dissenting shareholder for the
  value of the shares as fixed by the court.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Interest

  [(22)]{.lawlabel} The court may allow a reasonable rate of interest on
  the amount payable to each dissenting shareholder from the date the
  action approved by the resolution from which the shareholder dissents
  becomes effective until the date of payment.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice that s. (25) applies

  [(23)]{.lawlabel} If subsection (25) applies, the bank shall within 10
  days after an order is made under subsection (21) notify each
  dissenting shareholder that it is unable to lawfully pay dissenting
  shareholders for their shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of s. (25)

  [(24)]{.lawlabel} If subsection (25) applies, a dissenting shareholder
  may by written notice delivered to the bank within 30 days after
  receiving notice under subsection (23)

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} withdraw their notice of dissent, in which case the
    bank is deemed to consent to the withdrawal and the shareholder is
    reinstated to their full rights as a shareholder; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} retain their status as a claimant against the bank,
    to be paid as soon as the bank is able to lawfully pay them or, in a
    liquidation, to be ranked subordinate to the rights of the bank's
    creditors but in priority to its shareholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limitation

  [(25)]{.lawlabel} A bank may not make a payment to a dissenting
  shareholder under this section if there are reasonable grounds for
  believing that the bank is or the payment would cause the bank to be
  in contravention of a regulation referred to in subsection 485(1)
  or (2) or of an order made under subsection 485(3).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 277
- 2005, c. 54, s. 57
:::

#### [Compulsory Acquisitions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-13914 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

- **[[283]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-283 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  this section and sections 284 to 293,

  [[affiliate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[affiliate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a body corporate that is
      affiliated with another body corporate within the meaning of
      subsection 6(2); ([groupe]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[associate of the offeror]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[associate of the offeror]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate that an offeror, directly or
        indirectly, controls, determined without regard to paragraph
        3(1)(d), or of which an offeror beneficially owns shares or
        securities currently convertible into shares carrying more than
        10 per cent of the voting rights under all circumstances or by
        reason of the occurrence of an event that has occurred and is
        continuing, or a currently exercisable option or right to
        purchase the shares or the convertible securities,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a partner of the offeror acting on behalf of
        the partnership of which they are partners,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a trust or estate in which the offeror has a
        substantial beneficial interest or in respect of which they
        serve as a trustee or a liquidator of the succession or in a
        similar capacity,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a spouse or common-law partner of the offeror,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a child of the offeror or of the offeror's
        spouse or common-law partner, or

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a relative of the offeror or of the offeror's
        spouse or common-law partner, if that relative has the same
        residence as the offeror; ([associé du
        pollicitant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[dissenting offeree]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[dissenting offeree]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a holder of a
      share who does not accept a take-over bid or a subsequent holder
      of the share who acquires it from the first-mentioned
      holder; ([pollicité opposant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[exempt offer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[exempt offer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2005, c. 54, s.
      58\]]{.Repealed}

  [[offeree]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[offeree]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person to whom a take-over
      bid is made; ([pollicité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[offeree bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[offeree bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a bank the shares of
      which are the object of a take-over bid; ([banque
      pollicitée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[offeror]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[offeror]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person, other than an
      agent, who makes a take-over bid, and includes two or more persons
      who, directly or indirectly,

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} make take-over bids jointly or in concert, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} intend to exercise jointly or in concert voting
        rights attached to shares for which a take-over bid is
        made; ([pollicitant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a share with or without voting
      rights and includes

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a security that is currently convertible into a
        share, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a currently exercisable option or right to
        acquire a share or a security referred to in paragraph
        (a); ([action]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[take-over bid]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[take-over bid]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an offer made by an
      offeror at approximately the same time to all of the shareholders
      of a distributing bank to acquire all of the shares of a class of
      issued shares, and includes an offer by a distributing bank to
      repurchase all of the shares of a class. ([offre d'achat visant à
      la mainmise]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Control

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section and sections 284 to
  293, a person controls a body corporate when the person controls the
  body corporate within the meaning of section 3, determined without
  regard to paragraph 3(1)(d).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Date of bid

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A take-over bid is deemed to be dated as of the date
  on which it is sent.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 283
- 2000, c. 12, s. 4
- 2005, c. 54, s. 58
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-283-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 283"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Right to acquire shares

**[[284]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-284 .sectionLabel}** If, within one hundred
and twenty days after the date of a take-over bid, the bid is accepted
by the holders of not less than 90 per cent of the shares of any class
of shares to which the take-over bid relates, other than shares held at
the date of the take-over bid by or on behalf of the offeror or an
affiliate or associate of the offeror, the offeror is entitled, on
complying with sections 285 to 290, subsections 291(1) and (2) and
section 292, to acquire the shares held by the dissenting offerees.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 284
- 2005, c. 54, s. 59(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-284-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 284"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Offeror's notice to dissenters

- **[[285]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-285 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  offeror may acquire shares held by a dissenting offeree by sending by
  registered mail within sixty days after the date of termination of the
  take-over bid and in any event within one hundred and eighty days
  after the date of the take-over bid, an offeror's notice to each
  dissenting offeree and to the Superintendent stating that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} offerees holding not less than 90 per cent of the
    shares of any class of shares to which the take-over bid relates,
    other than shares held at the date of the take-over bid by or on
    behalf of the offeror or an affiliate or associate of the offeror,
    have accepted the take-over bid;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the offeror is bound to take up and pay for or has
    taken up and paid for the shares of the offerees who accepted the
    take-over bid;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a dissenting offeree is required to elect

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} to transfer the dissenting offeree's shares to
      the offeror on the same terms on which the offeror acquired the
      shares from the offerees who accepted the take-over bid, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} to demand payment of the fair value of the
      dissenting offeree's shares in accordance with sections 289 to 292
      by notifying the offeror within twenty days after receipt of the
      offeror's notice;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a dissenting offeree who does not notify the
    offeror in accordance with paragraph 286(b) is deemed to have
    elected to transfer the shares to the offeror on the same terms on
    which the offeror acquired the shares from the offerees who accepted
    the take-over bid; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a dissenting offeree must send the dissenting
    offeree's shares to which the take-over bid relates to the offeree
    bank within twenty days after the dissenting offeree receives the
    offeror's notice.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of adverse claim

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Concurrently with sending the offeror's notice under
  subsection (1), the offeror shall send to the offeree bank a notice of
  adverse claim in accordance with subsection 129(1) with respect to
  each share held by a dissenting offeree.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 285
- 2005, c. 54, s. 60
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-285-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 285"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Share certificates and election

**[[286]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-286 .sectionLabel}** A dissenting offeree to
whom a notice is sent under subsection 285(1) shall within 20 days after
receiving the notice

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} send to the offeree bank the share certificates
  representing the shares to which the take-over bid relates; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} elect to transfer the shares to the offeror on the
  same terms as those on which the offeror acquired shares from the
  offerees who accepted the take-over bid or to demand payment of the
  fair value of the shares in accordance with sections 289 to 292 by
  notifying the offeror.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 286
- 2005, c. 54, s. 61
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-286-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 286"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed election

**[[286.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-286.1 .sectionLabel}** A dissenting
offeree who does not notify the offeror in accordance with paragraph
286(b) is deemed to have elected to transfer the shares to the offeror
on the same terms as those on which the offeror acquired shares from the
offerees who accepted the take-over bid.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2005, c. 54, s. 61
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment to offeree bank

- **[[287]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-287
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Within 20 days after the offeror
  sends a notice under subsection 285(1), the offeror shall pay the
  money, or transfer the other consideration, to the offeree bank that
  the offeror would have had to pay or transfer to a dissenting offeree
  if the dissenting offeree had elected to transfer their shares in
  accordance with paragraph 286(b).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Consideration in trust

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An offeree bank is deemed to hold in a fiduciary
  capacity for the dissenting offerees the money or other consideration
  it receives under subsection (1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deposit or custody

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An offeree bank shall deposit the money received
  under subsection (1) in a separate account in another deposit-taking
  financial institution in Canada and the offeree bank shall place any
  other consideration in the custody of another deposit-taking financial
  institution in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 287
- 2005, c. 54, s. 62
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-287-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 287"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Fiduciary capacity of bank

**[[287.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-287.1 .sectionLabel}** A bank that is
making a take-over bid to repurchase all of the shares of a class is
deemed to hold in a fiduciary capacity for the dissenting shareholders
the money that it would have had to pay, and the other consideration
that it would have had to transfer, to a dissenting offeree if the
dissenting offeree had elected to transfer their shares in accordance
with paragraph 286(b). The bank shall within 20 days after a notice is
sent under subsection 285(1) deposit the money in a separate account in
another deposit-taking financial institution in Canada and place any
other consideration in the custody of another deposit-taking financial
institution in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2005, c. 54, s. 63
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty of offeree bank

**[[288]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-288 .sectionLabel}** Within thirty days
after an offeror sends an offeror's notice under subsection 285(1), the
offeree bank shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the payment or transfer required by subsection
  287(1) is made, issue to the offeror a share certificate in respect of
  the shares that were held by the dissenting offerees;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} give to each dissenting offeree who elects to
  transfer shares under paragraph 286(b) and who sends the share
  certificates as required under paragraph 286(a) the money or other
  consideration to which they are entitled, disregarding fractional
  shares, which may be paid for in money; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the payment or transfer required by subsection
  287(1) is made and the money or other consideration is deposited as
  required by subsections 287(2) and (3) or by section 287.1, send to
  each dissenting offeree who has not sent share certificates as
  required under paragraph 286(a) a notice stating that

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} their shares have been cancelled,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the offeree bank or its designated person holds in
    a fiduciary capacity for that offeree the money or other
    consideration to which they are entitled as payment for or in
    exchange for the shares, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the offeree bank will, subject to sections 289 to
    292, send that money or other consideration to that offeree without
    delay after receiving the share certificates.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 288
- 2005, c. 54, s. 64
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-288-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 288"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Court may fix fair value

- **[[289]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-289 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  dissenting offeree has elected to demand payment of the fair value of
  their shares under paragraph 286(b), the offeror may, within 20 days
  after it has paid the money or transferred the other consideration
  under subsection 287(1), apply to a court to fix the fair value of the
  shares of that dissenting offeree.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Idem

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If an offeror fails to apply to a court under
  subsection (1), a dissenting offeree may apply to a court for the same
  purpose within a further period of twenty days.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Venue

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An application under subsection (1) or (2) shall be
  made to a court having jurisdiction in the place at which the head
  office of the bank is situated or in the province in which the
  dissenting offeree resides if the bank carries on business in that
  province.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No security for costs

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A dissenting offeree is not required to give security
  for costs in an application made under subsection (1) or (2).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 289
- 2005, c. 54, s. 65
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-289-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 289"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Parties and notice

**[[290]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-290 .sectionLabel}** On an application under
subsection 289(1) or (2),

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} all dissenting offerees who have made elections to
  demand payment under paragraph 286(b) and whose shares have not been
  acquired by the offeror shall be joined as parties and are bound by
  the decision of the court; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the offeror shall notify each affected dissenting
  offeree of the date, place and consequences of the application and of
  the dissenting offeree's right to appear and be heard in person or by
  counsel at the hearing of the application.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 290
- 2005, c. 54, s. 66
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-290-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 290"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Powers of court

- **[[291]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-291 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  an application to a court under subsection 289(1) or (2), the court
  may determine whether any other person is a dissenting offeree who
  should be joined as a party, and the court shall then fix a fair value
  for the shares of all dissenting offerees.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appraisers

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A court may in its discretion appoint one or more
  appraisers to assist the court in fixing a fair value for the shares
  of a dissenting offeree.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Final order

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The final order of a court shall be made against the
  offeror in favour of each dissenting offeree and for the amount for
  each dissenting offeree's shares as fixed by the court.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional powers of court

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} In connection with proceedings under subsection
  289(1) or (2), a court may make any order it thinks fit and, without
  limiting the generality of the foregoing, may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} fix the amount of money or other consideration that
    is deemed to be held in a fiduciary capacity under subsection 287(2)
    or section 287.1;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} order that the money or other consideration is to
    be held in trust by a person other than the offeree bank;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} allow a reasonable rate of interest on the amount
    payable to each dissenting offeree from the date the dissenting
    offeree sends the share certificates required under section 286
    until the date of payment; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} order that any money payable to a shareholder who
    cannot be found is to be paid to the Minister.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 291
- 2005, c. 54, s. 67
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-291-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 291"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Status of dissenter

**[[292]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-292 .sectionLabel}** Where no application is
made to a court under subsection 289(2) within the period set out in
that subsection, a dissenting offeree is deemed to have elected to
transfer the dissenting offeree's shares to the offeror on the same
terms on which the offeror acquired the shares from the offerees who
accepted the take-over bid.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Obligation to acquire shares

- **[[292.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-292.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a shareholder who holds shares of
  an offeree bank does not receive the notice referred to in subsection
  285(1), the shareholder may require the offeror to acquire the shares

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} within 90 days after the date of termination of the
    take-over bid; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the shareholder did not receive an offer under
    the take-over bid, within 90 days after the later of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the date of termination of the take-over bid, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the day on which the shareholder learned of the
      take-over bid.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Acquisition on same terms

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the shareholder requires the offeror to acquire
  shares, the offeror shall acquire them on the same terms as those on
  which the offeror acquires shares from offerees who accept the
  take-over bid.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2005, c. 54, s. 68
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment of unclaimed money

**[[293]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-293 .sectionLabel}** The Minister shall pay
to the Bank of Canada any amounts paid to the Minister under subsection
291(4), and section 367 applies in respect thereof as if the amounts
paid under subsection 291(4) had been paid under subsection 366(3).

#### [Trust Indentures]{.HTitleText3} {#h-14041 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[294]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-294 .sectionLabel}** In this section and
sections 295 to 306,

[[event of default]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[event of default]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in relation to a
    trust indenture, an event specified in the trust indenture on the
    occurrence of which the principal, interest and other moneys payable
    thereunder become or may be declared to be payable before maturity,
    but the event is not an event of default until all the conditions
    set out in the trust indenture in connection with the giving of
    notice of the event have been satisfied or the period of time for
    giving the notice has elapsed; ([cas de défaut]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[issuer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[issuer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a bank that has issued, is
    about to issue or is in the process of issuing subordinated
    indebtedness; ([émetteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[trustee]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[trustee]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any person appointed as
    trustee under the terms of a trust indenture to which a bank is a
    party, and includes any successor
    trustee; ([fiduciaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[trust indenture]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[trust indenture]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any deed, indenture or
    other instrument, including any supplement or amendment thereto,
    made by a bank under which the bank issues subordinated indebtedness
    and in which a person is appointed as trustee for the holders of the
    subordinated indebtedness issued thereunder. ([acte de
    fiducie]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

**[[295]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-295 .sectionLabel}** Sections 296 to 306
apply in respect of a trust indenture if the subordinated indebtedness
issued or to be issued under the trust indenture is part of a
distribution to the public.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption

**[[296]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-296 .sectionLabel}** The Superintendent may,
in writing, exempt a trust indenture from the application of sections
297 to 306 if, in the Superintendent's opinion, the trust indenture and
the subordinated indebtedness are subject to a law of a province or
other jurisdiction, other than Canada, that is substantially equivalent
to the provisions of this Act relating to trust indentures.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conflict of interest

- **[[297]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-297 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No
  person shall be appointed as trustee if at the time of the appointment
  there is a material conflict of interest between the person's role as
  trustee and any other role of the person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Eliminating conflict of interest

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A trustee shall, within ninety days after the trustee
  becomes aware that a material conflict of interest exists,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} eliminate the conflict of interest; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} resign from office.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Validity despite conflict

**[[298]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-298 .sectionLabel}** A trust indenture and
any subordinated indebtedness issued thereunder are valid
notwithstanding a material conflict of interest of the trustee.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Removal of trustee

**[[299]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-299 .sectionLabel}** If a trustee is
appointed in contravention of subsection 297(1) or if a trustee
contravenes subsection 297(2), any interested person may apply to a
court for an order that the trustee be replaced, and the court may make
an order on such terms as it thinks fit.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Trustee qualifications

**[[300]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-300 .sectionLabel}** A trustee, or at least
one of the trustees if more than one is appointed, must be

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a trust company pursuant to subsection 57(2) of the
  [Trust and Loan Companies Act](/eng/acts/T-19.8); or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate that is incorporated by or under an
  Act of the legislature of a province and authorized to carry on
  business as a trustee.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, ss. 300, 577
- 2007, c. 6, s. 18
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-300-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 300"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}List of security holders

- **[[301]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-301 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  holder of subordinated indebtedness issued under a trust indenture
  may, on payment to the trustee of a reasonable fee and on delivery of
  a statutory declaration to the trustee, require the trustee to
  provide, within fifteen days after the delivery to the trustee of the
  statutory declaration, a list setting out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the names and addresses of the registered holders
    of the outstanding subordinated indebtedness,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the principal amount of outstanding subordinated
    indebtedness owned by each such holder, and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate principal amount of subordinated
    indebtedness outstanding

  as shown on the records maintained by the trustee on the day the
  statutory declaration is delivered to that trustee.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty of issuer

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On the demand of a trustee, the issuer of
  subordinated indebtedness shall provide the trustee with the
  information required to enable the trustee to comply with subsection
  (1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Where applicant is entity

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where the person requiring the trustee to provide a
  list under subsection (1) is an entity, the statutory declaration
  required under that subsection shall be made by a director or an
  officer of the entity or a person acting in a similar capacity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of statutory declaration

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The statutory declaration required under
  subsection (1) must state

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the person requiring the
    trustee to provide the list and, if the person is an entity, the
    address for service thereof; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that the list will not be used except as permitted
    by subsection (5).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Use of list

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} No person shall use a list obtained under this
  section except in connection with

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an effort to influence the voting of the holders of
    subordinated indebtedness;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an offer to acquire subordinated indebtedness; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any other matter relating to the subordinated
    indebtedness or the affairs of the issuer or guarantor thereof.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Compliance with trust indentures

- **[[302]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-302 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  issuer or a guarantor of subordinated indebtedness issued or to be
  issued under a trust indenture shall, before undertaking

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the issue, certification and delivery of
    subordinated indebtedness under the trust indenture, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the satisfaction and discharge of the trust
    indenture,

  provide the trustee with evidence of compliance with the conditions in
  the trust indenture in respect thereof.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Compliance by issuer or guarantor

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On the demand of a trustee, the issuer or guarantor
  of subordinated indebtedness issued or to be issued under a trust
  indenture shall provide the trustee with evidence of compliance with
  the conditions in the trust indenture by the issuer or guarantor in
  respect of any act to be done by the trustee at the request of the
  issuer or guarantor.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Evidence of compliance

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The following documents constitute evidence of
  compliance for the purposes of subsections (1) and (2):

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statutory declaration or certificate made by a
    director or an officer of the issuer or guarantor stating that the
    conditions referred to in subsections (1) and (2) have been complied
    with;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an opinion of legal counsel that the conditions of
    the trust indenture requiring review by legal counsel have been
    complied with, if the trust indenture requires compliance with
    conditions that are subject to review by legal counsel; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an opinion or report of the auditors of the issuer
    or guarantor, or such other accountant as the trustee selects, that
    the conditions of the trust indenture have been complied with, if
    the trust indenture requires compliance with conditions that are
    subject to review by auditors.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Further evidence of compliance

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The evidence of compliance referred to in
  subsection (3) shall include a statement by the person giving the
  evidence

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} declaring that the person has read and understands
    the conditions of the trust indenture referred to in subsections (1)
    and (2);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} describing the nature and scope of the examination
    or investigation on which the person based the certificate,
    statement or opinion; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} declaring that the person has made such examination
    or investigation as the person believes necessary to enable the
    statements to be made or the opinions contained or expressed therein
    to be given.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Trustee may require evidence

- **[[303]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-303 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  the request of a trustee, the issuer or guarantor of subordinated
  indebtedness issued under a trust indenture shall provide the trustee
  with evidence in such form as the trustee requires of compliance with
  any condition thereof relating to any action required or permitted to
  be taken by the issuer or guarantor under the trust indenture.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Certificate of compliance

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} At least once in each twelve month period beginning
  on the date of the trust indenture and at any other time on the demand
  of a trustee, the issuer or guarantor of subordinated indebtedness
  issued under a trust indenture shall provide the trustee with a
  certificate stating that the issuer or guarantor has complied with all
  requirements contained in the trust indenture that, if not complied
  with, would, with the giving of notice, lapse of time or otherwise,
  constitute an event of default, or, if there has been failure to so
  comply, giving particulars thereof.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of default

**[[304]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-304 .sectionLabel}** A trustee shall, within
thirty days after the trustee becomes aware of the occurrence thereof,
give to the holders of subordinated indebtedness issued under a trust
indenture notice of every event of default arising under the trust
indenture and continuing at the time the notice is given, unless the
trustee believes on reasonable grounds that it is in the best interests
of the holders of the subordinated indebtedness to withhold the notice
and so informs the issuer and guarantor in writing.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty of care

- **[[305]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-305 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  exercising a trustee's powers and discharging a trustee's duties, the
  trustee shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} act honestly and in good faith with a view to the
    best interests of the holders of the subordinated indebtedness
    issued under the trust indenture; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} exercise the care, diligence and skill of a
    reasonably prudent trustee.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reliance on statements

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1), a trustee is not
  liable if the trustee relies in good faith on statements contained in
  a statutory declaration, certificate, opinion or report that complies
  with this Act or the trust indenture.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No exculpation

**[[306]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-306 .sectionLabel}** No term of a trust
indenture or of any agreement between a trustee and the holders of
subordinated indebtedness issued thereunder or between the trustee and
the issuer or guarantor operates to relieve a trustee from the duties
imposed on the trustee by sections 297, 301 and 304 and subsection
305(1).

### [Financial Statements and Auditors]{.HTitleText2} {#h-14123 .Subheading}

#### [Annual Financial Statement]{.HTitleText3} {#h-14124 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Financial year

- **[[307]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-307 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  financial year of a bank ends, at the election of the bank in its
  by-laws, on the expiration of the thirty-first day of October or the
  thirty-first day of December in each year.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}First financial year

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a bank, after the first day of July in any year,
  obtains an order approving the commencement and carrying on of
  business, the first financial year of the bank ends, at the election
  of the bank in its by-laws, on the expiration of the thirty-first day
  of October or the thirty-first day of December in the next calendar
  year.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), the financial year of a bank
  named in Schedule I as that Schedule read immediately before the day
  section 184 of the [Financial Consumer Agency of Canada
  Act](/eng/acts/F-11.1) comes into force ends on the expiration of the
  thirty-first day of October in each year unless the bank elects in its
  by-laws to have its financial year end on the thirty-first day of
  December in each year.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 307
- 2001, c. 9, s. 91
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Annual financial statement

- **[[308]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-308 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  directors of a bank must place before the shareholders or members, as
  the case may be, at every annual meeting

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a comparative annual financial statement (in this
    Act referred to as an "annual statement") relating separately to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the financial year immediately preceding the
      meeting, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the financial year, if any, immediately
      preceding the financial year referred to in subparagraph (i);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the report of the auditor or auditors of the bank;
    and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any further information respecting the financial
    position of the bank and the results of its operations required by
    the by-laws of the bank to be placed before the shareholders or
    members at the annual meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Annual statement --- contents

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} With respect to each of the financial years to which
  it relates, the annual statement of a bank must contain the prescribed
  statements and any information that is in the opinion of the directors
  necessary to present fairly, in accord­ance with the accounting
  principles referred to in subsection (4), the financial position of
  the bank as at the end of the financial year to which it relates and
  the results of the operations and changes in the financial position of
  the bank for that financial year.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional information

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A bank shall include with its annual statement

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a list of the subsidiaries of the bank, other than
    subsidiaries that are not required to be listed by the regulations
    and subsidiaries acquired pursuant to section 472 or pursuant to a
    realization of security in accordance with section 473 and which the
    bank would not otherwise be permitted to hold, showing, with respect
    to each subsidiary,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its name and the address of its head or principal
      office,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the book value of the aggregate of any shares of
      the subsidiary beneficially owned by the bank and by other
      subsidiaries of the bank, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the percentage of the voting rights attached to
      all the outstanding voting shares of the subsidiary that is
