[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reasonable opportunity to make
representations

- **[[400]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-400 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If,
  after receipt of the notice referred to in paragraph 399(1)(b), the
  applicant advises the Minister that the applicant wishes to make
  representations, the Minister must provide the applicant with a
  reasonable opportunity within a period of thirty days after the date
  of the notice, or within any further period that may be agreed on by
  the applicant and the Minister, to make representations in respect of
  the matter.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reasonable opportunity to make
  representations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If, after receipt of the notice sent in accordance
  with subsection 399(2) that the Minister is not satisfied that the
  transaction to which the application relates should be approved, the
  applicant advises the Minister that the applicant wishes to make
  representations, the Minister must provide the applicant with a
  reasonable opportunity within a period of 45 days after the date of
  the notice, or within any further period that may be agreed on by the
  applicant and the Minister, to make representations in respect of the
  matter.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 400
- 1994, c. 47, s. 21
- 2001, c. 9, s. 98
- 2012, c. 31, s. 115(E)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-400-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 400"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of decision

- **[[401]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Within a period of thirty days after
  the expiration of the period for making representations referred to in
  subsection 400(1), the Minister shall, in the light of any such
  representations and having regard to the matters to be taken into
  account, send a notice to the applicant indicating whether or not the
  Minister approves the transaction to which the application relates.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of decision

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Within a period of forty-five days after the
  expiration of the period for making representations referred to in
  subsection 400(2), the Minister shall, in the light of any such
  representations and having regard to the matters to be taken into
  account, send a notice to the applicant indicating whether or not the
  Minister approves the transaction to which the application relates.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 401
- 1994, c. 47, s. 22
- 2001, c. 9, s. 98
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed approval

**[[401.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.1 .sectionLabel}** If the Minister
does not send a notice under subsection 399(1) or (3) or 401(1) within
the period provided for in those subsections, the Minister is deemed to
have approved the transaction to which the application relates.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 98
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Federal credit union constraints

**[[401.11]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.11 .sectionLabel}** Subject to this
Act, a federal credit union may by by-law impose, change or remove
restrictions on the issue, transfer or ownership of its membership
shares, or shares of any class of the shares of the federal credit
union, in order to prevent a person from having a significant interest
in the membership shares or shares of that class.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2010, c. 12, s. 2070
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Constraining registration: Crown and
foreign governments

- **[[401.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No bank is to record in its
  securities register or members register a transfer or issue of any
  share or membership share of the bank to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} Her Majesty in right of Canada or of a province or
    any agent or agency of Her Majesty in either of those rights; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the government of a foreign country or any
    political subdivision of a foreign country, or any agent or agency
    of a foreign government.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), a bank may record in its
  securities register or members register a transfer or issue of any
  share or membership share of the bank to a foreign bank, or to a
  foreign institution, that is controlled by the government of a foreign
  country or any political subdivision of a foreign country, or by any
  agent or agency of a foreign government, if the share or membership
  share that is transferred or issued is beneficially owned by the
  foreign bank or foreign institution or by an entity controlled by the
  foreign bank or foreign institution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Certain foreign banks excluded

  [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not permit a bank to record in
  its securities register or members register a transfer or issue of any
  share or membership share of the bank to a foreign bank that is a
  foreign bank by reason only of paragraph (f) of the definition
  [[foreign bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in section 2.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), a bank may, with the
  Minister's approval, record in its securities register the issue of
  any share of the bank to an eligible agent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application made jointly

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The application for the approval referred to in
  subsection (3) must be made jointly by the bank and the eligible
  agent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Matters for consideration

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The Minister, in determining whether to grant the
  approval referred to in subsection (3), shall take into account all
  matters that he or she considers relevant, including those set out in
  paragraphs 396(1)(a) to (h).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Consequence of revocation of approval

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} If an approval referred to in subsection (3) is
  revoked, the bank shall delete any entry in its securities register in
  respect of the recording of the issuance of shares to the eligible
  agent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disposition of shareholdings

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} If a bank or an eligible agent fails to comply with
  any undertaking or term or condition in relation to an approval
  referred to in subsection (3), or if an eligible agent ceases to be an
  eligible agent, the Minister may, if the Minister considers it to be
  in the public interest to do so, by order, direct the eligible agent
  or former eligible agent and any person controlled by the eligible
  agent or former eligible agent to dispose of any number of shares of
  the bank beneficially owned by the eligible agent or former eligible
  agent or the persons controlled by the eligible agent or former
  eligible agent that the Minister specifies in the order, within the
  time specified in the order and in the proportion, if any, as between
  the eligible agent or former eligible agent and the persons controlled
  by the eligible agent or former eligible agent that is specified in
  the order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Representations

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} No direction shall be made under subsection (7)
  unless the Minister has provided each person to whom the direction
  relates and the bank concerned with a reasonable opportunity to make
  representations in respect of the subject-matter of the direction.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appeal

  [(9)]{.lawlabel} Any person with respect to whom a direction has been
  made under subsection (7) may, within 30 days after the date of the
  direction, appeal the matter in accordance with section 977.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 98
- 2010, c. 12, s. 2071
- 2012, c. 5, ss. 32, 223, c. 19, s. 333, c. 31, ss. 116, 154
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-401.2-20121214.html "Link to previous version of section 401.2"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Suspension of voting rights held by
governments

- **[[401.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.3
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite section 148, no person
  shall, in person or by proxy, exercise any voting rights attached to
  any share of a bank that is beneficially owned by

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} Her Majesty in right of Canada or of a province or
    any agency of Her Majesty in either of those rights; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the government of a foreign country or any
    political subdivision thereof, or any agency thereof.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Suspension of voting rights held by
  governments

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection 79.2(2), a member of a federal
  credit union must not, in person or by delegate, vote as a member of
  the federal credit union if the member is, or is an entity controlled
  by,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} Her Majesty in right of Canada or of a province or
    any agency of Her Majesty in either of those rights; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the government of a foreign country or any
    political subdivision thereof, or any agency thereof.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) and (2) do not apply to a foreign
  bank, or to a foreign institution, that is controlled by the
  government of a foreign country or any political subdivision of a
  foreign country, or by any agent or agency of a foreign government, if
  the share referred to in subsection (1), or, in the case of a federal
  credit union, a membership share, is beneficially owned by the foreign
  bank or foreign institution or by an entity controlled by the foreign
  bank or foreign institution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- eligible agent

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of the
  exercise of voting rights attached to any share referred to in
  subsection 401.2(3).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Consequence of suspension of approval

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} If an approval referred to in subsection 401.2(3) is
  suspended, the eligible agent shall not exercise, in person or by
  proxy, any voting rights attached to any share of the bank that is
  beneficially owned by the eligible agent.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 98
- 2010, c. 12, s. 2072
- 2012, c. 5, ss. 33, 223, c. 19, ss. 334, 348, c. 31, ss. 117, 155
:::

### [DIVISION V]{.HLabel2}[Directions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-15252 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disposition

- **[[402]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-402 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If,
  with respect to any bank, a person contravenes section 372 or
  subsection 373(1), 374(1) or 375(1) or section 376.1 or 376.2,
  subsection 377(1) or section 377.1 or 377.2 or fails to comply with an
  undertaking referred to in subsection 390(2) or with any terms and
  conditions imposed under section 397, the Minister may, if the
  Minister considers it in the public interest to do so, by order,
  direct that person and any person controlled by that person to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} dispose of any number of shares of the bank
    beneficially owned by any of those persons that the Minister
    specifies in the order, within the time specified in the order and
    in the proportion, if any, as between the person and the persons
    controlled by that person that is specified in the order;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} dispose of any number of membership shares of the
    bank beneficially owned by any of those persons that the Minister
    specifies in the order, within the time specified in the order and
    in the proportion, if any, as between the person and the persons
    controlled by that person that is specified in the order; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} take any other action that is necessary for any of
    those persons to cease controlling, within the meaning of paragraph
    3(1)(a.1), the federal credit union.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Representations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No direction shall be made under subsection (1)
  unless the Minister has provided each person to whom the direction
  relates and the bank concerned with a reasonable opportunity to make
  representations in respect of the subject-matter of the direction.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appeal

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Any person with respect to whom a direction has been
  made under subsection (1) may, within thirty days after the date of
  the direction, appeal the matter in accordance with section 977.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2001, c. 9, s. 99\]]{.Repealed}

- 1991, c. 46, s. 402
- 1999, c. 28, s. 21
- 2001, c. 9, s. 99
- 2010, c. 12, s. 2073
- 2012, c. 31, s. 153(E)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-402-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 402"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Permission to become another body
corporate

**[[402.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-402.1 .sectionLabel}** If subsection
402(1) applies, the Minister may, on application by the bank, permit the
bank to apply to be continued as a body corporate under any Act of
Parliament referred to in subsection 39.1(1) or 39.2(1) instead of, or
in addition to, issuing an order under subsection 402(1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 579
- 2007, c. 6, s. 22
- 2010, c. 12, s. 2074
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-402.1-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 402.1"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disposition --- threat to integrity or
security

- **[[402.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-402.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister is of the opinion
  that a person's holding or beneficial ownership of shares or
  membership shares of a bank poses a threat to the integrity or
  security of the bank or the financial system in Canada or a threat to
  national security, the Minister may, by order, direct that person and
  any person controlled by that person to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} dispose of any number of shares of the bank held or
    beneficially owned by any of the persons that the Minister specifies
    in the order, within the time specified in the order and in the
    proportion, if any, as between the person and the persons controlled
    by the person that is specified in the order; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} dispose of any number of membership shares of the
    bank held or beneficially owned by any of the persons that the
    Minister specifies in the order, within the time specified in the
    order and in the proportion, if any, as between the person and the
    persons controlled by the person that is specified in the order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Suspension of rights

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A direction made under subsection (1) may also
  suspend any of the rights under Part VI attached to the shares
  referred to in paragraph (1)(a) or the membership shares referred to
  in paragraph (1)(b) until the shares or membership shares are disposed
  of in accordance with the direction.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Representations

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} No direction shall be made under subsection (1)
  unless the Minister has provided each person to whom the direction
  relates and the bank concerned with a reasonable opportunity to make
  representations.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Temporary direction

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If, in the Minister's opinion, the length of time
  required for representations to be made under subsection (3) might be
  prejudicial to the public interest, the Minister may make a temporary
  direction to suspend any of the rights under Part VI attached to any
  of the shares referred to in paragraph (1)(a) or the membership shares
  referred to in paragraph (1)(b).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Cessation of effect

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A temporary direction ceases to have effect on the
  earlier of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the expiry of 30 days after the day on which it
    takes effect or of a shorter period that is specified in the
    temporary direction, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if a direction is made under subsection (1) in
    respect of the shares or membership shares, the day on which that
    direction takes effect.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appeal

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} Any person with respect to whom a direction has been
  made under subsection (1) may, within 30 days after the day on which
  the direction was made, appeal the matter in accordance with section
  977.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice --- Committee and Review Agency

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} If a direction has been made under subsection (1)
  or (4) for reasons related to national security, the Minister shall,
  within 30 days after the day on which the direction was made, notify

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the [[Committee]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined
    in section 2 of the [National Security and Intelligence Committee of
    Parliamentarians Act](/eng/acts/N-16.6); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the [[Review Agency]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as
    defined in section 2 of the [National Security and Intelligence
    Review Agency Act](/eng/acts/N-16.62).

::: HistoricalNote
- [2023, c. 26, s. 541](#1410955-1415387){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1410955-1415387.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application to court

- **[[403]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-403 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  person fails to comply with a direction made under subsection
  401.2(7), 402(1) or 402.2(1), an application on behalf of the Minister
  may be made to a court for an order to enforce the direction.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Court order

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A court may, on an application under subsection (1),
  make any order that the circumstances require to give effect to the
  terms of the direction, including requiring the bank concerned to sell
  the shares, or to redeem, purchase or transfer to another member the
  membership shares, that are the subject-matter of the direction.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appeal

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An appeal from an order of a court under this section
  lies in the same manner as, and to the same court to which, an appeal
  may be taken from any other order of the court.

- 1991, c. 46, s. 403

  ajax-after="1410957-1415389.html"}
:::

#### [General Provisions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-15279 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Interest of securities underwriter

**[[404]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-404 .sectionLabel}** This Part does not
apply to a securities underwriter in respect of shares of a body
corporate or ownership interests in an unincorporated entity that are
acquired by the underwriter in the course of a distribution to the
public of those shares or ownership interests and that are held by the
underwriter for a period of not more than six months.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Arrangements to effect compliance

- **[[405]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-405 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  directors of a bank may make such arrangements as they deem necessary
  to carry out the intent of this Part and, in particular, but without
  limiting the generality of the foregoing, may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} require any person in whose name a share or
    membership share of the bank is held to submit a declaration setting
    out

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the beneficial ownership of the share or
      membership share, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any other information that the directors
      consider relevant for the purposes of this Part;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} require any person who wishes to have a transfer of
    a share or membership share registered in the name of, or to have a
    share or membership share issued to, that person to submit a
    declaration referred to in paragraph (a) as though the person were
    the holder of that share or membership share; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} determine the circumstances in which a declaration
    referred to in paragraph (a) is to be required, the form of the
    declaration and the times at which it is to be submitted.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order of Superintendent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may, by order, direct a bank to
  obtain from any person in whose name a share or membership share of
  the bank is held a declaration setting out the name of every entity
  controlled by that person and containing information concerning

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the ownership or beneficial ownership of the share
    or membership share; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} such other related matters as are specified by the
    Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Compliance required

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} As soon as possible after receipt by a bank of a
  direction under subsection (2),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bank shall comply with the direction; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} every person who is requested by the bank to
    provide a declaration containing information referred to in
    subsection (1) or (2) shall comply with the request.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Outstanding declaration: effect

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If, under this section, a declaration is required to
  be submitted by a shareholder, member or other person in respect of
  the issue or transfer of any share or membership share, a bank may
  refuse to issue the share or membership share or register the transfer
  unless the required declaration is submitted.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 405
- 2010, c. 12, s. 2076
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-405-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 405"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reliance on information

**[[406]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406 .sectionLabel}** A bank and any person
who is a director or an officer, employee or agent of the bank may rely
on any information contained in a declaration required by the directors
pursuant to section 405 or on any information otherwise acquired in
respect of any matter that might be the subject of such a declaration,
and no action lies against the bank or any such person for anything done
or omitted to be done in good faith in reliance on any such information.

**[[407]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-407 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, 1994, c.
47, s. 23\]]{.Repealed}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}[Competition Act](/eng/acts/C-34)

**[[408]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-408 .sectionLabel}** Nothing in, or done
under the authority of, this Act affects the operation of the
[Competition Act](/eng/acts/C-34).

## [PART VIII]{.HLabel1}[Business and Powers]{.HTitleText1} {#h-15307 .Part}

### [General Business]{.HTitleText2} {#h-15308 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Main business

- **[[409]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-409
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to this Act, a bank shall
  not engage in or carry on any business other than the business of
  banking and such business generally as appertains thereto.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Idem

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, the business of banking
  includes

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} providing any financial service;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} acting as a financial agent;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} providing investment counselling services and
    portfolio management services; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} issuing payment, credit or charge cards and, in
    cooperation with others including other financial institutions,
    operating a payment, credit or charge card plan.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 409
- 2009, c. 2, s. 269(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-409-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 409"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional activities

- **[[410]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-410 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  addition, a bank may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} hold, manage and otherwise deal with real property;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide prescribed bank-related data processing
    services;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} outside Canada or, with the prior written approval
    of the Minister, in Canada, engage in any of the following
    activities, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} collecting, manipulating and transmitting

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} information that is primarily financial or
        economic in nature,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} information that relates to the business of a
        permitted entity, as defined in subsection 464(1), or

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} any other information that the Minister may, by
        order, specify,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} providing advisory or other services in the
      design, development or implementation of information management
      systems,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} designing, developing or marketing computer
      software, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} designing, developing, manufacturing or selling,
      as an ancillary activity to any activity referred to in any of
      subparagraphs (i) to (iii) that the bank is engaging in, computer
      equipment integral to the provision of information services
      related to the business of financial institutions or to the
      provision of financial services;

  - [(c.1)]{.lawlabel} with the prior written approval of the Minister,
    develop, design, hold, manage, manufacture, sell or otherwise deal
    with data transmission systems, information sites, communication
    devices or information platforms or portals that are used

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} to provide information that is primarily
      financial or economic in nature,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} to provide information that relates to the
      business of a permitted entity, as defined in subsection 464(1),
      or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} for a prescribed purpose or in prescribed
      circumstances;

  - [(c.2)]{.lawlabel} engage, under prescribed terms and conditions, if
    any are prescribed, in specialized business management or advisory
    services;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} promote merchandise and services to the holders of
    any payment, credit or charge card issued by the bank;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} engage in the sale of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} tickets, including lottery tickets, on a
      non-profit public service basis in connection with special,
      temporary and infrequent non-commercial celebrations or projects
      that are of local, municipal, provincial or national interest,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} urban transit tickets, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} tickets in respect of a lottery sponsored by
      the federal government or a provincial or municipal government or
      an agency of any such government or governments;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} act as a custodian of property;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} act as receiver, liquidator or sequestrator; and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} provide identification, authentication or
    verification services.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Except as authorized by or under this Act, a bank
  shall not deal in goods, wares or merchandise or engage in any trade
  or other business.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting what a bank may or may not do with
    respect to the carrying on of the activities referred to in
    paragraphs (1)(c) to (c.2);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} imposing terms and conditions in respect of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the provision of financial services referred to
      in paragraph 409(2)(a) that are financial planning services,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the provision of services referred to in
      paragraph 409(2)(c), and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the carrying on of the activities referred to
      in any of paragraphs (1)(c) to (c.2); and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} respecting the circumstances in which banks may be
    exempted from the requirement to obtain the approval of the Minister
    before carrying on a particular activity referred to in paragraph
    (1)(c) or (c.1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 410
- 1993, c. 34, s. 8(F)
- 1997, c. 15, s. 42
- 2001, c. 9, s. 100

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Networking

- **[[411]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-411
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 416, a bank may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} act as agent for any person in respect of the
    provision of any service that is provided by a financial
    institution, a permitted entity as defined in subsection 464(1) or a
    prescribed entity and may enter into an arrangement with any person
    in respect of the provision of that service; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} refer any person to any such financial institution
    or entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  respecting the disclosure of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the principal for whom a bank is acting
    as agent pursuant to subsection (1); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} whether any commission is being earned by a bank
    when acting as agent pursuant to subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 411
- 2001, c. 9, s. 101
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on fiduciary activities

**[[412]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-412 .sectionLabel}** No bank shall act in
Canada as

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} an executor, administrator or official guardian or a
  guardian, tutor, curator, judicial adviser or committee of a mentally
  incompetent person; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a trustee for a trust.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on deposit taking

- **[[413]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-413 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank shall not accept deposits in Canada unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is a member institution, as defined in section 2
    of the [Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation Act](/eng/acts/C-3);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it has been authorized under subsection 26.03(1) of
    that Act to accept deposits without being a member institution, as
    defined in section 2 of that Act; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the order approving the commencement and carrying
    on of business by the bank authorizes it to accept deposits solely
    in accordance with subsection (3).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2001, c. 9, s. 102\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deposits that fall below \$150,000

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A bank referred to in paragraph (1)(b) or (c) shall
  ensure that, on each day that is at least 30 days after the bank
  receives the authorization referred to in that paragraph,

  ::: {#15382 .Subsection}
  A/B ≤ 0.01

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the sum of all amounts each of which is the sum of all the
      deposits held by the bank at the end of a day in the preceding 30
      days each of which deposits is less than \$150,000 and payable in
      Canada; and

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the sum of all amounts each of which is the sum of all deposits
      held by the bank at the end of a day in those preceding 30 days
      and payable in Canada.
  :::

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exchange rate

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (3), the rate of
  exchange that shall be applied on any day in determining the amount in
  Canadian dollars of a deposit in a currency of a country other than
  Canada shall be determined in accordance with rules prescribed under
  subsection 26.03(2) of the [Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation
  Act](/eng/acts/C-3).

- Definition of [[deposit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (3),
  [[deposit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning that would be given to
  it by the schedule to the [Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation
  Act](/eng/acts/C-3) for the purposes of deposit insurance if that
  schedule were read without reference to subsections 2(2), (5) and (6)
  of that schedule, but does not include prescribed deposits.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} prescribing the deposits referred to in subsection
    (5); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} prescribing terms and conditions with respect to
    the acceptance of those deposits.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 413
- 1997, c. 15, s. 43
- 1999, c. 28, s. 21.1
- 2001, c. 9, s. 102
- 2007, c. 6, s. 23
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deposits less than \$150,000

- **[[413.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-413.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the regulations, a bank
  referred to in paragraph 413(1)(b) or (c) may not, in respect of its
  business in Canada, act as agent for any person in the taking of a
  deposit that is less than \$150,000 and payable in Canada.

- Meaning of [[deposit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[deposit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has
  the meaning assigned to that term by subsection 413(5).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  respecting the circumstances in which, and the conditions under which,
  a bank referred to in subsection (1) may act as agent for any person
  in the taking of a deposit that is less than \$150,000 and payable in
  Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 104
- 2007, c. 6, s. 25
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shared premises

- **[[413.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-413.3
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the regulations, no bank
  referred to in paragraph 413(1)(b) or (c) shall carry on business in
  Canada on premises that are shared with those of a member institution,
  within the meaning of section 2 of the [Canada Deposit Insurance
  Corporation Act](/eng/acts/C-3), that is affiliated with the bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limitation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) only applies in respect of premises or
  any portion of premises on which both the bank and the member
  institution carry on business with the public and to which the public
  has access.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Adjacent premises

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the regulations, no bank referred to in
  paragraph 413(1)(b) or (c) shall carry on business in Canada on
  premises that are adjacent to a branch or office of a member
  institution, within the meaning of section 2 of the [Canada Deposit
  Insurance Corporation Act](/eng/acts/C-3), that is affiliated with the
  bank, unless the bank clearly indicates to its customers that its
  business and the premises on which it is carried on are separate and
  distinct from the business and premises of the affiliated member
  institution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting the circumstances in which, and the
    conditions under which, a bank referred to in paragraph 413(1)(b)
    or (c) may carry on business in Canada on premises that are shared
    with those of a member institution referred to in subsection (1);
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} respecting the circumstances in which, and the
    conditions under which, a bank referred to in paragraph 413(1)(b)
    or (c) may carry on business in Canada on premises that are adjacent
    to a branch or office of a member institution referred to in
    subsection (3).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 104
- 2007, c. 6, s. 26
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-413.3-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 413.3"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on guarantees

- **[[414]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-414 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank shall not guarantee on behalf of any person the payment or
  repayment of any sum of money unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the sum of money is a fixed sum of money with or
    without interest thereon; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the person on whose behalf the bank has undertaken
    to guarantee the payment or repayment has an unqualified obligation
    to reimburse the bank for the full amount of the payment or
    repayment to be guaranteed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(a) does not apply where the person on
  whose behalf the bank has undertaken to guarantee the payment or
  repayment is a subsidiary of the bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations imposing
  terms and conditions in respect of guarantees permitted by this
  section.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 414
- 1997, c. 15, s. 44
- 2001, c. 9, s. 105
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on securities activities

**[[415]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-415 .sectionLabel}** A bank shall not deal
in Canada in securities to the extent prohibited or restricted by such
regulations as the Governor in Council may make for the purposes of this
section.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition

- **[[415.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-415.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited for a bank to issue
  a debt obligation in relation to which the amounts of principal and
  interest owing are guaranteed to be paid from loans or other assets
  held by an entity that is created and organized for the principal
  purpose of holding those loans or other assets and with the intention
  of legally isolating those loans or other assets from the bank, unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the debt obligation is a covered bond as defined in
    section 21.5 of the [National Housing Act](/eng/acts/N-11);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bank is a registered issuer as defined in
    section 21.5 of that Act other than one whose right to issue covered
    bonds has been suspended; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the debt obligation is issued under a registered
    program as defined in section 21.5 of that Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  exempting any type of debt obligation from the application of
  subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2012, c. 19, s. 362
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Derivatives and eligible financial
contracts --- regulations

- **[[415.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-415.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make
  regulations respecting a bank's activities in relation to derivatives
  and eligible financial contracts.

- Definition of [[derivative]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[derivative]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}
  means an option, swap, futures contract, forward contract or other
  financial or commodity contract or instrument whose market price,
  value, delivery obligations, payment obligations or settlement
  obligations are derived from, referenced to or based on an underlying
  interest, including a price, rate, index, value, variable, event,
  probability or thing.

- Definition of [[eligible financial contract]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[eligible financial
  contract]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in subsection
  39.15(9) of the [Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation
  Act](/eng/acts/C-3).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 20, s. 210
- 2016, c. 7, s. 157
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-415.2-20140619.html "Link to previous version of section 415.2"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Benchmarks  --- regulations

- **[[415.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-415.3
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make
  regulations respecting a bank's activities in relation to benchmarks.

- Definition of [[benchmark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[benchmark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}
  means a price, estimate, rate, index or value that is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} determined from time to time by reference to an
    assessment of one or more underlying interests;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} made available to the public, either free of charge
    or on payment; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} used for reference for any purpose, including

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} determining the interest payable, or other sums
      that are due, under loan agreements or other financial contracts
      or instruments,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} determining the value of financial instruments
      or the price at which they may be bought or sold, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} measuring the performance of financial
      instruments.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 20, s. 210
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on insurance business

- **[[416]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-416 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank shall not undertake the business of insurance except to the
  extent permitted by this Act or the regulations.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on acting as agent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank shall not act in Canada as agent for any
  person in the placing of insurance and shall not lease or provide
  space in any branch in Canada of the bank to any person engaged in the
  placing of insurance.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  respecting the matters referred to in subsection (1) and regulations
  respecting relations between banks and

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} entities that undertake the business of insurance;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} insurance agents or insurance brokers.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Saving

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Nothing in this section precludes a bank from

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} requiring insurance to be placed by a borrower for
    the security of the bank; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} obtaining group insurance for its employees or the
    employees of any bodies corporate in which it has a substantial
    investment pursuant to section 468.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 1997, c. 15, s. 45\]]{.Repealed}

- Definition of [[business of insurance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[business of
  insurance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the issuance of any annuity if the liability in
    respect of the annuity is contingent on the death of a person; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the issuance of any debt obligation, any of whose
    terms and conditions are established on the basis of mortality
    considerations, under which the issuer is obliged to make periodic
    payments.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 416
- 1997, c. 15, s. 45
- 2012, c. 19, s. 206
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-416-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 416"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on leasing

**[[417]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-417 .sectionLabel}** A bank shall not engage
in Canada in any personal property leasing activity in which a financial
leasing entity, as defined in subsection 464(1), is not permitted to
engage.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 417
- 2001, c. 9, s. 106
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on residential mortgages

- **[[418]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-418 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank shall not make a loan in Canada on the security of residential
  property in Canada for the purpose of purchasing, renovating or
  improving that property, or refinance such a loan, if the amount of
  the loan, together with the amount then outstanding of any mortgage
  having an equal or prior claim against the property, would exceed 80
  per cent of the value of the property at the time of the loan.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a loan made or guaranteed under the [National
    Housing Act](/eng/acts/N-11) or any other Act of Parliament by or
    pursuant to which a different limit on the value of property on the
    security of which the bank may make a loan is established;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a loan if repayment of the amount of the loan that
    exceeds the maximum amount set out in subsection (1) is guaranteed
    or insured by a government agency or a private insurer approved by
    the Superintendent;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the acquisition by the bank from an entity of
    securities issued or guaranteed by the entity that are secured on
    any residential property, whether in favour of a trustee or
    otherwise, or the making of a loan by the bank to the entity against
    the issue of such securities; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a loan secured by a mortgage where

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the mortgage is taken back by the bank on a
      property disposed of by the bank, including where the disposition
      is by way of a realization of a security interest, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the mortgage secures payment of an amount
      payable to the bank for the property.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 418
- 1997, c. 15, s. 46
- 2007, c. 6, s. 27
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-418-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 418"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on charges to borrowers

- **[[418.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-418.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to any regulations made
  under subsection (2), a bank that has obtained insurance or a
  guarantee against default on a loan made in Canada on the security of
  residential property shall not charge a borrower an amount for the
  insurance or guarantee that exceeds the actual cost to the bank of the
  insurance or guarantee.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting the determination of the actual cost to
    a bank for the purposes of subsection (1);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} respecting the circumstances in which a bank is
    exempt from the application of subsection (1);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} respecting, in relation to insurance or a guarantee
    against default on a loan made by a bank in Canada on the security
    of residential property,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the arrangements into which the bank and any
      affiliates that it controls, and the representatives and the
      employees of each, may or may not enter, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the payments or benefits that the bank and any
      affiliates that it controls, and the representatives and the
      employees of each, may or may not accept from an insurer or the
      insurer's affiliates; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} respecting any other matters necessary to carry out
    the purposes of subsection (1).

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 27, s. 320\]]{.Repealed}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Policies re security interests

- **[[419]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-419 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  directors of a bank shall establish and the bank shall adhere to
  policies regarding the creation of security interests in property of
  the bank to secure obligations of the bank and the acquisition by the
  bank of beneficial interests in property that is subject to security
  interests.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order to amend policies

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may, by order, direct a bank to
  amend its policies as specified in the order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Compliance

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A bank shall comply with an order made under
  subsection (2) within the time specified in the order.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 419
- 2001, c. 9, s. 107
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-419-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 419"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations and guidelines

**[[419.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-419.1 .sectionLabel}** The Governor in
Council may make regulations and the Superintendent may make guidelines
respecting the creation by a bank of security interests in its property
to secure obligations of the bank and the acquisition by the bank of
beneficial interests in property that is subject to security interests.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 107
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

**[[419.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-419.2 .sectionLabel}** Sections 419 and
419.1 do not apply in respect of a security interest created by a bank
to secure an obligation of the bank to the Bank of Canada or the Canada
Deposit Insurance Corporation.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 107
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on receivers

**[[420]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-420 .sectionLabel}** A bank shall not grant
to a person the right to appoint a receiver or a receiver and manager of
the property or business of the bank.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on partnerships

- **[[421]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-421
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Except with the approval of the
  Superintendent, a bank may not be a general partner in a limited
  partnership or a partner in a general partnership.

- Meaning of [[general partnership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), [[general
  partnership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any partnership other than a
  limited partnership.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 421
- 2001, c. 9, s. 108
:::

- **[[422]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-422
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2001, c. 9, s.
  109\]]{.Repealed}

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 1993, c. 44, s. 27\]]{.Repealed}

Definition of [[non-WTO Member bank subsidiary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

**[[422.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-422.1 .sectionLabel}** In section 422.2,
[[non-WTO Member bank subsidiary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a bank that
is a subsidiary of a foreign bank and that is not controlled by a WTO
Member resident.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1993, c. 44, s. 28
- 1994, c. 47, s. 24
- 1999, c. 28, s. 22
- 2001, c. 9, s. 110
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limitation on branches in Canada of
non-WTO Member bank subsidiaries

**[[422.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-422.2 .sectionLabel}** No non-WTO Member
bank subsidiary shall have any branch in Canada, other than its head
office and one branch, without the approval of the Minister.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1993, c. 44, s. 28
- 1999, c. 28, s. 22
:::

#### [Special Security]{.HTitleText3} {#h-15576 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

- **[[425]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-425 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purposes of sections 426 to 436,

  [[agricultural equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[agricultural equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means implements,
      apparatus, appliances and machinery of any kind usually affixed to
      real property, for use on a farm, but does not include a farm
      electric system; ([installations agricoles]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"} ou [matériel agricole immobilier]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[agricultural implements]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[agricultural implements]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means tools,
      implements, apparatus, appliances and machines of any kind not
      usually affixed to real property, for use on or in connection with
      a farm, and vehicles for use in the business of farming and,
      without restricting the generality of the foregoing, includes
      plows, harrows, drills, seeders, cultivators, mowing machines,
      reapers, binders, threshing machines, combines, leaf tobacco tying
      machines, tractors, movable granaries, trucks for carrying
      products of agriculture, equipment for bee-keeping, cream
      separators, churns, washing machines, spraying apparatus, portable
      irrigation apparatus, incubators, milking machines, refrigerators
      and heating and cooking appliances for farming operations or use
      in the farm home of a kind not usually affixed to real
      property; ([instruments agricoles]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
      [matériel agricole mobilier]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[aquacultural electric system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aquacultural electric system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means all
      machinery, apparatus and appliances for the generation or
      distribution of electricity in an aquaculture operation, whether
      or not affixed to real property; ([installation électrique
      aquicole]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[aquacultural equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aquacultural equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means implements,
      apparatus, appliances and machinery of any kind usually affixed to
      real property for use in an aquaculture operation, but does not
      include an aquacultural electric system; ([installations
      aquicoles]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [matériel aquicole
      immobilier]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[aquacultural implements]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aquacultural implements]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means tools,
      implements, apparatus, appliances and machines of any kind not
      usually affixed to real property, for use in an aquaculture
      operation, and includes net pen systems, vehicles and boats for
      use in aquaculture; ([instruments aquicoles]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"} ou [matériel aquicole mobilier]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[aquacultural stock growing or produced in the aquaculture operation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aquacultural stock growing or produced in the aquaculture
      operation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means all products of the
      aquaculture operation; ([stock en croissance ou produits de
      l'exploitation aquicole]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[aquaculture]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aquaculture]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the cultivation of
      aquatic plants and animals; ([aquiculture]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[aquaculture operation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aquaculture operation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any premises
      or site where aquaculture is carried out; ([exploitation
      aquicole]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[aquaculturist]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aquaculturist]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes the owner,
      occupier, landlord and tenant of an aquaculture
      operation; ([aquiculteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[aquatic broodstock]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aquatic broodstock]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any aquatic
      plants and animals used to produce aquatic seedstock; ([stock
      géniteur aquicole]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[aquatic plants and animals]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aquatic plants and animals]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means plants
      and animals that, at most stages of their development or life
      cycles, live in an aquatic environment; ([organismes animaux et
      végétaux aquatiques]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[aquatic seedstock]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aquatic seedstock]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means aquatic plants and
      animals that at any stage of their development are purchased or
      collected by an aquaculturist for cultivation; ([stock aquicole de
      départ]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[bill of lading]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[bill of lading]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes all receipts for
      goods, wares and merchandise accompanied by an undertaking

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} to move the goods, wares and merchandise from
        the place where they were received to some other place, by any
        means whatever, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to deliver to a place other than the place
        where the goods, wares and merchandise were received a like
        quantity of goods, wares and merchandise of the same or a
        similar grade or kind; ([connaissement]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[crops growing or produced on the farm]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[crops growing or produced on the
      farm]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means all products of the
      farm; ([récoltes sur pied ou produites à la
      ferme]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[farm]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[farm]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means land in Canada used for the
      purpose of farming, which term includes livestock raising,
      dairying, bee-keeping, fruit growing, the growing of trees and all
      tillage of the soil; ([ferme]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[farm electric system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[farm electric system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means all machinery,
      apparatus and appliances for the generation or distribution of
      electricity on a farm whether or not affixed to real
      property; ([installation électrique de ferme]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[farmer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[farmer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes the owner, occupier,
      landlord and tenant of a farm; ([agriculteur]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[fish]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fish]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes shellfish, crustaceans and
      marine animals; ([poisson]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[fisherman]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fisherman]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person whose business
      consists in whole or in part of
      fishing; ([pêcheur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[fishing]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fishing]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means fishing for or catching fish
      by any method; ([pêche]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[fishing equipment and supplies]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fishing equipment and supplies]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
      equipment, apparatus, appliances and supplies for use in the
      operation of a fishing vessel and not forming part thereof, or for
      use in fishing, and, without restricting the generality of the
      foregoing, includes detachable engines and machinery, lines,
      hooks, trawls, nets, anchors, traps, bait, salt, fuel and
      stores; ([engins et fournitures de pêche]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[fishing vessel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fishing vessel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any ship or boat or
      any other description of vessel for use in fishing and equipment,
      apparatus and appliances for use in the operation thereof and
      forming part thereof, or any share or part interest
      therein; ([bateau de pêche]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[forest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[forest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means land in Canada covered with
      timber stands or that, formerly so covered, is not put to any use
      inconsistent with forestry, and includes a sugar
      bush; ([forêt]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[forestry]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[forestry]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the conservation,
      cultivation, improvement, harvesting and rational utilization of
      timber stands and the resources contained therein and obtainable
      therefrom, and includes the operation of a sugar
      bush; ([sylviculture]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[forestry equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[forestry equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means implements,
      apparatus, appliances and machinery of any kind usually affixed to
      real property, for use in a forest; ([matériel sylvicole
      immobilier]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[forestry implements]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[forestry implements]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means tools,
      implements, apparatus, appliances and machines of any kind not
      usually affixed to real property, for use in forestry, and
      includes vehicles for use in forestry; ([matériel sylvicole
      mobilier]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[forestry producer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[forestry producer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person whose
      business consists in whole or in part of forestry and includes a
      producer of maple products; ([sylviculteur]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[goods, wares and merchandise]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[goods, wares and merchandise]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes
      products of agriculture, products of aquaculture, products of the
      forest, products of the quarry and mine, products of the sea,
      lakes and rivers, and all other articles of commerce; ([effets,
      denrées ou marchandises]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[grain]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[grain]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes wheat, oats, barley, rye,
      corn, buckwheat, flax, beans and all kinds of
      seeds; ([grain]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[hydrocarbons]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[hydrocarbons]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means solid, liquid and
      gaseous hydrocarbons and any natural gas whether consisting of a
      single element or of two or more elements in chemical combination
      or uncombined and, without restricting the generality of the
      foregoing, includes oil-bearing shale, tar sands, crude oil,
      petroleum, helium and hydrogen
      sulphide; ([hydrocarbures]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[livestock]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[livestock]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} horses and other equines,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} cattle, sheep, goats and other ruminants, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} swine, poultry, bees and fur-bearing
        animals; ([bétail]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[manufacturer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[manufacturer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any person who
      manufactures or produces by hand, art, process or mechanical means
      any goods, wares and merchandise and, without restricting the
      generality of the foregoing, includes a manufacturer of logs,
      timber or lumber, maltster, distiller, brewer, refiner and
      producer of petroleum, tanner, curer, packer, canner, bottler and
      a person who packs, freezes or dehydrates any goods, wares and
      merchandise; ([fabricant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[minerals]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[minerals]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes base and precious
      metals, coal, salt and every other substance that is an article of
      commerce obtained from the earth by any method of extraction, but
      does not include hydrocarbons or any animal or vegetable substance
      other than coal; ([substances minérales]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[products of agriculture]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[products of agriculture]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} grain, hay, roots, vegetables, fruits, other
        crops and all other direct products of the soil, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} honey, livestock (whether alive or dead), dairy
        products, eggs and all other indirect products of the
        soil; ([produits agricoles]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[products of aquaculture]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[products of aquaculture]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes all
      cultivated aquatic plants and animals; ([produits
      aquicoles]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[products of the forest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[products of the forest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} logs, pulpwood, piling, spars, railway ties,
        poles, pit props and all other timber,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} boards, laths, shingles, deals, staves and all
        other lumber, bark, wood chips and sawdust and Christmas trees,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} skins and furs of wild animals, and

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} maple products; ([produits de la
        forêt]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[products of the quarry and mine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[products of the quarry and mine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes
      stone, clay, sand, gravel, metals, ores, coal, salt, precious
      stones, metalliferous and non-metallic minerals and hydrocarbons,
      whether obtained by excavation, drilling or otherwise; ([produits
      des carrières et des mines]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[products of the sea, lakes and rivers]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[products of the sea, lakes and
      rivers]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes fish of all kinds, marine
      and freshwater organic and inorganic life and any substances
      extracted or derived from any water, but does not include products
      of aquaculture; ([produits aquatiques]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[unperfected]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[unperfected]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a security
      interest, means that the security interest has not been registered
      in a public register maintained under the law under which the
      security interest is created, or has not been perfected or
      published by any other means recognized by that law, where the
      registration or other means of perfection or publication would
      have made the security interest effective against third parties or
      would have determined priorities in rank in respect of rights in,
      on or in respect of the property that is subject to the security
      interest; ([non parfaite]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[warehouse receipt]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[warehouse receipt]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any receipt given by any person for goods,
        wares and merchandise in the person's actual, visible and
        continued possession as bailee thereof in good faith and not as
        the owner thereof,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} receipts given by any person who is the owner
        or keeper of a harbour, cove, pond, wharf, yard, warehouse,
        shed, storehouse or other place for the storage of goods, wares
        and merchandise, for goods, wares and merchandise delivered to
        the person as bailee, and actually in the place or in one or
        more of the places owned or kept by the person, whether or not
        that person is engaged in other business,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} receipts given by any person in charge of logs
        or timber in transit from timber limits or other lands to the
        place of destination of the logs or timber,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} Lake Shippers' Clearance Association receipts
        and transfer certificates, British Columbia Grain Shippers'
        Clearance Association receipts and transfer certificates, and
        all documents recognized by the [Canada Grain
        Act](/eng/acts/G-10) as elevator receipts, and

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} receipts given by any person for any
        hydrocarbons received by the person as bailee, whether the
        person's obligation to restore requires delivery of the same
        hydrocarbons or may be satisfied by delivery of a like quantity
        of hydrocarbons of the same or a similar grade or
        kind. ([récépissé d'entrepôt]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Interpretation --- products and
  by-products

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of sections 426 to 436, each thing
  included in the following terms as defined in subsection (1), namely,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} [[aquacultural stock growing or produced in the
    aquaculture operation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm},

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} [[crops growing or produced on the
    farm]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm},

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} [[livestock]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm},

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} [[products of agriculture]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm},

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} [[products of aquaculture]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm},

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} [[products of the forest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm},

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} [[products of the quarry and
    mine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} [[products of the sea, lakes and
    rivers]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm},

  comprises that thing in any form or state and any part thereof and any
  product or by-product thereof or derived therefrom.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Loans on hydrocarbons and minerals

- **[[426]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-426 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank may lend money and make advances on the security of any or all of
  the following, namely,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} hydrocarbons or minerals in, under or on the
    ground, in place or in storage,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the rights, licences or permits of any person to
    obtain and remove any such hydrocarbons or minerals and to enter on,
    occupy and use lands from or on which any of such hydrocarbons or
    minerals are or may be extracted, mined or produced,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the estate or interest of any person in or to any
    such hydrocarbons or minerals, rights, licences, permits and lands
    whether the estate or interest is entire or partial, and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the equipment and casing used or to be used in
    extracting, mining or producing or seeking to extract, mine or
    produce, and storing any such, hydrocarbons or minerals,

  or of any rights or interests in or to any of the foregoing whether
  the security be taken from the borrower or from a guarantor of the
  liability of the borrower or from any other person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Security

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Security under this section may be given by signature
  and delivery to the bank, by or on behalf of the person giving the
  security, of an instrument in the prescribed form or in a form to the
  like effect, and shall affect the property described in the instrument
  giving the security

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} of which the person giving the security is the
    owner at the time of the delivery of the instrument, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} of which that person becomes the owner at any time
    thereafter before the release of the security by the bank, whether
    or not the property is in existence at the time of the delivery,

  all of which property is for the purposes of this Act property covered
  by the security.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Rights under security

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Any security given under this section vests in the
  bank, in addition to and without limitation of any other rights or
  powers vested in or conferred on it, full power, right and authority,
  through its officers, employees or agents, in the event of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} non-payment of any loan or advance as security for
    the payment of which the bank has taken the security, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} failure to care for, maintain, protect or preserve
    the property covered by the security,

  to do all or any of the following, namely, take possession of, seize,
  care for, maintain, use, operate and, subject to the provisions of any
  other Act and any regulations made under any other Act governing the
  ownership and disposition of the property that is the subject of the
  security, sell the property covered by the security or part thereof as
  it sees fit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Liability to account for surplus

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where a bank exercises any right conferred on it by
  subsection (3) in relation to property given to it as security, the
  bank shall provide to the person entitled thereto any surplus proceeds
  resulting from the exercise of the right that remain after payment of
  all loans and advances, together with interest and expenses, in
  relation to which the property was given as security.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of sale

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A sale pursuant to subsection (3) of any property
  given to a bank as security vests in the purchaser all the right and
  title in and to such property that the person giving the security had
  when the security was given and that that person thereafter acquired.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sale to be by public auction

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} Unless a person by whom property was given to a bank
  as security has agreed otherwise, a sale pursuant to subsection (3)
  shall be made by public auction after

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} notice of the time and place of the sale has been
    sent by registered mail to the recorded address of the person by
    whom the property was given as security at least ten days prior to
    the sale; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} publication of an advertisement of the sale, at
    least two days prior to the sale, in at least two newspapers
    published in or nearest to the place where the sale is to be made.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Priority of bank's rights

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (8), (9) and (10), all the
  rights and powers of a bank in respect of the property covered by
  security given under this section have priority over all rights
  subsequently acquired in, on or in respect of the property and also
  over the claim of any mechanics' lien holder, of any unpaid vendor of
  equipment or casing or of any person who had a security interest in
  that property that was unperfected at the time the bank acquired its
  security in the property.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(7.1)]{.lawlabel} The priority referred to in subsection (7) does not
  extend over the claim of any unpaid vendor who had a lien on the
  equipment or casing, or of any person who has a security interest in
  the property that was unperfected at the time the bank acquired its
  security in the property, if the bank acquired its security with
  knowledge of that unpaid vendor's lien or that other person's security
  interest.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Idem

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} The rights and powers of a bank in respect of the
  property covered by security given under this section do not have
  priority over an interest or a right acquired in, on or in respect of
  the property unless, prior to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the registration of such interest or right, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the registration or filing of the deed or other
    instrument evidencing such interest or right, or of a caution,
    caveat or memorial in respect thereof,

  there has been registered or filed in the proper land registry or land
  titles office or office in which are recorded the rights, licences or
  permits referred to in this section,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an original of the instrument giving the security,

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a copy of the instrument giving the security,
    certified by an officer or employee of the bank to be a true copy,
    or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a caution, caveat or memorial in respect of the
    rights of the bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Procedure for registering

  [(9)]{.lawlabel} Every registrar or officer in charge of the proper
  land registry or land titles or other office to whom a document
  mentioned in paragraph (8)(c), (d) or (e) is tendered shall register
  or file the document according to the ordinary procedure for
  registering or filing within that office documents that evidence liens
  or charges against, or cautions, caveats or memorials in respect of
  claims to, interests in or rights in respect of any such property and
  subject to payment of the like fees.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(10)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (8) and (9) do not apply if the law of
  the appropriate province does not permit the registration or filing of
  the tendered document or if any law enacted by or under the authority
  of Parliament, governing the ownership and disposal of the property
  that is the subject of security given under this section, does not
  provide by specific reference to this section for the registration or
  filing of the tendered document.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Further security

  [(11)]{.lawlabel} When making a loan or an advance on the security
  provided for by this section, a bank may take, on any property covered
  by the security, any further security it sees fit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Substitution of security

  [(12)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding anything in this Act, where the bank
  holds any security covering hydrocarbons or minerals, it may take in
  lieu of that security, to the extent of the quantity covered by the
  security taken, any security covering or entitling it to the delivery
  of the same hydrocarbons or minerals or hydrocarbons or minerals of
  the same or a similar grade or kind.
