[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

- **[[508]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-508 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This
  Part applies to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a foreign bank that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is a bank according to the laws of the
      jurisdiction under whose laws it was incorporated or in any
      jurisdiction in which it carries on business,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} engages in the business of providing financial
      services and employs, to identify or describe its business, a name
      that includes the word "bank", "[banque]{.otherLang lang="fr"}",
      "banking" or "[bancaire]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", either alone or
      in combination with other words, or any word or words in any
      language other than English or French corresponding generally to
      any of those words, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} is regulated as a bank or as a deposit-taking
      institution according to the jurisdiction under whose laws it was
      incorporated or in any jurisdiction in which it carries on
      business; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is associated with a foreign bank
    and that is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a member of a material banking group,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} controlled by a foreign bank described in any of
      subparagraphs (a)(i) to (iii), or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} associated with a foreign bank described in any
      of subparagraphs (a)(i) to (iii) and that foreign bank or any
      entity controlled by that foreign bank is

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} engaging in or carrying on business in Canada,
        other than holding, managing or otherwise dealing with real
        property,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} maintaining a branch in Canada, other than an
        office referred to in section 522,

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} establishing, maintaining or acquiring for use
        in Canada an automated banking machine, a remote service unit or
        a similar automated service, or, in Canada, accepting data from
        such a machine, unit or service other than in circumstances
        described in section 511 or 512,

      - [(D)]{.lawlabel} acquiring or holding control of, or a
        substantial investment in, a Canadian entity, or

      - [(E)]{.lawlabel} acquiring or holding any share or ownership
        interest in a Canadian entity and

        - [(I)]{.lawlabel} an entity associated with the foreign bank
          holds control of, or a substantial investment in, the Canadian
          entity, or

        - [(II)]{.lawlabel} the foreign bank, an entity associated with
          the foreign bank and one or more other entities associated
          with the foreign bank would, if they were one person, hold
          control of, or a substantial investment in, the Canadian
          entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Member of a material banking group

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, an entity is a
  member of a material banking group if either of the following ratios,
  expressed as a percentage, is equal to or greater than the percentage
  prescribed for the purpose of this subsection:

  ::: {#17353 .Subsection}
  A/B or C/D

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the sum of the total assets of all foreign banks described in
      any of subparagraphs (1)(a)(i) to (iii) with which the entity is
      associated, other than the total assets of foreign banks described
      in any of those subparagraphs whose assets are consolidated into
      the total assets of any foreign bank described in any of those
      subparagraphs with which the entity is associated;

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is
      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the entity is not controlled by any person,
        the total assets of the entity, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, the sum of the total assets
        of the entity and of all its affiliates, other than entities
        whose total assets are consolidated into the total assets of an
        affiliate of the entity;

  [C]{.dfn}
  :   is the sum of the total revenue of all foreign banks described in
      any of subparagraphs (1)(a)(i) to (iii) with which the entity is
      associated, other than the total revenue of foreign banks
      described in any of those subparagraphs whose revenue is
      consolidated into the total revenue of any foreign bank described
      in any of those subparagraphs with which the entity is associated;
      and

  [D]{.dfn}
  :   is
      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the entity is not controlled by any person,
        the total revenue of the entity, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, the sum of the total revenue
        of the entity and of all its affiliates, other than entities
        whose total revenue is consolidated into the total revenue of an
        affiliate of the entity.
  :::

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption from material banking group
  status

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (2), the Minister may, subject to
  any terms and conditions that he or she considers appropriate, exempt
  an entity from being a member of a material banking group if neither
  of the ratios determined in accordance with that subsection in
  relation to that entity exceeds the percentage prescribed for the
  purposes of this subsection.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subsections 507(4) to (7) do not apply

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsections 507(4) to (7) do not apply with respect
  to the making of any determination relating to control or a
  substantial investment for the purposes of subparagraph (1)(b)(iii).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in this section.

  [[total assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[total assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an entity,
      means the total value of its assets

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} as reported on a consolidated basis in its most
        recently completed financial statements that were prepared in
        accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the jurisdiction in which the entity was
          formed or incorporated,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a jurisdiction in which it carries on
          business, or

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a country or territory that is a WTO Member
          as defined in subsection 2(1) of the [World Trade Organization
          Agreement Implementation Act](/eng/acts/W-11.8); or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if its most recently completed financial
        statements were not prepared in the manner described in
        paragraph (a), as would have been reported on a consolidated
        basis in its most recently completed financial statements had
        they been prepared in accordance with generally accepted
        accounting principles in Canada. ([actif total]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[total revenue]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[total revenue]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an entity,
      means its total revenue

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} as reported on a consolidated basis in its most
        recently completed financial statements that were prepared in
        accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the jurisdiction in which the entity was
          formed or incorporated,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a jurisdiction in which it carries on
          business, or

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a country or territory that is a WTO Member
          as defined in subsection 2(1) of the [World Trade Organization
          Agreement Implementation Act](/eng/acts/W-11.8); or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if its most recently completed financial
        statements were not prepared in the manner described in
        paragraph (a), as would have been reported on a consolidated
        basis in its most recently completed financial statements had
        they been prepared in accordance with generally accepted
        accounting principles in Canada. ([recettes d'exploitation
        totales]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

### [DIVISION 2]{.HLabel2}[General Prohibitions and Exceptions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-17385 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibited activities

- **[[510]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-510
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Except as permitted by this Part, a
  foreign bank or an entity associated with a foreign bank shall not

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in Canada, engage in or carry on

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any business that a bank is permitted to engage
      in or carry on under this Act, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any other business;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} maintain a branch in Canada for any purpose;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} establish, maintain or acquire for use in Canada an
    automated banking machine, a remote service unit or a similar
    automated service, or in Canada accept data from such a machine,
    unit or service; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} acquire or hold control of, or a substantial
    investment in, a Canadian entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deeming re acts of agent, etc. ---
  foreign banks

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, a foreign bank is
  deemed to be carrying out or to have carried out anything prohibited
  by subsection (1) if it is carried out by a nominee or agent of the
  foreign bank acting as such.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deeming re acts of agent, etc. ---
  associated entities

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, an entity associated
  with a foreign bank is deemed to be carrying out or to have carried
  out anything prohibited by subsection (1) if it is carried out by a
  nominee or agent of the entity associated with the foreign bank acting
  as such.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application re federal institutions
  associated with a foreign bank

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an entity referred to in any of paragraphs
    468(1)(a) to (f) that is an entity associated with a foreign bank;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity that an entity referred to in
    paragraph (a) controls, or in which such an entity has a substantial
    investment.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application re Canadian entity
  associated with a foreign bank

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Paragraphs (1)(a) and (b) do not apply to a Canadian
  entity that is an entity associated with a foreign bank and that is
  held or acquired in accordance with this Part.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 510
- 1996, c. 6, s. 9
- 1997, c. 15, s. 77
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 50
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-510-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 510"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit --- business growth fund

- **[[510.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-510.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The aggregate value of all ownership
  interests in the business growth fund and the entities that the
  business growth fund controls that a foreign bank and the entities
  associated with it hold must not exceed \$200,000,000.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), the value of an
  ownership interest is determined by the amount paid for it at the time
  of its issuance.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2018, c. 27, s. 142
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Business growth fund

- **[[510.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-510.02
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 510.01 and
  subsections (2) to (4), a foreign bank or an entity associated with a
  foreign bank may hold or acquire a substantial investment in the
  business growth fund or a Canadian entity that the business growth
  fund controls.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}For greater certainty

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, a foreign bank or an entity
  associated with a foreign bank is prohibited from acquiring control of
  the business growth fund or any Canadian entity that the business
  growth fund controls.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- entity

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A foreign bank or an entity associated with a foreign
  bank is prohibited from holding or acquiring a substantial investment
  in the business growth fund or any Canadian entity that the business
  growth fund controls if the business growth fund or any entity that
  the business growth fund controls holds or acquires shares of, or
  other ownership interests in, any of the following entities, or in any
  entity that controls any of the following entities:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an entity referred to in any of paragraphs
    468(1)(a) to (j);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is primarily engaged in the leasing
    of motor vehicles in Canada for the purpose of extending credit to a
    customer or financing a customer's acquisition of a motor vehicle;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is primarily engaged in providing
    temporary possession of personal property, including motor vehicles,
    to customers in Canada for a purpose other than to finance the
    customer's acquisition of the property;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an entity that acts as an insurance broker or agent
    in Canada; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is engaged in any prescribed
    activity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- capital and loans

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A foreign bank or an entity associated with a foreign
  bank is prohibited from holding or acquiring a substantial investment
  in the business growth fund or any Canadian entity that the business
  growth fund controls if the business growth fund or any entity that
  the business growth fund controls holds shares of, or other ownership
  interests in, an entity or holds a loan made to an entity and, in
  respect of that entity and its affiliates, the aggregate value of the
  following exceeds \$100,000,000:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} all ownership interests that are held by the
    foreign bank, the entities associated with the foreign bank, the
    business growth fund or the entities that the business growth fund
    controls, the value of those ownership interests as determined by
    the amount paid for them at the time each was first acquired by any
    of those entities; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the outstanding principal of all loans held by the
    business growth fund or the entities that the business growth fund
    controls.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2018, c. 27, s. 142
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception re real property holding and
management

**[[510.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-510.1 .sectionLabel}** Except as may be
prescribed, paragraphs 510(1)(a) and (b) do not apply in respect of the
holding or managing of, or otherwise dealing with, real property in
Canada by a foreign bank or an entity associated with a foreign bank.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2007, c. 6, s. 51
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception re accessing accounts

**[[511]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-511 .sectionLabel}** Nothing in paragraphs
510(1)(a) to (c) is to be construed as prohibiting a foreign bank or an
entity associated with a foreign bank from providing its customers who
are natural persons not ordinarily resident in Canada with access in
Canada to their accounts located outside Canada through the use of
automated banking machines located in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 511
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 51
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-511-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 511"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception re quotations

**[[512]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-512 .sectionLabel}** Nothing in paragraphs
510(1)(a) to (c) is to be construed as prohibiting a foreign bank or an
entity associated with a foreign bank from establishing, maintaining or
using a private telephone service or similar facility for the purpose of
quoting to customers in Canada, or entering with customers in Canada
into verbal agreements relating to, foreign exchange, deposit or loan
rates if there is no accounting or information processing involved in
the private telephone service or similar facility.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 512
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception re automated services

- **[[513]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-513 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  foreign bank, or an entity associated with a foreign bank, that has
  received the approval of the Minister under paragraph 522.22(1)(f) may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if it is a foreign securities dealer that has also
    received the approval of the Minister under paragraph 522.22(1)(i),
    engage in the activities referred to in paragraph 510(1)(c) so long
    as they relate to its business referred to in paragraph
    522.18(1)(b); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if it is a foreign cooperative credit society,
    engage in the activities referred to in paragraph 510(1)(c) so long
    as they relate to its business as a cooperative credit society
    engaged in or carried on by it in accordance with provincial laws
    relating to cooperative credit societies.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph 510(1)(c) does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity referred to in any of paragraphs
    468(1)(g) to (i);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed Canadian entity, other than a
    permitted Canadian entity, that is controlled by a Canadian entity
    referred to in paragraph (a); or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any other Canadian entity, other than a limited
    commercial entity, that is acquired or held by a foreign bank or an
    entity associated with a foreign bank in accordance with Divisions 4
    and 5, and that has received the approval of the Minister under
    paragraph 522.22(1)(i).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 513
- 1997, c. 15, s. 78
- 1999, c. 28, s. 29
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 52
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Change of status

- **[[516]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-516 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If
  an entity becomes a foreign bank, or an entity associated with a
  foreign bank, to which this Part applies and immediately before it
  became such a foreign bank or such an entity it maintained a branch or
  engaged in or carried on business in Canada that is not permitted by
  or under this Part, it may continue to maintain that branch or engage
  in or carry on that business for a period of six months after the day
  on which it became such a foreign bank or such an entity, or for any
  other shorter period that may be specified or approved by the
  Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transitional

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a foreign bank or an entity associated with a
  foreign bank was permitted by section 516 or 517, as that section read
  immediately before the day on which this subsection came into force,
  to maintain a branch or engage in or carry on business in Canada that
  is not permitted by or under this Part, it may continue to maintain
  that branch or engage in or carry on that business for the period
  during which it could have done so under that section**.**

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 516
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 53
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-516-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 516"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Change of status

- **[[517]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-517 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If
  an entity becomes a foreign bank, or an entity associated with a
  foreign bank, to which this Part applies and immediately before it
  became such a foreign bank or such an entity it held control of, or a
  substantial investment in, a Canadian entity and that control or
  substantial investment is not permitted by or under this Part, it may
  continue to hold control of, or a substantial investment in, the
  Canadian entity for a period of six months after the day on which it
  became such a foreign bank or such an entity, or for any other shorter
  period that may be specified or approved by the Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transitional

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a foreign bank or an entity associated with a
  foreign bank was permitted by section 516 or 517, as that section read
  immediately before the day on which this subsection came into force,
  to hold control of, or a substantial investment in, a Canadian entity
  and that holding is not permitted by or under this Part, it may
  continue to hold control of, or the substantial investment in, the
  Canadian entity for the period during which it could have done so
  under that section.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 517
- 1997, c. 15, s. 81
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 53
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-517-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 517"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction

**[[517.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-517.1 .sectionLabel}** If an order has
been made under subsection 973.1(1) in respect of a foreign bank or an
entity associated with a foreign bank and section 516 or 517 applies to
the foreign bank or entity, as the case may be, the period under section
516 or 517 may not extend beyond the expiry of the period referred to in
the order made under subsection 973.1(1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 54(E)
:::

[Previous
Version](section-517.1-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 517.1"){.PITLink}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition re guarantee and acceptance
of securities and bills

- **[[518]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-518
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) to (4),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a foreign bank shall not guarantee any securities
    or accept any bills of exchange or depository bills that are issued
    by a person resident in Canada and that are intended by the issuer
    or by any party to the security or bill to be sold or traded in
    Canada; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} no person shall participate in any arrangement in
    connection with a guarantee or acceptance prohibited by paragraph
    (a).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of the
  guarantee or acceptance by a foreign bank of securities, bills of
  exchange or depository bills that are issued by

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a non-bank affiliate of the foreign bank;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any other person resident in Canada and guaranteed
    or accepted by

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a bank that is a subsidiary of the foreign bank
      or of an entity associated with the foreign bank,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity referred to in any of
      paragraphs 468(1)(a) to (i) in which a bank that is a subsidiary
      of the foreign bank, or of an entity associated with the foreign
      bank, holds a substantial investment,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity referred to in any of
      paragraphs 468(1)(a) to (i) that is controlled by a bank that is a
      subsidiary of the foreign bank, or of an entity associated with
      the foreign bank,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity referred to in any of
      paragraphs 468(1)(b) to (i) that is a non-bank affiliate of the
      foreign bank, or

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed entity;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a bank that is a subsidiary of the foreign bank or
    of an entity associated with the foreign bank;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity in which a bank that is a
    subsidiary of the foreign bank, or of an entity associated with the
    foreign bank, holds a substantial investment;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity controlled by a bank that is a
    subsidiary of the foreign bank or of an entity associated with the
    foreign bank; or

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the business in Canada of an authorized foreign
    bank; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a foreign insurance company in relation to its
    insurance business in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), a foreign bank, or an entity
  associated with a foreign bank, that has received the approval of the
  Minister under paragraph 522.22(1)(f) may guarantee any securities or
  accept any bills of exchange or depository bills in relation to its
  business permitted under paragraph 522.18(1)(a) or (b).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 518
- 1997, c. 15, s. 82
- 1999, c. 28, s. 30, c. 31, s. 15(F)
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 55
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-518-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 518"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibited activities --- non-bank
affiliates

- **[[519]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-519
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections 510(4) and (5),
  a non-bank affiliate of a foreign bank shall not, in Canada,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} engage in the business of accepting deposit
    liabilities;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} engage in the business of acting as an agent for
    the acceptance of deposit liabilities for a foreign bank or an
    entity associated with a foreign bank, other than for

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an authorized foreign bank,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a foreign cooperative credit society that has
      received the approval of the Minister under paragraph 522.22(1)(f)
      to engage in or carry on the business of a cooperative credit
      society, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} an entity referred to in any of paragraphs
      468(1)(a), (c), (d) and (h) or a trust or loan corporation
      referred to in paragraph 468(1)(g); or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} represent to the public that any instrument issued
    by it is a deposit or that any liability incurred by it is a
    deposit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a non-bank affiliate
  that is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a trust or loan corporation incorporated by or
    under an Act of Parliament or of the legislature of a province;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity referred to in paragraph
    468(1)(d) or (h); or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed entity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 519
- 1997, c. 15, s. 83
- 1999, c. 28, s. 31
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 56
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-519-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 519"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Borrowing from the public --- non-bank
affiliates

- **[[519.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-519.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A non-bank affiliate of a foreign
  bank that carries on as part of its business the provision of
  financial services may borrow money in Canada from the public only if
  it discloses that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is not a member institution of the Canada
    Deposit Insurance Corporation;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the liability incurred by it through the borrowing
    is not a deposit; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} it is not regulated as a financial institution in
    Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Manner of disclosure

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The disclosure must be

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in a prospectus, information circular or other
    offering document or a similar document related to the borrowing or,
    if there is no such document, in a statement delivered to the
    lender; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other manner that may be prescribed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception for certain borrowing

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} to a borrowing of a prescribed class or type or to
    a borrowing in prescribed circumstances or in a prescribed manner;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} except as may be provided in any regulations, to a
    borrowing

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} from a person in an amount of \$150,000 or more,
      or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} through the issue of instruments in
      denominations of \$150,000 or more.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a non-bank affiliate
  that is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity referred to in any of paragraphs
    468(1)(b), (c) or (e) to (g);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an entity controlled by a bank holding company or
    an insurance holding company or in which a bank holding company or
    an insurance holding company has a substantial investment;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a financial institution referred to in
    paragraph (g) of the definition [[financial
    institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in section 2; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed entity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2007, c. 6, s. 56
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition re deposits

- **[[520]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-520 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  foreign bank --- or an entity that is associated with a foreign bank
  and that is incorporated or formed otherwise than by or under an Act
  of Parliament or of the legislature of a province --- shall not, as
  part of its business in Canada,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} engage in the business of accepting deposit
    liabilities;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} engage in the business of acting as an agent for
    the acceptance of deposit liabilities for a foreign bank or an
    entity associated with a foreign bank; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} represent to the public that any instrument issued
    by it is a deposit or that any liability incurred by it is a
    deposit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a foreign bank that is an authorized foreign bank;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a foreign cooperative credit society that has
    received the approval of the Minister under paragraph 522.22(1)(f)
    to engage in or carry on the business of a cooperative credit
    society.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(b) does not apply to a foreign
  securities dealer that has received the approval of the Minister under
  paragraph 522.22(1)(f) or to a foreign insurance company --- or to a
  prescribed entity --- that engages in the business of acting as an
  agent for the acceptance of deposit liabilities for

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an authorized foreign bank;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a foreign cooperative credit society that has
    received the approval of the Minister under paragraph 522.22(1)(f)
    to engage in or carry on the business of a cooperative credit
    society; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an entity referred to in paragraph 468(1)(a),
    (c), (d) or (h) or a trust or loan corporation referred to in
    paragraph 468(1)(g).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 520
- 1999, c. 28, s. 32
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 56
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-520-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 520"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Borrowing from the public

- **[[520.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-520.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A foreign bank --- or an entity that
  is associated with a foreign bank and that is incorporated or formed
  otherwise than by or under an Act of Parliament or of the legislature
  of a province --- may, as part of its business in Canada, borrow money
  in Canada from the public only if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it maintains a branch in Canada as permitted by
    section 522.05 or 522.19 or it engages in or carries on business in
    Canada as permitted by that section; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it discloses that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it is not a member institution of the Canada
      Deposit Insurance Corporation,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the liability incurred through the borrowing is
      not a deposit, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} it is not regulated as a financial institution
      in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Manner of disclosure

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The disclosure must be

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in a prospectus, information circular or other
    offering document or a similar document related to the borrowing or,
    if there is no such document, in a statement delivered to the
    lender; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other manner that may be prescribed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception for certain borrowing

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The disclosure is not required in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a borrowing of a prescribed class or type or a
    borrowing in prescribed circumstances or in a prescribed manner; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} except as may be provided in any regulations, a
    borrowing

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} from a person in an amount of \$150,000 or more,
      or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} through the issue of instruments in
      denominations of \$150,000 or more.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an authorized foreign bank;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a foreign cooperative credit society that has
    received the approval of the Minister under paragraph 522.22(1)(f)
    to engage in or carry on the business of a cooperative credit
    society;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a foreign insurance company;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a foreign securities dealer that has received the
    approval of the Minister under paragraph 522.22(1)(f); or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed entity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2007, c. 6, s. 56
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

**[[521]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-521 .sectionLabel}** The Governor in Council
may make regulations exempting any class or classes of businesses,
investments, activities and branches from any of the prohibitions set
out in section 510 or 518.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 521
- 1997, c. 15, s. 84
- 1999, c. 28, s. 33
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Permitted Canadian offices

**[[522]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522 .sectionLabel}** A foreign bank may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} with the approval of the Superintendent and

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} subject to any terms and conditions that are
    attached to the approval, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} subject to and in accordance with rules that are
    prescribed in relation to the operation of representative offices
    and the conduct of their personnel,

  maintain representative offices in Canada that are registered with the
  Superintendent in the prescribed manner; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} with the approval of the Governor in Council and
  subject to any terms and conditions that are attached to the approval,
  locate its head office in Canada and, from that office, issue
  directions and do all other things reasonably necessary for the
  conduct of its banking business outside Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 522
- 1997, c. 15, s. 85
- 1999, c. 28, s. 34
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Examination of representative offices

- **[[522.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent shall, from time
  to time, make or cause to be made any examination and inquiry into the
  operation of any representative office of a foreign bank and the
  conduct of the personnel in that office that the Superintendent
  considers necessary for the purpose of ascertaining whether the office
  is being operated, and whether the personnel of the office are
  conducting themselves, in accordance with the rules prescribed for the
  purposes of paragraph 522(a).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Powers of Superintendent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), the
  Superintendent and any person acting under the direction of the
  Superintendent have the same powers and obligations that the
  Superintendent has in relation to the examination of banks under this
  Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Name of representative office

**[[522.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.011 .sectionLabel}** If the name
under which a representative office of a foreign bank is or will be
identifying itself in Canada is one referred to in any of paragraphs
530(1)(a) to (e), the Superintendent may, as the case may be,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} refuse to grant the approval referred to in paragraph
  522(a);

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} impose restrictions on the use of the name in Canada;
  or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} direct the foreign bank to change the name.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2007, c. 6, s. 57
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Cancellation of registration

**[[522.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.02 .sectionLabel}** The
Superintendent may cancel the registration of a representative office of
a foreign bank if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the foreign bank requests the Superintendent to
  cancel the registration;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Superintendent is of the opinion that the
  representative office is not being operated, or the personnel of that
  office are not conducting themselves, in accordance with the rules
  prescribed for the purposes of paragraph 522(a); or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Superintendent is of the opinion that the foreign
  bank has failed to comply with a restriction imposed under paragraph
  522.011(b) or a direction made under paragraph 522.011(c).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 57
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-522.02-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 522.02"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Business conducted from head office in
Canada

- **[[522.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.03
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) and (3),
  if the head office of a foreign bank is located in Canada under
  paragraph 522(b), the foreign bank shall not conduct any business from
  that office with persons resident in Canada or with Her Majesty in
  right of Canada or a province except for the purpose of acquiring
  premises, supplies, services and staff for that office.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a foreign bank, immediately before the
  establishment of its head office in Canada under paragraph 522(b),
  held deposits of, or had loans outstanding to, persons resident in
  Canada or Her Majesty in right of Canada or a province, the foreign
  bank may repay those deposits and collect those loans through the head
  office in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a foreign bank controlled a bank or was a major
  shareholder of a bank immediately before the establishment of the
  foreign bank's head office in Canada under paragraph 522(b), the
  foreign bank may continue to carry out from the head office in Canada
  any activities that were carried out from the head office of the
  foreign bank in relation to the bank before the establishment of the
  head office in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

### [DIVISION 3]{.HLabel2}[No Financial Establishment in Canada]{.HTitleText2} {#h-17629 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Permitted investment --- foreign bank

- **[[522.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.04
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A foreign bank that does not have a
  financial establishment in Canada may acquire or hold control of, or a
  substantial investment in, a Canadian entity, so long as, by virtue of
  the acquisition, neither the foreign bank nor any entity associated
  with the foreign bank controls or becomes a major owner of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity referred to in any of paragraphs
    468(1)(a) to (i); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity that is a financial services
    entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Permitted investment --- associated
  entity

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An entity that is associated with a foreign bank and
  that does not have a financial establishment in Canada may acquire or
  hold control of, or a substantial investment in, a Canadian entity, so
  long as, by virtue of the acquisition, neither the entity nor the
  foreign bank, nor any other entity associated with the foreign bank,
  controls or becomes a major owner of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity referred to in any of paragraphs
    468(1)(a) to (i); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity that is a financial services
    entity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Permitted Canadian commercial branch

**[[522.05]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.05 .sectionLabel}** A foreign bank,
or an entity that is incorporated or formed otherwise than by or under
an Act of Parliament or of the legislature of a province and that is
associated with a foreign bank, that does not have a financial
establishment in Canada may maintain a branch in Canada or engage in or
carry on business in Canada so long as less than

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the prescribed portion --- or if no portion is
  prescribed, 10 per cent --- of its business in Canada, determined in
  the prescribed manner, consists of one or more of the activities
  referred to in any of paragraphs (a) to (g) of the definition
  [[financial services entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
  507(1); and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the prescribed portion --- or if no portion is
  prescribed, 10 per cent --- of its business outside Canada, determined
  in the prescribed manner, consists of one or more activities referred
  to in any of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} paragraphs (a) to (g) of the definition [[financial
    services entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 507(1), and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} paragraph (h) of that definition, except under
    prescribed circumstances.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Permitted branches re leasing

**[[522.06]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.06 .sectionLabel}** Despite section
522.05, a foreign bank, or an entity that is incorporated or formed
otherwise than by or under an Act of Parliament or of the legislature of
a province and that is associated with a foreign bank, that does not
have a financial establishment in Canada and that outside Canada

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} engages only in the activities referred to in the
  definition [[leasing entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
  507(1), or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} engages only in activities other than those referred
  to in any of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} paragraphs (a) to (g) of the definition [[financial
    services entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 507(1), and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} paragraph (h) of that definition, except under
    prescribed circumstances,

may in Canada engage in the activities of a leasing entity so long as it
does not engage in any other activity in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

### [DIVISION 4]{.HLabel2}[Financial Establishment in Canada]{.HTitleText2} {#h-17658 .Subheading}

#### [Investments]{.HTitleText3} {#h-17659 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Investment in a financial institution

**[[522.07]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.07 .sectionLabel}** Subject to the
requirements relating to approval set out in Division 5, a foreign bank
or an entity associated with a foreign bank may acquire or hold control
of, or a substantial investment in, a Canadian entity referred to in any
of paragraphs 468(1)(a) to (i).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 58
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-522.07-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 522.07"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Permitted investments

- **[[522.08]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.08
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2) and the
  requirements relating to approval set out in Division 5, a foreign
  bank or an entity associated with a foreign bank may acquire or hold
  control of, or a substantial investment in, a Canadian entity, other
  than an entity referred to in any of paragraphs 468(1)(a) to (i),
  whose business is limited to one or more of the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} engaging in

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any financial service activity that a bank is
      permitted to engage in under any of paragraphs 409(2)(a) to (d),
      or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any other activity that a bank is permitted to
      engage in under section 410 or 411;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} acquiring or holding shares of, or ownership
    interests in, entities that a foreign bank or an entity associated
    with a foreign bank is permitted to acquire or hold under this
    Division or Division 8 --- other than limited commercial entities,
    except in prescribed circumstances;

  - [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} acquiring or holding shares of, or ownership
    interests in, entities incorporated or formed otherwise than by or
    under an Act of Parliament or of the legislature of a province;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} engaging in the provision of any services
    exclusively to any or all of the following, so long as the Canadian
    entity is also providing those services to the foreign bank or to
    any member of the foreign bank's group, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the foreign bank,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any member of the foreign bank's group,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any entity that is primarily engaged in the
      business of providing financial services,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} any entity in which an entity referred to in
      subparagraph (iii) has a substantial investment and that is

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} an entity in which a bank is permitted to
        acquire a substantial investment under section 468,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} an entity in which a foreign bank or an entity
        associated with a foreign bank is permitted to acquire a
        substantial investment under this section and section 522.07, or

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed entity, or

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed person, if it is doing so under
      prescribed terms and conditions, if any are prescribed;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} engaging in any activity that a bank is permitted
    to engage in --- or in any other prescribed activity ---, other than
    an activity referred to in paragraph (a) or (e), that relates to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the promotion, sale, delivery or distribution of
      a financial product or financial service that is provided by the
      foreign bank or by any member of the foreign bank's group, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if a significant portion of the business of the
      Canadian entity involves an activity referred to in subparagraph
      (i), the promotion, sale, delivery or distribution of a financial
      product or financial service that is provided by any other entity
      that is primarily engaged in the business of providing financial
      services;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} engaging in the activities referred to in the
    definition [[closed-end fund]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, [[mutual fund
    distribution entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, [[mutual fund
    entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[real property brokerage
    entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 464(1); and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} engaging in prescribed activities, under prescribed
    terms and conditions, if any are prescribed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional restriction

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A foreign bank or an entity associated with a foreign
  bank may not acquire or hold control of, or a substantial investment
  in, a Canadian entity whose business includes any activity referred to
  in any of paragraphs (1)(a) to (e) if the activities of the Canadian
  entity include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} activities that a bank is not permitted to engage
    in under section 412, 417 or 418;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} dealing in securities, except as may be permitted
    under paragraph (1)(e) or as may be permitted to a bank under
    paragraph 409(2)(c);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} activities that a bank is not permitted to engage
    in under section 416, if the Canadian entity engages in the
    activities of a finance entity or of any other entity as may be
    prescribed;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} acquiring or holding control of, or a substantial
    investment in, another Canadian entity unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a Canadian entity that is
      controlled by the foreign bank or the entity associated with a
      foreign bank, the foreign bank or the entity associated with a
      foreign bank itself would be permitted to acquire or hold control
      of, or a substantial investment in, the other Canadian entity
      under this section or section 522.07 or 522.1 or Division 8, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a Canadian entity that is not
      controlled by the foreign bank or the entity associated with a
      foreign bank, the foreign bank or the entity associated with a
      foreign bank itself would be permitted to acquire or hold control
      of, or a substantial investment in, the other Canadian entity
      under this section, section 522.07, any of paragraphs 522.1(a)
      or (c) to (e) or Division 8; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed activity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraph (2)(a), a foreign bank or an
  entity associated with a foreign bank may acquire or hold control of,
  or acquire or increase a substantial investment in, any entity that
  acts as a trustee for a trust if the entity has been permitted under
  the laws of a province to act as a trustee for a trust and the
  following conditions are satisfied:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the entity acts as a trustee only with respect to a
    closed-end fund or mutual fund entity; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the entity engages in other business, that
    business is limited to engaging in one or more of the following:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the activities of a mutual fund distribution
      entity,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any activity that a bank is permitted to engage
      in under paragraph 410(1)(c.2), and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the provision of investment counselling
      services and portfolio management services.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 59
- 2012, c. 5, s. 55
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Investment in a limited commercial entity
--- foreign bank

- **[[522.09]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.09
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the requirements relating
  to approval set out in Division 5, a foreign bank that has a financial
  establishment in Canada may acquire or hold control of, or a
  substantial investment in, a Canadian entity if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Canadian entity is not an entity referred to in
    any of paragraphs 468(1)(a) to (i);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Canadian entity does not engage in more than
    the prescribed portion of --- or if no portion is prescribed, 10 per
    cent of --- the activities referred to in paragraphs 522.08(1)(a)
    to (f) or in any of paragraphs (a) to (h) of the definition
    [[financial services entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
    507(1), determined in the prescribed manner;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Canadian entity does not engage in any leasing
    activities; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the opinion of the Minister, the Canadian entity
    engages in or carries on business that is the same as, or similar,
    related or incidental to, the business outside Canada of the foreign
    bank or any entity associated with the foreign bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Investment in a limited commercial
  entity --- entity associated with a foreign bank

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the requirements relating to approval set
  out in Division 5, an entity that is associated with a foreign bank
  and that has a financial establishment in Canada may acquire or hold
  control of, or a substantial investment in, a Canadian entity if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Canadian entity is not an entity referred to in
    any of paragraphs 468(1)(a) to (i);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Canadian entity does not engage in more than
    the prescribed portion of --- or if no portion is prescribed, 10 per
    cent of --- the activities referred to in paragraphs 522.08(1)(a)
    to (f) or in any of paragraphs (a) to (h) of the definition
    [[financial services entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
    507(1), determined in the prescribed manner;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Canadian entity does not engage in leasing
    activities; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the opinion of the Minister, the Canadian entity
    engages in or carries on business that is the same as, or similar,
    related or incidental to, the business outside Canada of the entity
    associated with the foreign bank, the foreign bank or any other
    entity associated with the foreign bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Investment in holding body corporate
  --- limited commercial entities

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A foreign bank or an entity associated with a foreign
  bank may acquire or hold control of, or a substantial investment in, a
  Canadian entity whose business is limited to acquiring or holding
  shares of, or ownership interests in, limited commercial entities.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 60
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Acquisition of other investments

**[[522.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.1 .sectionLabel}** A foreign bank or
an entity associated with a foreign bank may acquire or hold control of,
or a substantial investment in, a Canadian entity

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} by way of an investment permitted by any of sections
  522.11 to 522.13;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} by way of a temporary investment permitted by section
  522.14;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} as a result of a default that has occurred under the
  terms of an agreement with respect to a loan or under any other
  documents governing the terms of a loan, as permitted by section
  522.15;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} through a realization of security, as permitted by
  section 522.15; or

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} if it does so in accordance with regulations made
  under paragraph 522.23(a) concerning specialized financing.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 61
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Indirect investments through federal
institutions

- **[[522.11]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.11
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A foreign bank or an entity
  associated with a foreign bank may acquire or hold control of, or a
  substantial investment in, a Canadian entity by way of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an acquisition or holding of the control of a
    Canadian entity referred to in any of paragraphs 468(1)(a) to (f),
    or of a prescribed Canadian entity, that controls or has a
    substantial investment in the Canadian entity; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an acquisition or holding of shares or ownership
    interests in the Canadian entity by

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity referred to in any of
      paragraphs 468(1)(a) to (f), or a prescribed Canadian entity, that
      is controlled by the foreign bank or the entity associated with
      the foreign bank, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity controlled by a Canadian
      entity referred to in subparagraph (i).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Indirect investments through federal
  institutions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a foreign bank or an entity associated with a
  foreign bank acquires or holds control of, or a substantial investment
  in, a Canadian entity under subsection (1), none of the requirements
  relating to approval set out in Division 5 apply in respect of that
  acquisition or holding.

::: HistoricalNote

- 2007, c. 6, s. 62
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Investments through provincial
institutions

**[[522.12]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.12 .sectionLabel}** An entity that is
associated with a foreign bank and that is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} an entity referred to in any of paragraphs 468(1)(g)
  to (i), or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity controlled by an entity referred to
  in any of paragraphs 468(1)(g) to (i)

may acquire or hold control of, or a substantial investment in, a
Canadian entity that is not a permitted Canadian entity or an entity
referred to in paragraphs 468(1)(a) to (i), and if it does so, none of
the requirements relating to approval set out in Division 5 apply in
respect of that acquisition or holding.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Indirect investments through provincial
institutions

**[[522.13]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.13 .sectionLabel}** A foreign bank or
an entity associated with a foreign bank may acquire or hold control of,
or a substantial investment in, a Canadian entity, other than a
permitted Canadian entity or a Canadian entity referred to in any of
paragraphs 468(1)(a) to (i), by way of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} an acquisition or holding of the control of a
  Canadian entity referred to in any of paragraphs 468(1)(g) to (i), or
  of a prescribed Canadian entity, that controls or has a substantial
  investment in the Canadian entity; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} an acquisition or holding of shares or ownership
  interests in the Canadian entity by

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity referred to in any of paragraphs
    468(1)(g) to (i), or a prescribed Canadian entity, that is
    controlled by the foreign bank or the entity associated with the
    foreign bank, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian entity controlled by a Canadian entity
    referred to in subparagraph (i).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Temporary investments

- **[[522.14]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.14
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to sections 522.21 and
  522.211, a foreign bank or an entity associated with a foreign bank
  may, by way of temporary investment, acquire or hold control of, or a
  substantial investment in, a Canadian entity if the foreign bank or
  the entity associated with a foreign bank has a financial
  establishment in Canada or would, by virtue of the temporary
  investment, have a financial establishment in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Divestiture

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If subsection (1) applies in respect of a foreign
  bank or an entity associated with a foreign bank, the foreign bank or
  entity shall do all things necessary to ensure that, within two years
  after acquiring the control or the substantial investment or within
  any other period that may be specified or approved by the Minister, it
  no longer controls or has a substantial investment in the entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} On application by a foreign bank, or an entity
  associated with a foreign bank, the Minister may extend the period
  referred to in subsection (2) by any further period or periods.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If a foreign bank, or an entity associated with a
  foreign bank, acquires or holds, by way of a temporary investment,
  control of, or a substantial investment in, a Canadian entity for
  which the approval of the Minister would have been required under any
  of paragraphs 522.22(1)(a) to (e) if the foreign bank or the entity
  associated with a foreign bank had acquired the control or the
  substantial investment under section 522.07 or 522.08, the foreign
  bank or the entity associated with a foreign bank shall, within 90
  days after acquiring control, or after acquiring the substantial
  investment,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} apply to the Minister for approval to retain
    control of the Canadian entity or to continue to hold the
    substantial investment in the Canadian entity for a period specified
    by the Minister or for an indeterminate period on any terms and
    conditions that the Minister considers appropriate; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} do all things necessary to ensure that, on the
    expiry of the 90 days, it no longer controls the Canadian entity or
    holds a substantial investment in the Canadian entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed temporary investment

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} If a foreign bank or an entity associated with a
  foreign bank holds control of, or a substantial investment in, a
  Canadian entity as permitted by this Division and the foreign bank or
  the entity associated with the foreign bank becomes aware of a change
  in the business, affairs or activities of the Canadian entity that, if
  the change had taken place before the acquisition of control or the
  substantial investment, would have caused the entity not to be a
  limited commercial entity or a Canadian entity referred to in section
  522.07 or 522.08 or would have been such that approval for the
  acquisition would have been required under any of paragraphs
  522.22(1)(a) to (e) or (g), the foreign bank or the entity associated
  with the foreign bank is deemed to have acquired, on the day it
  becomes aware of the change, a temporary investment in respect of
  which subsections (1) to (4) apply.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notification

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} Within 90 days after acquiring control or a
  substantial investment under subsection (1) or (5), a foreign bank or
  an entity associated with a foreign bank shall notify the Minister in
  writing of the acquisition.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 63
:::

:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Acquisition by loan workout or
realization of security

- **[[522.15]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.15
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a foreign bank or an entity
  associated with a foreign bank acquires or holds control of, or a
  substantial investment in, a Canadian entity

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} as a result of a default that has occurred under
    the terms of an agreement with respect to a loan made between the
    foreign bank --- or the entity associated with a foreign bank ---
    and the Canadian entity, or under any other documents governing the
    terms of the loan, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} through the realization of a security interest for
    any loan or advance made by the foreign bank or the entity
    associated with the foreign bank, or for any other debt or liability
    owing to it,

  it may retain the control or the substantial investment for five
  years, but it shall do all things necessary to ensure that, within
  five years after the acquisition, it no longer controls the Canadian
  entity or holds a substantial investment in the Canadian entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On application by a foreign bank or an entity
  associated with a foreign bank, the Minister may extend the period
  referred to in subsection (1) by any further period or periods.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If, under subsection (1), a foreign bank or an entity
  associated with a foreign bank acquires or holds control of, or a
  substantial investment in, a Canadian entity for which the approval of
  the Minister is required under Division 5, the foreign bank or entity
  associated with the foreign bank may retain control of the Canadian
  entity, or continue to hold the substantial investment, for an
  indeterminate period if the approval in writing of the Minister is
  obtained before the end of the period referred to in subsection (1) or
  of any extension granted under subsection (2).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

#### [Branches]{.HTitleText3} {#h-17785 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Bank branches

**[[522.16]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.16 .sectionLabel}** A foreign bank
may, under Part XII.1, maintain a branch in Canada to carry on business
in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Insurance branches

**[[522.17]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.17 .sectionLabel}** A foreign bank,
or an entity that is incorporated or formed otherwise than by or under
an Act of Parliament or of the legislature of a province and that is
associated with a foreign bank may obtain an order under Part XIII of
the [Insurance Companies Act](/eng/acts/I-11.8) to insure, in Canada,
risks.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Business of a cooperative credit society
and dealing in securities

- **[[522.18]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.18
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the requirements relating
  to approval set out in Division 5, a foreign bank --- or an entity
  associated with a foreign bank ---

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is a foreign cooperative credit society may,
    in Canada, engage in or carry on the business of a cooperative
    credit society, so long as that business is engaged in or carried on
    in accordance with provincial laws relating to cooperative credit
    societies; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is a foreign securities dealer may, in Canada,
    engage in or carry on the business of dealing in securities, or the
    business of providing investment counselling services and portfolio
    management services, so long as that business is engaged in or
    carried on in accordance with provincial laws relating to securities
    dealing or investment counselling and portfolio management.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Business of investment counselling
  services and portfolio management services

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the requirements relating to approval set
  out in Division 5, an entity associated with a foreign bank
  incorporated or formed, and regulated, otherwise than by or under an
  Act of Parliament or of the legislature of a province, that engages in
  or carries on, outside Canada, the business of providing investment
  counselling services and portfolio management services may engage in
  or carry on that business in Canada so long as that business in Canada
  is engaged in or carried on in accordance with provincial laws
  relating to investment counselling and portfolio management.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 64
:::

[Previous
Version](section-522.18-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 522.18"){.PITLink}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limited commercial branches

- **[[522.19]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.19
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the requirements relating
  to approval set out in Division 5, and subject to subsection (2), a
  foreign bank, or an entity that is incorporated or formed otherwise
  than by or under an Act of Parliament or of the legislature of a
  province and that is associated with a foreign bank, that has a
  financial establishment in Canada may maintain a branch in Canada or
  engage in or carry on business in Canada, so long as

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} less than the prescribed portion --- or if no
    portion is prescribed, 10 per cent --- of its business in Canada,
    determined in the prescribed manner, consists of one or more of the
    activities referred to in any of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} paragraphs 522.08(1)(a) to (f), and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} paragraphs (a) to (g) of the definition
      [[financial services entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
      507(1);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} less than the prescribed portion --- or if no
    portion is prescribed, 10 per cent --- of its business outside
    Canada, determined in the prescribed manner, consists of one or more
    of the activities referred to in any of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} paragraphs 522.08(1)(a) to (f),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} paragraphs (a) to (g) of the definition
      [[financial services entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
      507(1), and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} paragraph (h) of that definition, except under
      prescribed circumstances; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the opinion of the Minister, the business in
    Canada is the same as, or similar, related or incidental to, the
    business outside Canada of the foreign bank or the entity associated
    with a foreign bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A foreign bank --- or an entity associated with a
  foreign bank --- that maintains a branch or engages in or carries on
  any business under subsection (1) may not in Canada engage in any
  leasing activities.

- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 65
:::

### [DIVISION 5]{.HLabel2}[Approvals]{.HTitleText2} {#h-17818 .Subheading}

#### [Application]{.HTitleText3} {#h-17819 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application

**[[522.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.2 .sectionLabel}** This Division does
not apply in respect of investments acquired and held, branches
maintained and businesses engaged in or carried on in accordance with
Division 3.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

#### [Approval to Have a Financial Establishment in Canada]{.HTitleText3} {#h-17824 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No financial establishment without
approval --- foreign bank

- **[[522.21]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.21
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A foreign bank may not, without the
  prior written approval of the Minister, have a financial establishment
  in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply if the foreign bank or
  any entity associated with the foreign bank

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is an authorized foreign bank;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is a foreign insurance company;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} controls or is a major owner of a Canadian entity
    referred to in any of paragraphs 468(1)(a) to (f); or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} has already received the approval of the Minister
    to have a financial establishment in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deeming

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A foreign bank that was the subject of a designation
  order under subsection 508(1) as that subsection read immediately
  before the coming into force of this subsection and whose designation
  order has not been revoked is deemed to have received the approval of
  the Minister to have a financial establishment in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 67
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-522.21-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 522.21"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No financial establishment without
approval --- associated entity

- **[[522.211]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.211
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An entity that is associated with a
  foreign bank may not, without the prior written approval of the
  Minister, have a financial establishment in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply if the entity
  associated with a foreign bank, the foreign bank or any other entity
  associated with the foreign bank

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is an authorized foreign bank;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is a foreign insurance company;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} controls or is a major owner of a Canadian entity
    referred to in any of paragraphs 468(1)(a) to (f); or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} has already received the approval of the Minister
    to have a financial establishment in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deeming

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An entity associated with a foreign bank that was the
  subject of a designation order under subsection 508(1) as that
  subsection read immediately before the coming into force of this
  subsection and whose designation order has not been revoked is deemed
  to have received the approval of the Minister to have a financial
  establishment in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2007, c. 6, s. 67
:::

#### [Approvals in Respect of Investments and Activities]{.HTitleText3} {#h-17851 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Minister's approval

- **[[522.22]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.22
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2) and the
  regulations, a foreign bank or an entity associated with a foreign
  bank may not, without the prior written approval of the Minister,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} acquire control of a Canadian entity referred to in
    any of paragraphs 468(1)(g) to (i) from a person who is not a member
    of the foreign bank's group;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} acquire control of a Canadian entity whose business
    includes one or more of the activities referred to in paragraph
    522.08(1)(a) and that engages, as part of its business, in any
    financial intermediary activity that exposes the Canadian entity to
    material market or credit risk --- including a finance entity --- if
    the control is acquired from an entity referred to in any of
    paragraphs 468(1)(a) to (f) that is not a member of the foreign
    bank's group, but does not include a Canadian entity whose
    activities are limited to the activities of one or more of the
    following entities:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a factoring entity as defined in the regulations,
      or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a financial leasing entity;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} acquire or hold control of, or a substantial
    investment in, a Canadian entity whose business includes one or more
    of the activities referred to in paragraph 522.08(1)(d);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} acquire or hold control of, or a substantial
    investment in, a Canadian entity that engages in Canada in an
    activity described in paragraph 410(1)(c);

  - [(d.1)]{.lawlabel} acquire or hold control of, or a substantial
    investment in, a Canadian entity that engages in an activity
    described in paragraph 410(1)(c.1);

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} acquire or hold control of, or a substantial
    investment in, a Canadian entity that engages in an activity
    prescribed for the purposes of paragraph 522.08(1)(f);

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} engage in or carry on a business permitted by
    paragraph 522.18(1)(a) or (b) or subsection 522.18(2);

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} acquire or hold control of, or a substantial
    investment in, a limited commercial entity;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} maintain a branch or engage in or carry on a
    business permitted by section 522.19; or

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} engage in an activity referred to in paragraph
    510(1)(c) in the circumstances described in paragraph 513(1)(a) or
    (2)(c).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Approval for indirect investments

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the regulations, if a foreign bank or an
  entity associated with a foreign bank

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} obtains the approval of the Minister under any of
    paragraphs (1)(a) to (e) and (g) to acquire or hold control of, or a
    substantial investment in, a Canadian entity, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} through that acquisition or holding, indirectly
    acquires control of, or a substantial investment in, another
    Canadian entity that would require the approval of the Minister
    under any of those paragraphs,

  and that indirect acquisition is disclosed to the Minister in writing
  before the approval is obtained, the foreign bank or the entity
  associated with a foreign bank is deemed to have obtained the approval
  of the Minister for that indirect acquisition.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Ministerial approval of more than one
  entity

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister, under paragraph (1)(g), approves the
  acquisition or holding of control of, or a substantial investment in,
  a limited commercial entity by a foreign bank or by an entity
  associated with a foreign bank, the Minister may also authorize the
  foreign bank or entity associated with a foreign bank to, at any time,
  acquire and hold control of, or a substantial investment in, another
  limited commercial entity that engages in activities that are
  substantially the same as those engaged in by the Canadian entity in
  respect of which the approval was given.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Substantial investment by underwriter

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Nothing in this Part precludes a foreign bank or an
  entity associated with a foreign bank from acquiring a substantial
  investment in a Canadian entity if the substantial investment is
  acquired in the course of a distribution to the public of shares or
  ownership interests in the Canadian entity by a securities underwriter
  so long as the securities underwriter holds the substantial investment
  for no longer than six months.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) applies regardless of whether or not
  the approval of the Minister is required under section 522.21 or
  522.211.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 68
:::
