### [DIVISION 6]{.HLabel2}[Administration]{.HTitleText2} {#h-17880 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

**[[522.23]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.23 .sectionLabel}** The Governor in
Council may make regulations for the purposes of this Part and, in
particular, may make regulations

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} concerning specialized financing;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of subsection 522.22(1) or (2),
  permitting the acquisition or holding of control or the acquisition or
  holding of substantial investments, or prescribing the circumstances
  under which either of those subsections does not apply or the foreign
  banks, entities associated with foreign banks or other entities in
  respect of which either of those subsections does not apply, including
  prescribing foreign banks, entities associated with foreign banks or
  other entities on the basis of the activities they engage in;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} restricting the ownership by foreign banks, or
  entities associated with foreign banks, of shares in a body corporate
  or of ownership interests in an unincorporated entity under Division 3
  or 4 and imposing terms and conditions applicable to foreign banks, or
  entities associated with foreign banks, that own such shares or
  interests;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} in respect of sections 409 to 411, for the purposes
  of paragraph 522.08(1)(a), subsection 522.22(1) and section 522.24;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} respecting the calculation referred to in subsection
  508(2), including regulations respecting the classes of entities
  associated with a foreign bank, and the classes of foreign banks
  described in any of subparagraphs 508(1)(a)(i) to (iii) that are
  associated with a foreign bank, that are to be taken into account in
  that calculation;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} defining any terms in subsection 508(2);

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} respecting exemptions under subsection 508(3); and

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} defining [[factoring entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} for
  the purpose of paragraph 522.22(1)(b).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 69
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-522.23-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 522.23"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application of regulations

**[[522.24]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.24 .sectionLabel}** Any regulations
made for the purposes of sections 409 to 411 apply for the purposes of
paragraph 522.08(1)(a) and subsection 522.22(1) unless otherwise
provided in the regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Divestiture

- **[[522.25]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.25
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a foreign bank or an entity
  associated with a foreign bank contravenes any provision of Division 4
  or fails to comply with any terms and conditions imposed by any order
  made for the purpose of any of those provisions, the Minister may, if
  the Minister considers it in the public interest to do so, by order,
  direct the foreign bank or the entity to divest itself of the control
  of, or a substantial investment in, a bank or bank holding company to
  which the offence relates.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Ceasing to engage in or carry on
  business

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If an authorized foreign bank or an entity associated
  with an authorized foreign bank contravenes any provision of Division
  4 or fails to comply with any terms and conditions imposed by any
  order made for the purpose of any of those provisions, the Minister
  may, if the Minister considers it in the public interest to do so,
  revoke the order made under subsection 524(1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Divestment order

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, by order, direct a foreign bank or
  an entity associated with a foreign bank, within any period that the
  Minister considers reasonable, to dispose of assets used in a business
  or activity engaged in or carried on, or to dispose of the control of
  an entity or a substantial investment in an entity acquired or held,
  in contravention of this Part or in contravention of any terms and
  conditions imposed

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} under subsection 522.26(2); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} under subsection 518(4) or 521(1.02), as it read
    immediately before October 24, 2001.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 70
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-522.25-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 522.25"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publication

**[[522.26]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.26 .sectionLabel}** The
Superintendent must publish in the [Canada
Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) a notice of every approval granted
for the purpose of section 522.21 or 522.211 and of every revocation of
any such approval.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 71
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-522.26-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 522.26"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Obligation to provide information

**[[522.27]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.27 .sectionLabel}** A foreign bank or
entity associated with a foreign bank shall, at the times and in the
form specified by the Superintendent, provide the Superintendent with
the information that he or she may require.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 71
:::

### [DIVISION 8]{.HLabel2}[Transitional]{.HTitleText2} {#h-17918 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

- **[[522.29]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.29
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in
  this Division.

  [[affected entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[affected entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an entity associated with a foreign bank that
        is an affected foreign bank and that has a financial
        establishment in Canada; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed entity associated with a foreign
        bank referred to in paragraph (c) of the definition [[affected
        foreign bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}. ([entité
        visée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[affected foreign bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[affected foreign bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a foreign bank
      that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} immediately before the day this Division comes
        into force, was the subject of an order made under subsection
        524(1) or former subsection 521(1.06) and whose order has not
        been revoked; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} on or before June 13, 2000, controlled a
        foreign bank subsidiary as defined in former section 2.

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2007, c. 6, s.
        73\]]{.Repealed} ([banque étrangère visée]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Former provision

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every reference in this Division to a former
  provision means a reference to that provision as it read immediately
  before the day this Division comes into force.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
- 2007, c. 6, s. 73
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-522.29-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 522.29"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Former s. 507(4)

- **[[522.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.3
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every order made under former
  subsection 507(4) exempting an entity from the status of being
  associated with a foreign bank or exempting a Canadian entity from
  being a "non-bank affiliate of a foreign bank" that is in force on the
  day this Division comes in force continues in force, subject to any
  further order that the Minister may make varying or revoking it.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Date order takes effect

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A revocation order or variation order takes effect
  three months after the date it is made unless the Minister and the
  entity to which it relates agree that the order is to take effect at
  another time.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publication

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall publish in the [Canada
  Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) a notice of every revocation
  order.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Former par. 518(3)(b) or s. 521(1)

**[[522.31]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.31 .sectionLabel}** Every order made
under former paragraph 518(3)(b) or former subsection 521(1) that is in
force on the day this Division comes into force continues in force,
subject to any further order that the Minister may make varying or
revoking it.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Former s. 521(1)

- **[[522.32]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.32
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An affected foreign bank or affected
  entity that had received consent under former subsection 521(1) to
  acquire or hold control of, or a substantial investment in, a Canadian
  entity that is a financial services entity but is not a permitted
  Canadian entity or an entity referred to in any of paragraphs
  468(1)(a) to (i) may continue to hold control of, or a substantial
  investment in, the Canadian entity on and after the day this Division
  comes into force if the consent had not been revoked before that day.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) applies so long as

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Canadian entity restricts its businesses in
    accordance with any terms and conditions in the consent under former
    subsection 521(1), or in an undertaking to the Minister or
    Superintendent, other than a term or condition that limits the size
    of the Canadian entity's assets; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} neither the affected foreign bank nor any affected
    entity in relation to the foreign bank

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is an authorized foreign bank, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} controls or is a major shareholder of a bank or
      a bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Former par. 518(3)(b) and former s.
  521(1)

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An affected foreign bank or an affected entity that,
  immediately before the day this Division comes into force, holds
  control of, or a substantial investment in, a Canadian entity that is
  a permitted Canadian entity or an entity referred to in any of
  paragraphs 468(1)(g) to (i) by virtue of former paragraph 518(3)(b) or
  a consent received under former subsection 521(1) may continue to hold
  control of, or a substantial investment in, the Canadian entity on and
  after the day this Division comes into force if the approval or
  consent had not been revoked before that day and, if it does so, it is
  deemed to have received any approval required under paragraphs
  522.22(1)(a) to (e) in respect of the Canadian entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Former par. 518(3)(b)

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} An affected foreign bank or affected entity that,
  immediately before the day this Division comes into force, holds, by
  virtue of former paragraph 518(3)(b), control of, or a substantial
  investment in, a Canadian entity that is not a permitted Canadian
  entity or a financial services entity may continue to hold control of,
  or a substantial investment in, the Canadian entity on and after the
  day this Division comes into force if any approval of the Minister
  under that former paragraph has not been revoked before that day, so
  long as the Canadian entity does not engage in leasing activities.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (3) and (4) apply so long as

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} after the coming into force of this Division, the
    Canadian entity restricts its businesses in accordance with any
    terms and conditions in the Minister's approval under former
    paragraph 518(3)(b), or in a consent received under former
    subsection 521(1), as the case may be, or in an undertaking to the
    Minister or Superintendent given before the day this Division comes
    into force, other than a term or condition that limits the size of
    the Canadian entity's assets;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} within one year after the coming into force of this
    Division, the affected foreign bank or affected entity discloses to
    the Minister the nature of its businesses and activities on June 13,
    2000; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} after the coming into force of this Division, the
    Canadian entity does not change the nature of its businesses as of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} June 13, 2000, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any other date after June 13, 2000 and before
      the coming into force of this Division on which the businesses of
      the Canadian entity were approved by the Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Holding other than by virtue of former
  par. 518(3)(b) or s. 521(1)

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} An affected foreign bank or an affected entity that,
  immediately before the day this Division comes into force, holds,
  otherwise than by virtue of former paragraph 518(3)(b) or a consent
  received under former subsection 521(1), control of, or a substantial
  investment in, a Canadian entity that is not a permitted Canadian
  entity or a financial services entity may continue to hold control of,
  or a substantial investment in, the Canadian entity on and after the
  day this Division comes into force.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (6) applies so long as

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} within one year after the coming into force of this
    Division, the affected foreign bank or affected entity discloses to
    the Minister the nature of its businesses on June 13, 2000;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} after the coming into force of this Division, the
    Canadian entity does not change the nature of its businesses as of
    June 13, 2000 and its businesses remain in conformity with former
    paragraph 518(3)(a);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Canadian entity does not engage in leasing
    activities; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} neither the affected foreign bank nor any affected
    entity

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is an authorized foreign bank, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} controls or is a major shareholder of a bank or
      a bank holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Investments

- **[[522.33]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.33
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite section 517 and subject to
  subsection (2), paragraph 510(1)(d) does not apply in respect of the
  holding of control of, or a substantial investment in, a Canadian
  entity whose principal activity in Canada is an activity referred to
  in any of former subparagraphs 518(3)(a)(i) to (v) and that was
  acquired by a foreign bank or an entity associated with a foreign bank
  before August 1, 1997 and before

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the foreign bank became a foreign bank or the
    foreign bank with which the entity is associated became a foreign
    bank, as the case may be; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Canadian entity's principal activity in Canada
    became an activity described in those subparagraphs.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) applies only if the foreign bank or an
  entity associated with the foreign bank

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is not an authorized foreign bank; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} does not control, and is not a major shareholder
    of, a bank or a bank holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 132
:::

## [PART XII.01]{.HLabel1}[Non-Application of the Investment Canada Act]{.HTitleText1} {#h-17989 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}[Investment Canada Act](/eng/acts/I-21.8)

- **[[522.34]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-522.34
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The [Investment Canada
  Act](/eng/acts/I-21.8) does not apply in respect of any of the
  following, whether it occurs directly or indirectly:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the acquisition of control of a Canadian business,
    within the meaning of that Act, that is an entity referred to in any
    of paragraphs 468(1)(a) to (f) by a foreign bank or by an entity
    associated with a foreign bank;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the establishment of a new Canadian business,
    within the meaning of that Act, that is the insurance business in
    Canada of a foreign insurance company that is a foreign bank to
    which Part XII does not apply or that is an entity associated with a
    foreign bank to which that Part does not apply;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the acquisition of control of a Canadian business,
    within the meaning of that Act, by an entity referred to in any of
    paragraphs 468(1)(a) to (f) that is controlled by a foreign bank or
    by an entity associated with a foreign bank;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the establishment of a new Canadian business,
    within the meaning of that Act, by a foreign bank to which Part XII
    applies, or by an entity associated with a foreign bank to which
    that Part applies, that has a financial establishment in Canada, or
    would have one by virtue of the establishment of the new Canadian
    business; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the acquisition of control of a Canadian business,
    within the meaning of that Act, by a foreign bank to which Part XII
    applies, or by an entity associated with a foreign bank to which
    that Part applies, that has a financial establishment in Canada, or
    would have one by virtue of the acquisition.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in subsection (1).

  [[entity associated with a foreign bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[entity associated with a foreign
      bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an entity that is or is deemed to
      be associated with a foreign bank within the meaning of section
      507. ([entité liée à une banque étrangère]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[foreign insurance company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[foreign insurance company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a foreign
      company as defined in subsection 2(1) of the [Insurance Companies
      Act](/eng/acts/I-11.8). ([société d'assurances
      étrangère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Financial establishment in Canada

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (1), a foreign bank has
  a financial establishment in Canada if the foreign bank has or is
  deemed to have a financial establishment in Canada for the purpose of
  Part XII.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Financial establishment in Canada

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (1), an entity
  associated with a foreign bank has a financial establishment in Canada
  if the entity has or is deemed to have a financial establishment in
  Canada for the purpose of Part XII.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2007, c. 6, s. 74
:::

## [PART XII.1]{.HLabel1}[Authorized Foreign Banks]{.HTitleText1} {#h-18008 .Part}

### [Application]{.HTitleText2} {#h-18009 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application to authorized foreign banks

- **[[523]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-523 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This
  Part applies only in respect of the business in Canada of authorized
  foreign banks.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Assets and liabilities

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The assets and liabilities of an authorized foreign
  bank in respect of its business in Canada, as shown by its books and
  records, are considered to be the assets and liabilities of the
  authorized foreign bank in respect of its business in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 523
- 1997, c. 15, s. 86
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
:::

### [Formalities of Authorization]{.HTitleText2} {#h-18017 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order permitting carrying on of business
in Canada, etc.

- **[[524]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-524 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  application by a foreign bank, the Minister may make an order
  permitting the foreign bank to establish a branch in Canada to carry
  on business in Canada under this Part.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restrictions and requirements

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The order may be made subject to the restrictions
  referred to in subsection 540(1) and the requirements referred to in
  section 627.74.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reciprocal treatment

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may make an order only if the Minister
  is satisfied that, if the application is made by a non-WTO Member
  foreign bank, treatment as favourable for banks to which this Act
  applies exists or will be provided in the jurisdiction in which the
  authorized foreign bank principally carries on business, either
  directly or through a subsidiary.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Consultation with Superintendent

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may make an order only if the Minister
  is of the opinion, after consultation with the Superintendent, that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the applicant is a bank in the jurisdiction under
    whose laws it was incorporated and is regulated in a manner
    acceptable to the Superintendent; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the applicant's principal activity is the provision
    of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} financial services, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} services that would be permitted by this Act if
      they were provided by a bank in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 524
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2001, c. 9, s. 133
- [2018, c. 27, s. 322](#1039548-1369062){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039548-1369062.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-524-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 524"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition

**[[524.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-524.1 .sectionLabel}** No foreign bank may
establish a branch in Canada to carry on business in Canada under this
Part if the foreign bank or an entity affiliated with the foreign bank

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} has control of or has a substantial investment in an
  entity that engages in Canada in any personal property leasing
  activity that a financial leasing entity as defined in subsection
  464(1) is prohibited from engaging in; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} engages in Canada in any personal property leasing
  activity that a financial leasing entity as defined in subsection
  464(1) is prohibited from engaging in.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 134
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition

**[[524.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-524.2 .sectionLabel}** No authorized
foreign bank and no entity affiliated with an authorized foreign bank
may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} control or have a substantial investment in an entity
  that engages in Canada in any personal property leasing activity that
  a financial leasing entity as defined in subsection 464(1) is
  prohibited from engaging in; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} engage in Canada in any personal property leasing
  activity that a financial leasing entity as defined in subsection
  464(1) is prohibited from engaging in.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 134
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Policies and procedures --- integrity or
security

**[[524.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-524.3 .sectionLabel}** An authorized
foreign bank shall establish and adhere to policies and procedures to
protect itself against threats to its integrity or security in relation
to its business in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2023, c. 26, s. 543](#1410959-1437048){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1410959-1437048.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application procedure

- **[[525]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-525 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  application for an order under subsection 524(1) shall be filed with
  the Superintendent, together with any other information, material and
  evidence that the Superintendent may require.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publishing notice of intent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Before filing an application, a foreign bank
  applicant shall, at least once a week for a period of four consecutive
  weeks, publish, in a form satisfactory to the Superintendent, a notice
  of intention to make the application in the [Canada
  Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) and in a newspaper in general
  circulation at or near the place where its principal office is to be
  situated.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Objections

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A person who objects to the proposed order may,
  within thirty days after the date of the last publication under
  subsection (2), submit the objection in writing to the Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Minister to be informed

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of an objection, the Superintendent shall
  inform the Minister of it.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Inquiry into objection and report

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of an objection, and if the application
  for the order has been received, the Superintendent shall, if
  satisfied that it is necessary and in the public interest to do so,
  hold or cause to be held a public inquiry into the objection as it
  relates to the application and, on completion of the inquiry, the
  Superintendent shall report the findings of the inquiry to the
  Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report to be made available

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} Within thirty days after receiving the report, the
  Minister shall make it available to the public.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Rules governing proceedings

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the approval of the Governor in Council,
  the Superintendent may make rules governing the proceedings at public
  inquiries held under this section.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 525
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Factors to be considered by Minister

**[[526]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-526 .sectionLabel}** Before making an order
under subsection 524(1), the Minister shall take into account all
matters that the Minister considers relevant to the application,
including

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the nature and sufficiency of the financial resources
  of the foreign bank as a source of continuing financial support for
  the carrying on of its business in Canada;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the soundness and feasibility of plans of the foreign
  bank for the future conduct and development of its business in Canada;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the business record and past performance of the
  foreign bank;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the reputation of the foreign bank for being operated
  in a manner that is consistent with the standards of good character
  and integrity;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} whether the proposed authorized foreign bank will be
  operated responsibly by persons with the competence and experience
  suitable for involvement in the operation of a financial institution;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the impact of any integration of the businesses and
  operations in Canada of the authorized foreign bank with those of its
  affiliates in Canada on the conduct of those businesses and
  operations; and

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} the best interests of the financial system in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 526
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2001, c. 9, s. 135
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of order

- **[[527]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-527 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  order made under subsection 524(1) shall set out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the authorized foreign bank and, where
    applicable, the name under which it is permitted to carry on
    business in Canada;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the province in which the principal office of the
    authorized foreign bank is to be situated;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} whether the authorized foreign bank is subject to
    any restrictions and requirements referred to in subsection 524(2);
    and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the date on which the order becomes effective.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Provisions of order

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may set out in the order any provision
  not contrary to this Act that the Minister considers advisable in
  order to take into account the particular circumstances of the
  proposed authorized foreign bank with respect to the carrying on of
  business in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Terms and conditions

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may impose any terms and conditions in
  respect of the order that the Minister considers appropriate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of order

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent shall cause to be published in the
  [Canada Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) a notice of the making of
  the order.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 527
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2005, c. 54, s. 79
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amended order

- **[[528]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-528 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  application by an authorized foreign bank, the Minister may, by
  further order,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2007, c. 6, s. 75\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} add any provision referred to in subsection 527(2)
    or any term or condition referred to in subsection 527(3) or change
    or remove any of those provisions, terms or conditions that are
    included in the order made under subsection 524(1) or in any other
    order made under this section; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} add or remove the restrictions and requirements
    referred to in subsection 524(2).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Change of name

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} On application by an authorized foreign bank, the
  Superintendent may, by order, change the name under which it is
  permitted to carry on business in Canada or the province in which its
  principal office is situated as that name or province is set out in
  the order made under subsection 524(1) or in any other order made
  under this section.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of intention

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Before making an application under subsection (1),
  the authorized foreign bank must publish a notice of intention to make
  the application at least once a week for a period of four consecutive
  weeks in the [Canada Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) and in a
  newspaper of general circulation at or near the place where its
  principal office is situated.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transitional

- **[[529]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-529
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to this section but
  notwithstanding any other provision of this Act or the regulations,
  the Minister may, on the recommendation of the Superintendent, by
  order, grant an authorized foreign bank permission to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} engage in a business activity specified in the
    order that an authorized foreign bank is not otherwise permitted by
    this Part to engage in;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} have liabilities that an authorized foreign bank is
    not otherwise permitted by this Part to have, if the authorized
    foreign bank or an affiliate of the authorized foreign bank had
    those liabilities at the time an application for an order under
    subsection 524(1) was made;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} hold assets that an authorized foreign bank is not
    otherwise permitted by this Part to hold, if the assets were held,
    at the time an application for an order under subsection 524(1) was
    made, by the authorized foreign bank or an affiliate of the
    authorized foreign bank;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} acquire and hold assets that an authorized foreign
    bank is not otherwise permitted by this Part to acquire or hold if
    the authorized foreign bank was obliged, at the time an application
    for an order under subsection 524(1) was made, to acquire those
    assets;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2001, c. 9, s. 136\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an authorized foreign bank that is
    not subject to the restrictions and requirements referred to in
    subsection 524(2), carry on business in Canada without having to
    deposit assets having a value of at least five million dollars, as
    required by subparagraphs 534(3)(a)(ii) and 582(1)(b)(i), if the
    authorized foreign bank continues to hold a substantial investment
    in

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a bank that is a subsidiary of a foreign bank and
      the Minister has approved an application for letters patent
      dissolving the bank made by the subsidiary under section 344, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a company to which the [Trust and Loan Companies
      Act](/eng/acts/T-19.8) applies and the Minister has approved an
      application for letters patent dissolving the company made under
      section 349 of that Act; or

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} maintain outside Canada any records or registers
    required by this Act to be maintained in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An order under subsection (1) may not be made if the
  effect of the order would be to permit an authorized foreign bank to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} contravene section 545, in the case of an
    authorized foreign bank that is not subject to the restrictions and
    requirements referred to in subsection 524(2); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} have deposit liabilities so as to cause the
    authorized foreign bank to be in contravention of section 540, in
    the case of an authorized foreign bank that is subject to the
    restrictions and requirements referred to in subsection 524(2).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duration

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Permission granted under subsection (1) shall be
  expressed to be granted for a period specified in the order not
  exceeding

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} with respect to any activity described in paragraph
    (1)(a), thirty days after the day on which an order made under
    subsection 524(1) becomes effective in respect of the authorized
    foreign bank or, where the activity is conducted pursuant to an
    agreement existing on that day, on the expiration of the agreement;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to any matter described in paragraph
    (1)(b), ten years; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} with respect to any matter described in any of
    paragraphs (1)(c) to (g), two years.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Renewal

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (5), the Minister may, on the
  recommendation of the Superintendent, by order, renew permission
  granted under subsection (1) with respect to any matter described in
  paragraphs (1)(b) to (f) for any further period or periods that the
  Minister considers necessary.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limitation

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may not grant to an authorized foreign
  bank any permission

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} with respect to matters described in paragraph
    (1)(b), that purports to be effective more than ten years after the
    day on which an order made under subsection 534(1) becomes effective
    in respect of the authorized foreign bank, unless the Minister is
    satisfied on the basis of evidence on oath provided by an officer of
    the authorized foreign bank that the authorized foreign bank will
    not be able at law to redeem or discharge at the end of the ten
    years any liabilities to which the permission relates;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to matters described in paragraphs
    (1)(c) and (d), that purports to be effective more than ten years
    after the day on which an order made under subsection 534(1) becomes
    effective in respect of the authorized foreign bank; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} with respect to matters described in paragraph
    (1)(f), that purports to be effective more than seven years after
    the day on which an order made under subsection 534(1) becomes
    effective in respect of the authorized foreign bank.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 529
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2001, c. 9, s. 136
- 2007, c. 6, s. 76
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibited names

- **[[530]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-530 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  order made under subsection 524(1) or 528(1.1) may not provide for the
  use of a name that is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} prohibited by an Act of Parliament;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the opinion of the Superintendent, deceptively
    misdescriptive;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the same as or, in the opinion of the
    Superintendent, substantially the same as or confusingly similar to,
    any existing trademark, trade name or corporate name of a body
    corporate, except where

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the trademark or trade name is being changed or
      the body corporate is being dissolved or is changing its corporate
      name, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} consent to the use of the trademark, trade name
      or corporate name is signified to the Superintendent in any manner
      that the Superintendent may require;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the same as or, in the opinion of the
    Superintendent, substantially the same as or confusingly similar to,
    the known name under or by which any other entity carries on
    business or is identified; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} reserved under section 43 for an existing or
    proposed bank or for an existing or proposed authorized foreign bank
    or under section 697 for an existing or proposed bank holding
    company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Name otherwise prohibited

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An order made under subsection 524(1) or 528(1.1) may
  provide for the use of a name that includes a word referred to in
  section 47 of the [Trust and Loan Companies Act](/eng/acts/T-19.8).

**[[531]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-531 .sectionLabel}** An authorized foreign
bank shall set out its name and, where applicable, any other permitted
name, as set out in the order made under subsection 524(1) or 528(1.1),
in legible characters in all contracts, invoices, negotiable instruments
and other documents evidencing rights and obligations with respect to
other parties that are issued or made by or on behalf of the authorized
foreign bank.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Directing change of name

- **[[532]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-532 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If
  through inadvertence or otherwise an order made under subsection
  524(1) or 528(1.1) provides for the use of a name that is prohibited
  by section 530, the Superintendent may, by order, direct the
  authorized foreign bank to change the name without delay and the
  authorized foreign bank shall comply with that direction.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Revoking name

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where an authorized foreign bank does not comply with
  a direction under subsection (1) within sixty days after the service
  of the direction, the Superintendent may revoke the name and assign
  another name and, until changed in accordance with section 528, that
  other name is the name of the authorized foreign bank.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Other name

- **[[533]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-533
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 531 and
  subsection (2), an authorized foreign bank may carry on business in
  Canada under a name other than the name set out in the order made
  under subsection 524(1) or 528(1.1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Directions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where an authorized foreign bank carries on business
  in Canada under a name other than the name set out in the order, the
  Superintendent may, by order, direct the authorized foreign bank not
  to use that other name if the Superintendent is of the opinion that
  the other name is a name referred to in any of paragraphs 530(1)(a) to
  (e).

### [Commencement and Carrying on of Business in Canada]{.HTitleText2} {#h-18163 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order approving commencement and carrying
on of business in Canada

- **[[534]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-534 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  application by an authorized foreign bank, the Superintendent may make
  an order approving the commencement and carrying on of business in
  Canada by the authorized foreign bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An authorized foreign bank may not commence to carry
  on business in Canada until it is authorized to do so by an order made
  under subsection (1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions for order

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may make the order only if the
  Superintendent is satisfied that the authorized foreign bank has

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} deposited in Canada unencumbered assets of a type
    approved by the Superintendent, the total value of which, determined
    in accordance with the accounting principles referred to in
    subsection 308(4), shall be

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an authorized foreign bank that is
      subject to the restrictions and requirements referred to in
      subsection 524(2), one hundred thousand dollars, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, five million dollars or any
      greater amount that the Superintendent specifies;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} submitted a power of attorney in accordance with
    subsection 536(2); and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} complied with all other relevant requirements of
    this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deposit agreement

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The assets referred to in paragraph (3)(a) shall be
  kept with a Canadian financial institution approved by the
  Superintendent pursuant to a deposit agreement entered into with the
  prior approval of the Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions of order

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The order under subsection (1) may contain any
  conditions or limitations that the Superintendent considers
  appropriate that are consistent with this Act and that relate to the
  carrying on of the business in Canada of the authorized foreign bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Variations

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} In respect of an order made under subsection (1), the
  Superintendent may at any time, by further order,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} make the order subject to any conditions or
    limitations that the Superintendent considers appropriate that are
    consistent with this Act and that relate to the business in Canada
    of the authorized foreign bank, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} amend or revoke any authorization contained in the
    order or any condition or limitation to which the order is subject,

  but before making a further order the Superintendent shall provide the
  authorized foreign bank with an opportunity to make representations
  regarding that further order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Public notice

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} On the making of an order under subsection (1), the
  authorized foreign bank shall publish a notice of the making of the
  order in a newspaper in general circulation at or near the place where
  its principal office is to be situated.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice in [Canada
  Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/)

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent shall cause to be published in the
  [Canada Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) a notice of the making of
  an order under subsection (1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Time limit

  [(9)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent shall not make an order under
  subsection (1) in respect of an authorized foreign bank more than one
  year after the day on which the order under subsection 524(1) in
  respect of the authorized foreign bank becomes effective.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Cessation of existence

  [(10)]{.lawlabel} If an order under subsection (1) is not obtained
  within one year after the day on which the order under subsection
  524(1) in respect of the authorized foreign bank becomes effective,
  the order made under subsection 524(1) is revoked.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 534
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2001, c. 9, s. 138
:::

### [Principal Office and Principal Officer]{.HTitleText2} {#h-18195 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Principal office

- **[[535]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-535 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  authorized foreign bank shall at all times have a principal office in
  the province specified in the order made under subsection 524(1) or
  528(1.1) with respect to it.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Change of principal office

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An authorized foreign bank may change the address of
  its principal office within the province specified in the order made
  under subsection 524(1) or 528(1.1) with respect to it.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of change of address

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An authorized foreign bank shall send to the
  Superintendent, within fifteen days after any change of address of its
  principal office, a notice of the change of address.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 535
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2005, c. 54, s. 81
- 2007, c. 6, s. 81
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-535-20060427.html "Link to previous version of section 535"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Principal officer

- **[[536]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-536 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  authorized foreign bank shall appoint an employee who is ordinarily
  resident in Canada to be its principal officer for the purposes of
  this Part.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Power of attorney

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The authorized foreign bank shall provide the
  principal officer with a power of attorney expressly authorizing the
  principal officer to receive all notices under the laws of Canada from
  the Minister or Superintendent and shall without delay submit a copy
  of the power of attorney to the Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Vacancy

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where a vacancy occurs in the position of principal
  officer, the authorized foreign bank shall, without delay, fill the
  vacancy and submit a copy of the new power of attorney to the
  Superintendent.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 536
- 1996, c. 6, s. 13
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
:::

### [Transfer of Liabilities]{.HTitleText2} {#h-18214 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transfer of liabilities not permitted

- **[[537]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-537
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), an
  authorized foreign bank shall not transfer all or substantially all of
  the liabilities in respect of its business in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An authorized foreign bank may, with the approval of
  the Minister, transfer all or substantially all of the liabilities in
  respect of its business in Canada to another authorized foreign bank
  in respect of its business in Canada, to a bank or to a body corporate
  to which the [Trust and Loan Companies Act](/eng/acts/T-19.8) applies.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application for approval

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An approval may be given under subsection (2) only if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} notice of the authorized foreign bank's intention
    to apply for the approval has been published at least once a week
    for a period of four consecutive weeks in the [Canada
    Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) and in a newspaper in general
    circulation at or near the place where the principal office of the
    transferring authorized foreign bank is situated; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the application for approval is supported by
    evidence satisfactory to the Minister that the requirement of
    paragraph (a) has been satisfied and that the entity to which the
    authorized foreign bank intends to make the transfer is an entity
    referred to in subsection (2).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 537
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
:::

**[[537.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-537.1 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, 1999,

### [Business and Powers]{.HTitleText2} {#h-18227 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Main business

- **[[538]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-538
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to this Act, an authorized
  foreign bank shall not carry on any business in Canada other than the
  business of banking and any business generally that appertains to the
  business of banking.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Included activities

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, the business of banking
  includes

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} providing any financial service;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} acting as a financial agent;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} providing investment counselling services and
    portfolio management services; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} issuing payment, credit or charge cards and, in
    cooperation with others including other financial institutions,
    operating a payment, credit or charge card plan.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 538
- 1996, c. 6, s. 15
- 1997, c. 15, s. 88
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2009, c. 2, s. 272(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-538-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 538"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional activities

- **[[539]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-539 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  addition, an authorized foreign bank may, in Canada,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} hold, manage and otherwise deal with real property;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide prescribed bank-related data processing
    services;

  - [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} with the prior written approval of the Minister,
    engage in any of the following activities, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} collecting, manipulating and transmitting

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} information that is primarily financial or
        economic in nature,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} information that relates to the business of an
        entity in which a bank is permitted to acquire a substantial
        investment under section 468 or to the business of a Canadian
        entity acquired or held under section 522.08, and

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} any other information that the Minister may, by
        order, specify,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} providing advisory or other services in the
      design, development or implementation of information management
      systems,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} designing, developing or marketing computer
      software, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} designing, developing, manufacturing or selling,
      as an ancillary activity to any activity referred to in any of
      subparagraphs (i) to (iii) that the authorized foreign bank is
      engaging in, computer equipment integral to the provision of
      information services related to the business of financial
      institutions or to the provision of financial services;

  - [(b.2)]{.lawlabel} with the prior written approval of the Minister,
    develop, design, hold, manage, manufacture, sell or otherwise deal
    with data transmission systems, information sites, communication
    devices or information platforms or portals that are used

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} to provide information that is primarily
      financial or economic in nature,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} to provide information that relates to the
      business of an entity in which a bank is permitted to acquire a
      substantial investment under section 468 or to the business of a
      Canadian entity acquired or held under section 522.08, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} for a prescribed purpose or in prescribed
      circumstances;

  - [(b.3)]{.lawlabel} engage, under prescribed terms and conditions, if
    any are prescribed, in specialized business management or advisory
    services;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} promote merchandise and services to the holders of
    any payment, credit or charge card issued by the authorized foreign
    bank;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} engage in the sale of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} tickets, including lottery tickets, on a
      non-profit public service basis in connection with special,
      temporary and infrequent non-commercial celebrations or projects
      that are of local, municipal, provincial or national interest,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} urban transit tickets, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} tickets in respect of a lottery sponsored by
      the federal government or a provincial or municipal government or
      an agency of any of those governments;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} act as a custodian of property;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} act as receiver, liquidator or sequestrator; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} provide identification, authentication or
    verification services.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Except as authorized by or under this Act, an
  authorized foreign bank shall not deal in Canada in goods, wares or
  merchandise or engage in any trade or other business.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting what an authorized foreign bank may or
    may not do with respect to the carrying on of the activities
    referred to in paragraphs (1)(b.1) to (b.3);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} imposing terms and conditions in respect of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the provision of financial services referred to
      in paragraph 538(2)(a) that are financial planning services,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the provision of services referred to in
      paragraph 538(2)(c), and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the carrying on of the activities referred to
      in any of paragraphs (1)(b.1) to (b.3); and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} respecting the circumstances in which authorized
    foreign banks may be exempted from the requirement to obtain the
    approval of the Minister before carrying on a particular activity
    referred to in paragraph (1)(b.1) or (b.2).

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations apply

**[[539.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-539.1 .sectionLabel}** Regulations made
for the purpose of any of sections 409 to 411 apply in respect of
authorized foreign banks with any modifications that the circumstances
require unless regulations made under subsection 539(3) provide
otherwise.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 140

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restrictions

- **[[540]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-540
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where subsection 524(2) applies, the
  authorized foreign bank shall not, in respect of its business in
  Canada,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} except as permitted by subsection (4), engage in
    the business of accepting deposit liabilities, or otherwise borrow
    money;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subject to the regulations, act as an agent for any
    person in the taking of deposit liabilities; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} guarantee any securities or accept any bills of
    exchange or depository bills that are

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} issued by any person, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} intended by the issuer or any party to be sold
      or traded.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 27, s. 323\]]{.Repealed}

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 27, s. 323\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Authorized borrowing

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraph (1)(a), an authorized
  foreign bank may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} accept deposit liabilities or otherwise borrow
    money from

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a financial institution other than a foreign
      bank, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a foreign bank described in any of subparagraphs
      508(1)(a)(i) to (iii),

    by means of financial instruments that cannot be subsequently sold
    or traded; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} accept deposit liabilities or otherwise borrow
    money, from prescribed classes of entities referred to in
    subparagraph (a)(i) or (ii), by means of financial instruments that
    can be sold to or traded with those classes of entities, in
    accordance with regulations made pursuant to subsection (6).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application of paragraph (1)(c)

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(c) does not apply in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} securities or bills of exchange that are sold to or
    traded with any entity referred to in subparagraph (4)(a)(i) or (ii)
    and that cannot be subsequently sold or traded; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} securities or bills of exchange that can be sold to
    or traded with prescribed classes of entities referred to in
    subparagraph (4)(a)(i) or (ii), in accordance with regulations made
    pursuant to subsection (6).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} prescribing the class, type or amount of deposit
    liabilities or borrowings referred to in paragraph (4)(b);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} prescribing the class, type or amount of securities
    or bills of exchange referred to in paragraph (5)(b);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} prescribing the classes of entities referred to in
    paragraph (4)(b) or (5)(b);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} prescribing the terms and conditions respecting any
    sale or trade of financial instruments, securities or bills of
    exchange;

  - [(d.1)]{.lawlabel} respecting circumstances in which and the
    conditions under which an authorized foreign bank that is subject to
    the restrictions and requirements referred to in subsection 524(2)
    may act as agent for any person in the taking of deposit
    liabilities; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} respecting such other matters or things as are
    necessary to carry out the purposes of this section.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Guarantees and acceptances

**[[541.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-541.1 .sectionLabel}** An authorized
foreign bank that is not subject to the restrictions and requirements
referred to in subsection 524(2) may, in respect of its business in
Canada, guarantee any securities and accept any bills of exchange that
are issued by any person and intended by the issuer or any party to be
sold or traded.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment clearing and settlement

**[[542]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-542 .sectionLabel}** Subject to section 22.1
of the [Payment Clearing and Settlement Act](/eng/acts/P-4.4), an
authorized foreign bank may be a participant in a clearing and
settlement system designated under subsection 4(1) of that Act.

- **[[543]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-543
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to sections 540, 546 and

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} act as agent for any person in respect of the

**[[544]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-544 .sectionLabel}** No authorized foreign
bank shall act in Canada as

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deposits that fall below \$150,000

- **[[545]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-545 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  authorized foreign bank shall, in respect of its business in Canada,
  ensure that, on each day that is at least thirty days after the date
  of the order under subsection 534(1) made in respect of it,

  ::: {#18354 .Subsection}
  A/B ≤ 0.01

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the sum of all amounts each of which is the sum of all the
      deposits held by the authorized foreign bank at the end of a day
      in the preceding thirty days each of which deposits is less than
      \$150,000 and payable in Canada; and

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the sum of all amounts each of which is the sum of all deposits
      held by the authorized foreign bank at the end of a day in those
      preceding thirty days and payable in Canada.
  :::

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exchange rate

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (1), the rate of
  exchange that shall be applied on any day in determining the amount in
  Canadian dollars of a deposit in a currency of a country other than
  Canada shall be determined in accordance with any regulations that may
  be made.

- Meaning of [[deposit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (1),
  [[deposit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning that would be given to
  it by the schedule to the [Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation
  Act](/eng/acts/C-3) for the purposes of deposit insurance if that
  schedule were read without reference to subsections 2(2), (5) and (6)
  of that schedule, but does not include prescribed deposits.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 27, s. 325\]]{.Repealed}

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 27, s. 325\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting the determination of rates of exchange
    referred to in subsection (2); and

  - [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} prescribing the deposits referred to in
    subsection (3) and the terms and conditions with respect to the
    acceptance of those deposits.

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 27, s. 325\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 27, s. 325\]]{.Repealed}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deposits less than \$150,000

- **[[546]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-546
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the regulations, an
  authorized foreign bank that is not subject to the restrictions and
  requirements referred to in subsection 524(2) may not, in respect of
  its business in Canada, act as agent for any person in the taking of a
  deposit that is less than \$150,000 and payable in Canada.

- Meaning of [[deposit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[deposit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has
  the meaning assigned to that term by subsection 545(3).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  respecting the circumstances in which, and the conditions under which,
  an authorized foreign bank referred to in subsection (1) may act as
  agent for any person in the taking of a deposit that is less than
  \$150,000 and payable in Canada.

- 1996, c. 6, s. 18
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2001, c. 9, s. 143

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shared premises

- **[[547]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-547
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the regulations, no
  authorized foreign bank shall carry on business in Canada on premises
  that are shared with those of a member institution, within the meaning
  of section 2 of the [Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation
  Act](/eng/acts/C-3), that is affiliated with the authorized foreign
  bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limitation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) only applies in respect of premises or
  any portion of premises on which both the authorized foreign bank and
  the member institution carry on business with the public and to which
  the public has access.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Adjacent premises

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the regulations, no authorized foreign
  bank shall carry on business in Canada on premises that are adjacent
  to a branch or office of a member institution, within the meaning of
  section 2 of the [Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation
  Act](/eng/acts/C-3), that is affiliated with the authorized foreign
  bank, unless the authorized foreign bank clearly indicates to its
  customers that its business and the premises on which it is carried on
  are separate and distinct from the business and premises of the
  affiliated member institution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting the circumstances in which, and the
    conditions under which, an authorized foreign bank may carry on
    business in Canada on premises that are shared with those of a
    member institution referred to in subsection (1); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} respecting the circumstances in which, and the
    conditions under which, an authorized foreign bank may carry on
    business in Canada on premises that are adjacent to a branch or
    office of a member institution referred to in subsection (3).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 547
- 1996, c. 6, s. 19(E)
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2001, c. 9, s. 144
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on securities activities

**[[548]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-548 .sectionLabel}** An authorized foreign
bank shall not deal in Canada in securities to the extent prohibited or
restricted by any regulations that the Governor in Council may make for
the purposes of this section.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 548
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on insurance business

- **[[549]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-549 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  authorized foreign bank shall not undertake in Canada the business of
  insurance except to the extent permitted by this Act or the
  regulations.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on acting as agent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An authorized foreign bank shall not act in Canada as
  agent for any person in the placing of insurance and shall not lease
  or provide space in any branch in Canada of the authorized foreign
  bank to any person engaged in the placing of insurance.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  respecting the matters referred to in subsection (1) and regulations
  respecting relations between authorized foreign banks and

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} entities that undertake the business of insurance;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} insurance agents or insurance brokers.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Saving

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Nothing in this section precludes an authorized
  foreign bank from

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} requiring insurance to be placed by a borrower for
    the security of the authorized foreign bank; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} obtaining group insurance for its employees.

- Definition of [[business of insurance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[business of
  insurance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the issuance of any annuity if the liability in
    respect of the annuity is contingent on the death of a person; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the issuance of any debt obligation, any of whose
    terms and conditions are established on the basis of mortality
    considerations, under which the issuer is obliged to make periodic
    payments.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 549
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2012, c. 19, s. 207
:::

[Previous
Version](section-549-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 549"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on leasing

**[[550]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-550 .sectionLabel}** An authorized foreign
bank shall not engage in Canada in any personal property leasing
activity in which a financial leasing entity as defined in subsection
464(1) is not permitted to engage.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 550
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2001, c. 9, s. 145
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on residential mortgages

- **[[551]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-551 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  authorized foreign bank shall not make a loan in Canada on the
  security of residential property in Canada for the purpose of
  purchasing, renovating or improving that property, or refinance a loan
  for that purpose, if the amount of the loan, together with the amount
  outstanding of any mortgage having an equal or prior claim against the
  property, would exceed 80 per cent of the value of the property at the
  time of the loan.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a loan made or guaranteed under the [National
    Housing Act](/eng/acts/N-11) or any other Act of Parliament by or
    under which a different limit on the value of property on the
    security of which the authorized foreign bank may make a loan is
    established;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a loan if repayment of the amount of the loan that
    exceeds the maximum amount set out in subsection (1) is guaranteed
    or insured by a government agency or a private insurer approved by
    the Superintendent;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the acquisition by the authorized foreign bank from
    an entity of securities issued or guaranteed by the entity that are
    secured on any residential property, whether in favour of a trustee
    or otherwise, or the making of a loan by the authorized foreign bank
    to the entity against the issue of those securities; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a loan secured by a mortgage where

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the mortgage is taken back by the authorized
      foreign bank on a property disposed of by it, including where the
      disposition is by way of a realization of a security interest, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the mortgage secures payment of an amount
      payable to the authorized foreign bank for the property.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 551
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2007, c. 6, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-551-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 551"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on charges to borrowers

- **[[552]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-552
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to any regulations made
  under subsection (2), an authorized foreign bank that has obtained
  insurance or a guarantee against default on a loan made in Canada on
  the security of residential property shall not charge a borrower an
  amount for the insurance or guarantee that exceeds the actual cost to
  the authorized foreign bank of the insurance or guarantee.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting the determination of the actual cost to
    an authorized foreign bank for the purposes of subsection (1);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} respecting the circumstances in which an authorized
    foreign bank is exempt from the application of subsection (1);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} respecting, in relation to insurance or a guarantee
    against default on a loan made by an authorized foreign bank in
    Canada on the security of residential property,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the arrangements into which the authorized
      foreign bank, its representatives and its employees may or may not
      enter, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the payments or benefits that the authorized
      foreign bank, its representatives and its employees may or may not
      accept from an insurer or the insurer's affiliates; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} respecting any other matters necessary to carry out
    the purposes of subsection (1).

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 27, s. 326\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
