[Previous
Version](section-598-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 598"){.PITLink}
:::

### [Termination of Business in Canada]{.HTitleText2} {#h-19076 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Release of assets in Canada

- **[[599]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-599 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  authorized foreign bank that discontinues its business in Canada may
  apply in writing to the Superintendent for the release of its assets
  maintained on deposit under paragraph 534(3)(a) or subsection 582(1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions of release

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Except as otherwise provided in this Act, the assets
  may not be released unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the authorized foreign bank discharges, provides
    for the discharge of, or transfers, all its liabilities in respect
    of its business in Canada to a bank, to another authorized foreign
    bank in respect of its business in Canada or to a body corporate to
    which the [Trust and Loan Companies Act](/eng/acts/T-19.8) applies;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the authorized foreign bank provides the
    Superintendent with proof of the publication, for four consecutive
    weeks, in at least one newspaper of general circulation at or near
    the place where the principal office of the authorized foreign bank
    is situated and the [Canada Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) of a
    notice that it will apply to the Superintendent for the release of
    its assets on a day specified in the notice, which must be at least
    six weeks after the date of the notice, and calling on any of its
    depositors or creditors opposing that release to file their
    opposition with the Superintendent on or before the day.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Superintendent may release assets

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} After the day specified in the notice, the
  Superintendent may authorize the release of the assets if the
  Superintendent is satisfied that the authorized foreign bank has
  discharged, provided for the discharge of, or transferred, all of its
  liabilities in respect of its business in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Release of assets to liquidator

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsections (1) to (3), the assets on
  deposit of an authorized foreign bank that is in liquidation may, on
  the order of any court having jurisdiction under the [Winding-up and
  Restructuring Act](/eng/acts/W-11), be released to the liquidator.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order deemed to be revoked

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} An order made under subsection 524(1), 528(1) or
  (1.1) or 534(1) in respect of an authorized foreign bank is deemed to
  be revoked when the Superintendent authorizes the release of the
  assets of the authorized foreign bank under subsection (3).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 599
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2007, c. 6, s. 96
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-599-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 599"){.PITLink}
:::

### [Supervision]{.HTitleText2} {#h-19092 .Subheading}

#### [Returns]{.HTitleText3} {#h-19093 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Required information

**[[600]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-600 .sectionLabel}** An authorized foreign
bank shall provide the Superintendent with any information, at the times
and in the form, that the Superintendent may require.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 600
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Annual return

- **[[601]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-601 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  authorized foreign bank, in respect of its business in Canada, shall
  prepare annually a return of the condition and affairs of the
  authorized foreign bank as at the end of each financial year, showing
  its assets and liabilities and its income and expenditures during that
  financial year together with any other information that the
  Superintendent considers appropriate.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2007, c. 6, s. 97\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Accounting principles

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The annual return shall be prepared in accordance
  with the accounting principles referred to in subsection 308(4).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 601
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2007, c. 6, s. 97
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-601-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 601"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[602]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-602 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, 2007, c.
6, s. 98\]]{.Repealed}

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-602-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 602"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[603]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-603 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, 2007, c.
6, s. 98\]]{.Repealed}

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-603-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 603"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[604]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-604 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, 2007, c.
6, s. 98\]]{.Repealed}

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-604-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 604"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Production of information and documents

- **[[605]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-605 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  Superintendent may, by order, direct a person who controls an
  authorized foreign bank or any entity that is affiliated with an
  authorized foreign bank to provide the Superintendent with any
  information or documents that may be specified in the order if the
  Superintendent believes that the production of the information or
  documents is necessary in order to be satisfied that the provisions of
  this Act are being duly observed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Time

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person to whom an order is issued shall provide the
  information or documents specified in the order within the time
  specified in the order and, where the order does not specify a time,
  the person shall provide the information or documents within a
  reasonable time.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of an entity
  that is affiliated with an authorized foreign bank where that entity
  is a financial institution regulated

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} by or under an Act of Parliament; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} by or under an Act of the legislature of a province
    where the Superintendent has entered into an agreement with the
    appropriate official or public body responsible for the supervision
    of financial institutions in that province concerning the sharing of
    information on those financial institutions.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 46, s. 605
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Confidential information

- **[[606]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-606
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 609, all
  information regarding the business or affairs of an authorized foreign
  bank, or regarding a person dealing with an authorized foreign bank,
  that is obtained by the Superintendent, or by any person acting under
  the direction of the Superintendent, as a result of the administration
  or enforcement of any Act of Parliament, and all information prepared
  from that information, is confidential and shall be treated
  accordingly.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disclosure permitted

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Nothing in subsection (1) prevents the Superintendent
  from disclosing any information

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} to any government agency or body that regulates or
    supervises financial institutions, for purposes related to that
    regulation or supervision,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to any other agency or body that regulates or
    supervises financial institutions, for purposes related to that
    regulation or supervision,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} to the Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation for
    purposes related to its operation, and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} to the Deputy Minister of Finance or any officer of
    the Department of Finance authorized in writing by the Deputy
    Minister of Finance or to the Governor of the Bank of Canada or any
    officer of the Bank of Canada authorized in writing by the Governor
    of the Bank of Canada, for the purposes of policy analysis related
    to the regulation of financial institutions,

  if the Superintendent is satisfied that the information will be
  treated as confidential by the agency, body or person to whom it is
  disclosed.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2001, c. 9, s. 164
- 2007, c. 6, s. 99
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-606-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 606"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

**[[607]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-607 .sectionLabel}** The Governor in Council
may make regulations prohibiting, limiting or restricting the disclosure
by authorized foreign banks of prescribed supervisory information.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Evidentiary privilege

- **[[608]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-608
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Prescribed supervisory information
  shall not be used as evidence in any civil proceedings and is
  privileged for that purpose.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No testimony or production

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall by an order of any court, tribunal or
  other body be required in any civil proceedings to give oral testimony
  or to produce any document relating to any prescribed supervisory
  information.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exceptions to subsection (1)

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Minister, the Superintendent or the Attorney
    General of Canada may, in accordance with the regulations, if any,
    use prescribed supervisory information as evidence in any
    proceedings; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an authorized foreign bank may, in accordance with
    the regulations, if any, use prescribed supervisory information as
    evidence in any proceedings in relation to the administration or
    enforcement of this Act or the [Winding-up and Restructuring
    Act](/eng/acts/W-11) that are commenced by the authorized foreign
    bank, the Minister, the Superintendent or the Attorney General of
    Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exceptions to subsections (1) and (2)

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (1) and (2) and section 39.1 of
  the [Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions
  Act](/eng/acts/O-2.7), a court, tribunal or other body may, by order,
  require the Minister, the Superintendent or an authorized foreign bank
  to give oral testimony or to produce any document relating to any
  prescribed supervisory information in any civil proceedings in
  relation to the administration or enforcement of this Act that are
  commenced by the Minister, the Superintendent, the Attorney General of
  Canada or the authorized foreign bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No waiver

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The disclosure of any prescribed supervisory
  information, other than under subsection (3) or (4), does not
  constitute a waiver of the privilege referred to in subsection (1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may, for the purposes of
  subsection (3), make regulations respecting the circumstances in which
  prescribed supervisory information may be used as evidence.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2007, c. 6, s. 100
- 2015, c. 36, s. 233
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-608-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 608"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No waiver

- **[[608.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-608.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, the
  disclosure by an authorized foreign bank --- or by a person who
  controls an authorized foreign bank or by an entity that is affiliated
  with an authorized foreign bank --- to the Superintendent of any
  information that is subject to a privilege under the law of evidence,
  solicitor-client privilege or the professional secrecy of advocates
  and notaries or to litigation privilege does not constitute a waiver
  of any of those privileges or that secrecy.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No disclosure

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent shall not disclose any information
  referred to in subsection (1) to any person whose powers, duties or
  functions include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the investigation or prosecution of an offence
    under any Act of Parliament or of the legislature of a province; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the investigation of, or conduct of proceedings in
    respect of, a violation under an Act referred to in paragraph (a).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2018, c. 27, s. 169
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disclosure by Superintendent

- **[[609]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-609 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  Superintendent shall disclose, at the times and in the manner that the
  Minister may determine, any information obtained by the Superintendent
  under this Act that the Minister considers ought to be disclosed for
  the purposes of the analysis of the business in Canada of an
  authorized foreign bank and that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is contained in returns filed pursuant to the
    Superintendent's financial regulatory reporting requirements in
    respect of authorized foreign banks; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has been obtained as a result of an industry-wide
    or sectoral survey conducted by the Superintendent in relation to an
    issue or circumstances that could have an impact on the business in
    Canada of authorized foreign banks.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prior consultation required

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall consult with the Superintendent
  before making any determination under subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disclosure by an authorized foreign bank

- **[[610]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-610 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  authorized foreign bank shall make available to the public any
  information concerning

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the compensation of its executives, as that
    expression is defined by the regulations, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} its business and affairs for the purposes of the
    analysis of its business in Canada,

  in the form and manner and at the times that may be required by or
  under regulations that the Governor in Council may make for the
  purpose.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption by regulation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(a) does not apply to an authorized
  foreign bank that is within any class or classes of authorized foreign
  banks that may be prescribed.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exceptions to disclosure

**[[611]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-611 .sectionLabel}** Subject to any
regulations made under paragraph 627.998(n), information obtained by an
authorized foreign bank regarding any of its customers shall not be
disclosed or made available under subsection 609(1) or section 610.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- [2018, c. 27, s. 328](#1039562-1369111){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039562-1369111.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-611-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 611"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report respecting disclosure

**[[612]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-612 .sectionLabel}** The Superintendent
shall prepare a report respecting the disclosure of information by
authorized foreign banks and describing the state of progress made in
enhancing the disclosure of information in the financial services
industry. The report is to be included in the report referred to in
section 40 of the [Office of the Superintendent of Financial
Institutions Act](/eng/acts/O-2.7).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2001, c. 9, s. 165
:::

#### [Inspection of Authorized Foreign Banks]{.HTitleText3} {#h-19189 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Examination of authorized foreign banks

- **[[613]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-613 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  Superintendent, from time to time, but, in the case of an authorized
  foreign bank that is not subject to the restrictions and requirements
  referred to in subsection 524(2), at least once in each calendar year,
  shall make or cause to be made any examination and inquiry into the
  business and affairs of each authorized foreign bank that the
  Superintendent considers to be necessary or expedient to determine
  whether the authorized foreign bank is complying with the provisions
  of this Act and whether the authorized foreign bank has adequate
  policies and procedures to protect itself against threats to its
  integrity or security in relation to its business in Canada. After the
  conclusion of each examination and inquiry, the Superintendent shall
  report on it to the Minister.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2023, c. 26, s. 544\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Access to records of authorized foreign
  bank

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent or a person acting under the
  Superintendent's direction

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has a right of access to any records, cash, assets
    and security held by or on behalf of an authorized foreign bank; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} may require the directors, officers and the auditor
    of an authorized foreign bank to provide information and
    explanations, to the extent that they are reasonably able to do so,
    in respect of the condition and affairs of the authorized foreign
    bank or any entity in which it has a substantial investment under
    Part XII.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2001, c. 9, s. 166
- 2012, c. 5, s. 74
- [2023, c. 26, s. 544](#1410961-1415392){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1410961-1415392.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-613-20230622.html "Link to previous version of section 613"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Power of Superintendent on inquiry

**[[614]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-614 .sectionLabel}** The Superintendent has
all the powers of a person appointed as a commissioner under Part II of
the [Inquiries Act](/eng/acts/I-11) for the purpose of obtaining
evidence under oath, and may delegate those powers to any person acting
under the Superintendent's direction.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
:::

### [Remedial Powers]{.HTitleText2} {#h-19203 .Subheading}

#### [Prudential Agreements]{.HTitleText3} {#h-19204 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prudential agreement

**[[614.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-614.1 .sectionLabel}** The Superintendent
may enter into an agreement, called a "prudential agreement", with an
authorized foreign bank for the purposes of implementing any measure
designed to protect the interests of its depositors and creditors or
establishing adequate policies and procedures to protect it against
threats to its integrity or security in relation to its business in
Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 167
- [2023, c. 26, s. 545](#1410967-1415395){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1410967-1415395.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-614.1-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 614.1"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Directions of Compliance]{.HTitleText3} {#h-19209 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Superintendent's directions to authorized
foreign bank

- **[[615]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-615
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where, in the opinion of the
  Superintendent, an authorized foreign bank, or a person with respect
  to an authorized foreign bank, is committing, or is about to commit,
  an act that is an unsafe or unsound practice in relation to the
  business in Canada of the authorized foreign bank, or is pursuing or
  is about to pursue any course of conduct that is an unsafe or unsound
  practice in relation to that business, the Superintendent may direct
  the authorized foreign bank or person to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} cease or refrain from committing the act or
    pursuing the course of conduct; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} perform any acts that in the opinion of the
    Superintendent are necessary to remedy the situation.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Directions --- policies and procedures

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} If, in the opinion of the Superintendent, an
  authorized foreign bank does not have adequate policies and procedures
  to protect itself against threats to its integrity or security in
  relation to its business in Canada, the Superintendent may direct the
  authorized foreign bank to take any measures that in the opinion of
  the Superintendent are necessary to remedy the situation.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Opportunity for representations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), no direction shall be
  issued under subsection (1) or (1.1) to an authorized foreign bank or
  person unless the authorized foreign bank or person is provided with a
  reasonable opportunity to make representations in respect of the
  matter.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Temporary direction

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If, in the opinion of the Superintendent, the length
  of time required for representations to be made might be prejudicial
  to the public interest, the Superintendent may make a temporary
  direction with respect to the matters referred to in paragraphs (1)(a)
  and (b) or subsection (1.1) having effect for a period of not more
  than 15 days.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Continuing effect

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A temporary direction continues to have effect after
  the expiration of the fifteen day period referred to in subsection (3)
  if no representations are made to the Superintendent within that
  period or, if representations have been made, the Superintendent
  notifies the authorized foreign bank or person that the Superintendent
  is not satisfied that there are sufficient grounds for revoking the
  direction.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- [2023, c. 26, s. 546](#1410969-1415402){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1410969-1415402.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-615-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 615"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Court enforcement

- **[[616]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-616
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where an authorized foreign bank or
  a person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is contravening or has failed to comply with a
    prudential agreement entered into under section 614.1 or a direction
    of the Superintendent made under subsection 615(1), (1.1) or (3),

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is contravening this Act, or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} has omitted to do any thing under this Act that is
    required to be done by or on the part of the authorized foreign bank
    or person,

  the Superintendent may, in addition to any other action that may be
  taken under this Act, apply to a court for an order requiring the
  authorized foreign bank or person to comply with the prudential
  agreement or the direction, cease the contravention or do any thing
  that is required to be done, and on the application the court may so
  order and make any other order it thinks fit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appeal

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An appeal from a decision of a court under
  subsection (1) lies in the same manner, and to the same court, as an
  appeal from any other order of the court.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2001, c. 9, s. 168
- [2023, c. 26, s. 547](#1410971-1415404){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1410971-1415404.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-616-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 616"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Asset Maintenance]{.HTitleText3} {#h-19234 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order re: asset maintenance

**[[617]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-617 .sectionLabel}** Where, in the opinion
of the Superintendent, it is necessary for the protection of rights of
depositors and creditors of the authorized foreign bank in respect of
its business in Canada, the Superintendent may, by order,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} subject to any terms and conditions that the
  Superintendent considers necessary, direct an authorized foreign bank
  to maintain in Canada assets of any type and in any amount that the
  Superintendent may specify; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} require that the assets referred to in paragraph (a)
  be deposited with a Canadian financial institution approved by the
  Superintendent under a deposit agreement approved by the
  Superintendent.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
:::

#### [Disqualification and Removal of Principal Officers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-19241 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

- **[[617.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-617.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This section applies only in respect
  of an authorized foreign bank

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that has been notified by the Superintendent that
    this section applies to it where the authorized foreign bank is
    subject to measures designed to protect the interests of its
    depositors and creditors in respect of its business in Canada, which
    measures

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} have been specified by the Superintendent by way
      of conditions or limitations in respect of the order approving the
      commencement and carrying on of business in Canada by the
      authorized foreign bank, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} are contained in a prudential agreement entered
      into under section 614.1 or an undertaking given by the authorized
      foreign bank to the Superintendent; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is the subject of a direction made under
    section 615 or an order made under section 617.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information to be provided

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An authorized foreign bank shall provide the
  Superintendent with the name of any person who has been selected by
  the authorized foreign bank for appointment as principal officer,
  together with such other information about the background, business
  record and experience of the person as the Superintendent may require.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}When information to be provided

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The information required by subsection (2) shall be
  provided to the Superintendent at least 30 days prior to the date of
  the appointment or within any shorter period that the Superintendent
  may allow.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disqualification

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the Superintendent is of the opinion that, on the
  basis of the competence, business record, experience, conduct or
  character of a person, he or she is not suitable to hold the position
  of principal officer, the Superintendent may, by order, disqualify the
  person from being appointed to that office.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Risk of prejudice

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} In forming an opinion under subsection (4), the
  Superintendent must consider whether the interests of the depositors
  and creditors of the authorized foreign bank in respect of its
  business in Canada would likely be prejudiced if the person were to
  take office.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Representations may be made

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent must in writing notify the person
  concerned and the authorized foreign bank of an order that the
  Superintendent proposes to make under subsection (4) and must afford
  them an opportunity within 15 days after the date of the notice, or
  within any longer period that the Superintendent allows, to make
  representations to the Superintendent in relation to the matter.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} If an order is made under subsection (4)
  disqualifying a person from being appointed as principal officer, the
  person shall not be, and the authorized foreign bank shall not permit
  the person to be, appointed to that position.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 169
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Removal

- **[[617.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-617.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may, by order,
  remove a person from office as the principal officer of an authorized
  foreign bank if the Superintendent is of the opinion that the person
  is not suitable to hold that office

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} on the basis of the competence, business record,
    experience, conduct or character of the person; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} because the person has contravened or, by action or
    negligence, has contributed to the contravention of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} this Act or the regulations made under it,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a direction made under section 615,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} an order made under section 617,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a condition or limitation in respect of the
      order approving the commencement and carrying on of business in
      Canada by the authorized foreign bank, or

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a prudential agreement entered into under section
      614.1 or an undertaking given by the authorized foreign bank to
      the Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Risk of prejudice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In forming an opinion under subsection (1), the
  Superintendent must consider whether the interests of the depositors
  and creditors of the authorized foreign bank in respect of its
  business in Canada have been or are likely to be prejudiced by the
  person's holding office as principal officer.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Representations may be made

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent must in writing notify the
  principal officer and the authorized foreign bank of any removal order
  that the Superintendent proposes to make under subsection (1) and must
  afford them an opportunity within 15 days after the date of the
  notice, or within any longer period that the Superintendent allows, to
  make representations to the Superintendent in relation to the matter.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Suspension

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the Superintendent is of the opinion that the
  public interest is likely to be prejudiced by the principal officer
  continuing to exercise the powers or carry out the duties and
  functions of that office during the period for making representations,
  the Superintendent may make an order suspending the principal officer.
  The suspension may not extend beyond 10 days after the expiration of
  that period.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of order

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent shall, without delay, notify the
  principal officer and the authorized foreign bank of a removal order
  or suspension order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Consequences of removal order

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} The principal officer ceases to hold that office as
  of the date the removal order is made or any later date specified in
  the order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appeal

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} The principal officer or the authorized foreign bank
  may, within 30 days after the date of receipt of notice of the removal
  order under subsection (5), or within any longer period that the Court
  allows, appeal the matter to the Federal Court.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Powers of Federal Court

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} The Federal Court, in the case of an appeal, may
  dismiss the appeal or set aside the removal order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order not stayed by appeal

  [(9)]{.lawlabel} A removal order is not stayed by an appeal.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 169
:::

#### [Supervisory Intervention]{.HTitleText3} {#h-19291 .Subheading}

Meaning of [[assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

**[[618]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-618 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
sections 619 to 627, [[assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to an
authorized foreign bank, means

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} any asset in respect of its business in Canada,
  including the assets referred to in subsection 582(1) and section 617
  and the assets under its administration; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} any other asset in Canada of the authorized foreign
  bank.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Superintendent may take control

- **[[619]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-619
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to this Act, where any of
  the circumstances described in subsection (2) exist in respect of an
  authorized foreign bank or the business in Canada of an authorized
  foreign bank, the Superintendent may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} take control, for a period not exceeding sixteen
    days, of the assets of the authorized foreign bank; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} unless the Minister advises the Superintendent that
    the Minister is of the opinion that it is not in the public interest
    to do so,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} take control, for a period exceeding sixteen
      days, of the assets of the authorized foreign bank, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} where control of assets has been taken under
      paragraph (a), continue the control beyond the sixteen days
      referred to in that paragraph.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Circumstances for taking control

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Control by the Superintendent under subsection (1)
  may be taken in respect of an authorized foreign bank where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the authorized foreign bank has failed to pay its
    liabilities or, in the opinion of the Superintendent, will not be
    able to pay its liabilities as they become due and payable;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the authorized foreign bank in respect of its
    business in Canada has failed to pay its liabilities or, in the
    opinion of the Superintendent, will not be able to pay its
    liabilities as they become due and payable;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2001, c. 9, s. 170\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the assets of the authorized foreign bank in
    relation to its business in Canada are not, in the opinion of the
    Superintendent, sufficient to give adequate protection to the
    depositors and creditors of the authorized foreign bank in respect
    of its business in Canada;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} an asset appearing on the books or records of the
    authorized foreign bank in respect of its business in Canada or held
    under its administration is not, in the opinion of the
    Superintendent, satisfactorily accounted for;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the authorized foreign bank has failed to comply
    with an order of the Superintendent under section 617;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} in the opinion of the Superintendent, any other
    state of affairs exists in respect of the authorized foreign bank
    that may be materially prejudicial to the interests of the
    authorized foreign bank's depositors or creditors in respect of its
    business in Canada or to those of the owners of any assets under the
    authorized foreign bank's administration in respect of its business
    in Canada, including where proceedings under a law relating to
    bankruptcy or insolvency have been commenced in Canada or elsewhere
    in respect of the authorized foreign bank or its holding body
    corporate;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} in the opinion of the Superintendent, the continued
    operation of the authorized foreign bank in Canada would be
    materially prejudicial to its integrity or security in relation to
    its business in Canada; or

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the opinion of the Superintendent, the continued
    operation of the authorized foreign bank in Canada would pose a risk
    to national security.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Minister's powers

  [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to this Act, the Minister may, for reasons
  related to national security, direct the Superintendent to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} take control, for a period not exceeding 16 days,
    of the assets of the authorized foreign bank;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} take control, for a period exceeding 16 days, of
    the assets of the authorized foreign bank; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if control of assets has been taken under paragraph
    (a), continue the control beyond the 16 days referred to in that
    paragraph.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of proposed action

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent shall notify an authorized foreign
  bank of any action proposed to be taken in respect of it under
  paragraph (1)(b) and of its right to make written representations to
  the Superintendent within the time specified in the notice, not
  exceeding ten days after it receives the notice.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice --- up to 16 days

  [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} If the Superintendent takes control of the assets
  of an authorized foreign bank under paragraph (2.1)(a), the
  Superintendent shall notify the authorized foreign bank that control
  has been taken at the direction of the Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice --- more than 16 days

  [(3.2)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister is considering whether to exercise
  the powers under paragraph (2.1)(b) or (c), the Superintendent shall
  notify the authorized foreign bank of the action that is being
  considered and of its right to make written representations to the
  Minister within the time specified in the notice, not exceeding 10
  days after it receives the notice.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice --- Committee and Review Agency

  [(3.3)]{.lawlabel} Within 30 days after exercising any of the powers
  under subsection (2.1), the Minister shall notify

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the [[Committee]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined
    in section 2 of the [National Security and Intelligence Committee of
    Parliamentarians Act](/eng/acts/N-16.6); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the [[Review Agency]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as
    defined in section 2 of the [National Security and Intelligence
    Review Agency Act](/eng/acts/N-16.62).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Objectives of Superintendent

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the Superintendent has control under
  subsection (1) or (2.1) of the assets of an authorized foreign bank
  referred to in that subsection, the Superintendent may do all things
  necessary or expedient to protect the rights and interests of the
  depositors and creditors of the authorized foreign bank in respect of
  its business in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Powers of Superintendent

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} If the Superintendent has control under
  subsection (1) or (2.1) of the assets of an authorized foreign bank
  referred to in that subsection,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} neither the authorized foreign bank nor any person
    acting on its behalf shall deal in any way with any of the assets
    without the prior approval of the Superintendent or a representative
    designated by the Superintendent; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} no person acting on behalf of the authorized
    foreign bank shall have access to any cash or securities held in
    Canada by the authorized foreign bank without the prior approval of
    the Superintendent or a representative designated by the
    Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Persons to assist

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} If the Superintendent takes control of the assets of
  an authorized foreign bank under subparagraph (1)(b)(i) or (ii) or
  paragraph (2.1)(b) or (c), the Superintendent may appoint one or more
  persons to assist in the control of the assets.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2001, c. 9, s. 170
- 2007, c. 6, s. 101

:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Expiration of control

- **[[620]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-620
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Control by the Superintendent under
  subsection 619(1) of the assets of an authorized foreign bank expires
  on the day on which a notice by the Superintendent is sent to the
  principal officer of the authorized foreign bank stating that the
  Superintendent is of the opinion that the circumstances leading to the
  taking of control of the assets by the Superintendent have been
  substantially rectified and that the authorized foreign bank can
  resume control of its assets.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Expiration of control --- Minister's
  direction

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Control by the Superintendent under subsection
  619(2.1) of the assets of an authorized foreign bank expires on the
  day on which a notice by the Superintendent is sent to the principal
  officer of the authorized foreign bank stating that the Minister is of
  the opinion, on the recommendation of the Superintendent, that
  corrective measures have been taken in response to the reasons related
  to national security and that the authorized foreign bank can resume
  control of its assets.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- [2023, c. 26, s. 549](#1410984-1415433){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1410984-1415433.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-620-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 620"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Superintendent may request winding-up

**[[621]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-621 .sectionLabel}** The Superintendent may,
at any time before the receipt of a request under section 622 to
relinquish control of the assets of an authorized foreign bank, request
the Attorney General of Canada to apply for a winding-up order under
section 10.1 of the [Winding-up and Restructuring Act](/eng/acts/W-11)
in respect of the authorized foreign bank, if the assets of the
authorized foreign bank are under the control of the Superintendent
under subparagraph 619(1)(b)(i) or (ii) or paragraph 619(2.1)(b) or (c).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- [2023, c. 26, s. 550](#1410986-1415436){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1410986-1415436.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-621-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 621"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Requirement to relinquish control

**[[622]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-622 .sectionLabel}** If no action has been
taken by the Superintendent under section 621 and, after 30 days
following the taking of control by the Superintendent under subsection
619(1) or (2.1) of the assets of an authorized foreign bank, the
Superintendent receives from the principal officer of the authorized
foreign bank a notice in writing requesting the Superintendent to
relinquish control, the Superintendent shall, not later than 12 days
after receipt of the notice,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} comply with the request; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} request the Attorney General of Canada to apply for a
  winding-up order under section 10.1 of the [Winding-up and
  Restructuring Act](/eng/acts/W-11) in respect of the authorized
  foreign bank.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- [2023, c. 26, s. 551(E)](#1410988-1415438){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1410988-1415438.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-622-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 622"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Advisory committee

**[[623]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-623 .sectionLabel}** The Superintendent may
appoint a committee of not more than six members to advise the
Superintendent in respect of the assets and all other matters pertinent
to the duties and responsibilities of the Superintendent in exercising
control of the assets. The committee shall be appointed from among the
banks and authorized foreign banks that are subject to an assessment
under section 23 of the [Office of the Superintendent of Financial
Institutions Act](/eng/acts/O-2.7) and required to share in the expenses
resulting from the taking of control of the assets of the authorized
foreign bank under subsection 619(1) or (2.1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- [2023, c. 26, s. 552](#1410990-1415441){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1410990-1415441.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-623-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 623"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Expenses payable by authorized foreign
bank

- **[[624]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-624 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If
  control of the assets of an authorized foreign bank has been taken
  under subparagraph 619(1)(b)(i) or (ii) or paragraph 619(2.1)(b)
  or (c) and the control expires or is relinquished under section 620 or
  paragraph 622(a), the Superintendent may direct that the authorized
  foreign bank be liable for repayment of all or part of the expenses
  resulting from the taking of control of the assets and assessed
  against and paid by other authorized foreign banks and by banks under
  section 23 of the [Office of the Superintendent of Financial
  Institutions Act](/eng/acts/O-2.7), together with any interest in
  respect of the expenses at any rate that is specified by the
  Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Debt due to Her Majesty

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where any direction is made under subsection (1), the
  amount for which the authorized foreign bank is liable is a debt due
  to Her Majesty in right of Canada payable on demand and is recoverable
  in the Federal Court or any other court of competent jurisdiction.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- [2023, c. 26, s. 553(E)](#1410992-1415443){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1410992-1415443.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-624-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 624"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Priority of claim in liquidation

**[[625]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-625 .sectionLabel}** In the case of the
winding-up of the business in Canada of an authorized foreign bank, the
expenses resulting from the taking of control of the assets of the
authorized foreign bank under subsection 619(1) or (2.1) and assessed
against and paid by other authorized foreign banks and by banks under
section 23 of the [Office of the Superintendent of Financial
Institutions Act](/eng/acts/O-2.7) and interest in respect of the
expenses at any rate that is specified by the Superintendent, constitute
a claim of His Majesty in right of Canada against the assets of the
authorized foreign bank that ranks after any claim referred to in
paragraph 627(1)(d).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- [2023, c. 26, s. 554(E)](#1410994-1415446){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1410994-1415446.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-625-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 625"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application of assessment

**[[626]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-626 .sectionLabel}** Any amount recovered
under section 624 or 625 shall be applied to reduce the total amount of
expenses incurred for or in connection with the administration of this
Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order of priority for payment of claims

- **[[627]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to sections 72 and 94 of the
  [Winding-up and Restructuring Act](/eng/acts/W-11), where a winding-up
  order under that Act is made in respect of an authorized foreign bank,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the payment of any amount due to Her Majesty in
    right of Canada, in trust or otherwise, in respect of the business
    in Canada of the authorized foreign bank is a first charge on the
    assets of the authorized foreign bank;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the payment of any amount due to Her Majesty in
    right of a province, in trust or otherwise, in respect of the
    business in Canada of the authorized foreign bank is a second charge
    on the assets of the authorized foreign bank;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the payment of the deposit liabilities of the
    authorized foreign bank and all other liabilities of the authorized
    foreign bank in respect of its business in Canada, except the
    liabilities referred to in paragraph (d) and section 625, is a third
    charge on the assets of the authorized foreign bank; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the payment of any fines and penalties for which
    the authorized foreign bank is liable in respect of its business in
    Canada is a last charge on the assets of the authorized foreign
    bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Priority not affected

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Nothing in subsection (1) prejudices or affects the
  priority of any holder of any security interest in any property of an
  authorized foreign bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Priorities

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Priorities within each of paragraphs (1)(a) to (d)
  shall be determined in accordance with the laws governing priorities
  and, where applicable, by the terms of the liabilities referred to in
  those paragraphs.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 35
- 2001, c. 9, s. 171
:::

## [PART XII.2]{.HLabel1}[Dealings with Customers and the Public]{.HTitleText1} {#h-1369112 .Part}

### [DIVISION 1]{.HLabel2}[Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1369113 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

- **[[627.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in
  this Part.

  [[business day]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[business day]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} does not include a Saturday
      or a holiday. ([jour ouvrable]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[charge]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[charge]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes interest and, for greater
      certainty, a fee. ([frais]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[complaint]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[complaint]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means dissatisfaction, whether
      justified or not, expressed to an institution with respect to

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a product or service in Canada that is offered,
        sold or provided by the institution; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the manner in which a product or service in
        Canada is offered, sold or provided by the
        institution. ([plainte]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[credit agreement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[credit agreement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes an agreement for
      a line of credit, a credit card or any other kind of loan that is
      repayable in Canada. ([convention de crédit]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[deposit-type instrument]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[deposit-type instrument]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a product
      that is issued in Canada by an institution, that is related to a
      deposit and that specifies a fixed investment period and either

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a fixed rate of interest; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a variable rate of interest that is calculated
        on the basis of the institution's prime lending rate or an
        interest rate benchmark. ([instrument de type
        dépôt]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[eligible enterprise]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[eligible enterprise]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a business with
      authorized credit of less than \$1,000,000, fewer than 500
      employees and annual revenues of less than
      \$50,000,000. ([entreprise admissible]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a bank or an authorized
      foreign bank. ([institution]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to an agreement for
      a deposit-type instrument, a principal-protected note or a
      prescribed product, includes any return payable by an institution
      under the agreement. ([intérêt]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[interest rate benchmark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[interest rate benchmark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a rate that
      is determined from time to time by reference to an assessment of
      one or more underlying interests, is made available to the public,
      either free of charge or on payment, and is used for reference for
      determining the interest payable, or other sums that are due,
      under loan agreements or other financial contracts or
      instruments. ([taux d'intérêt de référence]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[maintenance charge]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[maintenance charge]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a charge in
      relation to a prepaid payment product that is imposed after the
      product has been purchased, other than a charge associated with
      the use of the product or of any service related to it. ([frais de
      tenue de compte]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[member bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[member bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a bank that is a
      [[member institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section
      2 of the [Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation
      Act](/eng/acts/C-3). ([banque membre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[optional product or service]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[optional product or service]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      product or service that is provided in Canada by an institution,
      an affiliate that the institution controls or an agent or
      representative of the institution or affiliate, for an additional
      charge, as a supplement to another product or service that is
      offered or provided by the institution. ([produit ou service
      optionnel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[personal authentication information]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[personal authentication information]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
      a personal identification number or any other password or
      information that a borrower creates or adopts to be used to
      authenticate their identity in relation to a credit card or credit
      card account. ([authentifiant personnel]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[personal deposit account]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[personal deposit account]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a deposit
      account in the name of one or more natural persons that is kept by
      that person or those persons other than for business
      purposes. ([compte de dépôt personnel]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[point of service]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[point of service]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a physical location
      to which the public has access and at which an institution carries
      on business with the public through natural persons in
      Canada. ([point de service]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[prepaid payment product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[prepaid payment product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a physical
      or electronic product that is issued in Canada by an institution,
      that is or can be loaded with funds and that can be used to make
      withdrawals or purchase goods or services. ([produit de paiement
      prépayé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[principal-protected note]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[principal-protected note]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a financial
      instrument that is issued in Canada by an institution to a person
      and that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} provides for one or more payments to be made by
        the institution that are determined, in whole or in part, by
        reference to an index or reference point, including

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the market price of a security, commodity,
          investment fund or other financial instrument, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the exchange rate between any two
          currencies; and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provides that the principal amount that the
        institution is obligated to repay at or before the note's
        maturity is equal to or greater than the total paid by the
        person for the note.

      A principal-protected note does not include a financial instrument
      that specifies that the interest or return on the instrument is
      determined solely on the basis of a fixed rate of interest or
      return or a variable rate of interest or return that is calculated
      on the basis of the institution's prime lending rate or an
      interest rate benchmark. ([billet à capital
      protégé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[promotional product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[promotional product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a prepaid
      payment product that is purchased by an entity and distributed as
      part of a promotional, loyalty or award program. ([produit
      promotionnel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[registered product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[registered product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a registered
      education savings plan, a registered retirement savings plan, a
      registered retirement income fund, a registered disability savings
      plan or any other plan, arrangement or fund to which Division G of
      Part I of the [Income Tax Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3) applies that is
      provided by an institution to a natural person. ([produit
      enregistré]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[residential mortgage]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[residential mortgage]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a loan made in
      Canada on the security of residential property that has four or
      fewer residential units. ([hypothèque
      résidentielle]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[retail deposit account]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[retail deposit account]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a personal
      deposit account that is opened with a deposit of less than
      \$150,000 or of less than any greater prescribed amount. ([compte
      de dépôt de détail]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[retail deposit-taking branch]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[retail deposit-taking branch]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      branch or office in Canada of a financial institution at which the
      financial institution, through a natural person, opens retail
      deposit accounts and disburses cash to customers. ([succursale de
      dépôt de détail]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[rural area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[rural area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an area located in Canada
      outside an urban area. ([zone rurale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[undue pressure]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[undue pressure]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any pressure, imposed
      in the form of a practice or communication or otherwise, that
      could be reasonably considered to be excessive or persistent in
      the circumstances. ([pressions indues]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[urban area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[urban area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, on a particular day, means a
      [[population centre]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in the
      census dictionary published by Statistics Canada for the purpose
      of the most recent general census whose results have been
      published before that day, that has a minimum population of 10,000
      natural persons on the basis of that census. ([zone
      urbaine]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Business purposes

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, a reference to "business
  purposes" in a provision of this Part is a reference to the business
  purposes of the natural person referred to in the provision.
