[Previous
Version](section-627.52-20220630.html "Link to previous version of section 627.52"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Provision of information

**[[627.53]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.53 .sectionLabel}** If an institution
or a body corporate is required under sections 627.43 to 627.52 to
provide information, it shall do so in a manner, and using language,
that is clear, simple and not misleading.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369666){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369666.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Content of Commissioner's report

**[[627.54]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.54 .sectionLabel}** The Commissioner
shall include in the report referred to in section 34 of the [Financial
Consumer Agency of Canada Act](/eng/acts/F-11.1)

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the procedures for dealing with complaints
  established by institutions under paragraph 627.43(1)(a);

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the number and nature of complaints that have been
  made to the Agency; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a summary of the information referred to in section
  627.47 and the information in the report referred to in paragraph
  627.49(j).

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369673){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369673.html"}
:::

### [DIVISION 3]{.HLabel2}[Disclosure and Transparency for Informed Decisions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1369674 .Subheading}

#### [Key Product Information]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1369675 .Subheading}

##### [General Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1369676 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disclosure of information

- **[[627.55]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.55
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If an institution is required under
  this Division to disclose information, it shall do so in a manner, and
  using language, that is clear, simple and not misleading, and shall do
  so in writing, unless otherwise provided for under this Division.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agreement by telephone

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the regulations, an institution that
  enters into an agreement with a person orally by telephone in respect
  of a product or service in Canada is deemed to have disclosed in
  writing the information referred to in subsection (1) if it

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} discloses orally to the person, before entering
    into the agreement by telephone,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the information or any prescribed portion of the
      information, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed information; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provides the information in writing to the person
    without delay after entering into the agreement.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369687){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369687.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disclosure --- customers and the public

**[[627.56]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.56 .sectionLabel}** If an institution
is required under this Division to disclose information to its customers
and to the public, it shall do so by

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} displaying the information prominently

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} at each of its branches in Canada where it offers
    products or services and at each of its points of service, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} on each of its websites through which it offers
    products or services in Canada; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} providing the information in writing to any person
  who requests it.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369695){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369695.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information box

- **[[627.57]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.57
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If an institution is required under
  this Division to disclose information in an application form or before
  entering into an agreement in respect of a product or service, it
  shall, at the time of that disclosure, disclose the information that
  is prescribed by presenting it prominently in a single prominently
  displayed information box.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information box --- disclosure by
  telephone

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall orally draw attention to the
  information that is required to be disclosed in the information box
  when

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the institution solicits applications for the
    product or service from a person orally by telephone; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a person contacts the institution orally by
    telephone for the purpose of applying for the product or service.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369704){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369704.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Resource person

**[[627.58]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.58 .sectionLabel}** Subject to the
regulations, an institution shall, before entering into an agreement
with a person by electronic means or by mail in respect of a product or
service in Canada, provide the person with the local or toll-free
telephone number of a natural person who is an employee or agent of the
institution and who is knowledgeable about the terms and conditions of
the agreement.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369708){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369708.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Other products or services

**[[627.59]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.59 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall, before entering into an agreement with a natural person in
respect of any product or service in Canada to be provided on an ongoing
basis and for which disclosure obligations are not otherwise provided
under this Division, disclose to that person

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the features of the product or service;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a list of all charges and penalties applicable to the
  product or service;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} particulars of the person's rights and obligations in
  respect of the product or service;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in paragraphs 627.65(a)
  to (c); and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed information.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369717){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369717.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Renewal or rollover

- **[[627.6]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.6
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If an institution enters into an
  agreement with a natural person other than for business purposes in
  respect of a product or service in Canada --- other than a loan that
  is secured by a mortgage on real property --- and the agreement
  provides that a product or service may be renewed or that, after the
  end of the term of the product or service, a new product or service
  may be provided to the person without a further agreement being
  entered into, the institution shall disclose to the person the
  information set out in subsection (2),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a product or service that is
    provided for a term of more than 30 days, 21 days before, and five
    days before, the last day of the term; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a product or service that is
    provided for a term of 30 days or less, five days before the last
    day of the term.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Content

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information to be disclosed is the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the interest rate that will be applicable to the
    product or service on its renewal, or to the new product or service;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any charges or penalties that may be imposed on the
    person in relation to the product or service on its renewal, or to
    the new product or service;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} particulars of the person's rights and obligations
    in relation to the product or service on its renewal, or to the new
    product or service;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the period within which the institution shall allow
    the person to cancel the agreement in respect of the product or
    service that may be renewed, or in respect of the new product or
    service; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed information.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369731){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369731.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Promotional and other offers

- **[[627.61]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.61
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a natural person accepts, other
  than for business purposes, a promotional, preferential, introductory
  or special offer with respect to a product or service other than an
  optional product or service, the institution shall disclose to the
  person the information set out in subsection (2),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the period during which the person will benefit
    from the offer is more than 30 days, 21 days before, and five days
    before, the last day of the period; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the period during which the person will benefit
    from the offer is 30 days or less, five days before the last day of
    the period.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Content

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information to be disclosed is the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the interest rate that will be applicable to the
    product or service after the day on which the person will no longer
    benefit from the offer;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any charges or penalties that may be imposed on the
    person in relation to the product or service after the day on which
    the person will no longer benefit from the offer;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} particulars of the person's rights and obligations
    in relation to the product or service after the day on which the
    person will no longer benefit from the offer;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the period within which the institution shall allow
    the person to cancel the agreement in respect of the product or
    service after the day on which the person will no longer benefit
    from the offer; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed information.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369745){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369745.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prescribed amendments to agreements

**[[627.62]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.62 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall, before any prescribed amendment that it makes to a term or
condition of an agreement with a person in respect of a product or
service in Canada takes effect, disclose prescribed information to the
person or any other person as directed by that person.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369749){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369749.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Advertisements

**[[627.63]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.63 .sectionLabel}** If an institution
is required under this Division to disclose information in an
advertisement, it shall do so by presenting it prominently --- as
specified in any regulations --- within the advertisement.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369753){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369753.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibited conduct

**[[627.64]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.64 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall disclose to its customers and to the public the fact that it shall
not, under section 627.04,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} impose undue pressure on a person, or coerce a
  person, for any purpose, including to obtain a product or service from
  a particular person, as a condition for obtaining another product or
  service from the institution; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} take advantage of a person.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369759){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369759.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Complaints procedures

**[[627.65]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.65 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall disclose to its customers and to the public

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its procedures for dealing with complaints
  established under paragraph 627.43(1)(a);

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name of the external complaints body and the
  manner in which that body may be contacted; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Agency's mailing address, website address and
  telephone number.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369766){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369766.html"}
- [2023, c. 26, s. 132](#1409416-1415328){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1409416-1415328.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-627.65-20220630.html "Link to previous version of section 627.65"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Voluntary codes of conduct and public
commitments

**[[627.66]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.66 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall disclose the voluntary codes of conduct that it has adopted, that
are designed to protect the interests of its customers and that are
publicly available --- and the public commitments that it has made and
that are designed to protect the interests of its customers --- by

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} making the voluntary codes and commitments available

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} at each of its branches in Canada where it offers
    products or services and at each of its points of service, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} on each of its websites through which it offers
    products or services in Canada; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} providing the voluntary codes and commitments in
  writing to any person who requests them.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369774){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369774.html"}
:::

##### [Deposit Accounts, Financial Instruments and Notes]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1369775 .Subheading}

###### [Deposit Accounts]{.HTitleText5} {#h-1369776 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Member banks --- customers and the public

**[[627.67]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.67 .sectionLabel}** A member bank
shall disclose to its customers and to the public

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the conditions to be met for the opening of a retail
  deposit account by a natural person under subsections 627.17(1) and
  (3);

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the personal identification requirements set out in
  paragraph 627.25(1)(b); and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed information.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369783){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369783.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Institutions --- customers and the public

**[[627.68]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.68 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall disclose to its customers and to the public

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a list of all charges applicable to personal deposit
  accounts in Canada with the institution and the usual amount, if any,
  charged by the institution for services normally provided in Canada to
  its customers and to the public;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} for a deposit account in Canada other than a personal
  deposit account,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a list of all charges applicable to any prescribed
    services that it provides in respect of the account and the fact
    that the list sets out all such charges, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a partial list of those charges and the manner in
    which information regarding charges not included in the list can be
    obtained;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the maximum periods during which the institution may
  hold funds deposited by cheque or other instrument before making them
  available for withdrawal, as set out in section 627.21; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the institution's policies concerning the maximum
  period during which the institution may hold funds deposited by cheque
  or other instrument in any situation to which section 627.21 does not
  apply.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369793){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369793.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Opening of deposit account

- **[[627.69]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.69
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall, before
  entering into an agreement with a person for the opening of a deposit
  account in Canada, disclose to the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsection (2), a list of all charges
    applicable to the account;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a personal deposit account, the
    circumstances in which the institution shall send the person an
    alert, in accordance with section 627.13;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a retail deposit account,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the rate of interest and the manner in which the
      amount of interest is calculated,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the maximum periods during which the institution
      may hold funds deposited by cheque or other instrument before
      making them available for withdrawal, as set out in section
      627.21, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the institution's policies concerning the
      maximum period during which the institution may hold funds
      deposited by cheque or other instrument in any situation to which
      section 627.21 does not apply; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed information.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}If amount of charge cannot be
  determined

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the amount of a charge referred to in paragraph
  (1)(a) cannot be determined before an agreement is entered into for
  the opening of a deposit account other than a personal deposit
  account, the institution shall, without delay after the amount is
  determined, disclose that amount to the person in whose name the
  account is kept.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369807){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369807.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Changes to holding periods

- **[[627.7]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.7
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall disclose any
  changes to the information referred to in paragraph 627.68(c) or (d)
  to its customers and to the public for a period of at least 60 days
  ending on the effective date of the change, and disclose any changes
  to the information referred to in subparagraph 627.69(1)(c)(ii)
  or (iii) to each person in whose name the retail deposit account is
  kept and to whom a statement of account is provided --- or to any
  other person as directed by that person --- at least 30 days before
  the effective date of the change.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shortened holding period

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the change results in a shortened period during
  which an institution may hold funds deposited by cheque or other
  instrument, the institution may meet the obligations set out in
  subsection (1) after the effective date of the change.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369814){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369814.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Change in rate of interest or manner of
calculation

**[[627.71]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.71 .sectionLabel}** If there is a
change in the rate of interest that is applicable to a deposit account
in Canada or in the manner in which the amount of interest for such an
account is calculated, an institution shall, without delay, disclose the
change

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} to the person in whose name the account is kept or to
  any other person as directed by that person; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} to the public by displaying it prominently

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} at each of its branches in Canada where it offers
    deposit accounts and at each of its points of service, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} on each of its websites through which it offers
    deposit accounts in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369822){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369822.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Increase or new charge

- **[[627.72]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.72
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall disclose to a
  person to whom a statement of account is provided --- or to any other
  person as directed by that person --- any increase to a charge
  applicable to a personal deposit account in Canada --- or applicable
  to a prescribed service in relation to deposit accounts in Canada,
  other than personal deposit accounts --- or any new charge applicable
  to a personal deposit account in Canada at least 30 days before the
  effective date of the increase or new charge.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statement of account not provided

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If there is a person in whose name the account is
  kept to whom a statement of account is not provided, an institution
  shall disclose to its customers and to the public any increase
  referred to in subsection (1) for a period of at least 60 days ending
  on the effective date of the increase or new charge, and if the
  increase or new charge is applicable to a personal deposit account, by
  displaying the increase or new charge prominently at each automated
  teller machine on which the name of the institution or information
  identifying the machine with the institution is displayed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Manner of obtaining further information

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall, to meet its obligations under
  subsection (2), also disclose the manner in which further details with
  respect to the increase or new charge can be obtained.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369831){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369831.html"}
:::

###### [Deposit Insurance]{.HTitleText5} {#h-1369832 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Authorized foreign banks --- customers
and the public

**[[627.73]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.73 .sectionLabel}** An authorized
foreign bank that is not subject to the restrictions and requirements
referred to in subsection 524(2) and a bank referred to in paragraph
413(1)(b) or (c) shall disclose to their customers and to the public
that deposits with them are not insured by the Canada Deposit Insurance
Corporation.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369836){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369836.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Authorized foreign banks --- customers
and the public

**[[627.74]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.74 .sectionLabel}** An authorized
foreign bank that is subject to this section under an order referred to
in subsection 524(2) shall disclose to its customers and to the public
that it does not accept deposits in Canada and that it is not a member
institution of the Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369840){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369840.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Authorized foreign banks --- deposit
accounts and agreements for prescribed products

**[[627.75]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.75 .sectionLabel}** An authorized
foreign bank that is not subject to the restrictions and requirements
referred to in subsection 524(2) shall, before entering into an
agreement with a person for the opening of a deposit account in Canada
or in respect of a prescribed product that relates to a deposit,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} disclose to the person the fact that deposits to the
  deposit account or in relation to the prescribed product, as the case
  may be, are not insured by the Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation,
  as well as any prescribed information; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} obtain the person's signature immediately next to the
  disclosure statement.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369846){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369846.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Certain banks --- deposit accounts and
agreements for prescribed products

- **[[627.76]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.76
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A bank referred to in paragraph
  413(1)(b) or (c) shall, before entering into an agreement with a
  person for the opening of a deposit account in Canada or in respect of
  a prescribed product that relates to a deposit, disclose to the person
  the fact that deposits to the deposit account or in relation to the
  prescribed product are not insured by the Canada Deposit Insurance
  Corporation.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shared premises

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank referred to in paragraph 413(1)(b) or (c) that
  shares premises with a [[member institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
  defined in section 2 of the [Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation
  Act](/eng/acts/C-3) shall, before entering into an agreement with a
  person for the opening of a deposit account in Canada or in respect of
  a prescribed product that relates to a deposit,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} disclose to the person

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the fact that the bank's business is separate and
      distinct from that of the member institution, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the fact that deposits to the deposit account or
      in relation to the prescribed product are not insured by the
      Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} orally explain to the person the information that
    is to be disclosed under paragraph (a); and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} obtain from the person a signed declaration stating
    that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the person has been given all of the information
      that is to be disclosed under paragraph (a) and has read it,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the bank has orally explained all the
      information that is to be disclosed under paragraph (a), and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the person understands all of the information
      that is to be disclosed under paragraph (a).

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369861){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369861.html"}
:::

###### [Financial Instruments and Notes]{.HTitleText5} {#h-1369862 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Availability of information

**[[627.77]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.77 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall disclose prescribed information with respect to a deposit-type
instrument, a principal-protected note or a prescribed product by

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} making the information available

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} at each of its branches in Canada and points of
    service where it offers any of these products, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} on each of its websites through which it offers
    these products in Canada; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} providing the information to any person who requests
  it.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369870){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369870.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Issuance

- **[[627.78]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.78
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall, before
  entering into an agreement with a person for the issuance of a
  deposit-type instrument, a principal-protected note or a prescribed
  product, disclose to the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the term of the product, how and when the principal
    is to be repaid and how and when the interest, if any, is to be
    paid;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the rate of interest in respect of the product
    is fixed, the annual rate of interest or, if the rate of interest is
    variable,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} how the rate of interest is determined,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the prime lending rate or the interest rate
      benchmark, as the case may be, that is used for the calculation of
      the rate of interest,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the prime lending rate or the interest rate
      benchmark in effect when the information is disclosed, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} how the person may obtain the rate of interest
      from the institution during the investment period;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any charges applicable to the product and their
    impact on the interest payable;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} how interest is accrued and any limitations in
    respect of the interest payable;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any risks associated with the product, including,
    if applicable, the risk that no interest may accrue;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} if the product relates to a deposit that is not
    eligible for deposit insurance coverage by the Canada Deposit
    Insurance Corporation, the fact that it is not eligible;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} whether the person may cancel their purchase of the
    product and, if so, how the purchase may be cancelled;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} whether the proposed agreement provides that the
    institution may amend a term or condition with respect to the
    product and, if so, in what circumstances;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} whether the manner in which the product is
    structured or administered may place the institution in a conflict
    of interest;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} any other information that could reasonably be
    expected to affect the person's decision to enter into the
    agreement; and

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed information.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}New instrument issued without further
  agreement

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If, after the maturity of a deposit-type instrument
  issued under an agreement referred to in subsection (1), an
  institution issues a new deposit-type instrument under that agreement,
  the institution shall disclose prescribed information to the person
  without delay after the instrument is issued.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369892){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369892.html"}
- [2024, c. 17, s. 229](#1467772-1479706){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1467772-1479706.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-627.78-20220630.html "Link to previous version of section 627.78"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Principal-protected note --- no interest

**[[627.79]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.79 .sectionLabel}** If a
principal-protected note ceases to be linked to an index or reference
point that was to be used to determine the interest payable under the
note and, as a result, no interest will be paid, the institution shall,
without delay, disclose that fact to the person to whom the note was
issued.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369896){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369896.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Current value

**[[627.8]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.8 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall disclose the following information without delay to a person who
makes a request concerning the value of a product referred to in section
627.78 that was issued to the person:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a principal-protected note,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the net asset value of the note on the day
    specified by the person and how that value is related to the
    interest payable under the note, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the last available measure, before the day
    specified by the person, of the index or reference point on which
    the interest is determined and how that measure is related to the
    interest payable under the note;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a deposit-type instrument, the amount
  of the principal and accrued interest on the day on which the request
  was made; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of any prescribed product, prescribed
  information.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369905){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369905.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amendments --- deposit-type instruments
or prescribed products

**[[627.81]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.81 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall, before any amendment that it makes to a term or condition with
respect to a deposit-type instrument or a prescribed product takes
effect, disclose the amendment and its potential impact on the interest
payable to the person to whom the instrument or product was issued.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369909){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369909.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amendments --- principal-protected notes

**[[627.82]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.82 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall, before any amendment that it makes to a term or condition with
respect to a principal-protected note that may have an impact on the
interest payable under the note takes effect, disclose the amendment and
its potential impact on the interest payable to the person to whom the
note was issued. However, if it is not possible to make that disclosure
before the time the amendment takes effect, the institution shall do so
as soon as possible after that time.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369913){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369913.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Redemption or purchase before maturity

**[[627.83]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.83 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} before redeeming or purchasing a principal-protected
  note before its maturity on the request of the person to whom it was
  issued, disclose to that person

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the value of the note on the last business day
    before the day on which the request is made, or the value of the
    note based on the last available measure of the index or reference
    point on which the interest is determined,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any charge or penalty,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the net amount that the person would have
    received for the redemption or purchase after deducting the amount
    referred to in subparagraph (ii) from the value of the note referred
    to in subparagraph (i), and

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the time at which and the manner in which the
    value of the note will be calculated, and the fact that the value of
    the note may differ from the value referred to in subparagraph (i);

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} before redeeming a deposit-type instrument before its
  maturity on the request of the person to whom it was issued, disclose
  to that person the amount of the principal and accrued interest, the
  amount of any charge or penalty and the net amount payable by the
  institution on redemption; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} before redeeming any prescribed product before its
  maturity on the request of the person to whom it was issued, disclose
  to that person prescribed information.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369924){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369924.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Manner

**[[627.84]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.84 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes
of sections 627.8 and 627.83, the institution shall disclose the
information in the same manner in which the request is made unless
otherwise directed by the person.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369928){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369928.html"}
:::

###### [Advertisements]{.HTitleText5} {#h-1369929 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Rate of interest

**[[627.85]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.85 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall --- in any advertisement in Canada in which it indicates the rate
of interest that it offers on a deposit or debt obligation --- disclose
the manner in which the amount of interest is calculated and any
circumstances that will affect the rate of interest, including the
balance of a deposit account. The information shall be disclosed in the
same manner in which the rate is indicated, whether visually or orally,
or both.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369933){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369933.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Uninsured deposits

**[[627.86]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.86 .sectionLabel}** An authorized
foreign bank that is not subject to the restrictions and requirements
referred to in subsection 524(2) and a bank referred to in paragraph
413(1)(b) or (c) shall --- in any advertisement in Canada in respect of
deposits --- disclose, visually or orally, that deposits with it are not
insured by the Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369937){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369937.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Financial instruments and notes

- **[[627.87]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.87
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall --- in any
  advertisement in Canada for a product that is a deposit-type
  instrument, a principal-protected note or a prescribed product ---
  disclose, visually or orally,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} how the public may obtain information about the
    product;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the advertisement refers to features of the
    product or the interest payable under it,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the manner in which interest is to be accrued and
      any limitations in respect of the interest payable, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the fact that the product relates to deposits
      that are not eligible to be insured by the Canada Deposit
      Insurance Corporation, if that is the case; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed information.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subparagraph (1)(b)(ii) does not apply to an
  authorized foreign bank that is not subject to the restrictions and
  requirements referred to in subsection 524(2) or a bank referred to in
  paragraph 413(1)(b) or (c).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Market performance

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall --- in any advertisement in
  Canada for a principal-protected note in which it uses past market
  performance --- disclose, visually or orally, the assumptions
  underlying any hypothetical examples used in the advertisement to
  represent that performance, and the fact that past market performance
  is not an indicator of future market performance.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Fair representation

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The institution shall, in the advertisements referred
  to in subsection (3), represent the past market performance fairly and
  only use realistic assumptions to underlie hypothetical examples.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369953){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369953.html"}
:::

##### [Credit]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1369954 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Availability of information

**[[627.88]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.88 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall disclose prescribed information with respect to a credit agreement
by

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} making the information available

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} at each of its branches in Canada and points of
    service, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} on each of its websites through which it offers
    products or services in Canada; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} providing the information to any person who requests
  it.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369962){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369962.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agreement --- natural persons

- **[[627.89]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.89
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall, before
  entering into a credit agreement with a natural person other than for
  business purposes, disclose to the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the cost of borrowing, as calculated and expressed
    in accordance with section 627.9;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} particulars of the person's rights and obligations;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any charges or penalties that may be imposed on the
    person;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a line of credit or credit card
    account, the circumstances in which the institution shall send the
    person an alert, in accordance with section 627.13; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed information.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agreement --- other persons

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall, before entering into a credit
  agreement with a person, other than a person referred to in subsection
  (1), disclose to the person prescribed information.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Applications for credit, payment or
  charge card

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall disclose in any application
  forms or related documents that it prepares for the issuance of
  credit, payment or charge cards

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a credit card,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a list of all non-interest charges,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in paragraph (1)(a),

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the day on which interest begins to accrue and
      information concerning any grace period that applies, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed information; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a payment or charge card, any
    prescribed information.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subsequent disclosure

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall, after entering into a credit
  agreement with a person, disclose prescribed information to the
  person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amendments

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall disclose to the person with whom
  it has entered into a credit agreement

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed amendment to the terms or conditions
    of the credit agreement; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed information resulting from the
    amendment.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Renewal

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall disclose to the person with whom
  it has entered into a credit agreement any prescribed information
  respecting the renewal of the credit agreement.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369990){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369990.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Calculating borrowing costs

**[[627.9]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.9 .sectionLabel}** The cost of
borrowing shall be calculated, in the prescribed manner, on the basis
that all obligations of the borrower are fulfilled and shall be
expressed as a rate per annum and, in the prescribed circumstances, as
an amount in dollars and cents.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369994){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369994.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Advertisements

**[[627.91]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.91 .sectionLabel}** An institution
that makes a prescribed representation in an advertisement in Canada for
a product that may be obtained by a natural person under a credit
agreement shall disclose prescribed information in the advertisement.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1369998){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1369998.html"}
:::

##### [Prepaid Payment Products]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1369999 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Issuance

- **[[627.92]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.92
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall, before
  entering into an agreement with a person for the issuance of a prepaid
  payment product, disclose to the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the issuing institution;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the day on which the product expires, if any;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if it is a promotional product, the day, if any, on
    which the person's right to use the funds that are loaded on the
    product will expire;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a toll-free telephone number that can be used to
    make inquiries about the prepaid payment product, including its
    balance and the terms or conditions with respect to the product, and
    to make complaints;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the following restrictions on the use of the
    product, if imposed by the issuing institution:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the fact that the product is not reloadable,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the fact that the product cannot be used to make
      withdrawals, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any other restriction that could reasonably be
      expected to affect the person's decision to enter into the
      agreement;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} all charges that may be imposed on the person by
    the issuing institution in respect of the product;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} if the funds that are loaded on the product are not
    insured by the Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation, a statement to
    that effect;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a statement indicating

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a promotional product, either that
      the person's right to use the funds that are loaded on the product
      will not expire, or that that right will expire, along with the
      expiry date, as the case may be, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of any other prepaid payment
      product, that the person's right to use the funds that are loaded
      on the product will not expire;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a website address where the information referred to
    in paragraphs (a) and (d) to (g) can be obtained; and

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed information.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Means of disclosure

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The institution shall disclose the information set
  out in paragraphs (1)(a) to (d) and (i) by setting it out directly on
  the prepaid payment product or, if the product is electronic, by
  disclosing it electronically on the person's request.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1370021){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1370021.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Increase or new charge

**[[627.93]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.93 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall not increase any charge or impose a new charge associated with a
prepaid payment product that is issued to a natural person unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person has provided the institution with their
  name and mailing or email address;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the institution has given the person the opportunity
  to modify the information referred to in paragraph (a); and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the institution discloses the new or increased charge
  by

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} sending a notice to the most recent address
    provided for the person at least 30 days before the effective date
    of the new or increased charge, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} displaying a notice on the institution's website
    for a period of at least 60 days ending on the effective date of the
    new or increased charge.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1370030){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1370030.html"}
:::

##### [Optional Products or Services]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1370031 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agreement --- natural persons

- **[[627.94]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.94
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall, before
  entering into an agreement with a natural person other than for
  business purposes for an optional product or service, disclose to the
  person the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a description of the optional product or service;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the term of the agreement;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a list of all charges that will be imposed for the
    use of the product or service, or the method used for determining
    the charges and an example to illustrate the method;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the conditions under which the person may cancel
    the agreement;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the date from which the product or service is
    available for use and, if different, from which charges apply; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the steps required to use the product or service.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Content --- cancellation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Before entering into the agreement, the institution
  shall also disclose

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the fact that the person may cancel the agreement
    by notifying the institution that the agreement is to be cancelled;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the fact that the cancellation will take effect on
    the last day of the billing cycle, or 30 days after the institution
    receives the notification, whichever is earlier; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the fact that it shall, without delay on receipt of
    the notification, refund or credit to the person any amount that it
    received for any part of the product or service that will be unused
    from the effective date of the cancellation, to be calculated in
    accordance with the prescribed formula.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1370047){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1370047.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Promotional and other offers

**[[627.95]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.95 .sectionLabel}** The institution
shall, immediately before obtaining a person's express consent under
section 627.42, disclose to the person the information set out in
paragraphs 627.94(1)(b) to (e) and subsection 627.94(2) and,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} if consent is to be obtained under subsection
  627.42(1), the day on which the person will no longer benefit from the
  offer; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} if consent is to be obtained under subsection
  627.42(2), the fact that the person no longer benefits from the offer.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1370053){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1370053.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amendments

**[[627.96]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.96 .sectionLabel}** If an institution
makes an amendment to a term or condition of an agreement referred to in
section 627.94 that results in a change to the information that was
required to be disclosed under that section, the institution shall, at
least 30 days before the day on which the amendment takes effect,
disclose that change to the person.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1370057){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1370057.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Cancellation

**[[627.97]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.97 .sectionLabel}** If an optional
product or service, other than one provided in relation to a credit
agreement, is provided on an ongoing basis by an institution, the
institution shall, as part of any disclosure that it is required to make
under section 627.95 or 627.96, disclose the information set out in
paragraph 627.94(1)(d) and subsection 627.94(2).

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1370061){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1370061.html"}
:::

##### [Registered Products]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1370062 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Availability of list of charges

**[[627.98]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.98 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall disclose a list of all charges applicable to registered products
by

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} making the list available

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} at each of its branches in Canada and points of
    service where it offers registered products, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} on each of its websites through which it offers
    registered products in Canada; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} providing the list to any person who requests it.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1370070){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1370070.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agreement --- persons

**[[627.99]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.99 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall, before entering into an agreement with a person for a registered
product in Canada, disclose to the person

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} information about all charges applicable to the
  product;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} information about how the person will be notified of
  any increase in those charges and of any new charges applicable to the
  product; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed information.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1370077){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1370077.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amendments

**[[627.991]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.991 .sectionLabel}** An institution
shall, before any amendment that it makes to a term or condition with
respect to a registered product takes effect, disclose the amendment to
the person to whom the product was issued.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1370081){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1370081.html"}
:::

##### [Mortgage Insurance]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1370104 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Availability of information

- **[[627.992]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.992
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If an institution or any of its
  affiliates imposes a charge for insurance or a guarantee that the
  institution obtains against default on a loan made in Canada on the
  security of residential property, the institution shall disclose
  prescribed information and any other information that could reasonably
  be expected to have an impact on a borrower by

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} making the information available

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} at each of its branches in Canada and points of
      service where it offers residential mortgages, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} on each of its websites through which it offers
      residential mortgages in Canada; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} providing the information to any person who
    requests it.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agreement --- persons

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall, before entering into an
  agreement under which such a charge is imposed on a person, disclose
  prescribed information to the person and any other information that
  could reasonably be expected to have an impact on the person.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1370137){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1370137.html"}
:::

#### [Public Notices]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1370308 .Subheading}

##### [Notice of Branch Closure]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1370309 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Written notice

- **[[627.993]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.993
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A member bank that closes a retail
  deposit-taking branch --- or that ceases to open retail deposit
  accounts or to disburse cash to customers through a natural person at
  a retail deposit-taking branch --- shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} give a written notice to the Commissioner not later
    than

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} four months before the date proposed for the
      closure of the branch or the cessation of the activity, if the
      branch is in an urban area or in a rural area where there is
      another retail deposit-taking branch within a travelling distance
      of 10 km from the branch, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} six months before the date proposed for the
      closure of the branch or the cessation of the activity, if the
      branch is in a rural area where there is no other retail
      deposit-taking branch within a travelling distance of 10 km from
      the branch;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} give a written notice to each customer of the
    branch and to the public not later than four months before the date
    proposed for the closure of the branch or the cessation of the
    activity, if the branch is in an urban area or in a rural area where
    there is another retail deposit-taking branch within a travelling
    distance of 10 km from the branch; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} give a written notice to each customer of the
    branch, to the public and to the chairperson, mayor, warden, reeve
    or other similar chief officer of the municipal or local government
    body or authority for the area in which the branch is located not
    later than six months before the date proposed for the closure of
    the branch or the cessation of the activity, if the branch is in a
    rural area where there is no other retail deposit-taking branch
    within a travelling distance of 10 km from the branch.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice to public

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The member bank shall give the notice to the public
  by

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} displaying it prominently at the branch; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the notice is one that is required under
    paragraph (1)(c), publishing it in a newspaper in general
    circulation at or near the place where the branch is located.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Content of notice

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The notice shall include prescribed information.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1370325){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1370325.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemptions

**[[627.994]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.994 .sectionLabel}** In prescribed
circumstances, the Commissioner may, on the request of a member bank,
exempt it from the requirement to give a notice under section 627.993 or
vary the time and manner in which such a notice is required to be given.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1370329){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1370329.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Meeting

- **[[627.995]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.995
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} After a notice is given but before
  the branch is closed or ceases to carry on the activity, the
  Commissioner shall require the member bank to convene and hold a
  meeting between representatives of the bank, representatives of the
  Agency and interested persons in the area affected by the closure of
  the branch or the cessation of the activity in order to exchange views
  about the closure of the branch or the cessation of the activity,
  including alternate service delivery by the bank and measures to help
  the branch's customers adjust to the closure or the cessation of the
  activity, if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the member bank has not consulted in the area well
    enough to ascertain the views of interested persons in the area with
    regard to the closure of the branch, the cessation of the activity,
    alternate service delivery by the bank or measures to help the
    branch's customers adjust to the closure or the cessation of the
    activity; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an area representative or a person from the area
    submits to the Commissioner a request for the meeting and the
    request is not frivolous or vexatious.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Rules

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Commissioner may establish rules for the
  convening and conduct of a meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application of [Statutory
  Instruments Act](/eng/acts/S-22)

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The [Statutory Instruments Act](/eng/acts/S-22) does
  not apply to rules established under subsection (2).

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1370340){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1370340.html"}
:::

##### [Public Accountability Statements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1370341 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Content

- **[[627.996]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.996
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A bank with equity of
  \$1,000,000,000 or more shall, within 135 days after the end of each
  financial year,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} file a written statement with the Commissioner that
    includes, for that financial year,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} prescribed information with respect to the
      contribution of the bank and its prescribed affiliates to the
      Canadian economy and society and with respect to any other matter,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the names of the voluntary codes of conduct that
      it has adopted, that are designed to protect the interests of its
      customers and that are publicly available --- and of any public
      commitments that it has made and that are designed to protect the
      interests of its customers --- along with the means by which the
      codes and commitments are made available to its customers and the
      public,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a description of the measures taken by the bank
      and its prescribed affiliates to provide products and services to
      low-income persons, senior persons, persons with disabilities and
      persons who face accessibility, linguistic or literacy challenges,
      and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a description of the consultations undertaken by
      the bank and its prescribed affiliates with their customers and
      the public in relation to

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} existing products and services, including the
        means by which they are provided,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the development of new products and services,
        including the means by which they would be provided,

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} the identification of trends and emerging
        issues that may have an impact on their customers or the public,
        and

      - [(D)]{.lawlabel} matters in respect of which the bank has
        received complaints; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} inform its customers and the public, through
    advertising, making public announcements, posting notices, mailing
    information or otherwise, about the means by which the statement is
    made available to them.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank is not required to include in the statement
  the information required under subparagraphs (1)(a)(i), (iii) and (iv)
  with respect to a prescribed affiliate if a company referred to in
  subsection 489.1(1) of the [Insurance Companies Act](/eng/acts/I-11.8)
  or subsection 444.2(1) of the [Trust and Loan Companies
  Act](/eng/acts/T-19.8) has already published that information in its
  statement published under those subsections.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Availability of statement

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The bank shall make the statement available free of
  charge

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} on each of its websites through which it offers
    products or services in Canada; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} by providing it to any person who requests it.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1370362){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1370362.html"}
:::

### [DIVISION 4]{.HLabel2}[Redress]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1370363 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Credit or refund of charge or penalty

- **[[627.997]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.997
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall, if it has
  imposed a charge or penalty in relation to a product or service,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} credit the amount of the charge or penalty or, if
    it was collected, refund the amount if the charge or penalty was not
    provided for in an agreement; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} credit the excess amount of the charge or penalty
    or, if it was collected, refund the excess amount if the charge or
    penalty was greater than the amount of charge or penalty that was
    provided for in an agreement.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Credit or refund of charge or penalty
  --- no express consent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An institution shall, if it has provided a person
  with a product or service without first having obtained from the
  person the express consent referred to in paragraph 627.08(1)(a), and
  if it has imposed a charge or penalty on the person in relation to the
  product or service, credit the amount of the charge or penalty or, if
  it was collected, refund the amount.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Interest

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The amount referred to in subsections (1) and (2)
  bears interest from the day on which it was imposed, at a rate equal
  to the Bank of Canada's overnight rate on that day, until the day on
  which the amount is refunded or credited.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1370374){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1370374.html"}
:::

### [DIVISION 5]{.HLabel2}[Regulations]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1370375 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

**[[627.998]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-627.998 .sectionLabel}** The Governor in
Council may make regulations respecting any matters involving an
institution's dealings, or the dealings of its employees,
representatives, agents or other intermediaries, with customers or the
public, any matters involving products or services that are the subject
of those dealings and any matters involving an institution that is
acting in the capacity of a representative, agent or other intermediary
for another entity, including regulations

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} requiring the disclosure of information;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} respecting the training of an institution's
  employees, representatives, agents or other intermediaries;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} respecting the content of advertisements and the
  manner in which it is displayed or communicated;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} respecting the rebate or refund of any amounts paid
  or to be paid in relation to the provision of a product or service;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} prescribing what an institution may, shall or shall
  not do --- including in relation to the imposition of charges or
  penalties --- in carrying out any of the activities that it is
  permitted to carry out, or in providing any of the services that it is
  permitted to provide, under section 409 or 538 and any ancillary,
  related or incidental activities or services;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} respecting the names of positions to be used by an
  institution's employees, representatives, agents or other
  intermediaries in their dealings with customers or the public;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} prescribing the time at which and the manner in which
  any of the activities referred to in paragraph (e) are to be carried
  out or any of the services referred to in that paragraph are to be
  provided;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} prescribing when documents and information that are
  required to be disclosed, sent or otherwise provided under this Part
  are deemed to have been provided;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} prescribing the manner in which any information that
  is required to be filed, disclosed, made available or otherwise
  provided under this Part is to be organized or broken down;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} prescribing the time at which and the manner in which
  any information that is required to be filed, disclosed, made
  available or otherwise provided under this Part is to be filed,
  disclosed, made available or otherwise provided;

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} prescribing the circumstances in which all or part of
  sections 627.08, 627.17, 627.28, 627.3, 627.31, 627.59, 627.72,
  627.89, 627.99, 627.992 and 627.993 do not apply;

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} specifying conduct that shall be considered or shall
  not be considered coercion for the purpose of paragraph 627.04(a);

- [(m)]{.lawlabel} requiring a member bank, at any point of service or
  any branch in Canada at which it opens retail deposit accounts through
  natural persons, to open, at the request of a natural person who meets
  the prescribed conditions, a low-cost or no-cost retail deposit
  account for the person, and prescribing the characteristics of such an
  account, including the name of the account;

- [(n)]{.lawlabel} respecting the collection, retention, use or
  disclosure of information about a customer and the manner in which
  complaints by the customer in relation to that collection, retention,
  use or disclosure are to be dealt with; and

- [(o)]{.lawlabel} respecting the requirements to be met by the external
  complaints body.

- [(p)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2023, c. 26, s. 133\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 27, s. 329](#1039564-1370395){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1039564-1370395.html"}
- [2023, c. 26, s. 133](#1409418-1415332){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1409418-1415332.html"}
:::
