    applies, including the information to be contained in the proposals
    and the times within which the transactions involved in them must
    occur;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} respecting the procedures to be followed by a bank
    that makes an application under subsection (1);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} respecting the approval, confirmation or
    authorization, if any, of all or any portion of proposals to which
    subsection (1) applies, including the approval of shareholders and
    including the terms and conditions of those approvals, confirmations
    or authorizations and their effect; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} specifying provisions of the Act for the purpose of
    paragraph (1)(b).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 72
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 106
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-678-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 678"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of issue of letters patent

**[[679]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-679 .sectionLabel}** The Superintendent
shall cause to be published in the [Canada
Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) a notice of the issuance of letters
patent incorporating a bank holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 73
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}First directors

**[[680]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-680 .sectionLabel}** The first directors of
a bank holding company are the directors named in the application for
letters patent to incorporate the bank holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 73
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of letters patent

**[[681]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-681 .sectionLabel}** A bank holding company
comes into existence on the date provided therefor in its letters
patent.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

#### [Continuance]{.HTitleText3} {#h-19883 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Federal corporations

- **[[682]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-682 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  body corporate incorporated under the [Canada Business Corporations
  Act](/eng/acts/C-44) or any other Act of Parliament, including a bank
  but not including a federal credit union, may apply to the Minister
  for letters patent continuing the body corporate as a bank holding
  company under this Part.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Other corporations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A body corporate incorporated otherwise than by or
  under an Act of Parliament may, if so authorized by the laws of the
  jurisdiction where it is incorporated, apply to the Minister for
  letters patent continuing the body corporate as a bank holding company
  under this Part.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2010, c. 12, s. 2083
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-682-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 682"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application for continuance

- **[[683]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-683
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where a body corporate applies for
  letters patent under subsection 682(1) or (2), sections 672 to 675
  apply in respect of the application, with such modifications as the
  circumstances require.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Special resolution approval

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where a body corporate applies for letters patent
  under subsection 682(1) or (2), the application must be duly
  authorized by a special resolution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Copy of special resolution

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A copy of the special resolution referred to in
  subsection (2) shall be filed with the application.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Power to issue letters patent

- **[[684]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-684 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  the application of a body corporate under subsection 682(1) or (2),
  the Minister may, subject to this Division, issue letters patent
  continuing the body corporate as a bank holding company under this
  Part.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Issue of letters patent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where letters patent are issued to a body corporate
  under subsection (1), section 676 applies in respect of the issue of
  letters patent, with such modifications as the circumstances require.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of letters patent

**[[685]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-685 .sectionLabel}** On the day set out in
the letters patent continuing a body corporate as a bank holding company
under subsection 684(1),

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the body corporate becomes a bank holding company as
  if it had been incorporated under this Part; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the letters patent are deemed to be the incorporating
  instrument of the continued bank holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Copy of letters patent

- **[[686]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-686
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where a body corporate is continued
  as a bank holding company under this Part, the Superintendent shall
  without delay send a copy of the letters patent to the appropriate
  official or public body in the jurisdiction in which the body
  corporate was authorized to apply to be continued under this Part.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of issuance of letters patent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent shall cause to be published in the
  [Canada Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) a notice of the issuance
  of letters patent continuing a body corporate as a bank holding
  company under this Part.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effects of continuance

**[[687]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-687 .sectionLabel}** Where a body corporate
is continued as a bank holding company under this Part,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the property of the body corporate continues to be
  the property of the bank holding company;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bank holding company continues to be liable for
  the obligations of the body corporate;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} an existing cause of action or claim by or against
  the body corporate or any liability of the body corporate to
  prosecution is unaffected;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a civil, criminal or administrative action or
  proceeding pending by or against the body corporate may continue to be
  prosecuted by or against the bank holding company;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} a conviction against, or any ruling, order or
  judgment in favour of or against the body corporate may be enforced by
  or against the bank holding company;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} a person who, on the day the body corporate becomes a
  bank holding company, was the holder of a security issued by the body
  corporate is not deprived of any right or privilege available to the
  person at that time in respect of the security or relieved of any
  liability in respect thereof, but any such right or privilege may be
  exercised only in accordance with this Act; and

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} the by-laws of the body corporate, except those that
  are in conflict with this Act, continue as the by-laws of the bank
  holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transitional

- **[[688]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-688
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding any other provision
  of this Act or the regulations, the Minister may, on the
  recommendation of the Superintendent, by order, grant to a bank
  holding company in respect of which letters patent were issued under
  subsection 684(1) permission to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} engage in a business activity specified in the
    order that a bank holding company is not otherwise permitted by this
    Act to engage in and that the body corporate continued as the bank
    holding company was engaging in at the time the application for the
    letters patent was made;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} continue to have issued and outstanding debt
    obligations the issue of which is not authorized by this Act if the
    debt obligations were outstanding at the time the application for
    the letters patent was made;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} hold assets that a bank holding company is not
    otherwise permitted by this Act to hold if the assets were held by
    the body corporate continued as the bank holding company at the time
    the application for the letters patent was made;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} acquire and hold assets that a bank holding company
    is not otherwise permitted by this Act to acquire or hold if the
    body corporate continued as the bank holding company was obliged, at
    the time the application for the letters patent was made, to acquire
    those assets; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} maintain outside Canada any records or registers
    required by this Act to be maintained in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duration

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The permission granted under subsection (1) shall be
  expressed to be granted for a period specified in the order not
  exceeding

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} with respect to any activity described in paragraph
    (1)(a), thirty days after the effective date of the letters patent
    or, where the activity is conducted pursuant to an agreement
    existing on the effective date of the letters patent, the expiration
    of the agreement;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to any matter described in paragraph
    (1)(b), ten years; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} with respect to any matter described in any of
    paragraphs (1)(c) to (e), two years.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Renewal

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (4), the Minister may, on the
  recommendation of the Superintendent, by order, renew a permission
  granted by order under subsection (1) with respect to any matter
  described in paragraphs (1)(b) to (d) for such further period or
  periods as the Minister considers necessary.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limitation

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall not grant to a bank holding
  company any permission

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} with respect to matters described in paragraph
    (1)(b), that purports to be effective more than ten years after the
    effective date of the letters patent, unless the Minister is
    satisfied on the basis of evidence on oath provided by an officer of
    the bank holding company that the bank holding company will not be
    able at law to redeem at the end of the ten years the outstanding
    debt obligations to which the permission relates; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to matters described in paragraphs
    (1)(c) and (d), that purports to be effective more than ten years
    after the effective date of the letters patent.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 107
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-688-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 688"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Discontinuance]{.HTitleText3} {#h-19952 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transferring to other Acts

- **[[689]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-689 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company may apply to be continued only as a body
  corporate under any other Act of Parliament or any Act of the
  legislature of a province, and it may do so only with the approval in
  writing of the Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions for approval

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No approval referred to in subsection (1) may be
  given to a bank holding company unless the Minister is satisfied that
  the application of the bank holding company has been authorized by a
  special resolution.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 108
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-689-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 689"){.PITLink}
:::

Meaning of [[bank holding company without a bank
subsidiary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

- **[[690]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-690 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purpose of this section, [[bank holding company without a bank
  subsidiary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a bank holding company that
  does not, at any time within one year after it came into existence,
  have a subsidiary that is a bank or that does not, for a period of one
  year, have a subsidiary that is a bank.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Obligation to apply

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company without a bank subsidiary
  must, within 30 days after becoming a bank holding company without a
  bank subsidiary, apply to be continued under subsection 689(1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Cessation of existence

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Except for the sole purpose of winding up its
  affairs, a bank holding company without a bank subsidiary that has no
  other subsidiary that fails to make an application under
  subsection (2) within the time provided for in that subsection ceases
  to exist on the expiration of that period.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Act ceases to apply

**[[691]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-691 .sectionLabel}** On the day specified by
the Minister, this Act ceases to apply to the body corporate continued
under the other Act of Parliament or under the Act of the legislature of
a province.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Withdrawing application

**[[692]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-692 .sectionLabel}** Where a special
resolution authorizing the application under subsection 689(1) so
states, the directors of a bank holding company may, without further
approval of the shareholders, withdraw the application before it is
acted on.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

#### [Corporate Name]{.HTitleText3} {#h-19977 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibited names

**[[693]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-693 .sectionLabel}** A bank holding company
may not be incorporated under this Part with a name

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is prohibited by an Act of Parliament;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is, in the opinion of the Superintendent,
  deceptively misdescriptive;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} that is the same as or, in the opinion of the
  Superintendent, substantially the same as or confusingly similar to,
  any existing

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} trademark or trade name, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} corporate name of a body corporate,

  except where the trademark or trade name is being changed or the body
  corporate is being dissolved or is changing its corporate name and
  consent to the use of the trademark, trade name or corporate name is
  signified to the Superintendent in such manner as the Superintendent
  may require;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} that is the same as or, in the opinion of the
  Superintendent, substantially the same as or confusingly similar to,
  the known name under or by which any entity carries on business or is
  identified; or

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} that is reserved under section 43 for a bank or an
  authorized foreign bank or a proposed bank or proposed authorized
  foreign bank or under section 697 for another bank holding company or
  a proposed bank holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- [2014, c. 20, s. 366(E)](#1034903-1145565){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1034903-1145565.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-693-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 693"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Affiliated bank holding company

**[[694]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-694 .sectionLabel}** Despite section 693 and
subject to section 695, a bank holding company that is affiliated with
another entity may, with the consent of that entity,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} be incorporated with, or change its name to,
  substantially the same name as that of the affiliated entity; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} subject to any terms and conditions that may be
  prescribed, carry on business under or identify itself by a name,
  other than its corporate name, that is substantially the same as the
  corporate name of the affiliated entity or that is another name under
  which or with which the affiliated entity carries on business or
  otherwise identifies itself.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 109
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-694-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 694"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction

**[[695]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-695 .sectionLabel}** A bank holding company
may not be incorporated or continued with, change its name to or carry
on business or identify itself by, a name that is substantially similar
to that of a bank unless the name contains words that, in the opinion of
the Superintendent, indicate to the public that the bank holding company
is distinct from any bank that is a subsidiary of the bank holding
company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}French or English form of name

- **[[696]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-696 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  name of a bank holding company may be set out in its letters patent in
  an English form, a French form, an English form and a French form or
  in a combined English and French form, and the bank holding company
  may use and be legally designated by any such form.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Mandatory abbreviation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite any other provision of this Act and subject
  to the regulations, every bank holding company shall have as part of
  its name, the abbreviations "bhc" or "spb".

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Alternate name

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company may identify itself outside
  Canada by its name in any language and the bank holding company may
  use and be legally designated by any such form of its name outside
  Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Other name

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (5) and section 832, a bank
  holding company may carry on business under or identify itself by a
  name other than its corporate name.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Directions

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Where a bank holding company is carrying on business
  under or identifying itself by a name other than its corporate name,
  the Superintendent may, by order, direct the bank holding company not
  to use that other name if the Superintendent is of the opinion that
  that other name is a name referred to in any of paragraphs 693(a) to
  (e).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  respecting the use of the abbreviations "bhc" or "spb" in the name of
  bank holding companies.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reserved name

**[[697]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-697 .sectionLabel}** The Superintendent may,
on request, reserve for ninety days a name for a proposed bank holding
company or for a bank holding company that intends to change its name.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Directing change of name

- **[[698]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-698 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If
  through inadvertence or otherwise a bank holding company

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} comes into existence or is continued with a name,
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} on an application to change its name, is granted a
    name

  that is prohibited by section 693 or 695, the Superintendent may, by
  order, direct the bank holding company to change its name and the bank
  holding company shall comply with that direction.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Revoking name

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where a bank holding company has been directed under
  subsection (1) to change its name and has not, within sixty days after
  the service of the direction, changed its name to a name that is not
  prohibited by this Part, the Superintendent may revoke the name of the
  bank holding company and assign to it a name and, until changed in
  accordance with section 215 or 217, the name of the bank holding
  company is thereafter the name so assigned.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

#### [Publication of Information]{.HTitleText3} {#h-20029 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publication of information

**[[699]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-699 .sectionLabel}** The Superintendent
shall, within sixty days after the end of each year, cause a notice to
be published in the [Canada Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/), showing

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of every bank holding company; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the province in which the head office of the bank
  holding company is situated.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 85
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-699-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 699"){.PITLink}
:::

### [DIVISION 4]{.HLabel2}[Organization and Commencement]{.HTitleText2} {#h-20036 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}First directors' meeting

- **[[700]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-700
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} After letters patent incorporating a
  bank holding company are issued, a meeting of the directors of the
  bank holding company shall be held at which the directors may, subject
  to this Division,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} make by-laws;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} adopt forms of share certificates and corporate
    records;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} authorize the issue of shares of the bank holding
    company;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} appoint officers;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} appoint an auditor to hold office until the first
    meeting of shareholders;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} make banking arrangements; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} deal with any other matters necessary to organize
    the bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Calling directors' meeting

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An incorporator or a director named in the
  application for letters patent may call the meeting referred to in
  subsection (1) by giving, subject to subsection 770(2), no fewer than
  five days notice of the purpose, time and place of the meeting to each
  director of the bank holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Calling shareholders' meeting

- **[[701]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-701
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} After the meeting referred to in
  subsection 700(1) is held, the directors of the bank holding company
  shall without delay call a meeting of the shareholders of the bank
  holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Meeting of shareholders

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The shareholders of a bank holding company shall, by
  resolution at the meeting of shareholders called pursuant to
  subsection (1),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} approve, amend or reject any by-law made by the
    directors of the bank holding company;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subject to section 756, elect directors to hold
    office for a term expiring not later than the close of the third
    annual meeting of shareholders following the election; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} appoint an auditor to hold office until the close
    of the first annual meeting of shareholders.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Term of first directors

**[[702]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-702 .sectionLabel}** A director named in the
application for letters patent to incorporate a bank holding company
holds office until the election of directors at the meeting of
shareholders called pursuant to subsection 701(1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

### [DIVISION 5]{.HLabel2}[Capital Structure]{.HTitleText2} {#h-20065 .Subheading}

#### [Share Capital]{.HTitleText3} {#h-20066 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Power to issue shares

- **[[703]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-703
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to this Part and the by-laws
  of the bank holding company, shares of a bank holding company may be
  issued at such times and to such persons and for such consideration as
  the directors of the bank holding company may determine.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shares

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Shares of a bank holding company shall be in
  registered form and shall be without nominal or par value.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shares of continued bank holding
  company

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where a body corporate is continued as a bank holding
  company under this Part, shares with nominal or par value issued by
  the body corporate before it was so continued are deemed to be shares
  without nominal or par value.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed share conditions

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If a right of a holder of a share with nominal or par
  value of a body corporate continued as a bank holding company under
  this Part, other than a voting right, was stated or expressed in terms
  of the nominal or par value of the share immediately before the body
  corporate was continued under this Part, that right is deemed, after
  the continuance, to be the same right stated or expressed without
  reference to the nominal or par value of the share.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Common shares

- **[[704]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-704 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company shall have one class of shares, to be designated
  as "common shares", which are non-redeemable and in which the rights
  of the holders thereof are equal in all respects, and those rights
  include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the right to vote at all meetings of shareholders
    except where only holders of a specified class of shares are
    entitled to vote;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the right to receive dividends declared on those
    shares; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the right to receive the remaining property of the
    bank holding company on dissolution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Designations of shares

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No bank holding company shall designate more than one
  class of its shares as "common shares" or any variation of that term.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Continued bank holding company

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A body corporate continued as a bank holding company
  under this Part that is not in compliance with subsection (2) on the
  date letters patent continuing it as a bank holding company are issued
  shall, within twelve months after that date, redesignate its shares to
  comply with that subsection.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Classes of shares

- **[[705]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-705 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  by-laws of a bank holding company may provide for more than one class
  of shares and, if they so provide, shall set out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the rights, privileges, restrictions and conditions
    attaching to the shares of each class; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the maximum number, if any, of shares of any class
    that the bank holding company is authorized to issue.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shareholder approval

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where a by-law referred to in subsection (1) is made,
  the directors of the bank holding company shall submit the by-law to
  the shareholders at the next meeting of shareholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effective date

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A by-law referred to in subsection (1) is not
  effective until it is confirmed or confirmed with amendments by
  special resolution of the shareholders at the meeting referred to in
  subsection (2).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shares issued in series

- **[[706]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-706 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  by-laws of a bank holding company may, subject to any limitations set
  out in them, authorize the issue of any class of shares in one or more
  series and may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} fix the maximum number of shares in each series and
    determine the designation, rights, privileges, restrictions and
    conditions attaching to them; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} authorize the directors to do anything referred to
    in paragraph (a).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Series participation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If any cumulative dividend or amounts payable on
  return of capital in respect of a series of shares are not paid in
  full, the shares of all series of the same class participate rateably
  in respect of accumulated dividends and return of capital.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Voting rights

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where voting rights are attached to any series of a
  class of shares, the shares of every other series of that class shall
  have the same voting rights.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on series

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} No rights, privileges, restrictions or conditions
  attached to a series of shares authorized under this section confer on
  the series a priority in respect of dividends or return of capital
  over any other series of shares of the same class that are then
  outstanding.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Material to Superintendent

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} If the directors exercise their authority under
  paragraph (1)(b), the directors shall, before the issue of shares of
  the series, send to the Superintendent particulars of the series of
  shares and a copy of the by-law that granted the authority to the
  directors.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 86
- 2007, c. 6, s. 110(E)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-706-20060427.html "Link to previous version of section 706"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}One share, one vote

**[[707]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-707 .sectionLabel}** Where voting rights are
attached to a share of a bank holding company, the voting rights may
confer only one vote in respect of that share.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shares non-assessable

**[[708]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-708 .sectionLabel}** Shares issued by a bank
holding company are non-assessable and the shareholders are not liable
to the bank holding company or to its creditors in respect thereof.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Consideration for share

- **[[709]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-709 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No
  share of any class of shares of a bank holding company shall be issued
  until it is fully paid for in money or, with the approval of the
  Superintendent, in property.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Other currencies

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} When issuing shares, a bank holding company may
  provide that any aspect of the shares relating to money or involving
  the payment of or the liability to pay money be in a currency other
  than the currency of Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Stated capital account

- **[[710]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-710 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company shall maintain a separate stated capital account
  for each class and series of shares it issues.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Addition to stated capital account

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company shall record in the
  appropriate stated capital account the full amount of any
  consideration it receives for any shares it issues.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (2), a bank holding company may,
  subject to subsection (4), record in the stated capital account
  maintained for the shares of a class or series any part of the
  consideration it receives in an exchange if it issues shares

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in exchange for

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} property of a person who immediately before the
      exchange did not deal with the bank holding company at arm's
      length within the meaning of that expression in the [Income Tax
      Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} shares of or another interest in a body
      corporate that immediately before the exchange or because of it
      did not deal with the bank holding company at arm's length within
      the meaning of that expression in the [Income Tax
      Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3), or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} property of a person who immediately before the
      exchange dealt with the bank holding company at arm's length
      within the meaning of that expression in the [Income Tax
      Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3) if the person, the bank holding company and
      all of the holders of shares in the class or series of shares so
      issued consent to the exchange;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} under an agreement referred to in subsection
    804(1); or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} to shareholders of an amalgamating body corporate
    who receive the shares in addition to or instead of securities of
    the amalgamated bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit on addition to a stated capital
  account

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} On the issuance of a share, a bank holding company
  shall not add to the stated capital account in respect of the share an
  amount greater than the amount of the consideration it receives for
  the share.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Constraint on addition to a stated
  capital account

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Where a bank holding company that has issued any
  outstanding shares of more than one class or series proposes to add to
  a stated capital account that it maintains in respect of a class or
  series of shares an amount that was not received by the bank holding
  company as consideration for the issue of shares, the addition must be
  approved by special resolution unless all the issued and outstanding
  shares are of not more than two classes of convertible shares referred
  to in subsection 720(4).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 87
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-710-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 710"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Stated capital of continued bank holding
company

- **[[711]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-711
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where a body corporate is continued
  as a bank holding company under this Part, the bank holding company
  shall record in the stated capital account maintained for each class
  and series of shares then outstanding an amount that is equal to the
  aggregate of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate amount paid up on the shares of each
    class and series of shares immediately before the body corporate was
    so continued, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount of the contributed surplus of the bank
    holding company that is attributable to those shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contributed surplus entry

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The amount of any contributed surplus recorded in the
  stated capital account pursuant to paragraph (1)(b) shall be deducted
  from the contributed surplus account of the bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shares issued before continuance

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Any amount unpaid in respect of a share issued by a
  body corporate before it was continued as a bank holding company under
  this Part and paid after it was so continued shall be recorded in the
  stated capital account maintained by the bank holding company for the
  shares of that class or series.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Pre-emptive right

- **[[712]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-712
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where the by-laws of a bank holding
  company so provide, no shares of any class shall be issued unless the
  shares have first been offered to the shareholders holding shares of
  that class, and those shareholders have a pre-emptive right to acquire
  the offered shares in proportion to their holdings of the shares of
  that class, at such price and on such terms as those shares are to be
  offered to others.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding the existence of a pre-emptive right,
  a shareholder of a bank holding company has no pre-emptive right in
  respect of shares of a class to be issued

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for a consideration other than money;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} as a share dividend; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} pursuant to the exercise of conversion privileges,
    options or rights previously granted by the bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding the existence of a pre-emptive right,
  a shareholder of a bank holding company has no pre-emptive right in
  respect of shares to be issued

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where the issue of shares to the shareholder is
    prohibited by this Part; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where, to the knowledge of the directors of the
    bank holding company, the offer of shares to a shareholder whose
    recorded address is in a country other than Canada ought not to be
    made unless the appropriate authority in that country is provided
    with information in addition to that submitted to the shareholders
    at the last annual meeting.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conversion privileges

- **[[713]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-713 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company may issue conversion privileges, options or
  rights to acquire securities of the bank holding company, and shall
  set out the conditions thereof

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the documents that evidence the conversion
    privileges, options or rights; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the securities to which the conversion
    privileges, options or rights are attached.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transferable rights

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Conversion privileges, options and rights to acquire
  securities of a bank holding company may be made transferable or
  non-transferable, and options and rights to acquire such securities
  may be made separable or inseparable from any securities to which they
  are attached.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reserved shares

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where a bank holding company has granted privileges
  to convert any securities issued by the bank holding company into
  shares, or into shares of another class or series, or has issued or
  granted options or rights to acquire shares, if the by-laws limit the
  number of authorized shares, the bank holding company shall reserve
  and continue to reserve sufficient authorized shares to meet the
  exercise of such conversion privileges, options and rights.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Holding of own shares

**[[714]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-714 .sectionLabel}** Except as provided in
sections 715 to 717, or unless permitted by the regulations, a bank
holding company shall not

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} hold shares of the bank holding company or of any
  body corporate that controls the bank holding company;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} hold any ownership interests of any unincorporated
  entity that controls the bank holding company;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} permit any of its subsidiaries to hold any shares of
  the bank holding company or of any body corporate that controls the
  bank holding company; or

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} permit any of its subsidiaries to hold any ownership
  interests of any unincorporated entity that controls the bank holding
  company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Purchase and redemption of shares

- **[[715]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-715
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2) and to its
  by-laws, a bank holding company may, with the consent of the
  Superintendent, purchase, for the purpose of cancellation, any shares
  issued by it, or redeem any redeemable shares issued by it at prices
  not exceeding the redemption price thereof calculated according to a
  formula stated in its by-laws or the conditions attaching to the
  shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restrictions on purchase and redemption

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company shall not make any payment to
  purchase or redeem any shares issued by it if there are reasonable
  grounds for believing that the bank holding company is, or the payment
  would cause the bank holding company to be, in contravention of any
  regulation referred to in subsection 949(1) or (2) or any direction
  made pursuant to subsection 949(3).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Donated shares

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company may accept from any
  shareholder a share of the bank holding company surrendered to it as a
  gift, but may not extinguish or reduce a liability in respect of an
  amount unpaid on any such share except in accordance with section 718.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Holding as personal representative

- **[[716]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-716 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company may permit its subsidiaries to hold, in the
  capacity of a personal representative, shares of the bank holding
  company or of any body corporate that controls the bank holding
  company or ownership interests in any unincorporated entity that
  controls the bank holding company, but only if the subsidiary does not
  have a beneficial interest in the shares or ownership interests.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Security interest

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company may permit its subsidiaries to
  hold by way of a security interest shares of the bank holding company
  or of any body corporate that controls the bank holding company, or
  any ownership interests of any entity that controls the bank holding
  company, if the security interest is nominal or immaterial when
  measured by criteria established by the bank holding company that have
  been approved in writing by the Superintendent.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 88(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-716-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 716"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- conditions before
acquisition

- **[[716.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-716.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company may permit
  any of its subsidiaries to acquire shares of the bank holding company
  through the issuance of those shares by the bank holding company to
  the subsidiary if the conditions prescribed for the purposes of this
  subsection are met before the subsidiary acquires the shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions after acquisition

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} After a subsidiary has acquired shares under the
  purported authority of subsection (1), the conditions prescribed for
  the purposes of this subsection must be met.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-compliance with conditions

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a bank holding company permits any of its
  subsidiaries to acquire shares of the bank holding company under the
  purported authority of subsection (1) and one or more of the
  conditions prescribed for the purposes of subsections (1) and (2) were
  not met, are not met or cease to be met, as the case may be, then,
  despite section 665 and subsection 710(2), the bank holding company
  must comply with the prescribed requirements.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2007, c. 6, s. 111
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Cancellation of shares

- **[[717]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-717
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), where a
  bank holding company purchases shares of the bank holding company or
  fractions thereof or redeems or otherwise acquires shares of the bank
  holding company, the bank holding company shall cancel those shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Requirement to sell

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a subsidiary of a bank holding company, through
  the realization of security, acquires any shares of the bank holding
  company or of any body corporate that controls the bank holding
  company or any ownership interests in an unincorporated entity that
  controls the bank holding company, the bank holding company shall
  cause its subsidiary to, within six months after the day of the
  realization, sell or otherwise dispose of the shares or ownership
  interests.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reduction of capital

- **[[718]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-718 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  stated capital of a bank holding company may be reduced by special
  resolution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limitation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company shall not reduce its stated
  capital by special resolution if there are reasonable grounds for
  believing that the bank holding company is, or the reduction would
  cause the bank holding company to be, in contravention of any
  regulation referred to in subsection 949(1) or (2) or any direction
  made pursuant to subsection 949(3).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of special resolution

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A special resolution to reduce the stated capital of
  a bank holding company shall specify the stated capital account or
  accounts from which the reduction of stated capital effected by the
  special resolution will be deducted.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Approval by Superintendent

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A special resolution to reduce the stated capital of
  a bank holding company has no effect until it is approved in writing
  by the Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(4.1)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (4) does not apply if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the reduction in the stated capital is made solely
    as a result of changes made to the accounting principles referred to
    in subsection 308(4); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} there is to be no return of capital to shareholders
    as a result of the reduction.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions for approval

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} No approval to reduce the stated capital of a bank
  holding company may be given by the Superintendent unless application
  therefor is made within three months after the time of the passing of
  the special resolution and a copy of the special resolution, together
  with a notice of intention to apply for approval, has been published
  in the [Canada Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statements to be submitted

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} In addition to evidence of the passing of a special
  resolution to reduce the stated capital of a bank holding company and
  of the publication thereof, statements showing

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the number of the bank holding company's shares
    issued and outstanding,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the results of the voting by class of shares of the
    bank holding company,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the bank holding company's assets and liabilities,
    and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the reason why the bank holding company seeks the
    reduction of capital

  shall be submitted to the Superintendent at the time of the
  application for approval of the special resolution.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 112
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-718-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 718"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Recovery by action

- **[[719]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-719
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where any money or property was paid
  or distributed to a shareholder or other person as a consequence of a
  reduction of capital made contrary to section 718, a creditor of the
  bank holding company may apply to a court for an order compelling the
  shareholder or other person to pay the money or deliver the property
  to the bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shares held by personal representative

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person holding shares in the capacity of a
  personal representative and registered on the records of the bank
  holding company as a shareholder and therein described as the personal
  representative of a named person is personally liable under subsection
  (1), but the named person is subject to all the liabilities imposed by
  that subsection.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limitation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An action to enforce a liability imposed by
  subsection (1) may not be commenced more than two years after the date
  of the act complained of.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Remedy preserved

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} This section does not affect any liability that
  arises under section 794.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Adjustment of stated capital account

- **[[720]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-720 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On a
  purchase, redemption or other acquisition by a bank holding company of
  shares or fractions thereof issued by it, the bank holding company
  shall deduct from the stated capital account maintained for the class
  or series of shares so purchased, redeemed or otherwise acquired an
  amount equal to the result obtained by multiplying the stated capital
  in respect of the shares of that class or series by the number of
  shares of that class or series so purchased, redeemed or otherwise
  acquired and dividing by the number of shares of that class or series
  outstanding immediately before the purchase, redemption or other
  acquisition.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Adjustment of stated capital account

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company shall adjust its stated
  capital account or accounts in accordance with any special resolution
  referred to in section 718.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shares converted to another class

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} On a conversion of outstanding shares of a bank
  holding company into shares of another class or series, or on a change
  of outstanding shares of the bank holding company into shares of
  another class or series, the bank holding company shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} deduct from the stated capital account maintained
    for the class or series of shares converted or changed an amount
    equal to the result obtained by multiplying the stated capital of
    the shares of that class or series by the number of shares of that
    class or series converted or changed, and dividing by the number of
    outstanding shares of that class or series immediately before the
    conversion or change; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} record the result obtained under paragraph (a) and
    any additional consideration received pursuant to the conversion or
    change in the stated capital account maintained or to be maintained
    for the class or series of shares into which the shares have been
    converted or changed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Stated capital of convertible shares

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (3) and subject to the
  bank holding company's by-laws, where a bank holding company issues
  two classes of shares and there is attached to each class a right to
  convert a share of one class into a share of the other class and a
  share is so converted, the amount of stated capital attributable to a
  share in either class is the aggregate of the stated capital of both
  classes divided by the number of outstanding shares of both classes
  immediately before the conversion.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conversion or change of shares

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Shares issued by a bank holding company and converted
  into shares of another class or series, or changed under subsection
  217(1) into shares of another class or series, become issued shares of
  the class or series of shares into which the shares have been
  converted or changed.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Addition to stated capital account

**[[721]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-721 .sectionLabel}** On a conversion of any
debt obligation of a bank holding company into shares of a class or
series of shares, the bank holding company shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} deduct from the liabilities of the bank holding
  company the nominal value of the debt obligation being converted; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} record the result obtained under paragraph (a) and
  any additional consideration received for the conversion in the stated
  capital account maintained or to be maintained for the class or series
  of shares into which the debt obligation has been converted.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Declaration of dividend

- **[[722]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-722 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  directors of a bank holding company may declare and a bank holding
  company may pay a dividend by issuing fully paid shares of the bank
  holding company or options or rights to acquire fully paid shares of
  the bank holding company and, subject to subsection (4), the directors
  of a bank holding company may declare and a bank holding company may
  pay a dividend in money or property, and where a dividend is to be
  paid in money, the dividend may be paid in a currency other than the
  currency of Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice to Superintendent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The directors of a bank holding company shall notify
  the Superintendent of the declaration of a dividend at least 15 days
  before the day fixed for its payment.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Share dividend

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If shares of a bank holding company are issued in
  payment of a dividend, the bank holding company shall record in the
  stated capital account maintained or to be maintained for the shares
  of the class or series issued in payment of the dividend the declared
  amount of the dividend stated as an amount of money.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}When dividend not to be declared

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The directors of a bank holding company shall not
  declare and a bank holding company shall not pay a dividend if there
  are reasonable grounds for believing that the bank holding company is,
  or the payment would cause the bank holding company to be, in
  contravention of any regulation referred to in subsection 949(1)
  or (2) or any direction made pursuant to subsection 949(3).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 113
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-722-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 722"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Subordinated Indebtedness]{.HTitleText3} {#h-20293 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on subordinated indebtedness

- **[[723]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-723 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company shall not issue subordinated indebtedness unless
  the subordinated indebtedness is fully paid for in money or, with the
  approval of the Superintendent, in property.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}References to subordinated indebtedness

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person shall not in any prospectus, advertisement,
  correspondence or literature relating to any subordinated indebtedness
  issued or to be issued by a bank holding company refer to the
  subordinated indebtedness otherwise than as subordinated indebtedness.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Other currencies

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} When issuing subordinated indebtedness, a bank
  holding company may provide that any aspect of the subordinated
  indebtedness relating to money or involving the payment of or the
  liability to pay money in relation thereto be in a currency other than
  that of Canada including, without restricting the generality of the
  foregoing, the payment of any interest thereon.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

#### [Security Certificates and Transfers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-20303 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sections 81 to 135 apply

**[[724]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-724 .sectionLabel}** Sections 81 to 135
apply in respect of bank holding companies, subject to the following:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} references to "bank" in those sections are to be read
  as references to "bank holding company";

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} references to "this Act" in those sections are to be
  read as references to "this Part";

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} references to "Part VII" in those sections are to be
  read as references to "Division 7 of Part XV";

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} references to "this Part" in those sections are to be
  read as references to "this Division";

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the reference to "subsections 137(5) to (7) and
  sections 138 to 141 and 145" in subsection 93(1) is to be read as a
  reference to "subsections 726(5) to (7) and sections 727 to 730 and
  734"; and

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the reference to "section 71 or 77" in subsection
  97(3) is to be read as a reference to "section 715 or 720".

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 90
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-724-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 724"){.PITLink}
:::

### [DIVISION 6]{.HLabel2}[Corporate Governance]{.HTitleText2} {#h-20314 .Subheading}

#### [Shareholders]{.HTitleText3} {#h-20315 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Place of meetings

- **[[725]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-725
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Meetings of shareholders of a bank
  holding company shall be held at the place within Canada provided for
  in the by-laws of the bank holding company or, in the absence of any
  such provision, at the place within Canada that the directors
  determine.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Participation by electronic means

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Unless the by-laws provide otherwise, any person who
  is entitled to attend a meeting of shareholders may participate in the
  meeting by means of a telephonic, electronic or other communication
  facility that permits all participants to communicate adequately with
  each other during the meeting if the bank holding company makes one
  available. A person who is participating in a meeting by one of those
  means is deemed for the purposes of this Part to be present at the
  meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  respecting the manner of and conditions for participating in a meeting
  by means of a telephonic, electronic or other communication facility
  that permits all participants to communicate adequately with each
  other during the meeting.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 91
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-725-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 725"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Calling meetings

- **[[726]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-726 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  directors of a bank holding company

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} shall, after the meeting called pursuant to
    subsection 701(1), call the first annual meeting of shareholders of
    the bank holding company, which meeting must be held not later than
    six months after the end of the first financial year of the bank
    holding company, and subsequently call an annual meeting of
    shareholders, which meeting must be held not later than six months
    after the end of each financial year; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} may at any time call a special meeting of
    shareholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order to delay calling annual meeting

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), the bank holding company may
  apply to the court for an order extending the time for calling an
  annual meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Obligation to notify Superintendent

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The bank holding company shall give notice of the
  application to the Superintendent before any hearing concerning the
  application and shall provide the Superintendent with a copy of any
  order that is issued.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Superintendent's right to appear

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent is entitled to appear and be heard
  in person or by counsel at any hearing concerning the application.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Authority to fix record date

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The directors may in advance fix a record date, that
  is within the prescribed period, for the determination of shareholders
  for any purpose, including for a determination of which shareholders
  are entitled to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} receive payment of a dividend;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} participate in a liquidation distribution;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} receive notice of a meeting of shareholders; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} vote at a meeting of shareholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Determination of record date

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} If no record date is fixed,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the record date for the determination of
    shareholders who are entitled to receive notice of a meeting of
    shareholders is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} at the close of business on the day immediately
      preceding the day on which the notice is given, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if no notice is given, the day on which the
      meeting is held; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the record date for the determination of
    shareholders for any other purpose, other than to establish a
    shareholder's right to vote, is at the close of business on the day
    on which the directors pass a resolution in respect of that purpose.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of record date

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} If a record date is fixed and unless notice of the
  record date is waived in writing by every holder of a share of the
  class or series affected whose name is set out in the securities
  register at the close of business on the day on which the directors
  fix the record date, notice of the record date shall be given within
  the prescribed period by

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} advertisement in a newspaper in general circulation
    in the place where the bank holding company's head office is
    situated and in each place in Canada where the bank holding company
    has a transfer agent or where a transfer of its shares may be
    recorded; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} written notice to each stock exchange in Canada on
    which the bank holding company's shares are listed for trading.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 92
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-726-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 726"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of meeting

- **[[727]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-727
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Notice of the time and place of a
  meeting of shareholders of a bank holding company shall be sent within
  the prescribed period to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} each shareholder entitled to vote at the meeting;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} each director;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the auditor of the bank holding company; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} In the case of a bank holding company that is not a
  distributing bank holding company, notice may be sent within any
  shorter period specified in its by-laws.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Number of eligible votes

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company with equity of twelve billion
  dollars or more shall set out in the notice of a meeting the number of
  eligible votes, as defined under subsection 156.09(1), that may be
  cast at the meeting as of the record date for determining those
  shareholders entitled to receive the notice of meeting, or if there
  are to be separate votes of shareholders at the meeting, the number of
  eligible votes, as defined in that subsection, in respect of each
  separate vote to be held at the meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publication in newspaper

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} In addition to the notice required under subsection
  (1), where any class of shares of a bank holding company is publicly
  traded on a recognized stock exchange in Canada, notice of the time
  and place of a meeting of shareholders shall be published once a week
  for at least four consecutive weeks before the date of the meeting in
  a newspaper in general circulation in the place where the head office
  of the bank holding company is situated and in each place in Canada
  where the bank holding company has a transfer agent or where a
  transfer of the bank holding company's shares may be recorded.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 93
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 78
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-727-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 727"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice not required

- **[[728]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-728 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  notice of a meeting is not required to be sent to shareholders who are
  not registered on the records of the bank holding company or the bank
  holding company's transfer agent on the record date fixed under
  paragraph 726(5)(c) or determined under paragraph 726(6)(a).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of default

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Failure to receive a notice of a meeting of
  shareholders does not deprive a shareholder of the right to vote at
  the meeting.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 94
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-728-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 728"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of adjourned meeting

- **[[729]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-729 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  meeting of shareholders is adjourned for less than thirty days, it is
  not necessary, unless the by-laws otherwise provide, to give notice of
  the adjourned meeting, other than by announcement at the earliest
  meeting that is adjourned.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice where adjournment is longer

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a meeting of shareholders is adjourned by one or
  more adjournments for a total of thirty days or more, notice of the
  continuation of the meeting shall be given as for an original meeting
  but, unless the meeting is adjourned by one or more adjournments for a
  total of more than ninety days, subsection 156.04(1) does not apply.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Special business

- **[[730]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-730 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} All
  matters dealt with at a special meeting of shareholders and all
  matters dealt with at an annual meeting of shareholders, except
  consideration of the financial statements, report of the auditor,
  election of directors, remuneration of directors and reappointment of
  the incumbent auditor, are deemed to be special business.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of special business

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Notice of a meeting of shareholders at which special
  business is to be transacted must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} state the nature of the special business in
    sufficient detail to permit a shareholder to form a reasoned
    judgment thereon; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} contain the text of any special resolution to be
    submitted to the meeting.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Waiver of notice

- **[[731]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-731 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  shareholder and any other person entitled to attend a meeting of
  shareholders may in any manner waive notice of a meeting of
  shareholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Attendance is waiver

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Attendance at a meeting of shareholders is a waiver
  of notice of the meeting, except when a person attends the meeting for
  the express purpose of objecting to the transaction of any business on
  the grounds that the meeting is not lawfully called.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Proposals

- **[[732]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-732
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (1.1) and
  (1.2), a registered holder or beneficial owner of shares that may be
  voted at an annual meeting of shareholders may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} submit to the bank holding company notice of any
    matter that they propose to raise at the meeting (in this section
    and section 733 referred to as a "proposal"); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} discuss at the meeting any matter in respect of
    which they would have been entitled to submit a proposal.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Eligibility to submit proposal

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} To be eligible to submit a proposal a person shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for at least the prescribed period be the
    registered holder or beneficial owner of at least the prescribed
    number of the bank holding company's outstanding shares; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} have the support of persons who, in the aggregate
    and including or not including the person who submits the proposal,
    have for at least the prescribed period been the registered holders
    or beneficial owners of at least the prescribed number of the bank
    holding company's outstanding shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information to be provided

  [(1.2)]{.lawlabel} A proposal is to be accompanied by the following
  information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the person submitting the
    proposal and the names and addresses of their supporters, if any;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the number of shares held or owned by the person
    and their supporters, if any, and the date that the shares were
    acquired.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information not part of proposal

  [(1.3)]{.lawlabel} The information provided under subsection (1.2)
  does not form part of a proposal or of the supporting statement
  referred to in subsection (3) and is not to be included for the
  purpose of the prescribed maximum number of words referred to in
  subsection (3).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Proof may be required

  [(1.4)]{.lawlabel} If the bank holding company requests within the
  prescribed period that a person provide proof that they are eligible
  to submit a proposal, the person shall within the prescribed period
  provide proof that they meet the requirements of subsection (1.1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Circulation of proposal

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company that solicits proxies shall
  set out in the management proxy circular required by subsection
  156.05(1) or attach to it any proposal submitted for consideration at
  a meeting of shareholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Supporting statement

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} At the request of the person who submits a proposal,
  the bank holding company shall set out in the management proxy
  circular or attach to it the person's statement in support of the
  proposal and their name and address. The statement and proposal
  together are not to exceed the prescribed maximum number of words.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Nomination of directors

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A proposal may include nominations for the election
  of directors if it is signed by one or more registered holders or
  beneficial owners of shares representing in the aggregate not less
  than 5% of the shares of the bank holding company or 5% of the shares
  of a class of its shares entitled to vote at the meeting at which the
  proposal is to be presented.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company is not required to comply with
  subsections (2) and (3) if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the proposal is not submitted to the bank holding
    company at least the prescribed number of days before the
    anniversary date of the notice of meeting that was sent to
    shareholders in respect of the previous annual meeting of
    shareholders;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it clearly appears that the primary purpose of the
    proposal is to enforce a personal claim or redress a personal
    griev­ance against the bank holding company or its directors,
    officers or security holders;

  - [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} it clearly appears that the proposal does not
    relate in a significant way to the business or affairs of the bank
    holding company;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the person submitting the proposal failed within
    the prescribed period before the bank holding company receives their
    proposal to present, in person or by proxy, at a meeting of
    shareholders a proposal that at their request had been set out in or
    attached to a management proxy circular;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} substantially the same proposal was set out in or
    attached to a management proxy circular or dissident's proxy
    circular relating to, and presented to shareholders at, a meeting of
    shareholders held within the prescribed period before the receipt of
    the proposal and did not receive the prescribed minimum amount of
    support at the meeting; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the rights conferred by subsections (1) to (4) are
    being abused to secure publicity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Bank holding company may refuse to
  include proposal

  [(5.1)]{.lawlabel} If a person who submits a proposal fails to
  continue to hold or own shares in accordance with paragraph (1.1)(a)
  or, as the case may be, does not continue to have the support of
  persons who are in the aggregate the registered holders or beneficial
  owners of the prescribed number of shares in accordance with paragraph
  (1.1)(b) until the end of the meeting, the bank holding company is not
  required to set out any proposal submitted by that person in or attach
  it to a management proxy circular for any meeting held within the
  prescribed period after the day of the meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Immunity for proposal and statement

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} No bank holding company or person acting on behalf of
  a bank holding company incurs any liability by reason only of
  circulating a proposal or statement in compliance with subsections (2)
  and (3).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 95
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-732-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 732"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of refusal

- **[[733]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-733 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  bank holding company refuses to include a proposal in a management
  proxy circular, it shall in writing notify the person submitting the
  proposal of its intention to omit the proposal from the management
  proxy circular and of the reasons for the refusal. It shall notify the
  person within the prescribed period after either the day on which it
  receives the proposal or, if it has requested proof under subsection
  732(1.4), the day on which it receives the proof.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application to court

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On the application of a person submitting a proposal
  who claims to be aggrieved by a bank holding company's refusal under
  subsection (1), a court may restrain the holding of the meeting at
  which the proposal is sought to be presented and make any further
  order that it thinks fit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appeal to court

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company or any person claiming to be
  aggrieved by a proposal may apply to a court for an order permitting
  the bank holding company to not attach the proposal to the notice of a
  meeting, and the court, if it is satisfied that subsection 732(5)
  applies, may make such order as it thinks fit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice to Superintendent

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} An applicant under subsection (2) or (3) shall give
  the Superintendent written notice of the application and the
  Superintendent may appear and be heard at the hearing of the
  application in person or by counsel.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 96
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-733-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 733"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}List of shareholders entitled to notice

- **[[734]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-734 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company shall prepare an alphabetical list of
  shareholders entitled to receive notice of a meeting showing the
  number of shares held by each shareholder

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if a record date is fixed under paragraph
    726(5)(c), no later than 10 days after that date; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if no record date is fixed, on the record date
    determined under paragraph 726(6)(a).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Voting list

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The bank holding company shall prepare an
  alphabetical list of shareholders entitled to vote as of the record
  date showing the number of shares held by each shareholder

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if a record date is fixed under paragraph
    726(5)(d), no later than 10 days after that date; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if no record date is fixed under paragraph
    726(5)(d), no later than 10 days after a record date is fixed under
    paragraph 726(5)(c) or no later than the record date determined
    under paragraph 726(6)(a), as the case may be.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Entitlement to vote

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 156.09, a shareholder whose name
  appears on a list prepared under subsection (2) is entitled to vote
  the shares shown opposite their name.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Examination of list

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A shareholder may examine the list of shareholders

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} during usual business hours at the head office of
    the bank holding company or at the place where its central
    securities register is maintained; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} at the meeting of shareholders for which the list
    was prepared.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 97
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-734-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 734"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Quorum

- **[[735]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-735
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Unless the by-laws otherwise
  provide, a quorum of shareholders is present at a meeting of
  shareholders if the holders of a majority of the shares who are
  entitled to vote at the meeting are present in person or represented
  by proxyholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Quorum present at opening

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a quorum is present at the opening of a meeting of
  shareholders, the shareholders present may, unless the by-laws
  otherwise provide, proceed with the business of the meeting,
  notwithstanding that a quorum is not present throughout the meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Quorum not present at opening

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a quorum is not present at the opening of a
  meeting of shareholders, the shareholders present may adjourn the
  meeting to a fixed time and place but may not transact any other
  business.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}One shareholder meeting

**[[736]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-736 .sectionLabel}** If a bank holding
company has only one shareholder, or only one holder of any class or
series of shares, the shareholder present in person or represented by a
proxyholder constitutes a meeting of shareholders or a meeting of
shareholders of that class or series.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}One share --- one vote

**[[737]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-737 .sectionLabel}** Subject to subsection
156.09, if a share of a bank holding company entitles the holder of the
share to vote at a meeting of shareholders, that share entitles the
shareholder to one vote at the meeting.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Representative shareholder

- **[[738]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-738 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If
  an entity is a shareholder of a bank holding company, the bank holding
  company shall recognize any natural person authorized by a resolution
  of the directors or governing body or similar authority of the entity
  to represent it at meetings of shareholders of the bank holding
  company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Powers
