  heirs or personal representatives of any person whom the bank holding
  company may indemnify under those subsections.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 115
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-799-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 799"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Directors' and officers' insurance

**[[800]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-800 .sectionLabel}** A bank holding company
may purchase and maintain insurance for the benefit of any person
referred to in section 799 against any liability incurred by the person

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the capacity of a director or an officer of the
  bank holding company, except where the liability relates to a failure
  to act honestly and in good faith with a view to the best interests of
  the bank holding company; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the capacity of a director or officer of another
  entity or while acting in a similar capacity for another entity, if
  they act or acted in that capacity at the bank holding company's
  request, except if the liability relates to a failure to act honestly
  and in good faith with a view to the best interests of the entity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 116
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-800-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 800"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application to court for indemnification

- **[[801]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-801 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company or a person referred to in section 799 may apply
  to a court for an order approving an indemnity under that section and
  the court may so order and make any further order it thinks fit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice to Superintendent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An applicant under subsection (1) shall give the
  Superintendent written notice of the application and the
  Superintendent is entitled to appear and to be heard at the hearing of
  the application in person or by counsel.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Other notice

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} On an application under subsection (1), the court may
  order notice to be given to any interested person and that person is
  entitled to appear and to be heard in person or by counsel at the
  hearing of the application.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

#### [Fundamental Changes]{.HTitleText3} {#h-21134 .Subheading}

##### [Amendments]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21135 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sections 215 to 222 apply

**[[802]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-802 .sectionLabel}** Sections 215 to 222
apply in respect of bank holding companies, subject to the following:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} references to "bank" in those sections are to be read
  as references to "bank holding company";

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} references to "this Act" in those sections are to be
  read as references to "this Part";

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the reference to "subsection 159(1) and section 168"
  in paragraph 217(1)(i) is to be read as a reference to "subsection
  749(1) and section 756"; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the reference to "sections 143 and 144" in subsection
  221(1) is to be read as a reference to "sections 732 and 733".

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

##### [Amalgamation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21144 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application to amalgamate

- **[[803]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-803 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  the joint application of two or more bodies corporate incorporated by
  or under an Act of Parliament, including banks and bank holding
  companies but not including federal credit unions, the Minister may
  issue letters patent amalgamating and continuing the applicants as one
  bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), if one of the applicants is a
  bank holding company that controls a bank named in Schedule I as that
  Schedule read immediately before the day section 184 of the [Financial
  Consumer Agency of Canada Act](/eng/acts/F-11.1) comes into force,
  other than a bank in respect of which the Minister has specified that
  subsection 378(1) no longer applies, the Minister shall not issue
  letters patent referred to in subsection (1) unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amalgamated bank holding company would be a
    widely held bank holding company; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amalgamated bank holding company would be
    controlled by a widely held bank holding company that, at the time
    the application was made, controlled

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the applicant, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any other applicant that is a bank holding
      company that controls a bank named in Schedule I as that Schedule
      read immediately before the day section 184 of the [Financial
      Consumer Agency of Canada Act](/eng/acts/F-11.1) comes into force,
      other than a bank in respect of which the Minister has specified
      that subsection 378(1) no longer applies.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), if the amalgamated bank
  holding company would be a bank holding company with equity of twelve
  billion dollars or more, the Minister shall not issue letters patent
  referred to in that subsection unless the amalgamated bank holding
  company is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} widely held;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} controlled, within the meaning of paragraphs
    3(1)(a) and (d), by a widely held bank, or by a widely held bank
    holding company, that controlled one of the applicants at the time
    the application was made; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} controlled, within the meaning of paragraph
    3(1)(d), by a widely held insurance holding company, or by an
    eligible Canadian financial institution, within the meaning of
    subsection 370(1), other than a bank, or by an eligible foreign
    institution, within the meaning of subsection 370(1), that
    controlled one of the applicants at the time the application was
    made.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2010, c. 12, s. 2084
- 2012, c. 5, s. 80
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-803-20120524.html "Link to previous version of section 803"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amalgamation agreement

- **[[804]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-804 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Each
  applicant proposing to amalgamate shall enter into an amalgamation
  agreement.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of agreement

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every amalgamation agreement shall set out the terms
  and means of effecting the amalgamation and, in particular,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the amalgamated bank holding company
    and the province in which its head office is to be situated;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name and place of ordinary residence of each
    proposed director of the amalgamated bank holding company;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the manner in which the shares of each applicant
    are to be converted into shares or other securities of the
    amalgamated bank holding company;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} if any shares of an applicant are not to be
    converted into shares or other securities of the amalgamated bank
    holding company, the amount of money or securities that the holders
    of those shares are to receive in addition to or in lieu of shares
    or other securities of the amalgamated bank holding company;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the manner of payment of money in lieu of the issue
    of fractional shares of the amalgamated bank holding company or of
    any other body corporate that are to be issued in the amalgamation;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the proposed by-laws of the amalgamated bank
    holding company;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} details of any other matter necessary to perfect
    the amalgamation and to provide for the subsequent management and
    operation of the amalgamated bank holding company; and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the proposed effective date of the amalgamation.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Cross ownership of shares

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If shares of one of the applicants are held by or on
  behalf of another of the applicants, other than shares held in the
  capacity of a personal representative or by way of security, the
  amalgamation agreement must provide for the cancellation of those
  shares when the amalgamation becomes effective without any repayment
  of capital in respect thereof, and no provision shall be made in the
  agreement for the conversion of those shares into shares of the
  amalgamated bank holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 117
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-804-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 804"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Approval of agreement by Superintendent

**[[805]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-805 .sectionLabel}** An amalgamation
agreement must be submitted to the Superintendent for approval and any
approval of the agreement under subsection 806(4) by the holders of any
class or series of shares of an applicant is invalid unless, before the
date of the approval, the Superintendent has approved the agreement in
writing.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 115
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-805-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 805"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shareholder approval

- **[[806]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-806 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  directors of each applicant shall submit an amalgamation agreement for
  approval to a meeting of the holders of shares of the applicant body
  corporate of which they are directors and, subject to subsection (3),
  to the holders of each class or series of such shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Right to vote

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Each share of an applicant carries the right to vote
  in respect of an amalgamation agreement whether or not it otherwise
  carries the right to vote.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Separate vote for class or series

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The holders of shares of a class or series of shares
  of each applicant are entitled to vote separately as a class or series
  in respect of an amalgamation agreement if the agreement contains a
  provision that, if it were contained in a proposed amendment to the
  by-laws or incorporating instrument of the applicant, would entitle
  those holders to vote separately as a class or series.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Special resolution

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), an amalgamation agreement
  is approved when the shareholders of each applicant that is a body
  corporate have approved the amalgamation by special resolution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Termination

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} An amalgamation agreement may provide that, at any
  time before the issue of letters patent of amalgamation, the agreement
  may be terminated by the directors of an applicant notwithstanding
  that the agreement has been approved by the shareholders of all or any
  of the applicant bodies corporate.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 118
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-806-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 806"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Vertical short-form amalgamation

- **[[807]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-807 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company may, without complying with sections 804 to 806,
  amalgamate with one or more bodies corporate that are incorporated by
  or under an Act of Parliament if the body or bodies corporate, as the
  case may be, are wholly-owned subsidiaries of the bank holding company
  and

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amalgamation is approved by a resolution of the
    directors of the bank holding company and of each amalgamating
    subsidiary; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the resolutions provide that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the shares of each amalgamating subsidiary will
      be cancelled without any repayment of capital in respect thereof,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the letters patent of amalgamation and the
      by-laws of the amalgamated bank holding company will be the same
      as the incorporating instrument and the by-laws of the
      amalgamating bank holding company that is the holding body
      corporate, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} no securities will be issued by the amalgamated
      bank holding company in connection with the amalgamation.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Horizontal short-form amalgamation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Two or more bodies corporate incorporated by or under
  an Act of Parliament may amalgamate and continue as one bank holding
  company without complying with sections 804 to 806 if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} at least one of the applicants is a bank holding
    company;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the applicants are all wholly-owned subsidiaries of
    the same holding body corporate;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the amalgamation is approved by a resolution of the
    directors of each of the applicants; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the resolutions provide that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the shares of all applicants, except those of one
      of the applicants that is a bank holding company, will be
      cancelled without any repayment of capital in respect thereof,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the letters patent of amalgamation and the
      by-laws of the amalgamated bank holding company will be the same
      as the incorporating instrument and the by-laws of the
      amalgamating bank holding company whose shares are not cancelled,
      and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the stated capital of the amalgamating bank
      holding companies and bodies corporate whose shares are cancelled
      will be added to the stated capital of the amalgamating bank
      holding company whose shares are not cancelled.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Joint application to Minister

- **[[808]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-808
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), unless an
  amalgamation agreement is terminated in accordance with subsection
  806(5), the applicants shall, within three months after the approval
  of the agreement in accordance with subsection 806(4) or the approval
  of the directors in accordance with subsection 807(1) or (2), jointly
  apply to the Minister for letters patent of amalgamation continuing
  the applicants as one bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions precedent to application

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No application for the issue of letters patent under
  subsection (1) may be made unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} notice of intention to make such an application has
    been published at least once a week for a period of four consecutive
    weeks in the [Canada Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) and in a
    newspaper in general circulation at or near the place where the head
    office of each applicant is situated; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the application is supported by satisfactory
    evidence that the applicants have complied with the requirements of
    this Part relating to amalgamations.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application of sections 672 to 674

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If two or more bodies corporate, none of which is a
  bank holding company, apply for letters patent under subsection (1),
  sections 672 to 674 apply in respect of the application with any
  modifications that the circumstances require.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Matters for consideration

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Before issuing letters patent of amalgamation
  continuing the applicants as one bank holding company, the Minister
  shall take into account all matters that the Minister considers
  relevant to the application, including

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the sources of continuing financial support for any
    bank that will be a subsidiary of the amalgamated bank holding
    company;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the soundness and feasibility of the plans of the
    applicants for the future conduct and development of the business of
    any bank that will be a subsidiary of the amalgamated bank holding
    company;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the business record and experience of the
    applicants;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the reputation of the applicants for being operated
    in a manner that is consistent with the standards of good character
    and integrity;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} whether the amalgamated bank holding company will
    be operated responsibly by persons with the competence and
    experience suitable for involvement in the operation of a financial
    institution;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the impact of any integration of the operations and
    businesses of the applicants on the conduct of those operations and
    businesses;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the opinion of the Superintendent regarding the
    extent to which the proposed corporate structure of the amalgamated
    bank holding company and its affiliates may affect the supervision
    and regulation of any bank that will be its subsidiary, having
    regard to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the nature and extent of the proposed financial
      services activities to be carried out by the affiliates of the
      amalgamated bank holding company, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the nature and degree of supervision and
      regulation applying to the proposed financial services activities
      to be carried out by the affiliates of the amalgamated bank
      holding company; and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the best interests of the financial system in
    Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Issue of letters patent

- **[[809]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-809
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where an application has been made
  to the Minister in accordance with section 808, the Minister may issue
  letters patent of amalgamation continuing the applicants as one bank
  holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Letters patent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where letters patent are issued pursuant to this
  section, section 676 applies with such modifications as the
  circumstances require in respect of the issue of the letters patent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publication of notice

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent shall cause to be published in the
  [Canada Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) notice of the issuance of
  letters patent pursuant to subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Court enforcement

- **[[810]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-810 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  bank holding company or any director, officer, employee or agent of a
  bank holding company is contravening or has failed to comply with any
  term or condition made in respect of the issuance of letters patent of
  amalgamation, the Minister may, in addition to any other action that
  may be taken under this Act, apply to a court for an order directing
  the bank holding company or the director, officer, employee or agent
  to comply with the term or condition, cease the contravention or do
  any thing that is required to be done, and on the application the
  court may so order and make any other order it thinks fit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appeal

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An appeal from an order of a court under this section
  lies in the same manner as, and to the same court to which, an appeal
  may be taken from any other order of the court.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of letters patent

- **[[811]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-811 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  the day provided for in the letters patent issued under section 809,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amalgamation of the applicants and their
    continuance as one bank holding company becomes effective;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the property of each applicant continues to be the
    property of the amalgamated bank holding company;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the amalgamated bank holding company continues to
    be liable for the obligations of each applicant;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} any existing cause of action, claim or liability to
    prosecution is unaffected;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any civil, criminal or administrative action or
    proceeding pending by or against an applicant may be continued to be
    prosecuted by or against the amalgamated bank holding company;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} any conviction against, or ruling, order or
    judgment in favour of or against, an applicant may be enforced by or
    against the amalgamated bank holding company;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} if any director or officer of an applicant
    continues as a director or officer of the amalgamated bank holding
    company, any disclosure by that director or officer of a material
    interest in any contract made to the applicant shall be deemed to be
    disclosure to the amalgamated bank holding company; and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the letters patent of amalgamation are the
    incorporating instrument of the amalgamated bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Minutes

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Any deemed disclosure under paragraph (1)(g) shall be
  recorded in the minutes of the first meeting of directors of the
  amalgamated bank holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transitional

- **[[812]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-812
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite any other provision of this
  Act or the regulations, the Minister may, by order, on the
  recommendation of the Superintendent, grant to a bank holding company
  in respect of which letters patent were issued under subsection 809(1)
  permission to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} engage in a business activity specified in the
    order that a bank holding company is not otherwise permitted by this
    Act to engage in and that one or more of the amalgamating bodies
    corporate was engaging in at the time application for the letters
    patent was made;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} continue to have issued and outstanding debt
    obligations the issue of which is not authorized by this Act if the
    debt obligations were outstanding at the time the application for
    the letters patent was made;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} hold assets that a bank holding company is not
    otherwise permitted by this Act to hold if the assets were held by
    one or more of the amalgamating bodies corporate at the time the
    application for the letters patent was made;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} acquire and hold assets that a bank holding company
    is not otherwise permitted by this Act to acquire or hold if one or
    more of the amalgamating bodies corporate were obliged, at the time
    the application for the letters patent was made, to acquire those
    assets; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} maintain outside Canada any records or registers
    required by this Act to be maintained in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duration of exceptions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The permission granted under subsection (1) shall be
  expressed to be granted for a period specified in the order not
  exceeding

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} with respect to any matter described in paragraph
    (1)(a), thirty days after the date of issue of the letters patent
    or, where the activity is conducted pursuant to an agreement
    existing on the date of issue of the letters patent, the expiration
    of the agreement;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to any matter described in paragraph
    (1)(b), ten years; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} with respect to any matter described in any of
    paragraphs (1)(c) to (e), two years.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Renewal

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (4), the Minister may, by order
  on the recommendation of the Superintendent, renew a permission
  granted by order under subsection (1) with respect to any matter
  described in any of paragraphs (1)(b) to (d) for any further period or
  periods that the Minister considers necessary.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limitation

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall not grant to a bank holding
  company any permission

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} with respect to matters described in paragraph
    (1)(b), that purports to be effective more than ten years after the
    effective date of the letters patent of amalgamation, unless the
    Minister is satisfied on the basis of evidence on oath provided by
    an officer of the bank holding company that the bank holding company
    will not be able at law to redeem at the end of the ten years the
    outstanding debt obligations to which the permission relates; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to matters described in paragraphs
    (1)(c) and (d), that purports to be effective more than ten years
    after the effective date of the letters patent.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 116
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-812-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 812"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Transfer of Business]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21289 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shareholder approval

- **[[813]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-813 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  sale, lease or exchange of all or substantially all the property of a
  bank holding company requires the approval of the shareholders in
  accordance with subsections (2) to (7).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of meeting

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A notice of a meeting of shareholders complying with
  sections 727 and 730 shall be sent in accordance with those sections
  to each shareholder and shall include or be accompanied by a copy or
  summary of the agreement of sale, lease or exchange.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shareholder approval

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} At the meeting referred to in the notice, the
  shareholders may authorize the sale, lease or exchange and may fix or
  authorize the directors to fix any of the sale's, lease's or
  exchange's terms and conditions.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Right to vote

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Each share of the bank holding company carries the
  right to vote in respect of the proposal whether or not the share
  otherwise carries the right to vote.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Class vote

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The holders of shares of a class or series of shares
  of the bank holding company are entitled to vote separately as a class
  or series in respect of the proposal if the shares of the class or
  series are affected by the proposed transaction in a manner different
  from the shares of another class or series.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Special resolution

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (1), the proposal is
  not approved unless the holders of the shares of each class or series
  of shares entitled to vote separately on the proposal have approved
  the proposal by special resolution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Abandoning transaction

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} Where a special resolution under subsection (6)
  approving a proposed transaction so states, the directors of a bank
  holding company may, subject to the rights of third parties, abandon
  the transaction without further approval of the shareholders.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

#### [Corporate Records]{.HTitleText3} {#h-21307 .Subheading}

##### [Head Office and Corporate Records]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21308 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Head office

- **[[814]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-814 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company shall at all times have a head office in the
  province specified in its incorporating instrument or by-laws.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Change of head office

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The directors of a bank holding company may change
  the address of the head office within the province specified in the
  incorporating instrument or by-laws.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of change of address

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company shall send to the
  Superintendent, within fifteen days after any change of address of its
  head office, a notice of the change of address.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 119
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-814-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 814"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Bank holding company records

- **[[815]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-815 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company shall prepare and maintain records containing

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} its incorporating instrument and by-laws and all
    amendments to them;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} minutes of meetings and resolutions of
    shareholders;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in paragraphs 951(1)(a)
    and (c) to (g) contained in all returns provided to the
    Superintendent pursuant to section 951; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} particulars of exceptions granted under section 688
    or 812 that are from time to time applicable to the bank holding
    company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional records

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In addition to the records described in subsection
  (1), a bank holding company shall prepare and maintain adequate

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} corporate accounting records; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} records containing minutes of meetings and
    resolutions of the board of directors and those of its committees.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Continued bank holding companies

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraph (1)(b) and subsection
  (2),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a body corporate continued as a bank
    holding company, [[records]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes similar
    records required by law to be maintained by the body corporate
    before it was so continued; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a body corporate amalgamated and
    continued as a bank holding company, [[records]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}
    includes similar records required by law to be maintained by the
    body corporate before it was so amalgamated.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Place of records

- **[[816]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-816 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  records described in section 815 shall be kept at the head office of
  the bank holding company or at such other place in Canada as the
  directors think fit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection 822(1.1), subsection (1) does
  not apply to a bank holding company that is a subsidiary of a foreign
  bank incorporated or formed otherwise in a country or territory other
  than Canada in which a trade agreement listed in Schedule IV is
  applicable or of a regulated foreign entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of place of records

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where any of the records described in section 815 are
  not kept at the head office of a bank holding company, the bank
  holding company shall notify the Superintendent of the place where the
  records are kept.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Inspection

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The records described in section 815 shall at all
  reasonable times be open to inspection by the directors.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Access to bank holding company records

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Shareholders and creditors of a bank holding company
  and their personal representatives may examine the records referred to
  in subsection 815(1) during the usual business hours of the bank
  holding company and may take extracts from them free of charge or have
  copies of them made on payment of a reasonable fee. If the bank
  holding company is a distributing bank holding company, any other
  person may on payment of a reasonable fee examine those records during
  the usual business hours of the bank holding company and take extracts
  from them or have copies of them made.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Copies of by-laws

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Every shareholder of a bank holding company is
  entitled, on request made not more frequently than once in each
  calendar year, to receive, free of charge, one copy of the by-laws of
  the bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Electronic access

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company may make the information
  contained in records referred to in subsection 815(1) available to
  persons by any system of mechanical or electronic data processing or
  any other information storage device that is capable of reproducing
  the records in intelligible written form within a reasonable time.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 120
- [2020, c. 1, s. 166](#1238229-1311905){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1238229-1311905.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-816-20061128.html "Link to previous version of section 816"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shareholder lists

- **[[817]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-817 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  person who is entitled to a basic list of shareholders of a bank
  holding company (in this section referred to as the "applicant") may
  request the bank holding company to furnish the applicant with a basic
  list within ten days after receipt by the bank holding company of the
  affidavit referred to in subsection (2) and, on payment of a
  reasonable fee by the applicant, the bank holding company shall comply
  with the request.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Affidavit and contents

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A request under subsection (1) must be accompanied by
  an affidavit containing

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the applicant,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name and address for service of the entity, if
    the applicant is an entity, and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an undertaking that the basic list and any
    supplemental lists obtained pursuant to subsections (5) and (6) will
    not be used except as permitted under section 819,

  and, if the applicant is an entity, the affidavit shall be made by a
  director or an officer of the entity, or any person acting in a
  similar capacity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Entitlement to list

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A shareholder or creditor of a bank holding company
  or their personal representative --- or if the bank holding company is
  a distributing bank holding company, any person --- is entitled to a
  basic list of shareholders of the bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Basic list

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A basic list of shareholders of a bank holding
  company consists of a list of shareholders that is made up to a date
  not more than ten days before the receipt of the affidavit referred to
  in subsection (2) and that sets out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the names of the shareholders of the bank holding
    company;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the number of shares owned by each shareholder; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the address of each shareholder as shown in the
    records of the bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Supplemental lists

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A person requiring a bank holding company to supply a
  basic list of shareholders may, if the person states in the
  accompanying affidavit that supplemental lists are required, request
  the bank holding company or its agent, on payment of a reasonable fee,
  to provide supplemental lists of shareholders setting out any changes
  from the basic list in the names and addresses of the shareholders and
  the number of shares owned by each shareholder for each business day
  following the date to which the basic list is made up.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}When supplemental lists to be furnished

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company or its agent shall provide a
  supplemental list of shareholders required under subsection (5)

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} within ten days following the date the basic list
    is provided, where the information relates to changes that took
    place prior to that date; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} within ten days following the day to which the
    supplemental list relates, where the information relates to changes
    that took place on or after the date the basic list was provided.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 121
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-817-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 817"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Option holders

**[[818]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-818 .sectionLabel}** A person requiring a
bank holding company to supply a basic list or a supplemental list of
shareholders may also require the bank holding company to include in
that list the name and address of any known holder of an option or right
to acquire shares of the bank holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Use of shareholder list

**[[819]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-819 .sectionLabel}** A list of shareholders
obtained under section 817 shall not be used by any person except in
connection with

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} an effort to influence the voting of shareholders of
  the bank holding company;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} an offer to acquire shares of the bank holding
  company; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} any other matter relating to the affairs of the bank
  holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Form of records

- **[[820]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-820 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  register or other record required or authorized by this Part to be
  prepared and maintained by a bank holding company

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} may be in a bound or loose-leaf form or in a
    photographic film form; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} may be entered or recorded by any system of
    mechanical or electronic data processing or any other information
    storage device that is capable of reproducing any required
    information in intelligible written form within a reasonable time.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conversion of records

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Registers and records maintained in one form may be
  converted to any other form.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Destruction of converted records

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding section 823, a bank holding company
  may destroy any register or other record referred to in subsection (1)
  at any time after the register or other record has been converted to
  another form.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Protection of records

**[[821]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-821 .sectionLabel}** A bank holding company
and its agents shall take reasonable precautions to

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} prevent loss or destruction of,

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} prevent falsification of entries in,

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} facilitate detection and correction of inaccuracies
  in, and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} ensure that unauthorized persons do not have access
  to or use of information in

the registers and records required or authorized by this Part to be
prepared and maintained.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Requirement to maintain copies and
process information in Canada

- **[[822]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-822 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If
  the Superintendent is of the opinion that it is incompatible with the
  fulfilment of the Superintendent's responsibilities under this Act for
  a bank holding company to maintain, in another country, copies of
  records referred to in section 815 or of its central securities
  register or for a bank holding company to process, in another country,
  information or data relating to the preparation and maintenance of
  those records or of its central securities register --- or if the
  Superintendent is advised by the Minister that, in the opinion of the
  Minister, it is not in the national interest for a bank holding
  company to do any of those activities in another country --- the
  Superintendent shall direct the bank holding company to not maintain
  those copies, or to not process the information or data, as the case
  may be, in that other country or to maintain those copies or to
  process the information or data only in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Direction --- immediate, direct,
  complete and ongoing access

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} Where a bank holding company referred to in
  subsection 816(1.1) or 828(3) maintains records referred to in section
  815 or the central securities register at a place outside Canada, the
  Superintendent may, in the case referred to in paragraph (a), and
  shall, in the case referred to in paragraph (b), by order, direct the
  bank holding company to maintain a copy of those records or register
  at any place in Canada as the directors think fit

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the Superintendent is of the opinion that he or
    she does not have immediate, direct, complete and ongoing access to
    those records or register; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the Superintendent is advised by the Minister
    that the Minister is of the opinion that it is not in the national
    interest for the bank holding company not to maintain a copy of
    those records or register at any place in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Bank holding company to comply

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company shall without delay comply
  with any order issued under subsection (1) or (1.1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 122
- 2007, c. 6, s. 117
- [2020, c. 1, s. 167](#1238231-1311910){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1238231-1311910.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-822-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 822"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Retention of records

**[[823]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-823 .sectionLabel}** A bank holding company
shall retain

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the records of the bank holding company referred to
  in subsection 815(1);

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} any record of the bank holding company referred to in
  paragraph 815(2)(a) or (b); and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the central securities register referred to in
  subsection 825(1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

**[[824]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-824 .sectionLabel}** The Governor in Council
may make regulations respecting the records, papers and documents to be
retained by a bank holding company, including the length of time those
records, papers and documents are to be retained, and what constitutes
immediate, direct, complete and ongoing access, for the purpose of
paragraph 822(1.1)(a).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- [2020, c. 1, s. 168](#1238235-1311915){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1238235-1311915.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-824-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 824"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Securities Registers]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21423 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Central securities register

- **[[825]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-825 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company shall maintain a central securities register in
  which it shall record the securities, within the meaning of section
  81, issued by it in registered form, showing in respect of each class
  or series of securities

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the names, alphabetically arranged, and latest
    known addresses of the persons who are security holders, and the
    names and latest known addresses of the persons who have been
    security holders;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the number of securities held by each security
    holder; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the date and particulars of the issue and transfer
    of each security.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Existing and continued bank holding
  companies

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), "central
  securities register" includes similar registers required by law to be
  maintained by a body corporate continued, or amalgamated and
  continued, as a bank holding company under this Part before the
  continuance, or amalgamation, as the case may be.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Access to central securities register

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Shareholders and creditors of a bank holding company
  and their personal representatives may examine the central securities
  register during the usual business hours of the bank holding company
  and may take extracts from it free of charge or have copies of it made
  on payment of a reasonable fee. If the bank holding company is a
  distributing bank holding company, any other person may on payment of
  a reasonable fee examine the central securities register during the
  usual business hours of the bank holding company and take extracts
  from it or have copies of it made.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Electronic access

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The bank holding company may make the information
  contained in the central securities register available by any
  mechanical or electronic data processing system or other information
  storage device that is capable of reproducing it in intelligible
  written form within a reasonable time.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Affidavit and undertaking

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A person who wishes to examine the central securities
  register, take extracts from it or have copies of it made shall
  provide the bank holding company with an affidavit containing their
  name and address --- or if they are an entity, the name and address
  for service of the entity --- and with an undertaking that the
  information contained in the register will not be used except in the
  same way as a list of shareholders may be used under section 819. In
  the case of an entity, the affidavit is to be sworn by a director or
  officer of the entity or a person acting in a similar capacity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Supplemental information

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} A person who wishes to examine a central securities
  register, take extracts from it or have copies of it made may on
  payment of a reasonable fee, if they state in the accompanying
  affidavit that supplementary information is required, request the bank
  holding company or its agent to provide supplementary information
  setting out any changes made to the register.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}When supplementary information to be
  provided

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company or its agent shall provide the
  supplementary information within

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 10 days after the day on which the central
    securities register is examined if the changes take place before
    that day; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 10 days after the day to which the supplementary
    information relates if the changes take place on or after the day on
    which the central securities register is examined.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 123
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-825-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 825"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Branch registers

**[[826]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-826 .sectionLabel}** A bank holding company
may establish as many branch securities registers as it considers
necessary.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agents

**[[827]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-827 .sectionLabel}** A bank holding company
may appoint an agent to maintain its central securities register and
each of its branch securities registers.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Location of central securities register

- **[[828]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-828 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  central securities register of a bank holding company shall be
  maintained by the bank holding company at its head office or at any
  other place in Canada designated by the directors of the bank holding
  company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Location of branch securities register

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A branch securities register of a bank holding
  company may be kept at any place in or outside Canada designated by
  the directors of the bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection 822(1.1), subsection (1) does
  not apply to a bank holding company that is a subsidiary of a foreign
  bank incorporated or formed otherwise in a country or territory other
  than Canada in which a trade agreement listed in Schedule IV is
  applicable or of a regulated foreign entity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- [2020, c. 1, s. 169](#1238239-1311918){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1238239-1311918.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-828-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 828"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of registration

**[[829]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-829 .sectionLabel}** Registration of the
issue or transfer of a security in the central securities register or in
a branch securities register is complete and valid registration for all
purposes.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Particulars in branch register

- **[[830]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-830 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  branch securities register shall only contain particulars of the
  securities issued or transferred at the branch for which that register
  is established.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Particulars in central register

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Particulars of each issue or transfer of a security
  registered in a branch securities register of a bank holding company
  shall also be kept in the central securities register of the bank
  holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Destruction of certificates

**[[831]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-831 .sectionLabel}** A bank holding company,
its agent or a trustee within the meaning of section 294 is not required
to produce

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a cancelled security certificate in registered form
  or an instrument referred to in subsection 713(1) that is cancelled or
  a like cancelled instrument in registered form after six years from
  the date of its cancellation;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a cancelled security certificate in bearer form or an
  instrument referred to in subsection 713(1) that is cancelled or a
  like cancelled instrument in bearer form after the date of its
  cancellation; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} an instrument referred to in subsection 713(1) or a
  like instrument, irrespective of its form, after the date of its
  expiration.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

##### [Corporate Name and Seal]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21479 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publication of name

**[[832]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-832 .sectionLabel}** A bank holding company
shall set out its name in legible characters in all contracts, invoices,
negotiable instruments and other documents evidencing rights or
obligations with respect to other parties that are issued or made by or
on behalf of the bank holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Corporate seal

- **[[833]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-833 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company may adopt a corporate seal and change one that it
  adopted.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Validity of unsealed documents

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A document executed on behalf of a bank holding
  company is not invalid merely because a corporate seal is not affixed
  to it.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 124
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-833-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 833"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Insiders]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21491 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Ss. 265 to 272 apply

**[[834]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-834 .sectionLabel}** Sections 265 to 272
apply in respect of bank holding companies except that references to
"bank" are to be read as references to "bank holding company".

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 124
:::

Version](section-834-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 834"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Prospectus]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21496 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Ss. 273 and 274 apply

**[[835]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-835 .sectionLabel}** Sections 273 and 274
apply in respect of bank holding companies except that references to
"bank" are to be read as references to "bank holding company".

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 124
:::

Version](section-835-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 835"){.PITLink}

##### [Going-private Transactions and Squeeze-out Transactions]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21501 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Ss. 275 to 277 apply

**[[835.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-835.1 .sectionLabel}** Sections 275 to 277
apply in respect of bank holding companies subject to the following:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} references to "bank" are to be read as references to
  "bank holding company";

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the reference to "this Act" in section 276 is to be
  read as a reference to "this Part"; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the reference to "a regulation referred to in
  subsection 485(1) or (2) or of an order made under subsection 485(3)"
  in subsection 277(25) is to be read as a reference to "a regulation
  referred to in subsection 949(1) or (2) or of an order made under
  subsection 949(3)".

::: HistoricalNote
- 2005, c. 54, s. 124
:::

##### [Compulsory Acquisitions]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21509 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Ss. 283 to 292.1 apply

**[[836]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-836 .sectionLabel}** Sections 283 to 292.1
apply in respect of bank holding companies, subject to the following:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} references to "bank" in those sections are to be read
  as references to "bank holding company";

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} references to "another deposit-taking financial
  institution" in subsection 287(3) are to be read as references to "a
  deposit-taking financial institution"; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the reference to "the Minister" in subsection 291(4)
  is to be read as a reference to "the Receiver General".

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 125
:::
