:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Recovery

**[[837]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-837 .sectionLabel}** If at any time a person
establishes an entitlement to any moneys paid to the Receiver General
under subsection 291(4), the Receiver General shall pay an equivalent
amount to that person out of the Consolidated Revenue Fund.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

##### [Trust Indentures]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21521 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sections 294 to 306 apply

**[[838]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-838 .sectionLabel}** Sections 294 to 306
apply in respect to bank holding companies, subject to the following:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} references to "bank" in those sections are to be read
  as references to "bank holding company";

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} references to "this Act" in those sections are to be
  read as references to "this Part"; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} references to "subordinated indebtedness" in those
  sections are to be read as references to "subordinated indebtedness"
  as defined in subsection 663(1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

#### [Financial Statements and Auditor]{.HTitleText3} {#h-21529 .Subheading}

##### [Annual Financial Statement]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21530 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Financial year of bank holding company

- **[[839]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-839 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  financial year of a bank holding company ends, at the election of the
  bank holding company in its by-laws, on the expiration of the
  thirty-first day of October of each year or the thirty-first day of
  December of each year.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}First financial year

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If, in any year, a bank holding company comes into
  existence after the first day of July, its first financial year ends,
  at its election in its by-laws, on the expiration of the thirty-first
  day of October or the thirty-first day of December in the next
  calendar year.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Annual financial statement

- **[[840]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-840 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  directors of a bank holding company shall place before the
  shareholders at every annual meeting

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a comparative annual financial statement (in this
    Part referred to as an "annual statement") relating separately to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the financial year immediately preceding the
      meeting, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the financial year, if any, immediately
      preceding the financial year referred to in subparagraph (i);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the report of the auditor of the bank holding
    company; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any further information respecting the financial
    position of the bank holding company and the results of its
    operations required by the by-laws of the bank holding company to be
    placed before the shareholders at the annual meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Annual statement --- contents

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} With respect to each of the financial years to which
  it relates, the annual statement of a bank holding company must
  contain the prescribed statements and any information that is in the
  opinion of the directors necessary to present fairly, in accordance
  with the accounting principles referred to in subsection (4), the
  financial position of the bank holding company as at the end of the
  financial year to which it relates and the results of the operations
  and changes in the financial position of the bank holding company for
  that financial year.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional information

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company shall include with its annual
  statement

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a list of the subsidiaries of the bank holding
    company, other than subsidiaries that are not required to be listed
    by the regulations and subsidiaries acquired pursuant to section 934
    or pursuant to a realization of security in accordance with section
    935 and which the bank holding company would not otherwise be
    permitted to hold, showing, with respect to each subsidiary,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its name and the address of its head or principal
      office,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the book value of the aggregate of any shares of
      the subsidiary beneficially owned by the bank holding company and
      by other subsidiaries of the bank holding company, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the percentage of the voting rights attached to
      all the outstanding voting shares of the subsidiary that is
      carried by the aggregate of any voting shares of the subsidiary
      beneficially owned by the bank holding company and by other
      subsidiaries of the bank holding company; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} such other information as the Governor in Council
    may, by order, require in such form as may be prescribed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Accounting principles

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The financial statements referred to in subsection
  (1), paragraph (3)(b) and subsection 842(1) shall, except as otherwise
  specified by the Superintendent, be prepared in accordance with
  generally accepted accounting principles, the primary source of which
  is the Handbook of the Chartered Professional Accountants of Canada. A
  reference in any provision of this Act to the accounting principles
  referred to in this subsection shall be construed as a reference to
  those generally accepted accounting principles with any specifications
  so made.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  respecting subsidiaries that are not required to be listed for the
  purposes of paragraph (3)(a).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 126
- 2017, c. 26, s. 62
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-840-20110601.html "Link to previous version of section 840"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Annual statement --- approval

- **[[841]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-841 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  directors of a bank holding company shall approve the annual statement
  and their approval shall be evidenced by the signature or a printed or
  otherwise mechanically reproduced facsimile of the signature of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the chief executive officer or, in the event of
    that officer's absence or inability to act, any other officer of the
    bank holding company authorized by the directors to sign in the
    stead of the chief executive officer; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} one director, if the signature required by
    paragraph (a) is that of a director, or two directors if the
    signature required by that paragraph is that of an officer who is
    not a director.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Condition precedent to publication

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company shall not publish copies of an
  annual statement unless it is approved and signed in accordance with
  subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 127
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-841-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 841"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statements --- subsidiaries

- **[[842]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-842 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company shall keep at its head office a copy of the
  current financial statements of each subsidiary of the bank holding
  company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Examination

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to this section, the shareholders of a bank
  holding company and their personal representatives may, on request
  therefor, examine the statements referred to in subsection (1) during
  the usual business hours of the bank holding company and may take
  extracts therefrom free of charge.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Barring examination

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company may refuse to permit an
  examination under subsection (2) by any person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application for order

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Within fifteen days after a refusal under subsection
  (3), the bank holding company shall apply to a court for an order
  barring the right of the person concerned to make an examination under
  subsection (2) and the court shall either order the bank holding
  company to permit the examination or, if it is satisfied that the
  examination would be detrimental to the bank holding company or to any
  other body corporate the financial statements of which would be
  subject to examination, bar the right and make any further order it
  thinks fit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice to Superintendent

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company shall give the Superintendent
  and the person seeking to examine the statements referred to in
  subsection (1) notice of an application to a court under subsection
  (4), and the Superintendent and the person may appear and be heard in
  person or by counsel at the hearing of the application.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Annual statement --- distribution

- **[[843]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-843 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company shall, no later than 21 days before the date of
  each annual meeting or before the signing of a resolution under
  paragraph 741(1)(b) in lieu of the annual meeting, send to each
  shareholder a copy of the documents referred to in subsections 840(1)
  and (3) unless that time period is waived by the shareholder.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company is not required to comply with
  subsection (1) with respect to a shareholder who has informed the bank
  holding company, in writing, that the shareholder does not wish to
  receive the annual statement.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of default

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where a bank holding company is required to comply
  with subsection (1) and the bank holding company does not comply with
  that subsection, the annual meeting at which the documents referred to
  in that subsection are to be considered shall be adjourned until that
  subsection has been complied with.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 128
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-843-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 843"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Copy to Superintendent

- **[[844]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-844
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), a bank
  holding company shall send to the Superintendent a copy of the
  documents referred to in subsections 840(1) and (3) not later than
  twenty-one days before the date of each annual meeting of shareholders
  of the bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Later filing

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a bank holding company's shareholders sign a
  resolution under paragraph 741(1)(b) in lieu of an annual meeting, the
  bank holding company shall send a copy of the documents referred to in
  subsections 840(1) and (3) to the Superintendent not later than thirty
  days after the signing of the resolution.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

##### [Auditors]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21599 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[845]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-845 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this section and sections 846 to 864.

[[firm of accountants]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[firm of accountants]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a partnership, the
    members of which are accountants engaged in the practice of
    accounting, or a body corporate that is incorporated by or under an
    Act of the legislature of a province and engaged in the practice of
    accounting. ([cabinet de comptables]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[member]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[member]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a firm of
    accountants, means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an accountant who is a partner in a partnership,
      the members of which are accountants engaged in the practice of
      accounting; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an accountant who is an employee of a firm of
      accountants. ([membre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appointment of auditor

- **[[846]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-846 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  shareholders of a bank holding company shall, by ordinary resolution
  at the first meeting of shareholders and at each succeeding annual
  meeting, appoint a firm of accountants to be the auditor of the bank
  holding company until the close of the next annual meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Remuneration of auditor

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The remuneration of the auditor may be fixed by
  ordinary resolution of the shareholders but, if not so fixed, shall be
  fixed by the directors.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Qualification of auditor

- **[[847]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-847 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  firm of accountants is qualified to be an auditor of a bank holding
  company if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} two or more members thereof are accountants who

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} are members in good standing of an institute or
      association of accountants incorporated by or under an Act of the
      legislature of a province,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} each have at least five years experience at a
      senior level in performing audits of a financial institution,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} are ordinarily resident in Canada, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} are independent of the bank holding company; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the member of the firm jointly designated by the
    firm and the bank holding company to conduct the audit of the bank
    holding company on behalf of the firm is qualified in accordance
    with paragraph (a).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Independence

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} independence is a question of fact; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a member of a firm of accountants is deemed not to
    be independent of a bank holding company if that member, a business
    partner of that member or the firm of accountants

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is a business partner, director, officer or
      employee of the bank holding company or of any affiliate of the
      bank holding company or is a business partner of any director,
      officer or employee of the bank holding company or of any
      affiliate of the bank holding company,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} beneficially owns or controls, directly or
      indirectly, a material interest in the shares of the bank holding
      company or of any affiliate of the bank holding company, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} has been a liquidator, trustee in bankruptcy,
      receiver or receiver and manager of any affiliate of the bank
      holding company within the two years immediately preceding the
      firm's proposed appointment as auditor of the bank holding
      company, other than an affiliate that is a subsidiary of the bank
      holding company acquired pursuant to section 934 or through a
      realization of security pursuant to section 935.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Business partners

  [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (2), a business
  partner of a member of a firm of accountants includes

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} another member of the firm; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a shareholder of the firm or of a business partner
    of the member.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of designation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Within fifteen days after appointing a firm of
  accountants as auditor of a bank holding company, the bank holding
  company and the firm of accountants shall jointly designate a member
  of the firm who has the qualifications described in subsection (1) to
  conduct the audit of the bank holding company on behalf of the firm
  and the bank holding company shall forthwith notify the Superintendent
  in writing of the designation.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}New designation

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where for any reason a member of a firm of
  accountants designated pursuant to subsection (3) ceases to conduct
  the audit of the bank holding company, the bank holding company and
  the firm of accountants may jointly designate another member of the
  same firm of accountants who has the qualifications described in
  subsection (1) to conduct the audit of the bank holding company and
  the bank holding company shall forthwith notify the Superintendent in
  writing of the designation.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed vacancy

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} In any case where subsection (4) applies and a
  designation is not made pursuant to that subsection within thirty days
  after the designated member ceases to conduct the audit of the bank
  holding company, there shall be deemed to be a vacancy in the office
  of auditor of the bank holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 129
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-847-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 847"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty to resign

- **[[848]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-848 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  auditor that ceases to be qualified under section 847 shall resign
  forthwith after any member of the firm becomes aware that the firm has
  ceased to be so qualified.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disqualification order

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Any interested person may apply to a court for an
  order declaring that an auditor of a bank holding company has ceased
  to be qualified under section 847 and declaring the office of auditor
  to be vacant.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Revocation of appointment

- **[[849]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-849 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  shareholders of a bank holding company may, by ordinary resolution at
  a special meeting, revoke the appointment of an auditor.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Revocation of appointment

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may at any time revoke the
  appointment of an auditor made under subsection (3) or 846(1) or
  section 851 by notice in writing signed by the Superintendent and sent
  by registered mail to the auditor and to the bank holding company
  addressed to the usual place of business of the auditor and the bank
  holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Filling vacancy

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A vacancy created by the revocation of the
  appointment of an auditor under subsection (1) may be filled at the
  meeting at which the appointment was revoked and, if not so filled,
  shall be filled by the directors under section 851.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Ceasing to hold office

- **[[850]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-850 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  auditor of a bank holding company ceases to hold office when

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the auditor resigns; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the appointment of the auditor is revoked by the
    shareholders or the Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effective date of resignation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The resignation of an auditor becomes effective at
  the time a written resignation is sent to the bank holding company or
  at the time specified in the resignation, whichever is later.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Filling vacancy

- **[[851]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-851
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection 849(3), where
  a vacancy occurs in the office of auditor of a bank holding company,
  the directors shall forthwith fill the vacancy, and the auditor so
  appointed holds office for the unexpired term of office of the
  predecessor of that auditor.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Where Superintendent may fill vacancy

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the directors fail to fill a vacancy in
  accordance with subsection (1), the Superintendent may fill the
  vacancy and the auditor so appointed holds office for the unexpired
  term of office of the predecessor of that auditor.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Designation of member of firm

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where the Superintendent has, pursuant to subsection
  (2), appointed a firm of accountants to fill a vacancy, the
  Superintendent shall designate the member of the firm who is to
  conduct the audit of the bank holding company on behalf of the firm.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Right to attend meetings

- **[[852]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-852 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  auditor of a bank holding company is entitled to receive notice of
  every meeting of shareholders and, at the expense of the bank holding
  company, to attend and be heard thereat on matters relating to the
  duties of the auditor.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty to attend meeting

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a director or shareholder of a bank holding
  company, whether or not the shareholder is entitled to vote at the
  meeting, gives written notice, not less than ten days before a meeting
  of shareholders, to an auditor or former auditor of the bank holding
  company that the director or shareholder wishes the auditor's
  attendance at the meeting, the auditor or former auditor shall attend
  the meeting at the expense of the bank holding company and answer
  questions relating to the auditor's or former auditor's duties as
  auditor.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice to bank holding company

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A director or shareholder who gives notice under
  subsection (2) shall send concurrently a copy of the notice to the
  bank holding company and the bank holding company shall forthwith send
  a copy thereof to the Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Superintendent may attend

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may attend and be heard at any
  meeting referred to in subsection (2).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statement of auditor

- **[[853]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-853 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  auditor of a bank holding company that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} resigns,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} receives a notice or otherwise learns of a meeting
    of shareholders called for the purpose of revoking the appointment
    of the auditor, or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} receives a notice or otherwise learns of a meeting
    of directors or shareholders at which another firm of accountants is
    to be appointed in its stead, whether because of the auditor's
    resignation or revocation of appointment or because the auditor's
    term of office has expired or is about to expire,

  shall submit to the bank holding company and the Superintendent a
  written statement giving the reasons for the resignation or the
  reasons why the auditor opposes any proposed action.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Other statements

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} In the case of a proposed replacement of an auditor
  whether because of removal or the expiry of their term, the bank
  holding company shall make a statement of the reasons for the proposed
  replacement and the proposed replacement auditor may make a statement
  in which they comment on those reasons.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statements to be sent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The bank holding company shall send a copy of the
  statements referred to in subsections (1) and (1.1) without delay to
  every shareholder entitled to vote at the annual meeting of
  shareholders and to the Superintendent.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 130
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-853-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 853"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty of replacement auditor

- **[[854]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-854
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where an auditor of a bank holding
  company has resigned or the appointment of an auditor has been
  revoked, no firm of accountants shall accept an appointment as auditor
  of the bank holding company or consent to be an auditor of the bank
  holding company until the firm of accountants has requested and
  received from the other auditor a written statement of the
  circumstances and reasons why the other auditor resigned or why, in
  the other auditor's opinion, the other auditor's appointment was
  revoked.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1), a firm of accountants
  may accept an appointment or consent to be appointed as auditor of a
  bank holding company if, within fifteen days after a request under
  that subsection is made, no reply from the other auditor is received.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of non-compliance

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Unless subsection (2) applies, an appointment as
  auditor of a bank holding company is void if subsection (1) has not
  been complied with.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditors' examination

- **[[855]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-855 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  auditor of a bank holding company shall make such examination as the
  auditor considers necessary to enable the auditor to report on the
  annual statement and on other financial statements required by this
  Part to be placed before the shareholders, except such annual
  statements or parts thereof as relate to the period referred to in
  subparagraph 840(1)(a)(ii).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditing standards

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The examination of the auditor referred to in
  subsection (1) shall, except as otherwise specified by the
  Superintendent, be conducted in accordance with generally accepted
  auditing standards, the primary source of which is the Handbook of the
  Chartered Professional Accountants of Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2017, c. 26, s. 62
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-855-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 855"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Right to information

- **[[856]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-856 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  the request of the auditor of a bank holding company, the present or
  former directors, officers, employees or agents of the bank holding
  company shall, to the extent that such persons are reasonably able to
  do so,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} permit access to such records, assets and security
    held by the bank holding company or any entity in which the bank
    holding company has a substantial investment, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide such information and explanations

  as are, in the opinion of the auditor, necessary to enable the auditor
  to perform the duties of the auditor of the bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Directors to provide information

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On the request of the auditor of a bank holding
  company, the directors of the bank holding company shall, to the
  extent that they are reasonably able to do so,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} obtain from the present or former directors,
    officers, employees and agents of any entity in which the bank
    holding company has a substantial investment the information and
    explanations that such persons are reasonably able to provide and
    that are, in the opinion of the auditor, necessary to enable them to
    perform the duties of the auditor of the bank holding company; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide the auditor with the information and
    explanations so obtained.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No civil liability

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A person who in good faith makes an oral or written
  communication under subsection (1) or (2) shall not be liable in any
  civil action arising from having made the communication.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor's report and extended examination

- **[[857]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-857 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  Superintendent may, in writing, require that the auditor of a bank
  holding company report to the Superintendent on the extent of the
  procedures of the auditor in the examination of the annual statement
  and may, in writing, require that the auditor enlarge or extend the
  scope of that examination or direct that any other particular
  procedure be performed in any particular case, and the auditor shall
  comply with any such requirement of the Superintendent and report to
  the Superintendent thereon.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Special examination

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may, in writing, require that the
  auditor of a bank holding company make a particular examination to
  determine whether any procedures adopted by the bank holding company
  may be prejudicial to the interests of depositors, policyholders or
  creditors of any federal financial institution that is affiliated with
  the bank holding company, or any other examination as, in the
  Superintendent's opinion, the public interest may require, and report
  to the Superintendent thereon.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Special examination

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may direct that a special audit of
  a bank holding company be made if, in the opinion of the
  Superintendent, it is so required and may appoint for that purpose a
  firm of accountants qualified pursuant to subsection 847(1) to be an
  auditor of the bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Expenses payable by bank holding
  company

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The expenses entailed by any examination or audit
  referred to in any of subsections (1) to (3) are payable by the bank
  holding company on being approved in writing by the Superintendent.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor's report

- **[[858]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-858 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  auditor shall, not less than twenty-one days before the date of the
  annual meeting of the shareholders of the bank holding company, make a
  report in writing to the shareholders on the annual statement referred
  to in subsection 840(1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Audit for shareholders

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In each report required under subsection (1), the
  auditor shall state whether, in the opinion of the auditor, the annual
  statement presents fairly, in accordance with the accounting
  principles referred to in subsection 840(4), the financial position of
  the bank holding company as at the end of the financial year to which
  it relates and the results of the operations and changes in the
  financial position of the bank holding company for that financial
  year.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor's remarks

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} In each report referred to in subsection (2), the
  auditor shall include such remarks as the auditor considers necessary
  when

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the examination has not been made in accordance
    with the auditing standards referred to in subsection 855(2);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the annual statement has not been prepared on a
    basis consistent with that of the preceding financial year; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the annual statement does not present fairly, in
    accordance with the accounting principles referred to in subsection
    840(4), the financial position of the bank holding company as at the
    end of the financial year to which it relates or the results of the
    operations or changes in the financial position of the bank holding
    company for that financial year.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report on directors' statement

- **[[859]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-859 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  auditor of a bank holding company shall, if required by the
  shareholders, audit and report to the shareholders on any financial
  statement submitted by the directors to the shareholders, and the
  report shall state whether, in the opinion of the auditor, the
  financial statement presents fairly the information required by the
  shareholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Making of report

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A report of the auditor made under subsection (1)
  shall be attached to the financial statement to which it relates and a
  copy of the statement and report shall be sent by the directors to
  every shareholder and to the Superintendent.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor of subsidiaries

- **[[860]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-860 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company shall take all necessary steps to ensure that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} its auditor is the auditor of each of its
    subsidiaries; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a subsidiary with more than one
    auditor, the auditor of the bank holding company is one of the
    subsidiary's auditors.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subsidiary outside Canada

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) applies in the case of a subsidiary
  that carries on its operations in a country other than Canada unless
  the laws of that country do not permit the appointment of an auditor
  of the bank holding company as the auditor of that subsidiary.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of any
  particular subsidiary where the bank holding company, after having
  consulted its auditor, is of the opinion that the total assets of the
  subsidiary are not a material part of the total assets of the bank
  holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2005, c. 54, s. 131
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-860-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 860"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor's attendance

- **[[861]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-861 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  auditor of a bank holding company is entitled to receive notice of
  every meeting of the audit committee of the bank holding company and,
  at the expense of the bank holding company, to attend and be heard at
  that meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Attendance

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If so requested by a member of the audit committee,
  the auditor shall attend every meeting of the audit committee held
  during the member's term of office.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Calling meeting

- **[[862]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-862 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  auditor of a bank holding company or a member of the audit committee
  may call a meeting of the audit committee.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Right to interview

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The chief internal auditor of a bank holding company
  or any officer or employee of the bank holding company acting in a
  similar capacity shall, at the request of the auditor of the bank
  holding company and on receipt of reasonable notice, meet with the
  auditor.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of errors

- **[[863]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-863 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  director or an officer of a bank holding company shall forthwith
  notify the audit committee and the auditor of the bank holding company
  of any error or misstatement of which the director or officer becomes
  aware in an annual statement or other financial statement on which the
  auditor or any former auditor has reported.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Error noted by auditor

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the auditor or former auditor of a bank holding
  company is notified or becomes aware of an error or misstatement in an
  annual statement or other financial statement on which the auditor
  reported and in the opinion of the auditor the error or misstatement
  is material, the auditor or former auditor shall inform each director
  of the bank holding company accordingly.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty of directors

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} When under subsection (2) the auditor or former
  auditor of a bank holding company informs the directors of an error or
  misstatement in an annual statement or other financial statement, the
  directors shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} prepare and issue a revised annual statement or
    financial statement; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} otherwise inform the shareholders and the
    Superintendent of the error or misstatement.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Qualified privilege for statements

**[[864]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-864 .sectionLabel}** Any oral or written
statement or report made under this Part by the auditor or former
auditor of a bank holding company has qualified privilege.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

##### [Remedial Actions]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21801 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sections 334 to 338 apply

**[[865]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-865 .sectionLabel}** Sections 334 to 338
apply in respect of bank holding companies, subject to the following:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} references to "bank" in those sections are to be read
  as references to "bank holding company"; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} references to "this Act" in those sections are to be
  read as references to "this Part".

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

##### [Liquidation and Dissolution]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21808 .Subheading}

Definition of [[court]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}"

**[[866]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-866 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
subsections 346(1) and 347(1) and (2), sections 348 to 352, subsection
353(1), sections 355 and 357 to 359, subsections 363(3) and (4) and
section 368, [[court]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a court having
jurisdiction in the place where the bank holding company has its head
office.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application of certain provisions

- **[[867]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-867
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) and sections 342 to
  365, 368 and 868 do not apply to a bank holding company that is an
  insolvent person or a bankrupt as those terms are defined in
  subsection 2(1) of the [Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act](/eng/acts/B-3).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Staying proceedings on insolvency

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Any proceedings taken under this Division to dissolve
  or to liquidate and dissolve a bank holding company shall be stayed if
  the bank holding company is at any time found, in a proceeding under
  the [Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act](/eng/acts/B-3), to be an insolvent
  person as defined in subsection 2(1) of that Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}[Winding-up and Restructuring
  Act](/eng/acts/W-11) does not apply

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The [Winding-up and Restructuring
  Act](/eng/acts/W-11) does not apply to a bank holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Returns to Superintendent

**[[868]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-868 .sectionLabel}** A liquidator appointed
under this Division to wind up the business of a bank holding company
shall provide the Superintendent with such information relating to the
business and affairs of the bank holding company in such form as the
Superintendent requires.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

##### [Simple Liquidation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21826 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sections 342 to 346 apply

**[[869]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-869 .sectionLabel}** Sections 342 to 346
apply in respect of bank holding companies, subject to the following:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} references to "bank" in those sections are to be read
  as references to "bank holding company"; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the reference to "sections 143 and 144" in subsection
  343(1) is to be read as a reference to "sections 732 and 733".

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

##### [Court-supervised Liquidation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21833 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sections 347 to 360 apply

**[[870]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-870 .sectionLabel}** Sections 347 to 360
apply in respect of bank holding companies, subject to the following:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} references to "bank" in those sections are to be read
  as references to "bank holding company";

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the reference to "subsection 308(1)" in subsection
  353(1) is to be read as a reference to "subsection 840(1)"; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} paragraph 354(a) is to be read without reference to
  "or auditors".

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

##### [General]{.HTitleText4} {#h-21841 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sections 361 to 365 and 368 apply

**[[871]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-871 .sectionLabel}** Sections 361 to 365 and
368 apply in respect of bank holding companies, subject to the
following:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} references to "bank" in those sections are to be read
  as references to "bank holding company";

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} references to "this Part" in those sections are to be
  read as references to "this Division";

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the reference to "section 632" in subsection 362(2)
  is to be read as a reference to "section 951";

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the reference to "section 366" in section 364 is to
  be read as a reference to "section 872"; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the reference to "sections 366 and 367" in section
  365 is to be read as a reference to "section 872".

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Unknown claimants

- **[[872]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-872 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  the dissolution of a bank holding company under this Act, the portion
  of the property distributable to a creditor or shareholder who cannot
  be found shall be converted into money and paid to the Receiver
  General.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Constructive satisfaction

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A payment under subsection (1) is deemed to be in
  satisfaction of a debt or claim of such creditor or shareholder.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Recovery

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If at any time a person establishes that he or she is
  entitled to any moneys paid to the Receiver General under this Act,
  the Receiver General shall pay an equivalent amount to him or her out
  of the Consolidated Revenue Fund.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

### [DIVISION 7]{.HLabel2}[Ownership]{.HTitleText2} {#h-21860 .Subheading}

#### [Constraints on Ownership]{.HTitleText3} {#h-21861 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sections 370 to 371.1 apply

**[[873]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-873 .sectionLabel}** Sections 370 to 371.1
apply in respect of bank holding companies, except that references to
"bank" in sections 371 and 371.1 are to be read as references to "bank
holding company".

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2012, c. 19, s. 336
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-873-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 873"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Significant interest

**[[874]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-874 .sectionLabel}** Except as permitted by
this Division, no person shall have a significant interest in any class
of shares of a bank holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Acquisition of significant interest

- **[[875]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-875
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 876, no person,
  or entity controlled by a person, shall, without the approval of the
  Minister, purchase or otherwise acquire any share of a bank holding
  company or purchase or otherwise acquire control of any entity that
  holds any share of a bank holding company if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the acquisition would cause the person to have a
    significant interest in any class of shares of the bank holding
    company; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the person has a significant interest in a class
    of shares of the bank holding company, the acquisition would
    increase the significant interest of the person in that class of
    shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amalgamation, etc., constitutes
  acquisition

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the entity that would result from an amalgamation,
  a merger or a reorganization would have a significant interest in a
  class of shares of a bank holding company, the entity is deemed to be
  acquiring a significant interest in that class of shares of the bank
  holding company through an acquisition for which the approval of the
  Minister is required under subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 118
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-875-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 875"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limitations on share holdings

- **[[876]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-876 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No
  person may be a major shareholder of a bank holding company with
  equity of twelve billion dollars or more.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- widely held bank

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a widely held bank
  that controls, within the meaning of paragraphs 3(1)(a) and (d), the
  bank holding company with equity of twelve billion dollars or more if
  it controlled, within the meaning of those paragraphs, the bank
  holding company on the day the bank holding company's equity reached
  twelve billion dollars and it has controlled, within the meaning of
  those paragraphs, the bank holding company since that day.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- widely held bank holding
  company

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a widely held bank
  holding company that controls, within the meaning of paragraphs
  3(1)(a) and (d), the bank holding company with equity of twelve
  billion dollars or more if the widely held bank holding company
  controlled, within the meaning of those paragraphs, the bank holding
  company on the day the bank holding company's equity reached twelve
  billion dollars and the widely held bank holding company has
  controlled, within the meaning of those paragraphs, the bank holding
  company since that day.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- insurance holding
  companies and certain institutions

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to any of the following
  that controls, within the meaning of paragraph 3(1)(d), the bank
  holding company with equity of twelve billion dollars or more if it
  controlled, within the meaning of that paragraph, the bank holding
  company on the day the bank holding company's equity reached twelve
  billion dollars and it has controlled, within the meaning of that
  paragraph, the bank holding company since that day:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a widely held insurance holding company;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an eligible Canadian financial institution, other
    than a bank; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an eligible foreign institution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- other entities

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to an entity that
  controls, within the meaning of paragraphs 3(1)(a) and (d), the bank
  holding company with equity of twelve billion dollars or more if the
  entity is controlled, within the meaning of those paragraphs, by a
  widely held bank to which subsection (2) applies, or a widely held
  bank holding company to which subsection (3) applies, that controls
  the bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- other entities

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to an entity that
  controls, within the meaning of paragraph 3(1)(d), the bank holding
  company with equity of twelve billion dollars or more if the entity is
  controlled, within the meaning of that paragraph, by

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a widely held insurance holding company to which
    subsection (4) applies that controls the bank holding company;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an eligible Canadian financial institution, other
    than a bank, to which subsection (4) applies that controls the bank
    holding company; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an eligible foreign institution to which
    subsection (4) applies that controls the bank holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 81
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-876-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 876"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

- **[[877]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-877
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite section 876, if a bank
  holding company with equity of twelve billion dollars or more was
  formed as the result of an amalgamation, a person who is a major
  shareholder of the bank holding company on the effective date of the
  letters patent of amalgamation shall do all things necessary to ensure
  that the person is no longer a major shareholder of the bank holding
  company on the day that is one year after that day or on the day that
  is after any shorter period specified by the Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- widely held banks and
  bank holding companies

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a widely held bank
  or a widely held bank holding company that controlled, within the
  meaning of paragraphs 3(1)(a) and (d), one of the applicants for the
  letters patent of amalgamation and that has controlled, within the
  meaning of those paragraphs, the amalgamated bank holding company
  since the effective date of those letters patent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- insurance holding
  companies and certain institutions

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to any of the following
  that controlled, within the meaning of paragraph 3(1)(d), one of the
  applicants for the letters patent of amalgamation if it has
  controlled, within the meaning of that paragraph, the amalgamated bank
  holding company since the effective date of those letters patent:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a widely held insurance holding company;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an eligible Canadian financial institution, other
    than a bank; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an eligible foreign institution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- other entities

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to an entity that
  controls, within the meaning of paragraphs 3(1)(a) and (d), the
  amalgamated bank holding company if the entity is controlled, within
  the meaning of those paragraphs, by a widely held bank or widely held
  bank holding company to which subsection (2) applies that controls the
  amalgamated bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- other entities

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to an entity that
  controls, within the meaning of paragraph 3(1)(d), the amalgamated
  bank holding company if the entity is controlled, within the meaning
  of that paragraph, by any of the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a widely held insurance holding company to which
    subsection (3) applies that controls the amalgamated bank holding
    company;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an eligible Canadian financial institution to which
    subsection (3) applies, other than a bank, that controls the
    amalgamated bank holding company; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an eligible foreign institution to which
    subsection (3) applies that controls the amalgamated bank holding
    company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} If general market conditions so warrant and the
  Minister is satisfied that the person has used the person's best
  efforts to be in compliance with subsection (1) on the required day,
  the Minister may specify a later day as the day from and after which
  the person must comply with that subsection.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 82
:::

[Previous

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limitation on share holdings

- **[[878]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-878 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  person is a major shareholder of a bank holding company with equity of
  less than twelve billion dollars and the bank holding company's equity
  reaches twelve billion dollars or more, the person shall do all things
  necessary to ensure that the person is not a major shareholder of the
  bank holding company on the day that is three years after the day the
  bank holding company's equity reached twelve billion dollars.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply if any of subsections
  876(2) to (6) applies to the person in respect of the bank holding
  company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If general market conditions so warrant and the
  Minister is satisfied that the person has used the person's best
  efforts to be in compliance with subsection (1) on the required day,
  the Minister may specify a later day as the day from and after which
  the person must comply with that subsection.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 83
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-878-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 878"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Obligation of widely held bank holding
company

- **[[879]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-879 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  widely held bank holding company with equity of twelve billion dollars
  or more controls a bank and a person becomes a major shareholder of
  the bank or of any entity that also controls the bank, the widely held
  bank holding company must do all things necessary to ensure that, on
  the day that is one year after the person became a major shareholder
  of the bank or entity that controls it,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the widely held bank holding company no longer
    controls the bank; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bank or the entity that controls the bank does
    not have any major shareholder other than the widely held bank
    holding company or any entity that it controls.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of a bank
  with equity of less than two hundred and fifty million dollars, or any
  other prescribed amount.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If general market conditions so warrant and the
  Minister is satisfied that the widely held bank holding company has
  used its best efforts to be in compliance with subsection (1) on the
  required day, the Minister may specify a later day as the day from and
  after which it must comply with that subsection.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 84
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-879-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 879"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Obligation of widely held bank holding
company

- **[[879.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-879.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection 879(1), if a
  widely held bank holding company with equity of twelve billion dollars
  or more controls a bank in respect of which that subsection does not
  apply by reason of subsection 879(2) and the equity of the bank
  reaches two hundred and fifty million dollars or more or any other
  amount that is prescribed and on the day the equity of the bank
  reaches two hundred and fifty million dollars or more or the
  prescribed amount, as the case may be, a person is a major shareholder
  of the bank or of any entity that also controls the bank, the widely
  held bank holding company must do all things necessary to ensure that,
  on the day that is three years after that day,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the widely held bank holding company no longer
    controls the bank; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bank or the entity that controls the bank does
    not have any major shareholder other than the widely held bank
    holding company or any entity that the widely held bank holding
    company controls.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If general market conditions so warrant and the
  Minister is satisfied that the widely held bank holding company has
  used its best efforts to be in compliance with subsection (1) on the
  required day, the Minister may specify a later day as the day from and
  after which it must comply with that subsection.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 85
:::

:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition against significant interest

**[[880]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-880 .sectionLabel}** No person who has a
significant interest in any class of shares of a widely held bank
holding company with equity of twelve billion dollars or more may have a
significant interest in any class of shares of a subsidiary of the
widely held bank holding company that is a bank or a bank holding
company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 86
:::

:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition against significant interest

**[[881]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-881 .sectionLabel}** No person who has a
significant interest in any class of shares of a bank holding company
may have a significant interest in any class of shares of any widely
held bank with equity of twelve billion dollars or more, or of any
widely held bank holding company with equity of twelve billion dollars
or more, that controls the bank holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition against control

- **[[882]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-882 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No
  person shall control, within the meaning of paragraph 3(1)(d), a bank
  holding company with equity of twelve billion dollars or more.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- widely held bank

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply if any of subsections
  876(2) to (6) applies in respect of the person in respect of the bank
  holding company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 87
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on control

- **[[883]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-883 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No
  person shall, without the approval of the Minister, acquire control,
  within the meaning of paragraph 3(1)(d), of a bank holding company
  with equity of less than twelve billion dollars.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amalgamation, etc., constitutes
  acquisition

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the entity that would result from an amalgamation,
  a merger or a reorganization would control, within the meaning of
  paragraph 3(1)(d), a bank holding company with equity of less than
  twelve billion dollars, the entity is deemed to be acquiring control,
  within the meaning of that paragraph, of the bank holding company
  through an acquisition for which the approval of the Minister is
  required under subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 119
- 2012, c. 5, s. 88
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deeming

**[[884]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-884 .sectionLabel}** A bank holding company
with equity of less than twelve billion dollars that controls a bank to
which subsection 378(1) applies is deemed, for the purposes of sections
156.09, 727, 876, 879, 879.1, 880, 881, 882, 888 and 890, subsection
891(2), section 893 and subsection 906(2), to be a bank holding company
with equity of twelve billion dollars or more.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 88
:::

[Previous
Version](section-884-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 884"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition

**[[885]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-885 .sectionLabel}** No person may control
or be a major shareholder of a bank holding company if the person or an
entity affiliated with the person

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} has control of or has a substantial investment in an
  entity that engages in Canada in any personal property leasing
  activity that a financial leasing entity within the meaning of
  subsection 464(1) is prohibited from engaging in; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} engages in Canada in any personal property leasing
  activity that a financial leasing entity within the meaning of
  subsection 464(1) is prohibited from engaging in.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition

**[[886]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-886 .sectionLabel}** No person who controls
a bank holding company or who is a major shareholder of a bank holding
company, and no entity affiliated with that person, may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} control or have a substantial investment in an entity
  that engages in Canada in any personal property leasing activity that
  a financial leasing entity within the meaning of subsection 464(1) is
  prohibited from engaging in; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} engage in Canada in any personal property leasing
  activity that a financial leasing entity within the meaning of
  subsection 464(1) is prohibited from engaging in.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Constraint on registration

**[[887]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-887 .sectionLabel}** No bank holding company
shall, unless the acquisition of the share has been approved by the
Minister, record in its securities register a transfer or issue of any
share of the bank holding company to any person or to any entity
controlled by a person if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the transfer or issue of the share would cause the
  person to have a significant interest in any class of shares of the
  bank holding company; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the person has a significant interest in a
  class of shares of the bank holding company, the transfer or issue of
  the share would increase the significant interest of the person in
  that class of shares.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption

**[[888]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-888 .sectionLabel}** On application by a
bank holding company, other than a bank holding company with equity of
twelve billion dollars or more, the Superintendent may exempt any class
of non-voting shares of the bank holding company the aggregate book
value of which is not more than 30 per cent of the aggregate book value
of all the outstanding shares of the bank holding company from the
application of sections 875 and 887.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 89
:::

[Previous
Version](section-888-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 888"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- small holdings

**[[889]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-889 .sectionLabel}** Despite section 887,
if, as a result of a transfer or issue of shares of a class of shares of
a bank holding company to a person, other than an eligible agent, the
total number of shares of that class registered in the securities
register of the bank holding company in the name of that person would
not exceed 5,000 and would not exceed 0.1% of the outstanding shares of
that class, the bank holding company is entitled to assume that no
person is acquiring or increasing a significant interest in that class
of shares of the bank holding company as a result of that issue or
transfer of shares.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2012, c. 31, s. 120
:::

[Previous
Version](section-889-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 889"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}When approval not required

- **[[890]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-890
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite sections 875 and 887, the
  approval of the Minister is not required in respect of a bank holding
  company with equity of less than twelve billion dollars if a person
  with a significant interest in a class of shares of the bank holding
  company, or an entity controlled by a person with a significant
  interest in a class of shares of the bank holding company, purchases
  or otherwise acquires shares of that class, or acquires control of any
  entity that holds any share of that class, and the number of shares of
  that class purchased or otherwise acquired, or the acquisition of
  control of the entity, as the case may be, would not increase the
  significant interest of the person in that class of shares of the bank
  holding company to a percentage that is greater than the percentage
  referred to in subsection (2) or (3), whichever is applicable.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Percentage

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3) and for the purpose of
  subsection (1), the percentage is 5 percentage points in excess of the
  significant interest of the person in that class of shares of the bank
  holding company on the day of the most recent purchase or acquisition
  by the person or any entity controlled by the person, other than the
  entity referred to in subsection (1), of shares of that class of
  shares of the bank holding company, or of control of an entity that
  held shares of that class of shares of the bank holding company, for
  which approval was given by the Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}When approval not required

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a person has a significant interest in a class of
  shares of a bank holding company and the person's percentage of that
  class has decreased after the date of the most recent purchase or
  other acquisition by the person or any entity controlled by the
  person, other than the entity referred to in subsection (1), of shares
  of that class of shares of the bank holding company, or of control of
  an entity that held shares of that class of shares of the bank holding
  company, for which approval was given by the Minister, the percentage
  for the purposes of subsection (1) is the percentage that is the
  lesser of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 5 percentage points in excess of the significant
    interest of the person in that class of shares of the bank holding
    company on the day of the most recent purchase or other acquisition
    by the person or any entity controlled by the person, other than the
    entity referred to in subsection (1), of shares of that class of
    shares of the bank holding company, or of control of an entity that
    held shares of that class of shares of the bank holding company, for
    which approval was given by the Minister, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 10 percentage points in excess of the lowest
    significant interest of the person in that class of shares of the
    bank holding company at any time after the day of the most recent
    purchase or other acquisition by the person or any entity controlled
    by the person, other than the entity referred to in subsection (1),
    of shares of that class of shares of the bank holding company, or of
    control of an entity that held shares of that class of shares of the
    bank holding company, for which approval was given by the Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- eligible agent

  [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} If the person referred to in subsection (1) is an
  eligible agent or an entity controlled by an eligible agent, then the
  Minister may reduce the percentage referred to in subsection (2) or
  (3).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply if the purchase or
  other acquisition of shares or the acquisition of control referred to
  in that subsection would

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} result in the acquisition of control of the bank
    holding company by the person referred to in that subsection;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the person controls the bank holding company but
    the voting rights attached to the aggregate of any voting shares of
    the bank holding company beneficially owned by the person and by
    entities controlled by the person do not exceed 50 per cent of the
    voting rights attached to all of the outstanding voting shares of
    the bank holding company, cause the voting rights attached to that
    aggregate to exceed 50 per cent of the voting rights attached to all
    of the outstanding voting shares of the bank holding company;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} result in the acquisition of a significant interest
    in a class of shares of the bank holding company by an entity
    controlled by the person and the acquisition of that investment is
    not exempted by the regulations; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} result in an increase in a significant interest in
    a class of shares of the bank holding company by an entity
    controlled by the person by a percentage that is greater than the
    percentage referred to in subsection (2) or (3), whichever applies,
    and the increase is not exempted by the regulations.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} exempting from the application of paragraph (4)(c)
    the acquisition of a significant interest in a class of shares of
    the bank holding company by an entity controlled by the person; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} exempting from the application of paragraph (4)(d)
    an increase in a significant interest in a class of shares of the
    bank holding company by an entity controlled by the person by a
    percentage that is greater than the percentage referred to in
    subsection (2) or (3), whichever applies.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 90, c. 31, s. 121
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-890-20120524.html "Link to previous version of section 890"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}When approval not required

- **[[891]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-891
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite sections 875 and 887, the
  approval of the Minister is not required if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Superintendent has, by order, directed the bank
    holding company to increase its capital and shares of the bank
    holding company are issued and acquired in accordance with the terms
    and conditions, if any, that may be specified in the order; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a person, other than an eligible agent, who
    controls, within the meaning of paragraph 3(1)(a), the bank holding
    company acquires additional shares of the bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(a) does not apply in respect of a bank
  holding company with equity of twelve billion dollars or more.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 91, c. 31, s. 122
:::

[Previous
