:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Pre-approval

**[[892]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-892 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
sections 875 and 887, the Minister may approve

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the purchase or other acquisition of any number or
  percentage of shares of a bank holding company that may be required in
  a particular transaction or series of transactions; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the purchase or other acquisition of up to a
  specified number or percentage of shares of a bank holding company
  within a specified period.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Public holding requirement

- **[[893]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-893
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every bank holding company with
  equity of two billion dollars or more but less than twelve billion
  dollars shall, from and after the day determined under this section in
  respect of that bank holding company, have, and continue to have,
  voting shares that carry at least 35 per cent of the voting rights
  attached to all of the outstanding voting shares of the bank holding
  company and that are

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} shares of one or more classes of shares that are
    listed and posted for trading on a recognized stock exchange in
    Canada; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} shares none of which is beneficially owned by a
    person who is a major shareholder of the bank holding company in
    respect of the voting shares of the bank holding company or by any
    entity that is controlled by a person who is a major shareholder of
    the bank holding company in respect of such shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Determination of day

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The day referred to in subsection (1) is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the bank holding company had equity of two
    billion dollars or more but less than twelve billion dollars on the
    day the bank holding company was formed or came into existence, the
    day that is three years after that day; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, the day that is three years
    after the day of the first annual meeting of the shareholders of the
    bank holding company held after the equity of the bank holding
    company first reaches two billion dollars.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If general market conditions so warrant and the
  Minister is satisfied that a bank holding company has used its best
  efforts to be in compliance with this section on the day determined
  under subsection (2), the Minister may specify a later day as the day
  from and after which the bank holding company must comply with
  subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, ss. 132, 133
- 2012, c. 5, s. 92
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-893-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 893"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Public holding requirement

**[[894]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-894 .sectionLabel}** If a bank holding
company to which section 893 applies becomes a bank holding company with
equity of twelve billion dollars or more, that section continues to
apply to the bank holding company until no person is a major shareholder
of the bank holding company, other than a person in respect of whom
subsections 876(2) to (6) applies.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 93
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-894-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 894"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit on assets

- **[[895]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-895
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Unless an exemption order with
  respect to the bank holding company is granted under section 897, if a
  bank holding company fails to comply with section 893 in any month,
  the Minister may, by order, require the bank holding company not to
  have, until it complies with that section, average total assets in any
  three month period ending on the last day of a subsequent month
  exceeding the bank holding company's average total assets in the three
  month period ending on the last day of the month immediately before
  the month specified in the order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Average total assets

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), the average total
  assets of a bank holding company in a three month period is to be
  computed by adding the total assets of the bank holding company as
  calculated for the month end of each of the three months in the period
  and by dividing the sum by three.

- Definition of [[total assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsections (1) and (2), [[total
  assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a bank holding company,
  has the meaning given that expression by the regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Increase of capital

**[[896]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-896 .sectionLabel}** If the Superintendent
has, by order, directed a bank holding company with equity of two
billion dollars or more but less than twelve billion dollars to increase
its capital and shares of the bank holding company are issued and
acquired in accordance with any terms and conditions that may be
specified in the order, section 893 does not apply in respect of the
bank holding company until the time that the Superintendent may, by
order, specify.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, ss. 132, 133
- 2012, c. 5, s. 94
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-896-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 896"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption by order of the Minister

- **[[897]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-897 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  application by a bank holding company, the Minister may, if the
  Minister considers it appropriate to do so, by order exempt the bank
  holding company from the requirements of section 893, subject to any
  terms and conditions that the Minister considers appropriate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Compliance with section 893

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If an exemption order granted under this section in
  respect of a bank holding company expires, the bank holding company
  shall comply with section 893 as of the day the exemption order
  expires.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit on assets

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a bank holding company fails to comply with
  section 893 on the day referred to in subsection (2), the bank holding
  company shall not, until it complies with that section, have average
  total assets in any three month period ending on the last day of a
  subsequent month exceeding the bank holding company's average total
  assets in the three month period ending on the last day of the month
  immediately before the day referred to in subsection (2) or any later
  day that the Minister may, by order, specify.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application of ss. 895(2) and (3)

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsections 895(2) and (3) apply for the purposes of
  subsection (3).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

- **[[898]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-898 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  bank holding company fails to comply with section 893 as the result of
  any of the following, section 895 does not apply in respect of the
  bank holding company until the expiration of six months after the day
  it failed to comply with section 893:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a distribution to the public of voting shares of
    the bank holding company;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a redemption or purchase of voting shares of the
    bank holding company;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the exercise of any option to acquire voting shares
    of the bank holding company; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the conversion of any convertible securities into
    voting shares of the bank holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shares acquiring voting rights

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If, as the result of an event that has occurred and
  is continuing, shares of a bank holding company acquire voting rights
  in such number as to cause the bank holding company to no longer be in
  compliance with section 893, section 895 does not apply in respect of
  that bank holding company until the expiration of six months after the
  day the bank holding company ceased to be in compliance with section
  893 or any later day that the Minister may, by order, specify.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Acquisition of control permitted

- **[[899]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-899
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2) and
  sections 887 and 900, section 893 does not apply in respect of a bank
  holding company if a person acquires control of the bank holding
  company through the purchase or other acquisition of all or any number
  of the shares of the bank holding company by the person or by any
  entity controlled by the person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Undertaking required

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) applies only if the person referred to
  in that subsection provides the Minister with an undertaking
  satisfactory to the Minister to do all things necessary so that,
  within three years after the acquisition, or any other period that the
  Minister may specify, the bank holding company has voting shares that
  carry at least 35 per cent of the voting rights attached to all of the
  outstanding voting shares of the bank holding company and that are

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} shares of one or more classes of shares that are
    listed and posted for trading on a recognized stock exchange in
    Canada; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} shares none of which is beneficially owned by a
    person who is a major shareholder of the bank holding company in
    respect of the voting shares of the bank holding company or by any
    entity that is controlled by a person who is a major shareholder of
    the bank holding company in respect such shares.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application of section 893

**[[900]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-900 .sectionLabel}** At the expiration of
the period for compliance with an undertaking referred to in subsection
899(2), section 893 shall apply in respect of the bank holding company
to which the undertaking relates.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on voting rights

- **[[901]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If,
  with respect to any bank holding company, a particular person
  contravenes section 874, subsection 875(1), 876(1) or 878(1), section
  880 or 881 or subsection 882(1) or section 883 or fails to comply with
  an undertaking referred to in subsection 899(2) or with any term or
  condition imposed under section 907, no person, and no entity
  controlled by the particular person, shall, in person or by proxy,
  exercise any voting rights

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that are attached to shares of the bank holding
    company beneficially owned by the particular person or any entity
    controlled by the particular person; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that are subject to an agreement entered into by
    the particular person, or any entity controlled by the particular
    person, pertaining to the exercise of the voting rights.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subsection (1) ceases to apply

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) shall cease to apply in respect of a
  person when, as the case may be,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the shares to which the contravention relates have
    been disposed of;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the person ceases to control the bank holding
    company within the meaning of paragraph 3(1)(d);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the person failed to comply with an undertaking
    referred to in subsection 899(2), the bank holding company complies
    with section 893; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} if the person failed to comply with a term or
    condition imposed under section 907, the person complies with the
    term or condition.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Saving

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), if a person contravenes
  subsection 876(1) by reason only that, as a result of an event that
  has occurred and is continuing and is not within the control of the
  person, shares of the bank holding company beneficially owned by the
  person or by any entity controlled by the person acquire voting rights
  in such number so as to cause the person to be a major shareholder of
  the bank holding company, the Minister may, after consideration of the
  circumstances, permit the person and any entity controlled by the
  person to exercise voting rights, in person or by proxy, in respect of
  any class of voting shares of the bank holding company beneficially
  owned by them that do not in aggregate exceed 20 per cent of the
  voting rights attached to that class of voting shares.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Loss of control --- bank and bank holding
company

- **[[902]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-902
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite sections 876 and 882, a
  widely held bank or a widely held bank holding company may be a major
  shareholder of a bank holding company with equity of twelve billion
  dollars or more and cease to control, within the meaning of paragraphs
  3(1)(a) and (d), the bank holding company if it has entered into an
  agreement with the Minister to do all things necessary to ensure that
  it is not a major shareholder of the bank holding company on the
  expiration of the day specified in the agreement.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If general market conditions so warrant and the
  Minister is satisfied that the bank or the bank holding company has
  used its best efforts to be in compliance with subsection (1) on the
  required day, the Minister may specify a later day as the day from and
  after which it must comply with that subsection.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 95
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-902-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 902"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Loss of control --- other entities

- **[[903]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-903
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite sections 876 and 882, an
  eligible foreign institution, an eligible Canadian financial
  institution, other than a bank, or a widely held insurance holding
  company may be a major shareholder of a bank holding company with
  equity of twelve billion dollars or more and cease to control, within
  the meaning of paragraph 3(1)(d), the bank holding company if it has
  entered into an agreement with the Minister to do all things necessary
  to ensure that it is not a major shareholder of the bank holding
  company on the expiration of the day specified in the agreement.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If general market conditions so warrant and the
  Minister is satisfied that the institution or insurance holding
  company has used its best efforts to be in compliance with
  subsection (1) on the required day, the Minister may specify a later
  day as the day from and after which it must comply with that
  subsection.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 96
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-903-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 903"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Change in status

- **[[904]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-904 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  body corporate that is an eligible financial institution other than a
  bank controls, within the meaning of paragraph 3(1)(d), a bank holding
  company with equity of twelve billion dollars or more and the body
  corporate subsequently ceases to be an eligible financial institution,
  the body corporate must do all things necessary to ensure that, on the
  day that is one year after the day it ceased to be an eligible
  financial institution,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it does not control, within the meaning of
    paragraph 3(1)(d), the bank holding company; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is not a major shareholder of the bank holding
    company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If general market conditions so warrant and the
  Minister is satisfied that the body corporate has used its best
  efforts to be in compliance with subsection (1) on the required day,
  the Minister may specify a later day as the day from and after which
  it must comply with that subsection.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 97
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-904-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 904"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Approval Process]{.HTitleText3} {#h-22143 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application for approval

- **[[905]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-905 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  application for an approval of the Minister required under this
  Division must be filed with the Superintendent and contain the
  information, material and evidence that the Superintendent may
  require.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Applicant

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If, with respect to any particular transaction, this
  Division applies to more than one person, any one of those persons may
  make the application to the Minister for approval on behalf of all of
  those persons.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Matters for consideration

- **[[906]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-906
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), if an
  application for an approval under section 875 is made, the Minister,
  in determining whether or not to approve the transaction, shall take
  into account all matters that the Minister considers relevant to the
  application, including

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the nature and sufficiency of the financial
    resources of the applicant or applicants as a source of continuing
    financial support of any bank that is a subsidiary of the bank
    holding company;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the soundness and feasibility of the plans of the
    applicant or applicants for the future conduct and development of
    the business of any bank that is a subsidiary of the bank holding
    company;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the business record and experience of the applicant
    or applicants;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the character and integrity of the applicant or
    applicants or, if the applicant or any of the applicants is a body
    corporate, its reputation for being operated in a manner that is
    consistent with the standards of good character and integrity;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} whether the bank holding company will be operated
    responsibly by persons with the competence and experience suitable
    for involvement in the operation of a financial institution;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the impact of any integration of the businesses and
    operations of the applicant or applicants with those of the bank
    holding company and its affiliates on the conduct of those
    businesses and operations; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the best interests of the financial system in
    Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Except for an application by an eligible agent for an
  approval under section 875, and subject to subsection 882(1), the
  Minister shall take into account only paragraph (1)(d) if the
  application is in respect of a transaction that would result in the
  applicant or applicants holding

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} more than 10 per cent but no more than 20 per cent
    of any class of the outstanding voting shares of a widely held bank
    holding company with equity of twelve billion dollars or more; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} more than 10 per cent but no more than 30 per cent
    of any class of the outstanding non-voting shares of such a bank
    holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Favourable treatment

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall not approve a transaction that
  would cause a bank holding company to become a subsidiary of a foreign
  bank within the meaning of any of paragraphs (a) to (f) of the
  definition [[foreign bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in section 2 that is a
  non-WTO Member foreign bank, unless the Minister is satisfied that
  treatment as favourable for bank holding companies to which this Act
  applies exists or will be provided in the jurisdiction in which the
  foreign bank principally carries on business, either directly or
  through a subsidiary.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 132
- 2012, c. 5, s. 98, c. 31, s. 123
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-906-20120524.html "Link to previous version of section 906"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Terms and conditions

**[[907]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-907 .sectionLabel}** The Minister may impose
any terms and conditions in respect of an approval given under this
Division that the Minister considers necessary to ensure compliance with
any provision of this Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Certifying receipt of application

- **[[908]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-908 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If,
  in the opinion of the Superintendent, an application filed under this
  Division contains all the required information, the Superintendent
  shall without delay refer the application to the Minister and send a
  receipt to the applicant certifying the date on which the completed
  application was received by the Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Incomplete application

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If, in the opinion of the Superintendent, an
  application filed under this Division is incomplete, the
  Superintendent shall send a notice to the applicant specifying the
  information required by the Superintendent to complete the
  application.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 120(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-908-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 908"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of decision

- **[[909]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-909
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) and (3)
  and 910(1), the Minister shall, within a period of thirty days after
  the certified date referred to in subsection 908(1), send to the
  applicant

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a notice approving the transaction to which the
    application relates; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the Minister is not satisfied that the
    transaction to which the application relates should be approved, a
    notice to that effect, advising the applicant of the right to make
    representations to the Minister in respect of the matter.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of decision

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (4) and 910(2), the notice
  referred to in paragraph (1)(a) or (b) shall be sent by the Minister
  within a period of 45 days after the certified date referred to in
  subsection 908(1) in the following cases:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the application involves the acquisition of control
    of a bank holding company;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the application is made by an eligible agent or an
    entity controlled by an eligible agent; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an application is made for the approval referred to
    in subsection 913(3).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension of period for notice

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister is unable to complete the
  consideration of an application within the period referred to in
  subsection (1), the Minister shall,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} within that period, send a notice to that effect to
    the applicant; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} within a further period of thirty days after the
    date of the sending of the notice referred to in paragraph (a) or
    within any other further period that may be agreed on by the
    applicant and the Minister, send a notice referred to in paragraph
    (1)(a) or (b) to the applicant.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Further extensions

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister considers it appropriate to do so,
  the Minister may extend the period referred to in subsection (2) for
  one or more periods of forty-five days.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2012, c. 31, s. 124
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-909-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 909"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reasonable opportunity to make
representations

- **[[910]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-910 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If,
  after receipt of the notice referred to in paragraph 909(1)(b), the
  applicant advises the Minister that the applicant wishes to make
  representations, the Minister must provide the applicant with a
  reasonable opportunity within a period of thirty days after the date
  of the notice, or within any further period that may be agreed on by
  the applicant and the Minister, to make representations in respect of
  the matter.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reasonable opportunity to make
  representations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If, after receipt of the notice sent in accordance
  with subsection 909(2) that the Minister is not satisfied that the
  transaction to which the application relates should be approved, the
  applicant advises the Minister that the applicant wishes to make
  representations, the Minister must provide the applicant with a
  reasonable opportunity within a period of 45 days after the date of
  the notice, or within any further period that may be agreed on by the
  applicant and the Minister, to make representations in respect of the
  matter.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2012, c. 31, s. 125(E)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-910-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 910"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of decision

- **[[911]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-911
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Within a period of thirty days after
  the expiration of the period for making representations referred to in
  subsection 910(1), the Minister shall, in the light of any such
  representations and having regard to the matters to be taken into
  account, send a notice to the applicant indicating whether or not the
  Minister approves the transaction to which the application relates.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of decision

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Within a period of forty-five days after the
  expiration of the period for making representations referred to in
  subsection 910(2), the Minister shall, in the light of any such
  representations and having regard to the matters to be taken into
  account, send a notice to the applicant indicating whether or not the
  Minister approves the transaction to which the application relates.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed approval

**[[912]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-912 .sectionLabel}** If the Minister does
not send a notice under subsection 909(1) or (3) or 911(1) within the
period provided for in those subsections, the Minister is deemed to have
approved the transaction to which the application relates.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Constraining registration: Crown and
foreign governments

- **[[913]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-913 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No
  bank holding company shall record in its securities register a
  transfer or issue of any share of the bank holding company to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} Her Majesty in right of Canada or of a province or
    any agent or agency of Her Majesty in either of those rights; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the government of a foreign country or any
    political subdivision of a foreign country, or any agent or agency
    of a foreign government.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), a bank holding company may
  record in its securities register a transfer or issue of any share of
  the bank holding company to a foreign bank, or to a foreign
  institution, that is controlled by the government of a foreign country
  or any political subdivision of a foreign country, or by any agent or
  agency of a foreign government, if the share that is transferred or
  issued is beneficially owned by the foreign bank or foreign
  institution or by an entity controlled by the foreign bank or foreign
  institution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Certain foreign banks excluded

  [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not permit a bank holding
  company to record in its securities register a transfer or issue of
  any share of the bank holding company to a foreign bank that is a
  foreign bank by reason only of paragraph (f) of the definition
  [[foreign bank]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in section 2.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), a bank holding company may,
  with the Minister's approval, record in its securities register the
  issue of any share of the bank holding company to an eligible agent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application made jointly

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The application for the approval referred to in
  subsection (3) must be made jointly by the bank holding company and
  the eligible agent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Matters for consideration

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The Minister, in determining whether to grant the
  approval referred to in subsection (3), shall take into account all
  matters that he or she considers relevant, including those set out in
  paragraphs 906(1)(a) to (g).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Consequence of revocation of approval

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} If an approval referred to in subsection (3) is
  revoked, the bank holding company shall delete any entry in its
  securities register in respect of the recording of the issuance of
  shares to the eligible agent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disposition of shareholdings

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} If a bank holding company or an eligible agent fails
  to comply with any undertaking or term or condition in relation to an
  approval referred to in subsection (3), or if an eligible agent ceases
  to be an eligible agent, the Minister may, if the Minister considers
  it to be in the public interest to do so, by order, direct the
  eligible agent or former eligible agent and any person controlled by
  the eligible agent or former eligible agent to dispose of any number
  of shares of the bank holding company beneficially owned by the
  eligible agent or former eligible agent or the persons controlled by
  the eligible agent or former eligible agent that the Minister
  specifies in the order, within the time specified in the order and in
  the proportion, if any, as between the eligible agent or former
  eligible agent and the persons controlled by the eligible agent or
  former eligible agent that is specified in the order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Representations

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} No direction shall be made under subsection (7)
  unless the Minister has provided each person to whom the direction
  relates and the bank holding company concerned with a reasonable
  opportunity to make representations in respect of the subject-matter
  of the direction.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appeal

  [(9)]{.lawlabel} Any person with respect to whom a direction has been
  made under subsection (7) may, within 30 days after the date of the
  direction, appeal the matter in accordance with section 977.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2012, c. 5, s. 99, c. 19, s. 337, c. 31, s. 126
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-913-20120629.html "Link to previous version of section 913"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Suspension of voting rights held by
governments

- **[[914]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-914
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite section 737, no person
  shall, in person or by proxy, exercise any voting rights attached to
  any share of a bank holding company that is beneficially owned by

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} Her Majesty in right of Canada or of a province or
    any agency of Her Majesty in either of those rights; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the government of a foreign country or any
    political subdivision thereof, or any agency thereof.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a foreign bank, or
  to a foreign institution, that is controlled by the government of a
  foreign country or any political subdivision of a foreign country, or
  by any agent or agency of a foreign government, if the share referred
  to in subsection (1) is beneficially owned by the foreign bank or
  foreign institution or by an entity controlled by the foreign bank or
  foreign institution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- eligible agent

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of the
  exercise of voting rights attached to any share referred to in
  subsection 913(3).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Consequence of suspension of approval

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If an approval referred to in subsection 913(3) is
  suspended, the eligible agent shall not exercise, in person or by
  proxy, any voting rights attached to any share of the bank holding
  company that is beneficially owned by the eligible agent.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2012, c. 5, s. 100, c. 19, s. 338, c. 31, s. 127
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-914-20120629.html "Link to previous version of section 914"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disposition of shareholdings

- **[[915]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-915 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If,
  with respect to any bank holding company, a person contravenes section
  874 or subsection 875(1), 876(1) or 878(1) or section 880 or 881 or
  subsection 882(1) or section 883 or fails to comply with an
  undertaking referred to in subsection 899(2) or with any terms and
  conditions imposed under section 907, the Minister may, if the
  Minister deems it in the public interest to do so, by order, direct
  that person and any person controlled by that person to dispose of any
  number of shares of the bank holding company beneficially owned by any
  of those persons that the Minister specifies in the order, within the
  time specified in the order and in the proportion, if any, as between
  the person and the persons controlled by that person that is specified
  in the order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Representations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No direction shall be made under subsection (1)
  unless the Minister has provided each person to whom the direction
  relates and the bank holding company concerned with a reasonable
  opportunity to make representations in respect of the subject-matter
  of the direction.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appeal

**[[916]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-916 .sectionLabel}** Any person with respect
to whom a direction has been made under subsection 915(1) may, within
thirty days after the date of the direction, appeal the matter in
accordance with section 977.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2012, c. 31, s. 128(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-916-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 916"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application to court

- **[[917]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-917 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  person fails to comply with a direction made under subsection 913(7)
  or 915(1), an application on behalf of the Minister may be made to a
  court for an order to enforce the direction.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Court order

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A court may, on an application under subsection (1),
  make such order as the circumstances require to give effect to the
  terms of the direction and may, without limiting the generality of the
  foregoing, require the bank holding company concerned to sell the
  shares that are the subject-matter of the direction.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appeal

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An appeal from an order of a court under this section
  lies in the same manner as, and to the same court to which, an appeal
  may be taken from any other order of the court.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2012, c. 31, s. 129
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-917-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 917"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Interest of securities underwriter

**[[918]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-918 .sectionLabel}** This Division does not
apply to a securities underwriter in respect of shares of a body
corporate or ownership interests in an unincorporated entity that are
acquired by the underwriter in the course of a distribution to the
public of those shares or ownership interests and that are held by the
underwriter for a period of not more than six months.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Arrangements to effect compliance

- **[[919]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-919 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  directors of a bank holding company may make such arrangements as they
  deem necessary to carry out the intent of this Division and, in
  particular, but without limiting the generality of the foregoing, may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} require any person in whose name a share of the
    bank holding company is held to submit a declaration setting out

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the beneficial ownership of the share, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} such other information as the directors deem
      relevant for the purposes of this Division;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} require any person who wishes to have a transfer of
    a share registered in the name of, or to have a share issued to,
    that person to submit a declaration referred to in paragraph (a) as
    though the person were the holder of that share; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} determine the circumstances in which a declaration
    referred to in paragraph (a) is to be required, the form of the
    declaration and the times at which it is to be submitted.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order of Superintendent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may, by order, direct a bank
  holding company to obtain from any person in whose name a share of the
  bank holding company is held a declaration setting out the name of
  every entity controlled by that person and containing information
  concerning

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the ownership or beneficial ownership of the share;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} such other related matters as are specified by the
    Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Compliance required

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} As soon as possible after receipt by a bank holding
  company of a direction under subsection (2),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bank holding company shall comply with the
    direction; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} every person who is requested by the bank holding
    company to provide a declaration containing information referred to
    in subsection (1) or (2) shall comply with the request.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Outstanding declaration: effect

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where, pursuant to this section, a declaration is
  required to be submitted by a shareholder or other person in respect
  of the issue or transfer of any share, a bank holding company may
  refuse to issue the share or register the transfer unless the required
  declaration is submitted.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reliance on information

**[[920]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-920 .sectionLabel}** A bank holding company
and any person who is a director or an officer, employee or agent of the
bank holding company may rely on any information contained in a
declaration required by the directors pursuant to section 919 or on any
information otherwise acquired in respect of any matter that might be
the subject of such a declaration, and no action lies against the bank
holding company or any such person for anything done or omitted to be
done in good faith in reliance on any such information.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}[Competition Act](/eng/acts/C-34)

**[[921]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-921 .sectionLabel}** Nothing in, or done
under the authority of, this Act affects the operation of the
[Competition Act](/eng/acts/C-34).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

### [DIVISION 8]{.HLabel2}[Business and Powers]{.HTitleText2} {#h-22306 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Main business

- **[[922]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-922
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to this Part, a bank holding
  company shall not engage in or carry on any business other than

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} acquiring, holding and administering investments
    that are permitted by this Part;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} providing management, advisory, financing,
    accounting, information processing and other prescribed services to
    entities in which it has a substantial investment; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any other prescribed business.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  prescribing businesses or services for the purposes of subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on guarantees

- **[[923]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-923 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  bank holding company shall not guarantee on behalf of any person the
  payment or repayment of any sum of money.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person on whose behalf the bank holding company
    has undertaken to guarantee the payment or repayment is a subsidiary
    of the bank holding company; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the subsidiary has an unqualified obligation to
    reimburse the bank holding company for the full amount of the
    payment or repayment to be guaranteed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations imposing
  terms and conditions in respect of guarantees permitted by this
  section.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on partnerships

- **[[924]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-924
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Except with the approval of the
  Superintendent, a bank holding company shall not be a general partner
  in a limited partnership or a partner in a general partnership.

- Meaning of [[general partnership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), [[general
  partnership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any partnership other than a
  limited partnership.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

### [DIVISION 9]{.HLabel2}[Investments]{.HTitleText2} {#h-22335 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-22336 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

- **[[925]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-925 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  definitions in subsection 464(1) apply in respect of bank holding
  companies, except that the reference to "section 468" in the
  definition [[permitted entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} is to be read as a
  reference to "section 930" and the reference to "bank" in that
  definition is to be read as a reference to "bank holding company".

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Members of a bank holding company's
  group

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this Division, a member of a bank
  holding company's group is any of the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an entity referred to in any of paragraphs
    930(1)(a) to (f) that controls the bank holding company;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a subsidiary of the bank holding company or of an
    entity referred to in any of paragraphs 930(1)(a) to (f) that
    controls the bank holding company;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an entity in which the bank holding company, or an
    entity referred to in any of paragraphs 930(1)(a) to (f) that
    controls the bank holding company, has a substantial investment; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed entity in relation to the bank holding
    company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application of Division

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} This Division does not apply in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the holding of a security interest in real
    property, unless the security interest is prescribed under paragraph
    941(a) to be an interest in real property; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the holding of a security interest in securities of
    an entity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

#### [Investments]{.HTitleText3} {#h-22352 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Investments

**[[926]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-926 .sectionLabel}** Subject to this
Division, a bank holding company may invest its funds in the shares of
or ownership interests in any entity or make any other investment that
its directors consider necessary or advisable to manage the bank holding
company's liquidity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

#### [General Constraints on Investments]{.HTitleText3} {#h-22357 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Investment standards

**[[927]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-927 .sectionLabel}** The directors of a bank
holding company shall establish and the bank holding company shall
adhere to investment and lending policies, standards and procedures that
a reasonable and prudent person would apply to avoid undue risk of loss
and obtain a reasonable return.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit --- business growth fund

- **[[927.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-927.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The aggregate value of all ownership
  interests in the business growth fund and the entities that the
  business growth fund controls that a bank holding company and its
  subsidiaries hold must not exceed \$200,000,000.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), the value of an
  ownership interest is determined by the amount paid for it at the time
  of its issuance.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2018, c. 27, s. 143
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on control and substantial
investments

- **[[928]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-928
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) to (3.4),
  no bank holding company shall acquire control of, or hold, acquire or
  increase a substantial investment in, any entity other than a
  permitted entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception: indirect investments

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company may acquire control of, or
  acquire or increase a substantial investment in, an entity other than
  a permitted entity by way of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an acquisition of control of an entity referred to
    in any of paragraphs 930(1)(a) to (j), a specialized financing
    entity or a prescribed entity that controls or has a substantial
    investment in the entity; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an acquisition of shares or ownership interests in
    the entity by

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an entity referred to in any of paragraphs
      930(1)(a) to (j), a specialized financing entity or a prescribed
      entity that is controlled by the bank holding company, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an entity controlled by an entity referred to in
      any of paragraphs 930(1)(a) to (j), a specialized financing entity
      or a prescribed entity that is controlled by the bank holding
      company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception: temporary investments,
  realizations and loan workouts

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company may acquire control of, or
  acquire or increase a substantial investment in, an entity by way of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a temporary investment permitted by section 933;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an acquisition of shares of a body corporate or of
    ownership interests in an unincorporated entity permitted by section
    934; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a realization of security permitted by section 935.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Business growth fund

  [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 927.1 and subsections (3.2) to
  (3.4), a bank holding company may hold, acquire or increase a
  substantial investment in the business growth fund or any entity that
  the business growth fund controls.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}For greater certainty

  [(3.2)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, a bank holding company is
  prohibited from acquiring control of the business growth fund or any
  entity that the business growth fund controls.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- entity

  [(3.3)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company is prohibited from holding
  or acquiring a substantial investment in the business growth fund or
  any entity that the business growth fund controls if the business
  growth fund or any entity that the business growth fund controls hold
  or acquires shares of, or other ownership interests in, any of the
  following entities, or in any entity that controls any of the
  following entities:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an entity referred to in any of paragraphs
    930(1)(a) to (j);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is primarily engaged in the leasing
    of motor vehicles in Canada for the purpose of extending credit to a
    customer or financing a customer's acquisition of a motor vehicle;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is primarily engaged in providing
    temporary possession of personal property, including motor vehicles,
    to customers in Canada for a purpose other than to finance the
    customer's acquisition of the property;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an entity that acts as an insurance broker or agent
    in Canada; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is engaged in any prescribed
    activity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- capital and loans

  [(3.4)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company is prohibited from holding
  or acquiring a substantial investment in the business growth fund or
  any entity that the business growth fund controls if the business
  growth fund or any entity that the business growth fund controls holds
  shares of, or other ownership interests in, an entity or holds a loan
  made to an entity and, in respect of that entity and its affiliates,
  the aggregate value of the following exceeds \$100,000,000:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} all ownership interests that are held by the bank
    holding company, the bank holding company's subsidiaries, the
    business growth fund or the entities that the business growth fund
    controls, the value of those ownership interests as determined by
    the amount paid for them at the time each was first acquired by any
    of those entities; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the outstanding principal of all loans held by the
    business growth fund or the entities that the business growth fund
    controls.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception: uncontrolled event

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company is deemed not to contravene
  subsection (1) if the bank holding company acquires control of, or
  acquires or increases a substantial investment in, an entity solely as
  the result of an event not within the control of the bank holding
  company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application of subsection (2)

  [(4.1)]{.lawlabel} No bank holding company shall, under subsection
  (2), acquire control of, or acquire or increase a substantial
  investment in, an entity referred to in paragraph 930(1)(j).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Holding

  [(4.2)]{.lawlabel} If a bank holding company holds a substantial
  investment in an entity referred to in paragraph 930(1)(j) that it
  acquired or increased under subsection (2) before the coming into
  force of subsection (4.1), the bank holding company may continue to
  hold that substantial investment.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application of other provision

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Despite having acquired control of, or a substantial
  investment in, an entity under a particular provision of this Part, a
  bank holding company may continue to control the entity or hold the
  substantial investment in the entity as though it had made the
  acquisition under another provision of this Part so long as the
  conditions of that other provision are met.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Timing of deemed acquisition

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} If a bank holding company decides to exercise its
  right under subsection (5), the bank holding company is deemed to be
  acquiring the control or the substantial investment under the other
  provision.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, s. 121
- 2013, c. 40, s. 169
- 2018, c. 27, s. 144
:::

[Previous
Version](section-928-20131212.html "Link to previous version of section 928"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations re limits

**[[929]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-929 .sectionLabel}** The Governor in Council
may make regulations

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting the determination of the amount or value
  of loans, investments and interests for the purposes of this Division;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} respecting the loans and investments, and the maximum
  aggregate amount of all loans and investments, that may be made or
  acquired by a bank holding company and its prescribed subsidiaries to
  or in a person and any persons connected with that person;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} specifying the classes of persons who are connected
  with any person for the purposes of paragraph (b); and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} prescribing terms and conditions under which a bank
  holding company may acquire control of, or acquire or increase a
  substantial investment in, a specialized financing entity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

#### [Subsidiaries and Equity Investments]{.HTitleText3} {#h-22418 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Permitted investments

- **[[930]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-930
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (4) to (6), a
  bank holding company may acquire control of, or acquire or increase a
  substantial investment in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a bank;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a bank holding company;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate to which the [Trust and Loan
    Companies Act](/eng/acts/T-19.8) applies;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an association to which the [Cooperative Credit
    Associations Act](/eng/acts/C-41.01) applies;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} an insurance company or a fraternal benefit society
    incorporated or formed by or under the [Insurance Companies
    Act](/eng/acts/I-11.8);

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} an insurance holding company;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a trust, loan or insurance corporation incorporated
    or formed by or under an Act of the legislature of a province;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a cooperative credit society incorporated or
    formed, and regulated, by or under an Act of the legislature of a
    province;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is incorporated or formed by or
    under an Act of Parliament or of the legislature of a province and
    that is primarily engaged in dealing in securities; or

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is incorporated or formed, and
    regulated, otherwise than by or under an Act of Parliament or of the
    legislature of a province and that is primarily engaged outside
    Canada in a business that, if carried on in Canada, would be the
    business of banking, the business of a cooperative credit society,
    the business of insurance, the business of providing fiduciary
    services or the business of dealing in securities.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Permitted investments

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (3) to (6), a bank holding
  company may acquire control of, or acquire or increase a substantial
  investment in, an entity, other than an entity referred to in any of
  paragraphs (1)(a) to (j), whose business is limited to one or more of
  the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} engaging in any financial service activity that a
    bank is permitted to engage in under any of paragraphs 409(2)(a)
    to (d) or any other activity that a bank is permitted to engage in
    under section 410 or 411;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} acquiring or holding shares of, or ownership
    interests in, entities in which a bank holding company is permitted
    under this Division to hold or acquire;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} engaging in the provision of any services
    exclusively to any or all of the following, so long as the entity is
    providing those services to the bank holding company or any member
    of the bank holding company's group:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the bank holding company,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any member of the bank holding company's group,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any entity that is primarily engaged in the
      business of providing financial services,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} any permitted entity in which an entity referred
      to in subparagraph (iii) has a substantial investment, or

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed person, if it is doing so under
      prescribed terms and conditions, if any are prescribed;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} engaging in any activity that a bank is permitted
    to engage in, other than an activity referred to in paragraph (a) or
    (e), that relates to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the promotion, sale, delivery or distribution of
      a financial product or financial service that is provided by any
      member of the bank holding company's group, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if a significant portion of the business of the
      entity involves an activity referred to in subparagraph (i), the
      promotion, sale, delivery or distribution of a financial product
      or financial service that is provided by any other entity that is
      primarily engaged in the business of providing financial services;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} engaging in the activities referred to in the
    definition [[closed-end fund]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[mutual fund
    distribution entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[mutual fund
    entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} or [[real property brokerage
    entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection 464(1); and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} engaging in prescribed activities, under prescribed
    terms and conditions, if any are prescribed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company may not acquire control of, or
  acquire or increase a substantial investment in, an entity whose
  business includes any activity referred to in any of paragraphs (2)(a)
  to (e) if the entity engages in the business of accepting deposit
  liabilities or if the activities of the entity include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} activities that a bank is not permitted to engage
    in under any of sections 412, 417 and 418;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} dealing in securities, except as may be permitted
    under paragraph (2)(e) or as may be permitted to a bank under
    paragraph 409(2)(c);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} activities that a bank is not permitted to engage
    in under section 416 if the entity engages in the activities of a
    finance entity or of any other entity as may be prescribed;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} acquiring control of or acquiring or holding a
    substantial investment in another entity unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an entity that is controlled by
      the bank holding company, a bank would be permitted under Part IX
      to acquire a substantial investment in the other entity, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an entity that is not controlled
      by the bank holding company, a bank would be permitted to acquire
      a substantial investment in the other entity under subsection
      466(2), paragraph 466(3)(b) or (c) or subsection 466(4) or 468(1)
      or (2); or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed activity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraph (3)(a), a bank holding company
  may acquire control of, or acquire or increase a substantial
  investment in, any entity that acts as a trustee for a trust if the
  entity has been permitted under the laws of a province to act as a
  trustee for a trust and the following conditions are satisfied:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the entity acts as a trustee only with respect to a
    closed-end fund or mutual fund entity; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the entity engages in other business, that
    business is limited to engaging in one or more of the following:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the activities of a mutual fund distribution
      entity,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any activity that a bank is permitted to engage
      in under paragraph 410(1)(c.2), and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the provision of investment counselling
      services and portfolio management services.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Control

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (8) and the regulations, a bank
  holding company may not acquire control of, or acquire or increase a
  substantial investment in,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an entity referred to in paragraph (1)(a) or (b),
    unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the bank holding company controls, within the
      meaning of paragraphs 3(1)(a) and (d), the entity or would thereby
      acquire control, within the meaning of those paragraphs, of the
      entity, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the bank holding company is permitted by
      regulations made under paragraph 936(a) to acquire or increase the
      substantial investment;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an entity referred to in any of paragraphs (1)(c)
    to (j), unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the bank holding company controls, within the
      meaning of paragraph 3(1)(d), the entity, or would thereby acquire
      control, within the meaning of that paragraph, of the entity, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the bank holding company is permitted by
      regulations made under paragraph 936(a) to acquire or increase the
      substantial investment;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an entity whose business includes one or more of
    the activities referred to in paragraph (2)(a) and that engages, as
    part of its business, in any financial intermediary activity that
    exposes the entity to material market or credit risk, including a
    finance entity, a factoring entity and a financial leasing entity,
    unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the bank holding company controls, within the
      meaning of paragraph 3(1)(d), the entity, or would thereby acquire
      control, within the meaning of that paragraph, of the entity, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the bank holding company is permitted by
      regulations made under paragraph 936(a) to acquire or increase the
      substantial investment; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an entity whose business includes an activity
    referred to in paragraph (2)(b), including a specialized financing
    entity, unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the bank holding company controls, within the
      meaning of paragraph 3(1)(d), the entity, or would thereby acquire
      control, within the meaning of that paragraph, of the entity,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the bank holding company is permitted by
      regulations made under paragraph 936(a) to acquire or increase the
      substantial investment, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} subject to prescribed terms and conditions, if
      any are prescribed, the activities of the entity do not include
      the acquisition or holding of control of, or the acquisition or
      holding of shares or other ownership interests in, an entity
      referred to in any of paragraphs (a) to (c) or an entity that is
      not a permitted entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Minister's approval

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the regulations, a bank holding company
  may not, without the prior written approval of the Minister,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} acquire control of an entity referred to in
    paragraphs (1)(g) to (i) from a person who is not a member of the
    bank holding company's group;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} acquire control of an entity referred to in
    paragraph (1)(j) or (4)(c), other than an entity whose activities
    are limited to the activities of one or more of the following
    entities, if the control is acquired from an entity referred to in
    any of paragraphs (1)(a) to (f) that is not a member of the bank
    holding company's group:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a factoring entity, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a financial leasing entity;

  - [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} acquire control of an entity referred to in
    paragraph (1)(j) if the bank holding company is a bank holding
    company with equity of two billion dollars or more and

    ::: {#22485 .Paragraph}
    A + B \> C

    where

    [A]{.dfn}
    :   is the value of the entity's consolidated assets, as it would
        have been reported in the entity's annual financial statements
        if those statements had been prepared immediately before the
        acquisition,

    [B]{.dfn}
    :   is the aggregate of the values of the consolidated assets of all
        other entities referred to in paragraph (1)(j) that the bank
        holding company has acquired control of within the preceding 12
        months, as the value for each entity would have been reported in
        its annual financial statements if those statements had been
        prepared immediately before the acquisition of control of that
        entity, and

    [C]{.dfn}
    :   is 10% of the value of the bank holding company's consolidated
        assets, as shown in the bank holding company's last annual
        statement that was prepared before its first acquisition of
        control of an entity referred to in paragraph (1)(j) within the
        preceding 12 months;
    :::

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} acquire control of, or acquire or increase a
    substantial investment in, an entity whose business includes one or
    more of the activities referred to in paragraph (2)(d);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} acquire control of, or acquire or increase a
    substantial investment in, an entity that engages in Canada in an
    activity described in paragraph 410(1)(c);

  - [(d.1)]{.lawlabel} acquire control of, or acquire or increase a
    substantial investment in, an entity that engages in an activity
    described in paragraph 410(1)(c.1); or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} acquire control of, or acquire or increase a
    substantial investment in, an entity engaging in an activity
    prescribed for the purposes of paragraph (2)(f).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Matters for consideration

  [(5.1)]{.lawlabel} In addition to any matters or conditions provided
  for in this Act that are relevant to the granting of an approval, the
  Minister may, in considering whether to grant the approval under
  paragraph (5)(b.1), take into account all matters that he or she
  considers relevant in the circumstances, including

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the stability of the financial system in Canada;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the best interests of the financial system in
    Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Superintendent's approval

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (7) and the regulations, a bank
  holding company may not acquire control of, or acquire or increase a
  substantial investment in, an entity referred to in any of paragraphs
  (1)(g) to (j) and (4)(c) and (d) unless the bank holding company
  obtains the approval of the Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (6) does not apply in respect of a
  particular transaction if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bank holding company is acquiring control of an
    entity, other than a specialized financing entity, and the only
    reason for which the bank holding company would, but for this
    subsection, require approval for the acquisition is that the entity
    carries on activities referred to in paragraph (2)(b);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bank holding company is acquiring control of an
    entity whose activities are limited to the activities of a factoring
    entity or a financial leasing entity;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has approved the transaction under
    subsection (5) or is deemed to have approved it under subsection
    931(1);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsection (7.1), the bank holding
    company is acquiring control of an entity (referred to in this
    paragraph as the "target entity") referred to in paragraph (4)(c)
    or (d) and

    ::: {#22506 .Paragraph}
    A/B \< C

    where

    [A]{.dfn}
    :   is the aggregate of the values, as they would have been reported
        in the bank holding company's annual financial statements if
        those statements were prepared on the day of the acquisition of
        control of the target entity, of
        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the target entity's consolidated assets,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the assets of the bank holding company and
          of any subsidiary of the bank holding company that were
          acquired, at any time within the 12 months preceding the
          acquisition of control of the target entity, from any entity
          that, at that time, held any of the assets referred to in
          subparagraph (i), and

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the consolidated assets of any entity
          referred to in paragraph 4(c) or (d) the control of which is
          acquired by the bank holding company at the same time as the
          acquisition of control of the target entity --- or within the
          12 months preceding the acquisition of control of the target
          entity if, at any time within those 12 months, that entity and
          the target entity were affiliates --- excluding any assets
          referred to in subparagraph (i) or (ii) and the consolidated
          assets of an entity in respect of which no approval of the
          Superintendent is required under any of paragraphs (a) to (c),

    [B]{.dfn}
    :   is the value of the bank holding company's consolidated assets,
        as shown in its last annual statement prepared before the
        acquisition of control of the target entity, and

    [C]{.dfn}
    :   is
        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} 0.01, in the case of a bank holding company
          with equity of 12 billion dollars or more, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} 0.02, in the case of any other bank holding
          company; or
    :::

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the bank holding company is acquiring or increasing
    a substantial investment in an entity (referred to in this paragraph
    as the "target entity") without acquiring control of it, and

    ::: {#22517 .Paragraph}
    A/B \< C

    where

    [A]{.dfn}
    :   is the aggregate of the values, as they would have been reported
        in the bank holding company's annual financial statements if
        those statements were prepared on the day of the acquisition or
        increase of the substantial investment in the target entity, of
        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the shares of, or other ownership interests
          in, the target entity that the bank holding company or a
          subsidiary of the bank holding company is acquiring in the
          transaction that results in the acquisition or increase of a
          substantial investment in the target entity, and the shares
          of, or other ownership interests in, the target entity that
          are held by an entity the control of which the bank holding
          company is acquiring in the transaction that results in the
          acquisition or increase of a substantial investment in the
          target entity,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the shares of, or other ownership interests
          in, the target entity that are held by the bank holding
          company or a subsidiary of the bank holding company and that
          were acquired by the bank holding company or the subsidiary
          within the 12 months preceding the transaction referred to in
          subparagraph (i), and

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the shares of, or other ownership interests
          in, the target entity that are held by a subsidiary of the
          bank holding company the control of which was acquired by the
          bank holding company within the 12 months preceding the
          transaction referred to in subparagraph (i), excluding any
          shares or other ownership interests referred to in
          subparagraph (ii),

    [B]{.dfn}
    :   is the value of the bank holding company's consolidated assets,
        as shown in its last annual statement prepared before the
        transaction that results in the acquisition or increase of the
        substantial investment in the target entity, and

    [C]{.dfn}
    :   is
        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} 0.005, in the case of a bank holding company
          with equity of 12 billion dollars or more, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} 0.01, in the case of any other bank holding
          company.
    :::

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No exception for deemed acquisition

  [(7.1)]{.lawlabel} The exception in paragraph (7)(d) does not apply
  with respect to a deemed acquisition of control under subsection
  928(6).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Control not required

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company need not control an entity
  referred to in paragraph (1)(j), or an entity that is incorporated or
  formed otherwise than by or under an Act of Parliament or of the
  legislature of a province, if the laws or customary business practices
  of the country under the laws of which the entity was incorporated or
  formed do not permit the bank holding company to control the entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Giving up control prohibited

  [(9)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company that controls, within the
  meaning of paragraphs 3(1)(a) and (d), an entity referred to in
  paragraph (1)(a) or (b) may not give up control, within the meaning of
  paragraph 3(1)(a) or (d), of the entity while continuing to control,
  within the meaning of the other paragraph, the entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition on giving up control in
  fact

  [(10)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company that, under paragraph
  (4)(b), (c) or (d), controls an entity may not, without the prior
  written approval of the Minister, give up control, within the meaning
  of paragraph 3(1)(d), of the entity while it continues to control the
  entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Giving up control

  [(11)]{.lawlabel} A bank holding company that, under subsection (4),
  controls an entity may, with the prior written approval of the
  Superintendent, give up control of the entity while keeping a
  substantial investment in the entity if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bank holding company is permitted to do so by
    regulations made under paragraph 936(c); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the entity meets the conditions referred to in
    subparagraph (4)(d)(iii).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subsections do not apply

  [(12)]{.lawlabel} If a bank holding company controls, within the
  meaning of paragraph 3(1)(a), (b) or (c), an entity, subsections (5)
  and (6) do not apply in respect of any subsequent increases by the
  bank holding company of its substantial investment in the entity so
  long as the bank holding company continues to control the entity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
- 2007, c. 6, ss. 122, 134(F)
- 2012, c. 5, s. 101
- 2018, c. 27, s. 132
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Approval for indirect investments

- **[[931]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-931 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  bank holding company obtains the approval of the Minister under
  subsection 930(5) to acquire control of, or to acquire or increase a
  substantial investment in, an entity and, through that acquisition or
  increase, the bank holding company indirectly acquires control of, or
  acquires or increases a substantial investment in, another entity that
  would require the approval of the Minister under subsection 930(5) or
  the Superintendent under subsection 930(6) and that indirect
  acquisition or increase is disclosed to the Minister in writing before
  the approval is obtained, the bank holding company is deemed to have
  obtained the approval of the Minister or the Superintendent for that
  indirect acquisition or increase.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Approval for indirect investments

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a bank holding company obtains the approval of the
  Superintendent under subsection 930(6) to acquire control of, or to
  acquire or increase a substantial investment in, an entity and,
  through that acquisition or increase the bank holding company
  indirectly acquires control of, or acquires or increases a substantial
  investment in, another entity that would require the approval of the
  Superintendent under that subsection and that indirect acquisition or
  increase is disclosed to the Superintendent in writing before the
  approval is obtained, the bank holding company is deemed to have
  obtained the approval of the Superintendent for that indirect
  acquisition or increase.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Undertakings

- **[[932]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-932 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  bank holding company controls a permitted entity, other than an entity
  referred to in any of paragraphs 930(1)(a) to (f), the bank holding
  company shall provide the Superintendent with any undertakings that
  the Superintendent may require regarding

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the activities of the entity; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} access to information about the entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Undertakings

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a bank holding company acquires control of an
  entity referred to in any of paragraphs 930(1)(g) to (j), the bank
  holding company shall provide the Superintendent with any undertakings
  concerning the entity that the Superintendent may require.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agreements with other jurisdictions

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may enter into an agreement with
  the appropriate official or public body responsible for the
  supervision of any entity referred to in any of paragraphs 930(1)(g)
  to (j) in each province or in any other jurisdiction concerning any
  matters referred to in paragraphs (1)(a) and (b) or any other matter
  the Superintendent considers appropriate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Access to records

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite any other provision of this Division, a bank
  holding company shall not control a permitted entity, other than an
  entity referred to in any of paragraphs 930(1)(a) to (f), unless, in
  the course of the acquisition of control or within a reasonable time
  after the control is acquired, the bank holding company obtains from
  the permitted entity an undertaking to provide the Superintendent with
  reasonable access to the records of the permitted entity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 183
:::

#### [Exceptions and Exclusions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-22563 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Temporary investments in entity

- **[[933]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-933
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), a bank
  holding company may, by way of a temporary investment, acquire control
  of, or acquire or increase a substantial investment in, an entity but,
  within two years, or any other period that may be specified or
  approved by the Superintendent, after acquiring control or after
