    - ###### Networking {#networking-1 .MarginalNote}

      - [543]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to sections 540, 546
        and 549 and the regulations, an authorized foreign bank may, in
        Canada,

        - [(a)]{.lawlabel} act as agent for any person in respect of

          - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the carrying on of any activity referred to
            in subsection 410(1) or 539(1) that is engaged in by a
            financial institution, by an entity in which a bank is
            permitted to acquire a substantial investment under section
            468, if that section were read without reference to the
            requirements of subsections 468(4) to (6), or by a Canadian
            entity acquired or held under section 522.08, or

          - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the provision of any service that relates
            to financial services and that is provided by an institution
            or entity referred to in subparagraph (i);

        - [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} enter into an arrangement with any person
          in respect of the carrying on of an activity referred to in
          subparagraph (a)(i) or the provision of a service referred to
          in subparagraph (a)(ii); and

        - [(b)]{.lawlabel} refer any person to another person.

      - ###### Regulations {#regulations-6 .MarginalNote}

        [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

        - [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting the disclosure of the name of the
          person for whom an authorized foreign bank is acting as agent
          under subsection (1);

        - [(b)]{.lawlabel} respecting the disclosure of any commission
          being earned by an authorized foreign bank when acting as
          agent under subsection (1);

        - [(c)]{.lawlabel} respecting the circumstances in which an
          authorized foreign bank may act as an agent, enter into an
          arrangement or refer a person under subsection (1); and

        - [(d)]{.lawlabel} imposing terms and conditions in respect of
          the carrying on of activities under that subsection.

    - ###### Regulations {#regulations-7 .MarginalNote}

      [543.1]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may, for the purposes
      of section 538 and subsection 543(1), make regulations respecting
      what an authorized foreign bank is prohibited from doing when
      acting as an agent or when making referrals.
    :::
    ::::

        regulations made under paragraphs (2.2)(a) and (b), a bank
        holding company may acquire control of, or acquire or increase a
        substantial investment in, an entity that a bank may acquire
        control of, or acquire or increase a substantial investment in,
        under subsection 468(2.1).

      - ###### Regulations {#regulations-8 .MarginalNote}

        [(2.2)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

        - [(a)]{.lawlabel} imposing terms and conditions in respect of

          company may acquire control of, or acquire or increase a
          substantial investment in, under subsection (2.1); and

        - [(b)]{.lawlabel} respecting the circumstances in which a bank
          holding company may acquire control of, or acquire or increase

    - [(4)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph 930(7)(a) of the Act is replaced by the

- --- 2024, c. 15, s. 188

  - - [188]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subsection 136(1) of the French
      version of the [Bank Act](/eng/acts/B-1.01) is replaced by the
      following:

      :::: section
      ::: {.AmendedText lang="fr"}
      - ###### Lieu des assemblées {#lieu-des-assemblées .MarginalNote}

        - [136]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} Les assemblées des
          actionnaires ou des membres se tiennent au Canada, au lieu que
          prévoient les règlements administratifs ou, à défaut, que
          choisissent les administrateurs.
      :::
      ::::

    - [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection 136(2) of the Act is replaced by the
      following:

      :::: section
      ::: AmendedText
      - ###### Participation by electronic means {#participation-by-electronic-means .MarginalNote}

        [(2)]{.lawlabel} Unless the by-laws provide otherwise and in
        accordance with any regulations, any person who is entitled to
        attend a meeting of shareholders or members may participate in
        the meeting by means of a telephonic, electronic or other
        communication facility that permits all participants to
        communicate adequately with each other during the meeting if the
        bank makes one available. A person who is participating in a
        meeting by one of those means is deemed for the purposes of this
        Act to be present at the meeting.

      - ###### Meeting held by electronic means {#meeting-held-by-electronic-means .MarginalNote}

        [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} If the directors, shareholders or members of
        a bank call a meeting of shareholders or members under this Act,
        those directors, shareholders or members may determine that the
        meeting shall be held, in accordance with any regulations,
        entirely by means of a telephonic, electronic or other
        communication facility that permits all participants to
        communicate adequately with each other during the meeting, if
        the by-laws so provide.
      :::
      ::::

    following:

    - ###### Voting while participating electronically {#voting-while-participating-electronically .MarginalNote}

      [(4)]{.lawlabel} Unless the by-laws provide otherwise and in
      accordance with any regulations, any person who is participating
      in a meeting under subsection 136(2) or (2.1) and entitled to vote
      at that meeting may vote by means of the telephonic, electronic or
      other communication facility that the bank has made available for
      that purpose.
    :::
    ::::

      version of the Act is replaced by the following:

      :::: section

      - ###### Lieu des assemblées {#lieu-des-assemblées-1 .MarginalNote}

        - [725]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} Les assemblées des

      :::: section

      - ###### Participation by electronic means {#participation-by-electronic-means-1 .MarginalNote}

        [(2)]{.lawlabel} Unless the by-laws provide otherwise and in
        accordance with any regulations, any person who is entitled to
        attend a meeting of shareholders may participate in the meeting
        by means of a telephonic, electronic or other communication
        facility that permits all participants to communicate adequately
        with each other during the meeting if the bank holding company
        makes one available. A person who is participating in a meeting
        by one of those means is deemed for the purposes of this Part to

      - ###### Meeting held by electronic means {#meeting-held-by-electronic-means-1 .MarginalNote}

        [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} If the directors or shareholders of a bank

        shall be held, in accordance with any regulations, entirely by
        means of a telephonic, electronic or other communication

        with each other during the meeting, if the by-laws so provide.

    following:

    ::: AmendedText
    - ###### Voting while participating electronically {#voting-while-participating-electronically-1 .MarginalNote}

- --- 2024, c. 17, s. 398

  - [398]{.lawlabel} The [Bank Act](/eng/acts/B-1.01) is amended by
    adding the following after section 214:

    :::: section
    ::: AmendedText
    ##### [Disclosure Relating to Diversity]{.HTitleText3} {#disclosure-relating-to-diversity .SchedHeadL3}

    - ###### Diversity {#diversity .MarginalNote}

      - [214.1]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} The directors of a bank of a
        prescribed class must make available, in accordance with
        regulations made under subsection (2), information respecting
        diversity among directors and members of senior management, as
        defined by regulation, at the same time that a notice of annual
        meeting is sent under subsection 138(1) to shareholders or
        members entitled to receive that notice and to the
        Superintendent.

      - ###### Regulations {#regulations-10 .MarginalNote}

        [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), the
        Governor in Council may make regulations respecting the
        disclosure of information related to diversity among the
        directors and members of senior management of a bank of a
        prescribed class.
    :::
    ::::

- --- 2024, c. 17, s. 399

  - [399]{.lawlabel} The Act is amended by adding the following after
    section 801:

    :::: section
    ::: AmendedText
    ###### [Disclosure Relating to Diversity]{.HTitleText4} {#disclosure-relating-to-diversity-1 .SchedHeadL4}

    - ###### Diversity {#diversity-1 .MarginalNote}

      - [801.1]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} The directors of a bank
        holding company of a prescribed class must make available, in
        accordance with regulations made under subsection (2),
        information respecting diversity among directors and members of
        senior management, as defined by regulation, at the same time
        that a notice of annual meeting is sent under subsection 727(1)
        to shareholders entitled to receive that notice and to the
        Superintendent.

      - ###### Regulations {#regulations-11 .MarginalNote}

        disclosure of information related to diversity among the
        directors and members of senior management of a bank holding
        company of a prescribed class.
